// مترجم: پرداخت‌های منتظر تأیید (پایان‌یافته و تسویه‌نشده)
route('GET', '/api/translator/payments', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const rows = db.prepare("SELECT id, place, traveler_name, total, net, pay_method, pay_state, translator_confirmed FROM reservations WHERE translator_id = ? AND status = 'finished' AND (pay_state IS NULL OR pay_state NOT IN ('settled','refunded')) ORDER BY finished_at").all(u.id);
  const settlements = db.prepare("SELECT id, place, traveler_name, total, net, hours, pay_method, pay_state, translator_confirmed, traveler_paid, finished_at FROM reservations WHERE translator_id = ? AND status = 'done' AND pay_state = 'settled' ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 10").all(u.id);
  send(res, 200, {
    payments: rows.map((r) => ({ reservation_id: r.id, place: r.place, travelerName: r.traveler_name, total: r.total, net: r.net,
      pay_method: r.pay_method, pay_state: r.pay_state, confirmed: !!r.translator_confirmed })),
    settlements: settlements.map((r) => ({ reservation_id: r.id, place: r.place, travelerName: r.traveler_name, total: r.total, net: r.net,
      hours: r.hours, pay_method: r.pay_method, pay_state: r.pay_state, confirmed: !!r.translator_confirmed,
      traveler_paid: !!r.traveler_paid, finished_at: r.finished_at ? new Date(r.finished_at).toISOString() : null })),
    // بدهی نقدی فعال: تا تسویه، پیشنهاد جدید بسته است (گیت بدهی)
    debt: { amount: translatorDebt(u.id), blocked: translatorDebt(u.id) > 0 },
  });
});

// ---------- ثبت‌نام مترجم روی سرور (مراحل ۱ تا ۵) ----------
// پس از ثبت، پرونده فقط «در انتظار بررسی نهایی» می‌شود؛ هیچ فعال‌سازی خودکاری نیست (سند ۷.۳).
// زبان‌ها و زمینه‌ها همان مقادیری هستند که تطبیق استفاده می‌کند.
const REG_DONE = new Set(['active_general', 'active_specialized']);
const REG_CLOSED = new Set(['rejected', 'suspended', 'deleted']);
// زبان‌های ثبت‌نام همان فهرست زبان‌های جفت‌زبان‌های مدیر است (LANG_CODES) تا زبان‌های
// فعال در تطبیق (ترکی، فرانسه، روسی، چینی) دقیقاً همان‌ها در ثبت‌نام هم موجود باشند (یافتهٔ ۵).
const REG_LANGS = LANG_CODES;
const REG_FIELDS = ['tourism', 'pilgrimage', 'medical', 'business', 'legal'];
const clip = (v, max) => String(v || '').trim().slice(0, max);
const pick = (arr, allowed) => [...new Set((Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : []).filter((x) => allowed.includes(x)))];

route('POST', '/api/translator/registration', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  const b = await readJson(req);
  if (!requireFeature(res, 'translator_registration')) return;
  const cityRes = resolveCity(b.city_id, 'translator');
  if (cityRes.error) return send(res, cityRes.status, { error: cityRes.error });
  if (b.nda !== true || b.charter !== true) return send(res, 400, { error: 'consent_required' });
  if (b.gender !== 'male' && b.gender !== 'female') return send(res, 400, { error: 'gender_required' });
  const first = clip(b.first_name, 60), last = clip(b.last_name, 60);
  if (!first || !last) return send(res, 400, { error: 'name_required' });
  const langs = pick(b.languages, REG_LANGS);
  if (langs.length < 1) return send(res, 400, { error: 'languages_required' });
  // حوزه‌ها: مقادیر قدیمی (general) به تکسونومی تازه نگاشت می‌شوند؛ حداقل یک حوزه الزامی است
  const fields = pick((Array.isArray(b.fields) ? b.fields : []).map((x) => FIELD_ALIAS[x] || x), REG_FIELDS);
  if (fields.length < 1) return send(res, 400, { error: 'fields_required' });
  const postal = String(b.postal_code == null ? '' : b.postal_code).replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
  if (postal && postal.length !== 10) return send(res, 400, { error: 'postal_code_invalid' });
  // فیلدهای هویتی فرم ثبت‌نام (کد ملی، تاریخ تولد، شبا) اکنون دریافت و ذخیره می‌شوند؛
  // فرم سمت کلاینت این‌ها را الزامی می‌داند ولی تا پیش از این هرگز به سرور نمی‌رسیدند (یافتهٔ ۴).
  // اختیاری نگه داشته می‌شوند تا نشست‌های قدیمی/آزمون‌ها نشکنند؛ کلاینت ارسالشان را الزامی می‌کند.
  const faDigits = (s) => String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(d)));
  const nationalCode = faDigits(b.national_code).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (nationalCode && nationalCode.length !== 10) return send(res, 400, { error: 'national_code_invalid' });
  const birthDate = clip(b.birth_date, 20);
  const iban = faDigits(b.iban).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (iban && iban.length !== 24) return send(res, 400, { error: 'iban_invalid' });
  const profile = JSON.stringify({
    first_name: first, last_name: last, city: cityRes.city.name_fa, postal_code: postal || null,
    national_code: nationalCode || null, birth_date: birthDate || null, iban: iban || null,
    car: b.car === true, car_model: clip(b.car_model, 60),
    car_capacity: Math.min(Math.max(Math.trunc(Number(b.car_capacity)) || 0, 0), 8) || null,
    interview_at: clip(b.interview_at, 40),
    charter_at: now(), nda_at: now(),
  });
  const cur = db.prepare('SELECT status FROM translators WHERE user_id = ?').get(u.id);
  if (cur && REG_CLOSED.has(cur.status)) return send(res, 409, { error: 'registration_closed', status: cur.status });
  const next = !cur || cur.status === 'registered' || cur.status === 'in_progress' ? 'pending_review' : cur.status;
  db.prepare(`INSERT INTO translators (user_id, status, gender, profile, langs, fields, updated_at, city_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
              ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET status = excluded.status, gender = excluded.gender, profile = excluded.profile,
                langs = excluded.langs, fields = excluded.fields, updated_at = excluded.updated_at,
                city_id = CASE WHEN translators.status LIKE 'active_%' THEN translators.city_id ELSE excluded.city_id END`)
    .run(u.id, next, b.gender, profile, JSON.stringify(langs), JSON.stringify(fields), now(), cityRes.city.id);
  send(res, 200, { status: next, languages: langs, fields });
});

// تکمیل اختیاری حوزه‌ها پس از ورود به میز کار (از نمای «وضعیت مدارک و صلاحیت»):
// مترجم فعال هر زمان می‌تواند فهرست حوزه‌هایش را کامل کند؛ پایه‌ها بلافاصله باز می‌شوند،
// تخصصی‌ها با همان گیت (مدرک زبان تأییدشده). هیچ مانعی برای میز کار ایجاد نمی‌کند.
route('PATCH', '/api/translator/fields', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  const b = await readJson(req);
  const t = db.prepare('SELECT status, interview FROM translators WHERE user_id = ?').get(u.id);
  if (!t) return send(res, 409, { error: 'registration_required' });
  if (!REG_DONE.has(t.status)) return send(res, 409, { error: 'not_active', status: t.status });
  const fields = pick((Array.isArray(b.fields) ? b.fields : []).map((x) => FIELD_ALIAS[x] || x), REG_FIELDS);
  if (fields.length < 1) return send(res, 400, { error: 'fields_required' });
  db.prepare('UPDATE translators SET fields = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE user_id = ?').run(JSON.stringify(fields), now(), u.id);
  const cert = langCertOk({ user_id: u.id });
  // وضعیت مؤثر به‌روز می‌ماند: با مدرک زبانِ تأییدشده، فعالِ تخصصی
  if (t.interview === 'pass' && cert && t.status === 'active_general') {
    db.prepare("UPDATE translators SET status = 'active_specialized', updated_at = ? WHERE user_id = ?").run(now(), u.id);
  }
  send(res, 200, { ok: true, fields, unlocked: fields.filter((f) => BASE_FIELDS.has(f) || cert),
    locked: fields.filter((f) => SPEC_FIELDS.has(f) && !cert) });
});

// ---------- مدارک مترجم (رمزنگاری‌شده، سند ۴.۲ و ۶.۱) ----------
// فایل‌ها با AES-256-GCM رمز می‌شوند؛ کلید از HZ_DOC_KEY خوانده می‌شود.
// مترجم فقط وضعیت را می‌بیند؛ محتوا فقط برای تیم احراز (ادمین) باز می‌شود.
const DOC_KINDS = new Set(['nid_card', 'selfie', 'portrait', 'address_proof', 'criminal_record', 'drug_free',
  'ipd_permit', 'cip_permit', 'specialty_cert', 'lang_cert', 'car_docs', 'licence']);
// مدرک زبان (lang_cert) گیت حوزه‌های تخصصی است؛ گواهی تخصصی هر حوزه (specialty_cert:<field>) صرفاً مکمل پرونده است
const DOC_MIMES = { 'image/jpeg': 'jpg', 'image/png': 'png', 'application/pdf': 'pdf' };
const DOC_MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const DOC_EXPIRING = new Set(['car_docs', 'licence', 'ipd_permit', 'criminal_record']);
const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
// پایان روز تاریخ انقضا به وقت تهران (+03:30)
const expiryEnd = (d) => { const t = Date.parse(`${d}T23:59:59+03:30`); return Number.isNaN(t) ? null : t; };
const DOC_KEY = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(process.env.HZ_DOC_KEY || 'hz-dev-only-doc-key').digest();
if (!process.env.HZ_DOC_KEY) {
  if (!DEV) { console.error('خطا: HZ_DOC_KEY برای اجرای غیرتوسعه لازم است.'); process.exit(1); }
  console.log('هشدار: HZ_DOC_KEY تنظیم نشده؛ کلید توسعه استفاده می‌شود.');
}
// امضای فایل: محتوای واقعی باید با نوع اعلام‌شده یکی باشد
const DOC_SIGNATURES = { jpg: [[0xff, 0xd8, 0xff]], png: [[0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47]], pdf: [[0x25, 0x50, 0x44, 0x46]] };
const sigOk = (buf, ext) => (DOC_SIGNATURES[ext] || []).some((sig) => sig.every((b, i) => buf[i] === b));
const encryptDoc = (buf) => {
  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(12);
  const c = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', DOC_KEY, iv);
  const enc = Buffer.concat([c.update(buf), c.final()]);
  return Buffer.concat([iv, c.getAuthTag(), enc]);
};
const decryptDoc = (blob) => {
  const d = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', DOC_KEY, blob.subarray(0, 12));
  d.setAuthTag(blob.subarray(12, 28));
  return Buffer.concat([d.update(blob.subarray(28)), d.final()]);
};

route('POST', '/api/translator/documents', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (Number(req.headers['content-length'] || 0) > DOC_MAX_BYTES * 1.4) return send(res, 413, { error: 'file_too_large' });
  const b = await readJson(req, DOC_MAX_BYTES * 1.4);
  if (!DOC_KINDS.has(b.kind) && !/^specialty_cert:(general|medical|legal|business)$/.test(String(b.kind))) return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_kind' });
  const m = /^data:([a-z\/+]+);base64,(.+)$/i.exec(String(b.data || ''));
  if (!m || !DOC_MIMES[m[1].toLowerCase()]) return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_file_type' });
  const raw = Buffer.from(m[2], 'base64');
  if (!raw.length) return send(res, 400, { error: 'empty_file' });
  if (raw.length > DOC_MAX_BYTES) return send(res, 413, { error: 'file_too_large' });
  if (!sigOk(raw, DOC_MIMES[m[1].toLowerCase()])) return send(res, 400, { error: 'file_content_mismatch' });
  let expires = null;
  if (DOC_EXPIRING.has(b.kind)) {
    expires = expiryEnd(String(b.expires_at || '').trim());
    if (expires === null) return send(res, 400, { error: 'expiry_required' });
    if (expires < now()) return send(res, 400, { error: 'expiry_in_past' });
  }
  const t = db.prepare('SELECT status FROM translators WHERE user_id = ?').get(u.id);
  if (!t) return send(res, 409, { error: 'registration_required' });
  if (REG_CLOSED.has(t.status)) return send(res, 409, { error: 'registration_closed', status: t.status });
  const ts = now();
  db.prepare("DELETE FROM translator_documents WHERE user_id = ? AND kind = ? AND status IN ('uploaded', 'rejected')").run(u.id, b.kind);
  db.prepare(`INSERT INTO translator_documents (user_id, kind, status, mime, size, blob, expires_at, created_at, updated_at)
              VALUES (?, ?, 'uploaded', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`).run(u.id, b.kind, m[1].toLowerCase(), raw.length, encryptDoc(raw), expires, ts, ts);
  send(res, 200, { ok: true, kind: b.kind, status: 'uploaded' });
});

route('GET', '/api/translator/documents', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  const rows = db.prepare(`SELECT id, kind, status, size, reject_reason, expires_at, updated_at FROM translator_documents
    WHERE user_id = ? AND status != 'superseded' ORDER BY kind`).all(u.id);
  const t = now();
  send(res, 200, { documents: rows.map((r) => ({ kind: r.kind, status: r.status, size: r.size,
    reject_reason: r.reject_reason || '', updated_at: new Date(r.updated_at).toISOString(),
    expires_at: r.expires_at ? new Date(r.expires_at).toISOString() : null,
    expired: !!r.expires_at && r.expires_at < t,
    expiring_soon: !!r.expires_at && r.expires_at >= t && r.expires_at - t <= 30 * DAY_MS })) });
});

// ---------- تنظیم پذیرش جنسیت مسافر ----------
route('GET', '/api/translator/preferences', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const t = db.prepare('SELECT traveler_gender_pref FROM translators WHERE user_id = ?').get(u.id);
  const preference = t && TRAVELER_GENDER_PREF.has(t.traveler_gender_pref) ? t.traveler_gender_pref : 'any';
  send(res, 200, { traveler_gender_pref: preference });
});

route('PATCH', '/api/translator/preferences', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const b = await readJson(req);
  if (!b || !TRAVELER_GENDER_PREF.has(b.traveler_gender_pref)) return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_traveler_gender_pref' });
  const acceptsAny = b.traveler_gender_pref === 'any' ? 1 : 0;
  db.prepare('UPDATE translators SET traveler_gender_pref = ?, accept_any = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE user_id = ?')
    .run(b.traveler_gender_pref, acceptsAny, now(), u.id);
  // Re-run matching for waiting requests; already-issued offers remain unchanged.
  sweep();
  send(res, 200, { ok: true, traveler_gender_pref: b.traveler_gender_pref });
});

// ---------- پروفایل مترجم (نمایش + ویرایش مجاز) ----------
// هویت (نام/کد ملی) از پروندهٔ احراز می‌آید و اینجا فقط‌خواندنی است؛
// ویرایش پذیر: جنسیت و شهر. بقیهٔ ترجیحات مسیر خودش را دارد (preferences).
route('GET', '/api/translator/profile', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  const t = db.prepare(`SELECT t.gender, t.city_id, t.langs, t.status, t.profile, t.share_loc, t.loc_at, c.name_fa AS city_name
    FROM translators t LEFT JOIN cities c ON c.id = t.city_id WHERE t.user_id = ?`).get(u.id);
  if (!t) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  const pr = (() => { try { return JSON.parse(t.profile || '{}'); } catch (e) { return {}; } })();
  send(res, 200, {
    phone: u.phone,
    first_name: pr.first_name || '', last_name: pr.last_name || '',
    national_code: pr.national_code || '', birth_date: pr.birth_date || '',
    gender: ['male', 'female'].includes(t.gender) ? t.gender : null,
    city_id: t.city_id || null, city_name: t.city_name || null,
    langs: JSON.parse(t.langs || '[]'),
    location: { sharing: t.share_loc === 1, at: t.loc_at ? new Date(t.loc_at).toISOString() : null },
    status: t.status,
  });
});
route('PATCH', '/api/translator/profile', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  const b = await readJson(req);
  const t = db.prepare('SELECT status FROM translators WHERE user_id = ?').get(u.id);
  if (!t) return send(res, 409, { error: 'registration_required' });
  const sets = [], args = [];
  if ('gender' in b) {
    if (!['male', 'female'].includes(b.gender)) return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_gender' });
    sets.push('gender = ?'); args.push(b.gender);
  }
  if ('city_id' in b) {
    const city = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM cities WHERE id = ? AND translator_enabled = 1').get(Number(b.city_id) || 0);
    if (!city) return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_city' });
    sets.push('city_id = ?'); args.push(city.id);
  }
  if (!sets.length) return send(res, 400, { error: 'nothing_to_update' });
  sets.push('updated_at = ?'); args.push(now(), u.id);
  db.prepare('UPDATE translators SET ' + sets.join(', ') + ' WHERE user_id = ?').run(...args);
  audit('translator.profile_update', { user_id: u.id, keys: Object.keys(b) });
  send(res, 200, { ok: true });
});

// ---------- موقعیت مکانی اختیاری مترجم ----------
// فقط با اجازهٔ مترجم (share_loc) ذخیره می‌شود؛ برای تطبیق شعاعی و نقشهٔ زندهٔ پنل. آخرین نقطه نگه داشته می‌شود.
route('POST', '/api/translator/location', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  const b = await readJson(req);
  const lat = Number(b.lat), lng = Number(b.lng);
  if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || !Number.isFinite(lng) || Math.abs(lat) > 90 || Math.abs(lng) > 180) {
    return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_coordinates' });
  }
  if ('sharing' in b && typeof b.sharing !== 'boolean') return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_sharing' });
  const sharing = 'sharing' in b ? (b.sharing ? 1 : 0) : 1;
  db.prepare('UPDATE translators SET lat = ?, lng = ?, loc_at = ?, share_loc = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE user_id = ?')
    .run(lat, lng, now(), sharing, now(), u.id);
  send(res, 200, { ok: true, sharing: !!sharing });
});

// قابلیت خودرو (CAP — قاعدهٔ ۲ و ۴): ثبت/به‌روزرسانی بعدی خودرو از کارت صلاحیت، هر زمان مترجم خواست.
// انتخاب خودرو هیچ مانعی برای میز کار نیست؛ فقط تا تأیید بیمه (car_docs) و گواهینامه (licence)
// رزرو سواره برای او پیشنهاد نمی‌شود و همان حالت «فقط پیاده» می‌ماند.
route('PATCH', '/api/translator/vehicle', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  const b = await readJson(req);
  const t = db.prepare('SELECT status, profile FROM translators WHERE user_id = ?').get(u.id);
  if (!t) return send(res, 409, { error: 'registration_required' });
  if (!REG_DONE.has(t.status)) return send(res, 409, { error: 'not_active', status: t.status });
  const on = b.car === true;
  const model = clip(b.car_model, 60);
  const capacity = Math.min(Math.max(Math.trunc(Number(b.car_capacity)) || 0, 0), 8) || null;
  if (on && (!model || !capacity || capacity < 1)) return send(res, 400, { error: 'car_details_required' });
  const p = JSON.parse(t.profile || '{}');
  p.car = on;
  p.car_model = on ? model : '';
  p.car_capacity = on ? capacity : null;
  db.prepare('UPDATE translators SET profile = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE user_id = ?').run(JSON.stringify(p), now(), u.id);
  audit('translator.vehicle', { id: u.id, car: on });
  send(res, 200, { ok: true, car: on, car_ready: carReady({ user_id: u.id, profile: JSON.stringify(p) }, 1) });
});

// ---------- مترجم: پیشنهادها و آنلاین ----------
// Read effective presence without changing matching, score or profile data.
route('GET', '/api/translator/online', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const t = db.prepare('SELECT online FROM translators WHERE user_id = ?').get(u.id);
  const enabled = featureOn('translator_online');
  send(res, 200, { online: enabled && !!(t && t.online), enabled });
});

route('PATCH', '/api/translator/online', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const b = await readJson(req);
  if (!b || typeof b.online !== 'boolean') return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_online' });
  if (b.online === true && !requireFeature(res, 'translator_online')) return;
  const g = b.gender === 'male' || b.gender === 'female' ? b.gender : null;
  db.prepare(`UPDATE translators SET online = ?, updated_at = ?,
      gender = COALESCE(?, gender), accept_any = COALESCE(?, accept_any) WHERE user_id = ?`)
    .run(b.online ? 1 : 0, now(), g, typeof b.accept_any === 'boolean' ? (b.accept_any ? 1 : 0) : null, u.id);
  if (b.online) sweep();
  send(res, 200, { online: !!b.online });
});

route('GET', '/api/translator/offers', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  sweep();
  const t = db.prepare('SELECT online FROM translators WHERE user_id = ?').get(u.id);
  const serverTime = now();
  const rows = db.prepare(`SELECT o.id AS offer_id, o.expires_at, o.created_at AS offer_created_at, r.* FROM offers o JOIN reservations r ON r.id = o.reservation_id
    WHERE o.translator_id = ? AND o.status = 'pending' ORDER BY o.created_at`).all(u.id);
  // قبل از پذیرش: فقط ساعت/تاریخ، مبدا-مقصد، نشانی ملاقات، نام مسافر، یادداشت و سهم خالص (بدون جنسیت)
  const changeRows = db.prepare(`SELECT c.id, c.reservation_id, c.changes, c.expires_at, r.place, r.traveler_name, r.net, r.kind, r.scheduled_at
    FROM change_requests c JOIN reservations r ON r.id = c.reservation_id
    WHERE r.translator_id = ? AND c.status = 'pending' AND c.expires_at > ?`).all(u.id, now());
  const extRows = db.prepare(`SELECT e.id, e.reservation_id, e.extra_hours, e.extra_base, e.extra_tax, e.extra_net, e.expires_at, r.place, r.traveler_name, r.net
    FROM extension_requests e JOIN reservations r ON r.id = e.reservation_id
    WHERE r.translator_id = ? AND e.status = 'pending' AND e.expires_at > ?`).all(u.id, now());
  send(res, 200, { online: !!(t && t.online), server_time: new Date(serverTime).toISOString(),
    extensions: extRows.map((e) => ({ id: e.id, reservation_id: e.reservation_id, place: e.place, traveler_name: e.traveler_name,
      extra_hours: e.extra_hours, extra_total: e.extra_base + e.extra_tax, extra_net: e.extra_net,
      new_net: (e.net || 0) + e.extra_net, expires_at: new Date(e.expires_at).toISOString() })),
    changes: changeRows.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, reservation_id: c.reservation_id, place: c.place, traveler_name: c.traveler_name,
    kind: c.kind, scheduled_at: c.scheduled_at ? new Date(c.scheduled_at).toISOString() : null, changes: JSON.parse(c.changes), expires_at: new Date(c.expires_at).toISOString() })),
    offers: rows.map((r) => ({
    id: r.offer_id, reservation_id: r.id, kind: r.kind, origin_lang: r.origin_lang, dest_lang: r.dest_lang, field: r.field,
    place: r.place, traveler_name: r.traveler_name, notes: r.notes, hours: r.hours, car: r.car, party: r.party,
    scheduled_at: r.scheduled_at ? new Date(r.scheduled_at).toISOString() : null,
    net: r.net, created_at: new Date(r.offer_created_at).toISOString(), expires_at: new Date(r.expires_at).toISOString(),
  })) });
});

// Decision history is private to the offered translator; no passenger code or gender.
route('GET', '/api/translator/offers/:id', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const id = parseId(params.id);
  const o = id && db.prepare('SELECT * FROM offers WHERE id = ? AND translator_id = ?').get(id, u.id);
  if (!o) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  const r = db.prepare('SELECT net, translator_id FROM reservations WHERE id = ?').get(o.reservation_id);
  if (!r) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  send(res, 200, { id: o.id, reservation_id: o.reservation_id,
    status: o.status === 'pending' && o.expires_at <= now() ? 'expired' : o.status,
    expires_at: new Date(o.expires_at).toISOString(), net: r.net, assigned: r.translator_id === u.id });
});

route('POST', '/api/translator/offers/:id/accept', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const id = parseId(params.id);
  const o = id && db.prepare('SELECT * FROM offers WHERE id = ? AND translator_id = ?').get(id, u.id);
  if (!o) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  const r = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE id = ?').get(o.reservation_id);
  if (o.status !== 'pending' || o.expires_at <= now()) return send(res, 410, { error: 'offer_expired' });
  if (!SEARCHABLE.includes(r.status)) return send(res, 409, { error: 'no_longer_available' });
  db.transaction(() => {
    db.prepare("UPDATE reservations SET status = 'matched', translator_id = ?, matched_at = ?, translator_arrived_at = NULL, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(u.id, now(), now(), r.id);
    db.prepare("UPDATE offers SET status = 'accepted', decided_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(now(), o.id);
    db.prepare("UPDATE offers SET status = 'withdrawn', decided_at = ? WHERE reservation_id = ? AND status = 'pending'").run(now(), r.id);
  })();
  revEvent(r.id, 'matched', 'translator', { offer_id: o.id });
  // اعلان مسافر: مترجم مشخص شد (پوش + ثبت اعلان)
  const tp = db.prepare('SELECT profile FROM translators WHERE user_id = ?').get(u.id);
  const pj = tp ? (JSON.parse(tp.profile || '{}')) : {};
  const tname = [pj.first_name, pj.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
  notifyTraveler(r.traveler_id, r.id, 'matched', 'مترجم شما' + (tname ? ' (' + tname + ')' : '') + ' برای رزرو «' + (r.place || '') + '» مشخص شد؛ جزئیات در اپ.');
  pushTraveler(r.traveler_id, { title: 'مترجم شما مشخص شد', body: (tname || 'مترجم') + ' درخواست شما را پذیرفت؛ جزئیات در اپ.', tag: 'matched-' + r.id });
  send(res, 200, { ok: true, reservation_id: r.id });
});

route('POST', '/api/translator/offers/:id/decline', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const id = parseId(params.id);
  const o = id && db.prepare('SELECT * FROM offers WHERE id = ? AND translator_id = ?').get(id, u.id);
  if (!o) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  if (o.status !== 'pending' || o.expires_at <= now()) return send(res, 410, { error: 'offer_expired' });
  db.prepare("UPDATE offers SET status = 'declined', decided_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(now(), o.id);
  sweep();
  send(res, 200, { ok: true });
});

// The former assignee can verify their own cancellation without seeing the next assignee.
route('GET', '/api/translator/missions/:id/cancellation', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const id = parseId(params.id);
  const r = id && db.prepare('SELECT translator_id, status FROM reservations WHERE id = ?').get(id);
  const c = id && db.prepare('SELECT created_at FROM mission_cancellations WHERE reservation_id = ? AND translator_id = ?').get(id, u.id);
  if (!r || (!c && r.translator_id !== u.id)) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  send(res, 200, { reservation_id: id, cancelled: !!c,
    cancelled_at: c ? new Date(c.created_at).toISOString() : null,
    assigned: r.translator_id === u.id && r.status === 'matched' });
});

// لغو توسط مترجم پس از پذیرش: بدون جریمه‌ی پولی، امتیاز کم می‌شود و ماموریت دوباره تطبیق می‌شود
route('POST', '/api/translator/missions/:id/cancel', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const id = parseId(params.id);
  const r = id && db.prepare("SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE id = ? AND translator_id = ? AND status = 'matched'").get(id, u.id);
  if (!r) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  if (r.service_started_at) return send(res, 409, { error: 'service_already_started' });
  const t = now();
  let next = 'searching';
  if (r.kind === 'scheduled') next = t >= r.scheduled_at - TIMING.SCHEDULE_MATCH_BEFORE_MS ? 'matching' : 'waiting_schedule';
  db.transaction(() => {
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO mission_cancellations (reservation_id, translator_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)').run(r.id, u.id, t);
    db.prepare(`UPDATE reservations SET status = ?, translator_id = NULL, matched_at = NULL, translator_arrived_at = NULL, search_started_at = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?`)
      .run(next, t, t, r.id);
    db.prepare('UPDATE translators SET score = MAX(0, score - 5), updated_at = ? WHERE user_id = ?').run(t, u.id);
  })();
  revEvent(r.id, 'translator_cancelled', 'translator', { reassigned_to: next });
  // شکاف ۵: مسافر باید بداند مترجم کنار رفته و جستجوی جایگزین ادامه دارد
  notifyTraveler(r.traveler_id, r.id, 'translator_cancelled', 'مترجم شما از رزرو «' + (r.place || '') + '» کنار رفت؛ ' + (next === 'waiting_schedule' ? 'زمان‌بندی حفظ شد و جستجوی مترجم جایگزین ادامه دارد.' : 'جستجوی مترجم جایگزین آغاز شد.'));
  pushTraveler(r.traveler_id, { title: 'تغییر مترجم', body: 'مترجم قبلی از رزرو کنار رفت؛ جستجوی مترجم جایگزین آغاز شد.', tag: 'tcancel-' + r.id });
  sweep();
  send(res, 200, { ok: true, reservation_id: r.id, cancelled_at: new Date(t).toISOString(), reassigned: next !== 'waiting_schedule' });
});

route('GET', '/api/translator/missions', async (req, res) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const serverTime = now();
  const from = serverTime - 3600 * 1000;
  // Keep an in-progress service visible even when its scheduled/matched time is over an hour old.
  const fromReservations = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE translator_id = ? AND status = 'matched'
      AND (COALESCE(scheduled_at, matched_at) > ? OR service_started_at IS NOT NULL)
      ORDER BY COALESCE(scheduled_at, matched_at)`).all(u.id, from)
    .map((r) => ({ id: 'R' + r.id, reservation_id: r.id, code: 'R-' + r.id, purpose: r.field, travelerName: r.traveler_name, place: r.place,
      kind: r.kind, origin_lang: r.origin_lang, dest_lang: r.dest_lang, car: r.car, party: r.party, notes: r.notes,
      scheduled_at: r.scheduled_at ? new Date(r.scheduled_at).toISOString() : null,
      lat: r.lat == null ? null : r.lat, lng: r.lng == null ? null : r.lng,
      startAt: new Date(r.scheduled_at || r.matched_at).toISOString(), total: r.total, net: r.net, status: 'accepted',
      arrived_at: r.translator_arrived_at ? new Date(r.translator_arrived_at).toISOString() : null,
      started: !!r.service_started_at, service_started_at: r.service_started_at ? new Date(r.service_started_at).toISOString() : null, hours: r.hours,
      finish_requested: !!r.finish_requested_at }));
  // ماموریت‌های آزمایشی تزریقی (فقط حالت توسعه)
  const fromDev = db.prepare(`SELECT id, code, purpose, traveler_name, place, start_at, total, net, status FROM missions
      WHERE translator_id = ? AND status = 'accepted' AND start_at > ?`).all(u.id, from)
    .map((m) => ({ id: m.id, code: m.code, purpose: m.purpose, travelerName: m.traveler_name, place: m.place,
      startAt: new Date(m.start_at).toISOString(), total: m.total, net: m.net, status: m.status }));
  const all = fromReservations.concat(fromDev).sort((a, b) => Date.parse(a.startAt) - Date.parse(b.startAt));
  send(res, 200, { server_time: new Date(serverTime).toISOString(), missions: all });
});

// ---------- تغییر رزرو پس از پذیرش ----------
const CHANGE_COLUMNS = { scheduled_at: 'time', place: 'place', origin_lang: 'lang', dest_lang: 'lang', field: 'field',
  hours: 'duration', car: 'car', party: 'party', gender_pref: 'gender' };
const CHANGE_WINDOW_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000 * SCALE;   // مهلت پاسخ مترجم
const CHANGE_LIMIT = 3;                            // حداکثر تغییر مهم
const CHANGE_CUTOFF_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000 * SCALE;   // زیر ۳۰ دقیقه مانده، تغییر مهم پیشنهاد نمی‌شود

// اعتبارسنجی فیلدهای درخواست؛ یادداشت همیشه آزاد است
function parseChanges(b, r) {
  const out = {};
  if ('scheduled_at' in b) {
    if (r.kind !== 'scheduled') return { error: 'time_not_applicable' };
    const at = Date.parse(b.scheduled_at);
    if (!Number.isFinite(at)) return { error: 'invalid_time' };
    if (at - now() < TIMING.SCHEDULE_MIN_LEAD_MS) return { error: 'too_soon' };
    out.scheduled_at = at;
  }
  if ('place' in b) { const v = String(b.place || '').trim(); if (!v || v.length > 200) return { error: 'invalid_place' }; out.place = v; }
  if ('origin_lang' in b) { if (!LANGS.has(b.origin_lang)) return { error: 'invalid_language' }; out.origin_lang = b.origin_lang; }
  if ('dest_lang' in b) { if (!LANGS.has(b.dest_lang)) return { error: 'invalid_language' }; out.dest_lang = b.dest_lang; }
  if ('field' in b) { if (!FIELDS.has(b.field)) return { error: 'invalid_field' }; out.field = b.field; }
  if ('hours' in b) out.hours = Math.min(Math.max(Math.trunc(Number(b.hours)) || 1, DURATION_MIN_H), DURATION_MAX_H);
  if ('car' in b) out.car = b.car ? 1 : 0;
  if ('party' in b) out.party = Math.min(Math.max(Number(b.party) || 1, 1), 20);
  if ('gender_pref' in b) { if (!GENDER_PREF.has(b.gender_pref)) return { error: 'invalid_gender' }; out.gender_pref = b.gender_pref; }
  if ('notes' in b) out.notes = String(b.notes || '').slice(0, 500);
  return { changes: out, important: Object.keys(out).some((k) => k in CHANGE_COLUMNS) };
}

// اعمال تغییرها روی رزرو؛ اگر زمان یا مشخصات عوض شود، تطبیق از نو حساب می‌شود
function applyChanges(r, changes) {
  const keys = Object.keys(changes);
  if (!keys.length) return;
  const sets = keys.map((k) => `${k} = ?`).join(', ');
  const clearArrival = keys.some((k) => k === 'place' || k === 'scheduled_at');
  db.prepare(`UPDATE reservations SET ${sets}${clearArrival ? ', translator_arrived_at = NULL' : ''}, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?`)
    .run(...keys.map((k) => changes[k]), now(), r.id);
  const important = keys.some((k) => k in CHANGE_COLUMNS);
  if (!r.translator_id && important) {
    closeOffers(r.id);
    if ('scheduled_at' in changes) {
      setStatus(r.id, now() >= changes.scheduled_at - TIMING.SCHEDULE_MATCH_BEFORE_MS ? 'matching' : 'waiting_schedule');
    } else if (r.status === 'no_match') {
      setStatus(r.id, 'searching');
    }
  }
  sweep();
}

route('POST', '/api/traveler/bookings/:id/change', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'traveler'); if (!u) return;
  if (!requireFeature(res, 'booking_change')) return;
  const r = ownReservation(res, u, params); if (!r) return;
  if (r.status === 'cancelled') return send(res, 409, { error: 'not_changeable' });
  const b = await readJson(req);
  const parsed = parseChanges(b, r);
  if (parsed.error) return send(res, 400, { error: parsed.error });
  if (!Object.keys(parsed.changes).length) return send(res, 400, { error: 'nothing_to_change' });
  if (!parsed.important) { applyChanges(r, parsed.changes); return send(res, 200, { applied: true }); }
  if (r.scheduled_at && now() >= r.scheduled_at - CHANGE_CUTOFF_MS) return send(res, 409, { error: 'too_late_for_change' });
  if (!r.translator_id) { applyChanges(r, parsed.changes); return send(res, 200, { applied: true }); }
  // مترجم پذیرفته: رضایت او لازم است
  if (db.prepare("SELECT 1 FROM change_requests WHERE reservation_id = ? AND status = 'pending'").get(r.id)) return send(res, 409, { error: 'change_pending' });
  const count = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM change_requests WHERE reservation_id = ?').get(r.id).n;
  if (count >= CHANGE_LIMIT) return send(res, 409, { error: 'change_limit' });
  const info = db.prepare('INSERT INTO change_requests (reservation_id, changes, status, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)')
    .run(r.id, JSON.stringify(parsed.changes), 'pending', now() + CHANGE_WINDOW_MS, now());
  send(res, 202, { pending: true, id: info.lastInsertRowid, expires_at: new Date(now() + CHANGE_WINDOW_MS).toISOString() });
});

// ---------- تمدید زمان خدمت در جریان (سند: تمدید فقط با تأیید مترجم) ----------
// قیمت تمدید از روی همان نرخ لحظه‌ی ثبت رزرو حساب می‌شود (base/hours) تا تغییر تعرفه‌ی مدیر روی رزرو باز اثر نگذارد.
function extensionQuote(r, extraHours) {
  const perHourBase = r.hours > 0 ? Math.round(r.base / r.hours) : 0;
  const extraBase = perHourBase * extraHours;
  const extraTax = r.base > 0 ? Math.round(extraBase * r.tax / r.base) : 0;
  const extraNet = r.base > 0 ? Math.round(extraBase * r.net / r.base) : 0;
  return { extraBase, extraTax, extraNet };
}
const EXTENSION_MAX_HOURS = 12; // سقف کل مدت خدمت، هماهنگ با سقف ثبت رزرو

route('POST', '/api/traveler/bookings/:id/extend', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'traveler'); if (!u) return;
  const r = ownReservation(res, u, params); if (!r) return;
  const b = await readJson(req);
  const extra = Math.trunc(Number(b.extra_hours)) || 1;
  if (extra < 1 || extra > 4) return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_extension' });
  // تمدید فقط وقتی خدمت واقعاً شروع شده و هنوز تمام نشده است
  if (r.status !== 'matched' || !r.service_started_at || !r.translator_id) return send(res, 409, { error: 'extension_not_allowed' });
  if ((r.hours || 1) + extra > EXTENSION_MAX_HOURS) return send(res, 409, { error: 'extension_limit' });
  if (db.prepare("SELECT 1 FROM extension_requests WHERE reservation_id = ? AND status = 'pending'").get(r.id)) {
    return send(res, 409, { error: 'extension_pending' });
  }
  const q = extensionQuote(r, extra);
  const info = db.prepare(`INSERT INTO extension_requests (reservation_id, extra_hours, extra_base, extra_tax, extra_net, status, expires_at, created_at)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', ?, ?)`)
    .run(r.id, extra, q.extraBase, q.extraTax, q.extraNet, now() + CHANGE_WINDOW_MS, now());
  send(res, 202, { pending: true, id: info.lastInsertRowid, extra_hours: extra,
    extra_total: q.extraBase + q.extraTax, new_total: r.total + q.extraBase + q.extraTax,
    expires_at: new Date(now() + CHANGE_WINDOW_MS).toISOString() });
});

function ownExtension(res, u, params) {
  const id = parseId(params.id);
  const e = id && db.prepare('SELECT e.*, r.translator_id AS tid FROM extension_requests e JOIN reservations r ON r.id = e.reservation_id WHERE e.id = ?').get(id);
  if (!e || e.tid !== u.id) { send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' }); return null; }
  return e;
}
route('GET', '/api/translator/extensions/:id', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const e = ownExtension(res, u, params); if (!e) return;
  send(res, 200, { id: e.id, reservation_id: e.reservation_id,
    status: e.status === 'pending' && e.expires_at <= now() ? 'expired' : e.status,
    extra_hours: e.extra_hours, extra_total: e.extra_base + e.extra_tax, extra_net: e.extra_net,
    expires_at: new Date(e.expires_at).toISOString() });
});
route('POST', '/api/translator/extensions/:id/accept', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const e = ownExtension(res, u, params); if (!e) return;
  if (e.status !== 'pending' || e.expires_at <= now()) return send(res, 410, { error: 'extension_expired' });
  const r = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE id = ?').get(e.reservation_id);
  if (!r || r.status !== 'matched') return send(res, 409, { error: 'extension_not_allowed' });
  db.prepare("UPDATE extension_requests SET status = 'accepted', decided_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(now(), e.id);
  db.prepare(`UPDATE reservations SET hours = hours + ?, base = base + ?, tax = tax + ?, total = total + ?, net = net + ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?`)
    .run(e.extra_hours, e.extra_base, e.extra_tax, e.extra_base + e.extra_tax, e.extra_net, now(), r.id);
  send(res, 200, { ok: true });
});
route('POST', '/api/translator/extensions/:id/reject', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const e = ownExtension(res, u, params); if (!e) return;
  if (e.status !== 'pending' || e.expires_at <= now()) return send(res, 410, { error: 'extension_expired' });
  db.prepare("UPDATE extension_requests SET status = 'rejected', decided_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(now(), e.id);
  send(res, 200, { ok: true });
});

function ownChange(res, u, params) {
  const id = parseId(params.id);

  if (!c || c.tid !== u.id) { send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' }); return null; }

}
route('GET', '/api/translator/changes/:id', async (req, res, url, params) => {

route('POST', '/api/translator/changes/:id/accept', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  const u = requireUser(req, res, 'translator'); if (!u) return;
  if (!activeTranslator(res, u)) return;
  const c = ownChange(res, u, params); if (!c) return;

  const r = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE id = ?').get(c.reservation_id);
  if (!r || r.status !== 'matched') return send(res, 409, { error: 'change_not_allowed' });
  db.transaction(() => {

route('POST', '/api/translator/changes/:id/reject', async (req, res, url, params) => {

});


// ---------- قابلیت‌ها، شهرها و ممیزی (پنل مدیر) ----------
function featuresNow() {
  let stored = {};
  try { stored = JSON.parse(settingRaw('features') || '{}'); } catch (e) { stored = {}; }
  return resolveFeatures(stored);
}
function featureOn(key) { return featuresNow()[key] === true; }
function requireFeature(res, key) {
  if (featureOn(key)) return true;
  send(res, 409, { error: 'feature_disabled', feature: key });
  return false;
}
function audit(action, detail) {
  // هویت عامل از زمینهٔ درخواست ادمین خوانده می‌شود؛ اقدامات سیستم بدون actor ثبت می‌شوند
  const ctx = ADMIN_CTX.getStore();
  const actor = ctx && ctx.admin ? ctx.admin.username : null;
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO audit_log (created_at, action, detail, actor) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)').run(now(), action, JSON.stringify(detail || {}), actor);
}
// خط زمانی رزرو: هر گذار مهم یک ردیف در reservation_events ثبت می‌کند.
// رویدادهای وضعیتی از setStatus می‌آیند (status_* ) و گذارهای صریح از نقاط فراخوانی.
function revEvent(reservationId, event, actor, detail) {
  if (!reservationId) return;
  try {
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO reservation_events (reservation_id, event, actor, detail, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)')
      .run(reservationId, String(event), String(actor || 'system'), JSON.stringify(detail || {}), now());
  } catch (e) { /* ثبت خط زمانی هرگز جریان اصلی را نباید بشکند */ }
}
function defaultCityId() {
  const v = Number(getSetting('default_city_id'));
  return Number.isInteger(v) && v > 0 ? v : null;
}
// ---------- هندسهٔ پوشش سرویس (منطق تحقیق‌شدهٔ شهر/شعاع) ----------
// شعاع هر شهر یعنی «مرز جغرافیایی مسئولیت آن شهر» (الگوی service area در پلتفرم‌های اعزام):
// هر نقطهٔ ملاقات فقط به شهری تعلق دارد که دایرهٔ پوششش (مرکز + radius_km) آن نقطه را در بر بگیرد.
// اگر چند شهر یک نقطه را پوشش دهند، شهری برنده است که نقطه نسبت به شعاعش مرکزتر باشد (نسبت فاصله/شعاع کمینه).
function haversineKm(la1, lo1, la2, lo2) {
  const R = 6371, p = Math.PI / 180;
  const a = Math.sin((la2 - la1) * p / 2) * Math.sin((la2 - la1) * p / 2) +
    Math.cos(la1 * p) * Math.cos(la2 * p) * Math.sin((lo2 - lo1) * p / 2) * Math.sin((lo2 - lo1) * p / 2);
  return 2 * R * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(a));
}
function cityCoveringPoint(lat, lng) {
  let best = null;
  for (const c of db.prepare('SELECT id, lat, lng, radius_km, traveler_enabled FROM cities').all()) {
    const d = haversineKm(lat, lng, c.lat, c.lng);
    if (d <= c.radius_km && (!best || d / c.radius_km < best.d / best.radius_km)) {
      best = { id: c.id, d, radius_km: c.radius_km, traveler_enabled: c.traveler_enabled };
    }
  }
  return best;
}
// شهر درخواست: city_id صریح یا شهر پیش‌فرض؛ باید وجود داشته و برای آن نقش فعال باشد
function resolveCity(raw, role) {
  const id = raw === undefined || raw === null || raw === '' ? defaultCityId() : parseId(raw);
  if (!id) return { error: 'city_required', status: 400 };
  const c = db.prepare('SELECT id, name_fa, traveler_enabled, translator_enabled FROM cities WHERE id = ?').get(id);
  if (!c) return { error: 'invalid_city', status: 400 };
  const on = role === 'traveler' ? c.traveler_enabled : c.translator_enabled;
  if (!on) return { error: 'city_not_active', status: 409 };
  return { city: c };
}

route('GET', '/api/admin/features', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  const on = featuresNow();
  send(res, 200, { features: FEATURE_KEYS.map((k) => ({ key: k, group: FEATURES[k].group, label: FEATURES[k].label,
    implemented: FEATURES[k].implemented, requires: FEATURES[k].requires, effect: FEATURES[k].effect, enabled: on[k] })) });
});

route('PUT', '/api/admin/features', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'features.manage')) return;
  const b = await readJson(req);
  const before = featuresNow();
  const v = validateFeaturePatch(b, before);
  if (!v.ok) return send(res, v.status, { error: v.error, key: v.key, requires: v.requires });
  const changed = FEATURE_KEYS.filter((k) => v.next[k] !== before[k]);
  const stored = {};
  for (const k of FEATURE_KEYS) stored[k] = v.next[k];
  db.transaction(() => {
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value')
      .run('features', JSON.stringify(stored));
    // خاموش‌کردن ثبت‌نام آنلاین: مترجمان آنلاین به حالت آفلاین برگردند
    if (changed.includes('translator_online') && !v.next.translator_online) {
      db.prepare('UPDATE translators SET online = 0').run();
    }
  })();
  audit('features.update', { changed: changed.map((k) => ({ key: k, enabled: v.next[k] })) });
  send(res, 200, { ok: true, changed });
});

// ورودی شهر: اعتبارسنجی سخت‌گیرانه؛ partial یعنی فقط فیلدهای ارسالی بررسی شوند
function cityInput(b, partial) {
  const out = {};
  if (!partial || b.name_fa !== undefined) {
    const nf = typeof b.name_fa === 'string' ? b.name_fa.trim() : '';
    if (nf.length < 2 || nf.length > 40) return { error: 'invalid_name' };
    out.name_fa = nf;
  }
  if (b.name_en !== undefined) {
    const ne = typeof b.name_en === 'string' ? b.name_en.trim() : '';
    if (ne.length > 40 || !/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z .'-]*$/.test(ne) && ne !== '') return { error: 'invalid_name_en' };
    out.name_en = ne;
  }
  if (b.province !== undefined) {
    if (typeof b.province !== 'string' || b.province.length > 60) return { error: 'invalid_province' };
    out.province = b.province.trim();
  }
  if (!partial || b.lat !== undefined) {
    const la = typeof b.lat === 'number' ? b.lat : NaN;
    if (!Number.isFinite(la) || la < -90 || la > 90) return { error: 'invalid_lat' };
    out.lat = la;
  }
  if (!partial || b.lng !== undefined) {
    const lo = typeof b.lng === 'number' ? b.lng : NaN;
    if (!Number.isFinite(lo) || lo < -180 || lo > 180) return { error: 'invalid_lng' };
    out.lng = lo;
  }
  if (!partial || b.radius_km !== undefined) {
    const r = b.radius_km === undefined ? 30 : b.radius_km;
    if (!Number.isInteger(r) || r < 1 || r > 200) return { error: 'invalid_radius' };
    out.radius_km = r;
  }
  for (const k of ['traveler_enabled', 'translator_enabled']) {
    if (!partial || b[k] !== undefined) {
      const val = b[k] === undefined ? true : b[k];
      if (typeof val !== 'boolean') return { error: 'invalid_value', key: k };
      out[k] = val ? 1 : 0;
    }
  }
  return { value: out };
}

const cityView = (c) => ({ id: c.id, name_fa: c.name_fa, name_en: c.name_en, province: c.province, lat: c.lat, lng: c.lng,
  radius_km: c.radius_km, traveler_enabled: c.traveler_enabled === 1, translator_enabled: c.translator_enabled === 1,
  translators: c.translators || 0, open_bookings: c.open_bookings || 0, matched_bookings: c.matched_bookings || 0,
  translators_online: c.translators_online || 0, bookings_7d: c.bookings_7d || 0, done_7d: c.done_7d || 0 });

route('GET', '/api/admin/cities', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  const since7 = now() - 7 * DAY_MS;
  const rows = db.prepare(`SELECT c.*,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM translators t WHERE t.city_id = c.id AND t.status LIKE 'active_%') AS translators,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations r WHERE r.city_id = c.id AND r.status IN (${UNMATCHED_SQL})) AS open_bookings,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations r WHERE r.city_id = c.id AND r.status = 'matched') AS matched_bookings,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM translators t WHERE t.city_id = c.id AND t.online = 1) AS translators_online,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations r WHERE r.city_id = c.id AND r.created_at >= ?) AS bookings_7d,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations r WHERE r.city_id = c.id AND r.status = 'done' AND r.created_at >= ?) AS done_7d
    FROM cities c ORDER BY c.id`).all(since7, since7);
  send(res, 200, { cities: rows.map(cityView), default_city_id: defaultCityId() });
});

route('POST', '/api/admin/cities', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'cities.manage')) return;
  const b = await readJson(req);
  const v = cityInput(b && typeof b === 'object' ? b : {}, false);
  if (v.error) return send(res, 400, { error: v.error, key: v.key });
  const t = now();
  let id;
  try {
    const r = db.prepare(`INSERT INTO cities (name_fa, name_en, province, lat, lng, radius_km, traveler_enabled, translator_enabled, created_at, updated_at)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`).run(v.value.name_fa, v.value.name_en || '', v.value.province || '', v.value.lat,
      v.value.lng, v.value.radius_km, v.value.traveler_enabled, v.value.translator_enabled, t, t);
    id = Number(r.lastInsertRowid);
  } catch (e) {
    if (/UNIQUE/.test(e.message)) return send(res, 409, { error: 'city_exists' });
    throw e;
  }
  audit('city.create', { id, name_fa: v.value.name_fa });
  send(res, 201, { ok: true, id });
});

route('PATCH', '/api/admin/cities/:id', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'cities.manage')) return;
  const id = parseId(params.id);
  const cur = id && db.prepare('SELECT * FROM cities WHERE id = ?').get(id);
  if (!cur) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  const b = await readJson(req);
  if (!b || typeof b !== 'object' || Array.isArray(b)) return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_body' });
  const v = cityInput(b, true);
  if (v.error) return send(res, 400, { error: v.error, key: v.key });
  const keys = Object.keys(v.value);
  if (!keys.length) return send(res, 400, { error: 'nothing_to_change' });
  const next = { ...cur, ...v.value };
  const closing = cur.traveler_enabled === 1 && next.traveler_enabled === 0;
  const openIds = closing
    ? db.prepare(`SELECT id FROM reservations WHERE city_id = ? AND status IN (${UNMATCHED_SQL})`).all(id).map((x) => x.id)
    : [];
  if (openIds.length && b.confirm_cancel !== true) {
    return send(res, 409, { error: 'open_bookings', count: openIds.length });
  }
  db.transaction(() => {
    db.prepare(`UPDATE cities SET name_fa = ?, name_en = ?, province = ?, lat = ?, lng = ?, radius_km = ?,
      traveler_enabled = ?, translator_enabled = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?`)
      .run(next.name_fa, next.name_en, next.province, next.lat, next.lng, next.radius_km,
        next.traveler_enabled, next.translator_enabled, now(), id);
    // رزروهای باز این شهر (هنوز مترجم ندارند) لغو می‌شوند؛ بدون کارمزد، چون تطبیق نشده است
    for (const rid of openIds) { closeOffers(rid); setStatus(rid, 'cancelled'); }
  })();
  audit('city.update', { id, changed: keys, cancelled: openIds.length });
  send(res, 200, { ok: true, cancelled: openIds.length });
});

// پوشش سرویس: رزروهای «بیرون از پوشش» (نقاط کور) — رزروهای بازِ دارای مختصات که داخل هیچ دایرهٔ شهری نیستند.
// این‌ها رزروهایی‌اند که تطبیق هم‌شهری برایشان احتمال شکست دارد؛ کارشناس باید شهر را اصلاح یا پوشش را گسترش دهد.
route('GET', '/api/admin/coverage', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  const rows = db.prepare(`SELECT r.id, r.place, r.lat, r.lng, r.status, r.kind, r.traveler_name, r.created_at,
      c.name_fa AS city_name
    FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN cities c ON c.id = r.city_id
    WHERE r.lat IS NOT NULL AND r.lng IS NOT NULL AND r.status IN (${UNMATCHED_SQL}) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 100`).all();
  const outside = rows.filter((r) => !cityCoveringPoint(r.lat, r.lng));
  send(res, 200, { checked: rows.length,
    outside: outside.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, place: r.place || '', lat: r.lat, lng: r.lng, status: r.status, kind: r.kind,
      traveler_name: r.traveler_name || '', city_name: r.city_name || '', created_at: r.created_at })) });
});

// صف «گیر کرده‌ها» (نردبان CAP): چه مترجمی منتظر کدام گیت است تا کارشناس سریع بازش کند
route('GET', '/api/admin/gates', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  const rows = db.prepare(`SELECT t.user_id, t.status, t.fields, t.profile, u.phone
    FROM translators t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id
    WHERE t.status IN ('pending_review', 'active_general', 'active_specialized') ORDER BY t.updated_at ASC LIMIT 300`).all();
  const stuck = [];
  for (const t0 of rows) {
    let pr = {}; try { pr = JSON.parse(t0.profile || '{}'); } catch (e) {}
    const F = JSON.parse(t0.fields || '[]').map((f) => FIELD_ALIAS[f] || f);
    const items = [];
    if (t0.status === 'pending_review') items.push({ gate: 'decision', label: 'انتظار تصمیم کارشناس (بررسی نهایی)' });
    if (t0.status !== 'pending_review' && F.some((f) => SPEC_FIELDS.has(f)) && !langCertOk(t0))
      items.push({ gate: 'lang_cert', label: 'مدرک زبان برای حوزه‌های تخصصی ارسال/تأیید نشده است' });
    if (pr.car === true && !carReady(t0, 1))
      items.push({ gate: 'car', label: 'مدارک خودرو (بیمه/گواهینامه) کامل یا تأیید نیست' });
    if (items.length) stuck.push({ id: t0.user_id, phone: t0.phone, status: t0.status, name: [pr.first_name, pr.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' '), blocked: items });
  }
  send(res, 200, { stuck });
});

// ---------- نسل دوم پنل: هویت کارمند جاری ----------
route('GET', '/api/admin/me', async (req, res) => {
  if (!ADMIN_PASSWORD) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  const u = adminUserOf(req);
  if (!u) return send(res, 401, { error: 'unauthorized' });
  const perms = Object.keys(ADMIN_PERMS).filter((p) => (ADMIN_PERMS[p] || []).includes(u.role));
  send(res, 200, { user: { id: u.id, username: u.username, name: u.name, role: u.role, role_fa: ADMIN_ROLES[u.role] || u.role }, perms });
});

// ---------- کارمندان و نقش‌ها (فقط صاحب پلتفرم) ----------
route('GET', '/api/admin/staff', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'staff.manage')) return;
  const rows = db.prepare(`SELECT u.id, u.username, u.name, u.role, u.is_active, u.created_at, u.last_login_at,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_sessions s WHERE s.admin_user_id = u.id AND s.expires_at > ?) AS sessions
    FROM admin_users u ORDER BY u.id`).all(now());
  send(res, 200, { staff: rows.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, username: r.username, name: r.name, role: r.role,
    is_active: r.is_active === 1, created_at: r.created_at, last_login_at: r.last_login_at || null, sessions: r.sessions })) });
});

route('POST', '/api/admin/staff', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'staff.manage')) return;
  const b = await readJson(req);
  const username = clip(b.username, 40).toLowerCase();
  if (!/^[a-z0-9_.-]{3,40}$/.test(username)) return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_username' });
  if (!ADMIN_ROLES[b.role]) return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_role' });
  if (isWeakAdminPassword(String(b.password || ''))) return send(res, 400, { error: 'weak_password' });
  if (db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM admin_users WHERE username = ?').get(username)) return send(res, 409, { error: 'username_taken' });
  const t = now();
  const r = db.prepare('INSERT INTO admin_users (username, name, password_hash, role, is_active, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?)')
    .run(username, clip(b.name, 80), hashAdminPassword(String(b.password)), b.role, t);
  const id = Number(r.lastInsertRowid);
  audit('staff.create', { id, username, role: b.role });
  send(res, 201, { ok: true, id });
});

route('PATCH', '/api/admin/staff/:id', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'staff.manage')) return;
  const id = parseId(params.id);
  const target = id && db.prepare('SELECT * FROM admin_users WHERE id = ?').get(id);
  if (!target) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  const me = adminUserOf(req);
  const b = await readJson(req);
  const next = { name: target.name, role: target.role, is_active: target.is_active };
  if (b.name !== undefined) next.name = clip(b.name, 80);
  if (b.role !== undefined) {
    if (!ADMIN_ROLES[b.role]) return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_role' });
    next.role = b.role;
  }
  if (b.is_active !== undefined) next.is_active = b.is_active ? 1 : 0;
  if (next.role !== 'owner' || !next.is_active) {
    // آخرین owner فعال نمی‌تواند حذف نقش یا غیرفعال شود (ضد قفل‌شدن پنل)
    const otherOwners = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM admin_users WHERE role = 'owner' AND is_active = 1 AND id != ?").get(target.id).n;
    if (target.role === 'owner' && otherOwners === 0) return send(res, 409, { error: 'last_owner' });
  }
  if (me && me.id === target.id && !next.is_active) return send(res, 409, { error: 'self_disable' });
  db.prepare('UPDATE admin_users SET name = ?, role = ?, is_active = ? WHERE id = ?').run(next.name, next.role, next.is_active, target.id);
  if (!next.is_active) db.prepare('DELETE FROM admin_sessions WHERE admin_user_id = ?').run(target.id);
  audit('staff.update', { id: target.id, name: next.name, role: next.role, is_active: !!next.is_active });
  send(res, 200, { ok: true });
});

route('POST', '/api/admin/staff/:id/password', async (req, res, url, params) => {

  audit('staff.password_reset', { id: target.id, username: target.username });

});

// ---------- صف چرخهٔ تغییرات (تغییر + تمدید در انتظار تصمیم مترجم) ----------
route('GET', '/api/admin/changes', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  const t = now();
  const base = `SELECT cr.id, cr.reservation_id, cr.status, cr.created_at, cr.decided_at,
      r.traveler_name, r.place, r.status AS reservation_status, r.translator_id,
      COALESCE(json_extract(tp.profile, '$.first_name') || ' ' || json_extract(tp.profile, '$.last_name'), '') AS translator_name
    FROM change_requests cr
    JOIN reservations r ON r.id = cr.reservation_id
    LEFT JOIN users tru ON tru.id = r.translator_id
    LEFT JOIN translators tp ON tp.user_id = r.translator_id`;
  const extBase = `SELECT er.id, er.reservation_id, er.status, er.created_at, er.decided_at, er.extra_hours, er.extra_net,
      r.traveler_name, r.place, r.status AS reservation_status, r.translator_id,
      COALESCE(json_extract(tp.profile, '$.first_name') || ' ' || json_extract(tp.profile, '$.last_name'), '') AS translator_name
    FROM extension_requests er
    JOIN reservations r ON r.id = er.reservation_id
    LEFT JOIN users tru ON tru.id = r.translator_id
    LEFT JOIN translators tp ON tp.user_id = r.translator_id`;
  const changes = db.prepare(base + " ORDER BY (cr.status = 'pending') DESC, cr.id DESC LIMIT 100").all()
    .map((r) => ({ id: r.id, kind: 'change', reservation_id: r.reservation_id, status: r.status,
      created_at: r.created_at, decided_at: r.decided_at, traveler_name: r.traveler_name || '', place: r.place || '',
      reservation_status: r.reservation_status, translator_name: r.translator_name || '',
      waiting_minutes: r.status === 'pending' ? Math.round((t - r.created_at) / 60000) : null }));
  const extensions = db.prepare(extBase + " ORDER BY (er.status = 'pending') DESC, er.id DESC LIMIT 100").all()
    .map((r) => ({ id: r.id, kind: 'extension', reservation_id: r.reservation_id, status: r.status,
      created_at: r.created_at, decided_at: r.decided_at, extra_hours: r.extra_hours, extra_net: r.extra_net,
      traveler_name: r.traveler_name || '', place: r.place || '',
      reservation_status: r.reservation_status, translator_name: r.translator_name || '',
      waiting_minutes: r.status === 'pending' ? Math.round((t - r.created_at) / 60000) : null }));
  const all = changes.concat(extensions).sort((a, b) => (a.status === 'pending' ? 0 : 1) - (b.status === 'pending' ? 0 : 1) || b.created_at - a.created_at);
  send(res, 200, { changes: all.slice(0, 150), pending_count: all.filter((x) => x.status === 'pending').length });
});

// ---------- گزارش‌های عملیات (نمونه‌برداری از داشبوردهای استاندارد اعزام: نرخ تکمیل، زمان تطبیق، لغو، درآمد) ----------
route('GET', '/api/admin/reports', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'reports.view')) return;
  const q = new URL(req.url, 'http://x').searchParams;
  const days = [7, 30, 90].includes(Number(q.get('days'))) ? Number(q.get('days')) : 7;
  const since = now() - days * DAY_MS;
  const created = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM reservations WHERE created_at >= ?').get(since).n;
  const done = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM reservations WHERE status = 'done' AND created_at >= ?").get(since).n;
  const cancelled = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM reservations WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND created_at >= ?").get(since).n;
  const avgMatchRow = db.prepare('SELECT AVG(matched_at - created_at) AS a FROM reservations WHERE matched_at IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= ?').get(since);
  const byMethod = db.prepare(`SELECT COALESCE(pay_method, 'none') AS m, COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS sum
    FROM reservations WHERE created_at >= ? AND status IN ('finished','done') GROUP BY COALESCE(pay_method, 'none')`).all(since);
  const payout = db.prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net), 0) AS n FROM reservations WHERE created_at >= ? AND status = 'done'").get(since).n;
  const perDay = db.prepare(`SELECT date(created_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS d,
      SUM(CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS created,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled
    FROM reservations WHERE created_at >= ? GROUP BY d ORDER BY d`).all(since);
  const topTranslators = db.prepare(`SELECT r.translator_id AS id,
      COALESCE(json_extract(tp.profile, '$.first_name') || ' ' || json_extract(tp.profile, '$.last_name'), '') AS name,
      COUNT(*) AS missions, COALESCE(SUM(r.net), 0) AS net
    FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN translators tp ON tp.user_id = r.translator_id
    WHERE r.created_at >= ? AND r.status = 'done' AND r.translator_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.translator_id ORDER BY missions DESC LIMIT 8`).all(since);
  const newTranslators = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM users WHERE role = 'translator' AND created_at >= ?").get(since).n;
  const activeTranslators = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM translators WHERE status LIKE 'active_%'").get().n;
  send(res, 200, {
    days, generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    bookings: { created, done, cancelled,
      completion_rate: created ? Math.round((done / created) * 100) : null,
      cancel_rate: created ? Math.round((cancelled / created) * 100) : null,
      avg_match_minutes: avgMatchRow && avgMatchRow.a != null ? Math.round(avgMatchRow.a / 60000) : null },
    finance: { revenue_by_method: byMethod.map((x) => ({ method: x.m, count: x.n, total: x.sum })), translator_payout: payout },
    translators: { new_signups: newTranslators, active: activeTranslators },
    per_day: perDay,
    top_translators: topTranslators,
  });
});

// خروجی CSV رزروها (برای اکسل؛ با BOM تا فارسی درست باز شود)
route('GET', '/api/admin/reports.csv', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'reports.view')) return;
  const q = new URL(req.url, 'http://x').searchParams;
  const days = [7, 30, 90].includes(Number(q.get('days'))) ? Number(q.get('days')) : 30;
  const since = now() - days * DAY_MS;
  const rows = db.prepare(`SELECT r.id, r.created_at, r.kind, r.status, r.traveler_name, r.place, r.origin_lang, r.dest_lang,
      r.field, r.hours, r.car, r.total, r.net, r.pay_method, r.pay_state, r.scheduled_at,
      tu.phone AS translator_phone,
      COALESCE(json_extract(tp.profile, '$.first_name') || ' ' || json_extract(tp.profile, '$.last_name'), '') AS translator_name
    FROM reservations r
    LEFT JOIN users tu ON tu.id = r.translator_id
    LEFT JOIN translators tp ON tp.user_id = r.translator_id
    WHERE r.created_at >= ? ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 5000`).all(since);
  const esc = (v) => '"' + String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
  const head = ['id', 'created_at', 'kind', 'status', 'traveler_name', 'place', 'langs', 'field', 'hours', 'car', 'total', 'net', 'pay_method', 'pay_state', 'translator_name', 'translator_phone'];
  const lines = [head.join(',')];
  for (const r of rows) {
    lines.push([r.id, new Date(r.created_at).toISOString(), r.kind, r.status, esc(r.traveler_name), esc(r.place),
      r.origin_lang + '-' + r.dest_lang, r.field, r.hours, r.car ? 'yes' : 'no', r.total, r.net,
      r.pay_method || '', r.pay_state || '', esc(r.translator_name), r.translator_phone || ''].join(','));
  }
  audit('reports.export_csv', { days, rows: rows.length });
  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/csv; charset=utf-8', 'Content-Disposition': 'attachment; filename="hamrah-bookings.csv"', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' });
  res.end('\ufeff' + lines.join('\r\n'));
});

// ---------- پروندهٔ مسافر + مسدودسازی ----------
route('GET', '/api/admin/travelers/:id', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  const id = parseId(params.id);
  const u = id && db.prepare("SELECT id, phone, created_at, blocked FROM users WHERE id = ? AND role = 'traveler'").get(id);
  if (!u) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  const stats = db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled
    FROM reservations WHERE traveler_id = ?`).get(id);
  const reservations = db.prepare(`SELECT id, kind, status, place, origin_lang, dest_lang, total, net, pay_method, pay_state, created_at, scheduled_at
    FROM reservations WHERE traveler_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30`).all(id);
  send(res, 200, { traveler: { id: u.id, phone: u.phone, created_at: u.created_at, blocked: u.blocked === 1,
    reservations_total: stats.total || 0, done: stats.done || 0, cancelled: stats.cancelled || 0 },
    reservations });
});

// ---------- تعلیق/بازفعال‌سازی مترجم (نردبان پاسخ؛ بین «فعال» و «رد‌شده») ----------
route('POST', '/api/admin/translators/:id/suspend', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'translators.manage')) return;
  const id = parseId(params.id);
  const t = id && db.prepare('SELECT user_id, status FROM translators WHERE user_id = ?').get(id);
  if (!t) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  if (!String(t.status).startsWith('active_')) return send(res, 409, { error: 'not_active', status: t.status });
  const b = await readJson(req).catch(() => ({}));
  const reason = clip(b.reason, 200);
  if (!reason) return send(res, 400, { error: 'reason_required' });
  db.prepare('UPDATE translators SET status = ?, online = 0, updated_at = ? WHERE user_id = ?').run('suspended', now(), id);
  audit('translator.suspend', { id, reason });
  send(res, 200, { ok: true, status: 'suspended' });
});

route('POST', '/api/admin/translators/:id/reactivate', async (req, res, url, params) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'translators.manage')) return;
  const id = parseId(params.id);
  const t = id && db.prepare('SELECT user_id, status, interview FROM translators WHERE user_id = ?').get(id);
  if (!t) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  if (t.status !== 'suspended') return send(res, 409, { error: 'not_suspended', status: t.status });
  // بازگشت به وضعیت مؤثر: اگر گیت تخصص (مدرک زبان) باز باشد، active_specialized وگرنه active_general
  const st = t.interview === 'pass' && langCertOk({ user_id: id }) ? 'active_specialized' : 'active_general';
  db.prepare('UPDATE translators SET status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE user_id = ?').run(st, now(), id);
  audit('translator.reactivate', { id });
  send(res, 200, { ok: true, status: st });
});

// وضعیت اعلان فوری برای پنل: کلید عمومی VAPID + تعداد اشتراک‌ها + خطاهای اخیر
route('GET', '/api/admin/push', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'settings.manage')) return;
  const d = vapidDetails();
  const n = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM push_subscriptions').get().n;
  const byRole = db.prepare('SELECT role, COUNT(*) AS n FROM push_subscriptions GROUP BY role').all();
  const errs = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM push_subscriptions WHERE last_error IS NOT NULL').get().n;
  send(res, 200, { enabled: !!webpush && !!d, public_key: d ? d.publicKey : null, subscriptions: n, by_role: byRole, with_errors: errs });
});

// اعلان آزمایشی از پنل: بررسی زنده‌ی زنجیره‌ی پوش برای یک کاربر
route('POST', '/api/admin/push/test', async (req, res) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'settings.manage')) return;
  const b = await readJson(req).catch(() => ({}));
  const uid = Number(b && b.user_id);
  if (!Number.isInteger(uid) || uid <= 0) return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_user' });
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT id, role FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(uid);
  if (!u) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  const queued = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM push_subscriptions WHERE user_id = ?').get(uid).n;
  pushUser(uid, { title: 'اعلان آزمایشی پنل', body: String((b && b.text) || 'اگر این اعلان را می‌بینید، زنجیره‌ی اعلان فوری کار می‌کند.'), url: u.role === 'translator' ? '/translator/app.html' : '/traveler/app.html', tag: 'admin-test' });
  audit('push.test', { uid });
  send(res, 200, { ok: true, queued });
});

// پرداخت‌های درگاهی برای نمای مالی پنل
route('GET', '/api/admin/gateway-payments', async (req, res, url) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'finance.manage')) return;
  const rows = db.prepare(`SELECT g.id, g.reservation_id, g.provider, g.authority, g.amount, g.status, g.created_at, g.paid_at, g.ref_id,
    r.place, r.traveler_name FROM gateway_payments g LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.id = g.reservation_id ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT 100`).all();
  send(res, 200, { payments: rows.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, reservation_id: r.reservation_id, provider: r.provider,
    authority: r.authority, amount: r.amount, status: r.status, ref_id: r.ref_id, place: r.place, traveler_name: r.traveler_name,
    created_at: new Date(r.created_at).toISOString(), paid_at: r.paid_at ? new Date(r.paid_at).toISOString() : null })) });
});

route('GET', '/api/admin/audit', async (req, res, url) => {
  if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) return;
  if (!requirePerm(req, res, 'audit.view')) return;
  const lim = Math.min(Math.max(Number(url.searchParams.get('limit')) || 100, 1), 500);
  const rows = db.prepare('SELECT id, created_at, action, detail, actor FROM audit_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?').all(lim);
  send(res, 200, { entries: rows.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, at: new Date(r.created_at).toISOString(), action: r.action, detail: JSON.parse(r.detail), actor: r.actor || null })) });
});

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://x');
  const pathname = url.pathname;
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(securityHeaders(pathname, FRAME_ANCESTORS, SCRIPT_HASHES))) res.setHeader(k, v);
  if (!pathname.startsWith('/api/') && !pathname.startsWith('/pay/')) {
    if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') { res.writeHead(405); return res.end(); }
    return serveStatic(req, res, pathname);
  }
  let r = null, badParams = false; const params = {};
  for (const x of routes) {
    if (x.method !== req.method) continue;
    const m = pathname.match(x.re);
    if (m) {
      r = x;
      // رمزگشایی امن پارامترها: ورودی بدفرم ۴۰۰ می‌دهد، نه کرش پروسه (یافتهٔ بحرانی ۱)
      for (let i = 0; i < x.keys.length; i++) {
        const d = safeDecode(m[i + 1]);
        if (d === null) { badParams = true; break; }
        params[x.keys[i]] = d;
      }
      break;
    }
  }
  if (badParams) return send(res, 400, { error: 'invalid_encoding' });
  if (!r) return send(res, 404, { error: 'not_found' });
  try {
    if (pathname.startsWith('/api/admin/')) {
      const au = adminUserOf(req);
      await ADMIN_CTX.run({ admin: au }, async () => r.handler(req, res, url, params));
    } else {
      await r.handler(req, res, url, params);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    const status = e.status || 500;
    if (status === 500) console.error('[server]', e);
    if (!res.headersSent) send(res, status, { error: status === 500 ? 'server_error' : e.message });
  }
});

if (require.main === module) {
  // بررسی ایمنی پیکربندی انتشار بالاتر (ابتدای فایل) انجام شده است.
  setInterval(sweep, Math.max(100, 3000 * SCALE)).unref(); // موتور تطبیق هر ۳ ثانیه (در حالت فشرده کوتاه‌تر)
  server.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => {
    console.log(`همراه: http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}  (حالت توسعه: ${DEV ? 'روشن' : 'خاموش'}، پایگاه داده: ${DB_PATH})`);
    if (!DEV && !SMS.configured) console.log('هشدار: پیامک‌دهنده تنظیم نشده است (HZ_SMS_PROVIDER/HZ_SMS_API_KEY)؛ ارسال کد ورود پاسخ 503 می‌دهد.');
  });
}

module.exports = { server, db, CONFIG, normalizePhone };
