## `reference/tests/booking_options_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/booking_options_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"53b201b5a98652a447d3d45f034f7e0199616628f0e19ddb3869959db99d2e84"} -->
````````````````
"""Booking-form regression: selected options must reach storage and matching.

All booking/auth/matching requests use the real disposable HZ_DEV server. Only
public map services are stubbed. Scheduled cases set the browser clock to the
next day's midnight so the existing date picker is deterministic, including on
the last day of a month. The server clock is never changed.
"""
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import secrets

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api, booking

ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_booking_options'
SCHEDULE_SEARCH_COPY = {
    'fa': 'برای رزرو زمان‌دار، جست‌وجوی مترجم یک ساعت پیش از زمان انتخابی آغاز می‌شود. اگر تا ۱۵ دقیقه مانده مترجمی نپذیرد، وضعیت رزرو در برنامه به‌روزرسانی می‌شود.',
    'en': 'For a scheduled booking, interpreter search starts one hour before the selected time. If no interpreter has accepted by the 15-minute mark, the app updates the booking status.',
    'ar': 'في الحجز المجدول، يبدأ البحث عن مترجم قبل الموعد المحدد بساعة. إذا لم يقبل أي مترجم قبل ۱۵ دقيقة من الموعد، يحدّث التطبيق حالة الحجز.',
}
TIME_SLOT_WINDOW_COPY = {
    'fa': 'ساعت‌های فهرست‌شده: ۸ صبح تا ۹ شب',
    'en': 'Listed time slots: 8:00 AM–9:00 PM',
    'ar': 'الأوقات المدرجة: ٨:٠٠ صباحاً–٩:٠٠ مساءً',
}
TIME_SLOT_STEP_COPY = {
    'fa': 'انتخاب زمان با گام‌های ۳۰ دقیقه‌ای',
    'en': 'Select a time in 30-minute increments',
    'ar': 'اختر الوقت بفواصل ٣٠ دقيقة',
}
TIME_SLOT_FIRST_COPY = {'fa': '۰۸:۰۰ صبح', 'en': '8:00 AM', 'ar': '٨:٠٠ صباحاً'}
TIME_SLOT_LAST_COPY = {'fa': '۲۱:۰۰ شب', 'en': '9:00 PM', 'ar': '٩:٠٠ مساءً'}
INSTANT_MODE_COPY = {
    'fa': 'درخواست مترجم (اکنون)',
    'en': 'Request an interpreter now',
    'ar': 'طلب مترجم الآن',
}
INSTANT_SUBMIT_COPY = {
    'fa': 'ثبت درخواست مترجم',
    'en': 'Submit interpreter request',
    'ar': 'إرسال طلب مترجم',
}


async def login(request, role):
    phone = '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000)
    await api(request, 'POST', '/auth/request-code', data={'phone': phone, 'role': role})
    result = await api(request, 'POST', '/auth/verify',
                       data={'phone': phone, 'role': role, 'code': '123456'})
    return result['token'], phone


async def translator(request, gender):
    token, _ = await login(request, 'translator')
    # با گیت‌های واقعی CAP، دامنهٔ حوزه‌ها و باز بودن گیت تخصص باید صریح درخواست شود
    await api(request, 'POST', '/dev/approve-translator', token,
              {'fields': ['tourism', 'pilgrimage', 'medical', 'business', 'legal'], 'lang_cert': True})
    await api(request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', token,
              {'online': True, 'gender': gender, 'accept_any': False})
    return token


async def scenario(browser, kind, preference, lang):
    label = f'{kind}-{preference}-{lang}'
    ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844},
                                    timezone_id='UTC', service_workers='block')
    page = await ctx.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(20000)
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
    try:
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
        config = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/config')
        # Register the wrong candidate first: a silent fallback to 'any' would
        # offer a female-preference booking to the male traveler’s male candidate.
        wanted = 'female' if preference == 'female' else 'male'
        opposite = 'male' if wanted == 'female' else 'female'
        wrong = await translator(ctx.request, opposite)
        right = await translator(ctx.request, wanted)
        ptok, phone = await login(ctx.request, 'traveler')
        user = {'name': 'علی', 'last': 'رضایی', 'gender': 'مرد', 'phone': phone, 'lang': lang}
        await ctx.add_init_script(
            'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban.token.v1", ' + json.dumps(ptok) + ');'
            'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban.user.v1", ' + json.dumps(json.dumps(user)) + ');'
            'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban_lang", ' + json.dumps(lang) + ');')
        await ctx.route('https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/**',
                        lambda route: route.fulfill(json={'display_name': 'تهران، آزمون گزینه‌های رزرو'}))
        await ctx.route('https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org/**', lambda route: route.abort())
        if kind == 'scheduled':
            tomorrow = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=1)).replace(
                hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
            await page.clock.install(time=tomorrow)
        await page.goto(BASE + '/traveler/app.html')
        await expect(page.locator('#selected-location-title')).to_have_text('تهران، آزمون گزینه‌های رزرو')
        # Wait for live tariffs before comparing the UI estimate to the server total.
        await page.wait_for_function('() => typeof window.HZ_APPLY_CFG === "function" && !!window.HZ_NEAREST_CITY()')
        await expect(page.locator('#match-chance')).to_have_count(0)
        await page.locator('#confirm-location-btn').click()
        await expect(page.locator('#bottom-sheet')).to_be_visible()
        await expect(page.locator('#btn-mode-instant > span:last-child')).to_have_text(INSTANT_MODE_COPY[lang])
        await expect(page.locator('#txt-main-submit')).to_have_text(INSTANT_SUBMIT_COPY[lang])
        await page.locator('.cat-chip[data-cat=business]').click()
        await page.locator('#btn-inc-hours').click()  # 2 -> 3 hours
        await page.locator('#btn-inc-pax').click()  # 1 -> 2 passengers
        has_car = kind == 'scheduled'
        if not has_car:
            await page.locator('#btn-toggle-car').click()  # Default car -> pedestrian
        # Change away and back, including the 'any' case: the last selection wins.
        alternate = 'male' if preference != 'male' else 'female'
        await page.locator(f'.gender-btn[data-gender={alternate}]').click()
        await page.locator(f'.gender-btn[data-gender={preference}]').click()
        await expect(page.locator(f'.gender-btn[data-gender={preference}]')).to_have_attribute('aria-pressed', 'true')
        notes = f'گزینه‌های رزرو {label}'
        await page.locator('#notes-input').fill(notes)
        if kind == 'scheduled':
            await page.locator('#btn-mode-scheduled').click()
            await expect(page.locator('#scheduled-panel')).to_be_visible()
            await expect(page.locator('#scheduled-search-policy')).to_have_text(SCHEDULE_SEARCH_COPY[lang])
            await page.locator('#btn-open-timepicker').click()
            await expect(page.locator('#modal-timepicker')).to_be_visible()
            await expect(page.locator('#time-slot-step-policy')).to_have_text(TIME_SLOT_STEP_COPY[lang])
            await expect(page.locator('#time-selection-window-label')).to_have_text(TIME_SLOT_WINDOW_COPY[lang])
            slots = await page.locator('#time-slots-container button').all_text_contents()
            assert len(slots) == 27, (label, len(slots), slots)
            await expect(page.locator('#time-slots-container button').first).to_have_text(TIME_SLOT_FIRST_COPY[lang])
            await expect(page.locator('#time-slots-container button').last).to_have_text(TIME_SLOT_LAST_COPY[lang])
            await page.locator('#btn-cancel-time').click()
            await page.locator('#btn-mode-instant').click()
            await expect(page.locator('#scheduled-panel')).to_be_hidden()
            await expect(page.locator('#txt-main-submit')).to_have_text(INSTANT_SUBMIT_COPY[lang])
            await page.locator('#btn-mode-scheduled').click()
            await expect(page.locator('#scheduled-panel')).to_be_visible()
            await expect(page.locator('#scheduled-search-policy')).to_have_text(SCHEDULE_SEARCH_COPY[lang])
            await expect(page.locator('#match-chance')).to_have_count(0)
        # Read-only view of the form state; submission itself uses a real click.
        estimate = await page.evaluate('() => window.getBookingPricing(false).total')
        async with page.expect_response(lambda r: r.url.endswith('/api/traveler/bookings')
                                         and r.request.method == 'POST') as result:
            await page.locator('#btn-main-submit').click()
        response = await result.value
        assert response.status == 201, await response.text()
        sent = response.request.post_data_json
        for key, expected in {'kind': kind, 'gender_pref': preference, 'traveler_gender': 'male',
                              'category': 'business', 'hours': 3, 'car': has_car,
                              'party': 2, 'notes': notes, 'origin_lang': 'ar', 'dest_lang': 'fa'}.items():
            assert sent.get(key) == expected, (label, key, sent.get(key), expected)
        created = await response.json()
        stored = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, created['id'])
        assert stored['gender_pref'] == preference and stored['hours'] == 3, stored
        assert stored['field'] == 'business' and stored['notes'] == notes, stored
        assert stored['lat'] == sent['lat'] and stored['lng'] == sent['lng'], stored
        rates = config['tariffs']
        base = (rates['hourly']['business'] + int(has_car) * rates['car_fee_per_hour']) * 3
        tax = int(base * rates['tax_percent'] / 100 + 0.5)
        assert stored['base'] == base and stored['tax'] == tax, stored
        assert stored['total'] == base + tax == estimate, (stored, estimate)
        if kind == 'instant':
            assert stored['status'] == 'searching', stored
            other_offers = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/offers', wrong)
            right_offers = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/offers', right)
            assert not other_offers['offers'], (label, other_offers)
            assert len(right_offers['offers']) == 1, (label, right_offers)
            assert right_offers['offers'][0]['notes'] == notes, right_offers
            # Verify assignment too, not merely that the proper candidate sees an offer.
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/translator/offers/{right_offers['offers'][0]['id']}/accept", right)
            assert (await booking(ctx.request, ptok, stored['id']))['matched'] is True
        else:
            assert stored['status'] == 'waiting_schedule' and not stored['matched'], stored
            assert stored['scheduled_at'] == sent['scheduled_at'], (stored, sent)
        cancelled = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/traveler/bookings/{stored['id']}/cancel", ptok)
        assert cancelled['ok'], cancelled
        assert not errors, errors
        print(f'PASS: {label}; selected options, full price and assignment verified')
    except Exception:
        print(label, 'JavaScript errors:', errors)
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / f'{label}.png'), full_page=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise
    finally:
        await ctx.close()


async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            for kind in ('instant', 'scheduled'):
                for preference, lang in (('female', 'fa'), ('male', 'en'), ('any', 'ar')):
                    await scenario(browser, kind, preference, lang)
        finally:
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())

````````````````
````````````````
# تست یکپارچه‌ی دو اپ: مسافر رزرو می‌سازد، مترجم پیشنهاد را می‌بیند و می‌پذیرد، و وضعیت به اپ مسافر برمی‌گردد.
import asyncio, re, json, random
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8081'
import urllib.request
urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(BASE + '/api/dev/offline-all', method='POST'), timeout=10).read()  # فقط توسعه: پاک‌سازی مترجمان و رزروهای باز قبلی
TRAV_LOGIN = """async (phone) => {
  const H = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'};
  await fetch('/api/auth/request-code', {method:'POST', headers:H, body: JSON.stringify({phone, role:'traveler'})});
  const v = await (await fetch('/api/auth/verify', {method:'POST', headers:H, body: JSON.stringify({phone, role:'traveler', code:'123456'})})).json();
  localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.token.v1', v.token);
  localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.user.v1', JSON.stringify({name:'علی', last:'رضایی', gender:'مرد', phone}));
  return v.token;
}"""

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        route = lambda ctx: ctx.route(re.compile(r'https://(unpkg\.com|cdn\.|fonts\.).*'), lambda r: r.abort())
        # ---- مترجم: فعال و آنلاین ----
        tctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900}); await route(tctx)
        T = await tctx.new_page(); terr = []; T.on('pageerror', lambda e: terr.append(str(e)[:120]))
        await T.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html'); await T.wait_for_timeout(600)
        tphone = '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999))
        await T.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, tphone)
        await T.evaluate("async()=>{const t=HZ.load().token; await fetch('/api/translator/online',{method:'PATCH',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',Authorization:'Bearer '+t},body:JSON.stringify({online:true})});}")
        # ---- مسافر: ورود و رزرو فوری ----
        pctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900}); await route(pctx)
        P = await pctx.new_page(); perr = []; P.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)[:120]))
        await P.goto(BASE + '/traveler/index.html'); await P.wait_for_timeout(500)
        await P.evaluate(TRAV_LOGIN, '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999)))
        await P.goto(BASE + '/traveler/app.html'); await P.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        place = 'تست همگام‌سازی ' + str(random.randint(100, 999))
        created = await P.evaluate("""async (place)=>{const t=localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.token.v1');
            const r=await fetch('/api/traveler/bookings',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',Authorization:'Bearer '+t},
              body:JSON.stringify({kind:'instant',origin_lang:'ar',dest_lang:'fa',place,traveler_name:'علی رضایی'})});
            return {status:r.status, body: await r.json()};}""", place)
        print('booking created:', created['status'], created['body'].get('status'))
        # ---- مترجم: پیشنهاد را می‌بیند و می‌پذیرد ----
        await T.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html'); await T.wait_for_timeout(4500)
        offer_text = await T.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('offers-box').textContent")
        print('translator sees offer:', place in offer_text)
        # برچسب واقعی دکمهٔ پذیرش «پذیرش مأموریت و اعزام» است (aria-label)؛ سلکتور قدیمی «پذیرش» منسوخ شده بود
        await T.evaluate("""()=>{const box=document.getElementById('offers-box'); const btn=[...box.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-label')==='پذیرش مأموریت و اعزام'); btn && btn.click();}""")
        await T.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        missions = await T.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('missions-list').textContent")
        print('translator mission listed:', place in missions)
        # ---- مسافر: وضعیت باید همگام شود ----
        await P.wait_for_timeout(6500)
        bk = await P.evaluate("()=>JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1')||'[]')")
        mine = [x for x in bk if x.get('place') == place]
        print('traveler local status:', mine[0].get('statusLabel') if mine else 'missing', '| tab:', mine[0].get('tab') if mine else '-')
        dbg = await P.evaluate("async()=>{const t=localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.token.v1'); const r=await fetch('/api/traveler/bookings',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+t}}); return {api:(await r.json()).bookings.map(b=>b.status), tokenLen:(t||'').length, local: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1')||'[]').map(x=>[x.serverId,x.srvStatus,x.statusLabel])};}")
        print('debug:', json.dumps(dbg, ensure_ascii=False))
        ok = bool(mine) and mine[0].get('statusLabel') == 'مترجم تطبیق یافت'
        print('RESULT:', 'PASS' if ok and place in offer_text else 'FAIL', '| errors:', [e for e in terr + perr if 'tailwind' not in e] or 'none')
        await b.close()
        raise SystemExit(0 if (ok and place in offer_text) else 1)
asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

````````````````
# کارت تمدید باید همیشه روی صفحه‌ی تایمر (مرحله‌ی ۵) باشد، نه فقط در نیم ساعت پایانی.
# دکمه‌ی تمدید داخل کارت تمدید است و هشدار نیم ساعت آخر دکمه ندارد.
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def m():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844})
        pg = await ctx.new_page(); errs = []
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:140]))
        await pg.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081/traveler/index.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(400)
        await pg.evaluate("()=>{localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.user.v1', JSON.stringify({name:'Ali',last:'Rezaei',gender:'male',contact:'+98 912 345 6789',lang:'fa',passport:null}));localStorage.setItem('hamzaban_lang','fa')}")
        await pg.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081/traveler/app.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        info = await pg.evaluate("""()=>{
          var card = document.getElementById('extension-card');
          var btn = document.getElementById('btn-extend-one-hour');
          var warn = document.getElementById('expiry-warning');
          var stage5 = document.getElementById('stage-5');
          return {
            cardInStage5: !!(card && stage5 && stage5.contains(card)),
            btnInCard: !!(btn && card && card.contains(btn)),
            btnText: btn ? btn.innerText : '',
            warnHasButton: warn ? !!warn.querySelector('button') : null,
            cardHidden: card ? card.classList.contains('hidden') : null,
            statusEl: !!document.getElementById('extension-status')
          };
        }""")
        print(info)
        print('extension card always on timer page:', info['cardInStage5'] and info['btnInCard'] and not info['cardHidden'])
        print('extend button label ok:', 'تمدید خدمت' in info['btnText'])
        print('warning has no button:', info['warnHasButton'] is False)
        print('status element exists:', info['statusEl'])
        print('errors:', [e for e in errs if 'tailwind' not in e] or 'none')
        assert info['cardInStage5'] and info['btnInCard'] and not info['cardHidden'], info
        assert 'تمدید خدمت' in info['btnText'], info
        assert info['warnHasButton'] is False and info['statusEl'], info
        assert not errs, errs
        await b.close()

asyncio.run(m())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/features_ui.py`

````````````````
# تست امکانات از سرور در هر سه اپ: خاموش‌کردن امکان در پنل مدیر باید بخش مربوط را در اپ‌ها پنهان یا غیرفعال کند.
import asyncio, re, json, random, sys, urllib.request
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'http://127.0.0.1:8098'
PASSWORD = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'test-admin-pass'
results = []
def check(name, ok):
    results.append(bool(ok))
    print(('  ok   ' if ok else '  FAIL ') + name)

def api(method, path, body=None, token=None):
    h = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
    if token: h['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + token
    rq = urllib.request.Request(BASE + '/api' + path, method=method, headers=h,
                                data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(rq, timeout=10) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read() or b'{}')
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, json.loads(e.read() or b'{}')

TRAV_LOGIN = """async (phone) => {
  const H = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'};
  await fetch('/api/auth/request-code', {method:'POST', headers:H, body: JSON.stringify({phone, role:'traveler'})});
  const v = await (await fetch('/api/auth/verify', {method:'POST', headers:H, body: JSON.stringify({phone, role:'traveler', code:'123456'})})).json();
  localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.token.v1', v.token);
  localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.user.v1', JSON.stringify({name:'علی', last:'رضایی', gender:'مرد', phone}));
  return v.token;
}"""
TR_LOGIN = """async ([phone, token]) => {
  const st = HZ.load(); st.token = token; st.session = {phone, until: Date.now() + 3600e3};
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) st.completed[i] = true; st.status = 'active_general'; st.profile = {nameFa: 'نازنین', lastFa: 'تست'}; HZ.save(st); return true;
}"""

def disp(page, sel):
    return page.evaluate("(s)=>{const e=document.querySelector(s); return e ? getComputedStyle(e).display : 'missing'}", sel)

async def main():
    _, adm = api('POST', '/admin/login', {'password': PASSWORD})
    atok = adm['token']
    off = {'booking_convert': False, 'expiry_notifications': False, 'instant_booking': False, 'car_mode': False, 'translator_online': False,
           'interview_scheduling': False, 'translator_registration': False}
    s, r = api('PUT', '/admin/features', off, atok)
    check('خاموش‌کردن امکان‌ها از API پذیرفته شد', s == 200)
    s, r = api('POST', '/traveler/bookings', None, None)  # بدون نشست: باید رد شود (احراز هویت)
    check('بدون نشست، رزرو پذیرفته نمی‌شود', s == 401)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900})
        await ctx.route(re.compile(r'https://(unpkg\.com|cdn\.|fonts\.).*'), lambda r: r.abort())
        pg = await ctx.new_page(); errs = []
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:140]))
        # ورود مسافر
        await pg.goto(BASE + '/traveler/index.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(900)
        # تب ایمیل دیگر پنهان نیست؛ به‌جای آن صادقانه «(غیرفعال)» برچسب خورده است (هم‌راستا با سیاست متن)
        email_tab_label = await pg.text_content('#tab-email')
        check('زبانهٔ ایمیل ورود صریحاً غیرفعال اعلام می‌شود (' + repr(email_tab_label) + ')', 'غیرفعال' in (email_tab_label or ''))
        phone = '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999))
        await pg.evaluate(TRAV_LOGIN, phone)
        await pg.goto(BASE + '/traveler/app.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        check('دکمه‌ی حالت فوری پنهان است', await disp(pg, '#btn-mode-instant') == 'none')
        check('دکمه‌ی زمان‌دار نمایش داده می‌شود', await disp(pg, '#btn-mode-scheduled') != 'none')
        check('انتخاب خودرو پنهان است', await disp(pg, '#btn-toggle-car') == 'none')
        check('ثبت رزرو نشان داده شده ولی فعال است', await pg.evaluate("()=>!document.getElementById('btn-main-submit').disabled"))
        # مترجم: ثبت‌نام و آنلاین
        await pg.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(900)
        note = await pg.evaluate("()=>document.body.innerText.includes('ثبت‌نام مترجمان فعلاً بسته است')")
        check('پیام بسته‌بودن ثبت‌نام مترجم نمایش داده می‌شود', note)
        cities_ui = await pg.evaluate("()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#cityList button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim())")
        cities_api = api('GET', '/config')[1].get('translator_cities', [])
        check('چیپ‌های شهر مترجم از سرور ساخته شده‌اند', len(cities_ui) == len(cities_api) and len(cities_api) > 0 and all(c['name_fa'] in cities_ui for c in cities_api))
        check('دکمه‌های ثبت‌نام غیرفعال‌اند', await pg.evaluate(
            "()=>{const bs=[...document.querySelectorAll('[onclick*=\"finishRegistration\"]')]; return bs.length===0 || bs.every(x=>x.disabled)}"))
        tphone = '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999))
        await pg.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(500)
        await pg.evaluate(TR_LOGIN, [tphone, 'x'])  # حالت ساده برای بارگذاری میز کار
        await pg.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        check('کارت مصاحبه در میز کار پنهان است', await disp(pg, '#iv-box') == 'none')
        check('کلید آنلاین پنهان است', await disp(pg, '[aria-label="تغییر وضعیت آماده به خدمت"]') == 'none')
        check('خطای صفحه‌ها', not errs)
        # سمت سرور: رزرو فوری خاموش باید رد شود
        tok = await pg.evaluate("()=>localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.token.v1')")
        s, r = api('POST', '/traveler/bookings', {'kind': 'instant', 'origin_lang': 'ar', 'dest_lang': 'fa', 'place': 'تست', 'traveler_name': 'x'}, tok) if tok else (0, {})
        check('سرور رزرو فوری خاموش را رد می‌کند', s == 409 and r.get('error') == 'feature_disabled')
        await b.close()
    # بازگردانی
    on = {k: True for k in off}
    api('PUT', '/admin/features', on, atok)
    failed = results.count(False)
    print(f'نتیجه: {results.count(True)} موفق، {failed} ناموفق')
    sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)

asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/finish_flow_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/finish_flow_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"63e8039efff5e20154ff03ccfa27d4766d46c7db4f53178c8633bc031425367c"} -->
````````````````
"""Real-browser regression: translator requests, traveler rejects/approves or finishes early.

Requires a disposable HZ_DEV=1 server. Fails with a nonzero exit code on any
unexpected API response, missing control, JavaScript error, or wrong billed total
(ساعت‌های صورت‌حساب = سقف خدمت واقعی با کف یک ساعت؛ مبلغ اولیه در list_total).
"""
import asyncio
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import secrets

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

BASE = os.environ.get('BASE', 'http://127.0.0.1:8081').rstrip('/')
INVOICE_SOURCE_LABELS = {'fa': 'جزئیات رزرو', 'en': 'Booking details', 'ar': 'تفاصيل الحجز'}
ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_finish_flow'


async def api(request, method, path, token=None, data=None, status=200):
    headers = {'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token} if token else {}
    response = await request.fetch(BASE + '/api' + path, method=method,
                                   headers=headers, data=data)
    body = await response.json()
    assert response.status == status, (method, path, response.status, body)
    return body


async def booking(request, token, bid):
    body = await api(request, 'GET', '/traveler/bookings', token)
    return next(b for b in body['bookings'] if b['id'] == bid)


async def arrive_and_start(request, bid, translator_token, code):
    await api(request, 'POST', f'/translator/missions/{bid}/arrive', translator_token)
    return await api(request, 'POST', f'/translator/missions/{bid}/verify-code',
                     translator_token, {'code': code})


async def scenario(browser, own_finish):
    label = 'traveler-early-finish' if own_finish else 'reject-then-approve'
    category = 'business' if own_finish else 'legal'
    traveler_ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844},
                                             service_workers='block')
    translator_ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844},
                                               service_workers='block')
    pages = []
    errors = []
    try:
        await api(traveler_ctx.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
        translator = await translator_ctx.new_page()
        traveler = await traveler_ctx.new_page()
        pages = [('traveler', traveler), ('translator', translator)]
        for _, page in pages:
            page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
            page.set_default_timeout(20000)
        # Server-authenticated translator; test-only approval, never a production bypass.
        await translator.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        ttok = await translator.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000))
        assert ttok, 'Translator login failed'
        await api(translator_ctx.request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', ttok, {'online': True})

        phone = '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000)
        await api(traveler_ctx.request, 'POST', '/auth/request-code',
                  data={'phone': phone, 'role': 'traveler'})
        login = await api(traveler_ctx.request, 'POST', '/auth/verify',
                          data={'phone': phone, 'role': 'traveler', 'code': '123456'})
        ptok = login['token']
        user = {'name': 'علی', 'last': 'رضایی', 'gender': 'مرد', 'phone': phone, 'lang': 'fa'}
        await traveler_ctx.add_init_script(
            'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban.token.v1", ' + json.dumps(ptok) + ');'
            'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban.user.v1", ' + json.dumps(json.dumps(user)) + ');'
            'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban_lang", "fa");')
        # The booking/finish test must not depend on the availability or rate limits
        # of public map servers. Only geocoding is stubbed; all app APIs stay real.
        await traveler_ctx.route('https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/**',
                                  lambda route: route.fulfill(json={'display_name': 'تهران، محل آزمون مرورگر'}))
        await traveler_ctx.route('https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org/**', lambda route: route.abort())
        await traveler.goto(BASE + '/traveler/app.html')
        await expect(traveler.locator('#selected-location-title')).to_have_text('تهران، محل آزمون مرورگر')
        await traveler.locator('#confirm-location-btn').click()
        await expect(traveler.locator('#bottom-sheet')).to_be_visible()
        await traveler.locator(f'.cat-chip[data-cat={category}]').click()
        await traveler.locator('#btn-toggle-car').click()  # Default is car; test translator is pedestrian.
        # Actual booking button and actual server synchronization, not a local FSM shortcut.
        async with traveler.expect_response(lambda r: r.url.endswith('/api/traveler/bookings')
                                             and r.request.method == 'POST') as result:
            await traveler.locator('#btn-main-submit').click()
        response = await result.value
        assert response.status == 201, await response.text()
        created = await response.json()
        assert created['field'] == category, created
        sent = response.request.post_data_json
        assert sent['category'] == category and sent['car'] is False, sent
        bid, total = created['id'], created['total']
        assert total > 0
        offers = await api(translator_ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/offers', ttok)
        assert len(offers['offers']) == 1, offers
        offer = offers['offers'][0]
        await api(translator_ctx.request, 'POST', f"/translator/offers/{offer['id']}/accept", ttok)
        await expect(traveler.locator('#stage-3')).to_be_visible()
        await traveler.locator('#btn-arrived').click()
        await expect(traveler.locator('#stage-4')).to_be_visible()
        await arrive_and_start(translator_ctx.request, bid, ttok, created['service_code'])
        await expect(traveler.locator('#stage-5')).to_be_visible()
        await expect(traveler.locator('#extension-card')).to_be_visible()
        await expect(traveler.locator('#finish-request-banner')).to_be_hidden()
        assert (await booking(traveler_ctx.request, ptok, bid))['total'] == total

        async def request_finish():
            await translator.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
            # The signed-in landing view is the mission map and its bottom sheet.
            await expect(translator.locator('#missions-list').get_by_role('button', name='لغو ماموریت', exact=True)).to_have_count(0)
            button = translator.locator('#missions-list').get_by_role('button', name='درخواست پایان مأموریت', exact=True)
            await button.click()
            confirm = translator.locator('#mission-finish-confirm')
            async with translator.expect_response(lambda r: r.url.endswith(f'/missions/{bid}/finish')
                                                   and r.request.method == 'POST') as result:
                await confirm.click()
            response = await result.value
            assert response.status == 202, await response.text()
            await expect(traveler.locator('#finish-request-banner')).to_be_visible()
            pending = await booking(traveler_ctx.request, ptok, bid)
            assert pending['status'] == 'matched' and pending['finish_requested']
            assert pending['total'] == total
            # No payment may be recorded while only the translator has requested an end.
            await api(traveler_ctx.request, 'POST', f'/traveler/bookings/{bid}/payment', ptok,
                      {'method': 'cash'}, status=409)

        if not own_finish:
            await request_finish()
            async with traveler.expect_response(lambda r: r.url.endswith(f'/{bid}/finish-reject')) as result:
                await traveler.locator('#btn-reject-finish').click()
            assert (await result.value).status == 200
            await expect(traveler.locator('#finish-request-banner')).to_be_hidden()
            await expect(traveler.locator('#stage-5')).to_be_visible()
            continuing = await booking(traveler_ctx.request, ptok, bid)
            assert continuing['status'] == 'matched' and not continuing['finish_requested']
            assert continuing['total'] == total
            await request_finish()
            suffix, control, finished_by = 'finish-approve', '#btn-approve-finish', 'translator'
        else:
            suffix, control, finished_by = 'finish', '#btn-finish-service', 'traveler'

        async with traveler.expect_response(lambda r: r.url.endswith(f'/{bid}/{suffix}')
                                             and r.request.method == 'POST') as result:
            await traveler.locator(control).click()
        response = await result.value
        assert response.status == 200, await response.text()
        await expect(traveler.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_visible()
        current_language = 'fa'
        for language, invoice_copy in INVOICE_SOURCE_LABELS.items():
            if language != current_language:
                await traveler.locator('nav a[data-nav="account"]').click()
                await traveler.locator('#hz-lang-select').select_option(language)
                await traveler.locator('nav a[data-nav="map"]').click()
                current_language = language
            await expect(traveler.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_visible()
            await expect(traveler.locator('#invoice-source-label')).to_have_text(invoice_copy)
            invoice_text = await traveler.locator('#stage-6').inner_text()
            for unsupported_label in ('تأیید طرفین', 'Both parties confirm', 'تأكيد الطرفين'):
                assert unsupported_label not in invoice_text, f'unsupported mutual-confirmation claim remains in {language}: {unsupported_label}'
        final = await booking(traveler_ctx.request, ptok, bid)
        assert final['status'] == 'finished' and final['finished_by'] == finished_by
        # پایان زودهنگام با خدمت چندثانیه‌ای: کف یک ساعت صورتحساب می‌شود و مبلغ اولیه محفوظ می‌ماند
        assert final['billed_hours'] == 1 and final['total'] <= total and final['list_total'] == total, \
            'Early finish must bill the actual served duration (min one hour), keeping list_total'
        assert not errors, errors
        print(f'PASS: {label}; duration-based billing ({final["total"]}, first quote {total} kept as list_total); neutral invoice label in all three languages')
    except Exception:
        print('JavaScript errors:', errors)
        for name, page in pages:
            try:
                print(name, 'URL:', page.url)
                print(name, 'UI:', (await page.locator('body').inner_text())[-600:])
            except Exception:
                pass
        if 'ttok' in locals():
            print('Server missions:', await api(translator_ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/missions', ttok))
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for name, page in pages:
            try:
                await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / f'{label}-{name}.png'), full_page=True)
            except Exception:
                pass  # Preserve the original assertion/timeout, not a screenshot error.
        raise
    finally:
        await traveler_ctx.close()
        await translator_ctx.close()


async def main():
    # App synchronization runs every 5s and the FSM every 1s. Playwright's
    # default assertion timeout is only 5s (independent of page timeouts).
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser, own_finish=False)
            await scenario(browser, own_finish=True)
        finally:
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

````````````````
# کمک‌های مشترک تست مترجم: ورود از طریق API سرور و تزریق ماموریت (فقط تست)
LOGIN_JS = """async (phone) => {
  const H = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'};
  await fetch('/api/auth/request-code', {method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({phone, role: 'translator'})});
  const v = await (await fetch('/api/auth/verify', {method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({phone, role: 'translator', code: '123456'})})).json();
  if (!v.token) return null;
  const st = HZ.load(); st.token = v.token; st.session = {phone, until: Date.now() + 3600e3}; st.completed[1] = true; HZ.save(st);
  // گیت‌های CAP واقعی‌اند: دامنهٔ همهٔ حوزه‌ها + باز کردن گیت تخصص باید صریح درخواست شود
  await fetch('/api/dev/approve-translator', {method: 'POST',
    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + v.token},
    body: JSON.stringify({fields: ['tourism', 'pilgrimage', 'medical', 'business', 'legal'], lang_cert: true})});
  st.status = 'active_general'; st.profile = {nameFa: 'علی', lastFa: 'رضایی'}; HZ.save(st);
  return v.token;
}"""
SEED_JS = """async ([token, list]) => {
  for (const m of list) {
    await fetch('/api/dev/missions', {method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token}, body: JSON.stringify(m)});
  }
  return true;
}"""
````````````````

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/login_flow.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"7d83252334e58edc0f905c94a66feae5d71c195dc922f20db8a8b91d3023ee47"} -->
````````````````
import random
RANDPHONE = '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999))  # شماره‌ی تازه برای هر اجرا (محدودیت ارسال مجدد)
import asyncio, re, json, sys
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
lang = sys.argv[1]
ANY = re.compile(r'[\u0600-\u06FF]'); PF = re.compile(r'[پچژگک۰-۹]')
DIG = re.compile(r'^[\s\d۰-۹٠-٩.,:٫٬/%٪\-+()~$]*$')
async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch()
        ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844})
        await ctx.route(re.compile(r'https://(unpkg\.com|fonts\.googleapis\.com|fonts\.gstatic\.com).*'), lambda r: r.abort())
        pg = await ctx.new_page(); errs=[]
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:140]))
        await pg.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081/traveler/index.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(800)
        await pg.evaluate("l=>{localStorage.setItem('hamzaban_lang',l); location.reload()}", lang)
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(1000)
        left = {}
        async def scan(step):
            texts = await pg.evaluate("""()=>{const o=[];const w=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);let n;
              while(n=w.nextNode()){const t=n.nodeValue.trim(); if(!t) continue; const el=n.parentElement;
              if(!el||el.closest('script,style,option')||!el.getClientRects().length) continue; if(getComputedStyle(el).visibility==='hidden') continue; o.push(t)}
              document.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(i=>{ if(i.placeholder&&i.getClientRects().length) o.push(i.placeholder)});
              document.querySelectorAll('[title],[aria-label]').forEach(i=>{ if(i.getClientRects().length){ if(i.title) o.push(i.title); if(i.getAttribute('aria-label')) o.push(i.getAttribute('aria-label'))}});
              return o;}""")
            for t in texts:
                if DIG.match(t) or len(t)<2: continue
                if (lang=='en' and ANY.search(t)) or (lang=='ar' and PF.search(t)): left.setdefault(t, step)
        async def toast_or_alert():
            return await pg.evaluate("()=>{const a=document.getElementById('auth-alert');const e=document.getElementById('ident-err');const o=document.getElementById('otp-err');return [a&&!a.classList.contains('hidden')?a.textContent.trim():'',e&&!e.classList.contains('hidden')?e.textContent.trim():'',o&&!o.classList.contains('hidden')?o.textContent.trim():''].filter(Boolean).join(' | ')}")
        res=[]
        await scan('login-start')
        # step 1: send code without consents
        res.append(('send disabled without consents', await pg.is_disabled('#btn-request-otp'))); await scan('err-no-consent')
        # phone invalid
        await pg.fill('#phone-input', '12'); await pg.check('#check-age'); await pg.check('#check-terms')
        res.append(('invalid phone disabled', await pg.is_disabled('#btn-request-otp')))
        await pg.fill('#phone-input', RANDPHONE)
        await pg.click('#btn-request-otp', timeout=2000); await pg.wait_for_timeout(600)
        res.append(('step after send', await pg.evaluate("()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#step-identity,#step-otp,#step-identifier')].map(e=>e.id+':'+(e.classList.contains('hidden')?'hidden':'shown')).join(' ')")))
        await scan('otp-step')
        # wrong code then demo fill
        res.append(('verify disabled when empty', await pg.is_disabled('#btn-verify'))); await scan('otp-err')
        await pg.click('button[onclick="fillTestCode()"]', timeout=2000); await pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
        res.append(('after demo fill', await pg.evaluate("()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#otp-inputs-wrapper input')].map(i=>i.value).join('')")))
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(600)
        if await pg.is_visible('#btn-verify'):
            await pg.click('#btn-verify', timeout=2000); await pg.wait_for_timeout(900)
        res.append(('after verify step', await pg.evaluate("()=>['step-identity','step-otp','step-identifier'].map(i=>i+':'+(document.getElementById(i).classList.contains('hidden')?'hidden':'shown')).join(' ')")))
        if await pg.is_visible('#step-identity'):
            await scan('identity-step')
            res.append(('save disabled empty', await pg.is_disabled('#id-save')))
            await pg.fill('#id-name', 'Ali'); await pg.fill('#id-last', 'Rezaei')
            await pg.locator('.id-gender').nth(1).click(); await pg.wait_for_timeout(200)
            await scan('identity-filled')
            await pg.click('#id-save', timeout=2000); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        res.append(('after verify url', pg.url.split('/')[-1]))
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(800)
        res.append(('app dir/lang', await pg.evaluate("()=>document.documentElement.dir+' '+(localStorage.getItem('hamzaban_lang')||'-')")))
        print('== %s' % lang)
        for k,v in res: print('  %-28s %s' % (k, v))
        print('  errors:', errs or 'none')
        print('  left:', len(left))
        for k,v in left.items(): print('    [%s] %s' % (v,k[:110]))
        await b.close()
asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/logout_sessions_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/logout_sessions_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"d12413bedfc37a37679c0c563579f2ffc67fa31ef82cafd6150c54b402894a3c"} -->
````````````````
"""Real server revocation: single-device versus all-device traveler logout.

Three independent browser contexts share one account; another account stays
unaffected. Failed/unconfirmed requests preserve retryability, duplicate clicks
are guarded, and revoked peer devices return to sign-in on their next API sync.
"""
import asyncio
import json
from pathlib import Path
import secrets

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api

ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_logout_sessions'
FAILURE = {
    'fa': 'خروج ثبت نشد. اتصال اینترنت را بررسی کنید و دوباره تلاش کنید.',
    'en': 'Sign-out was not confirmed. Check your connection and try again.',
    'ar': 'لم يتم تأكيد الخروج. تحقّق من اتصال الإنترنت وحاول مجدداً.',
}
EXPIRED = {
    'fa': 'نشست شما پایان یافته است. لطفاً دوباره وارد شوید.',
    'en': 'Your session has ended. Please sign in again.',
    'ar': 'انتهت جلستك. يرجى تسجيل الدخول مجدداً.',
}


async def sign_in(request, phone):
    await api(request, 'POST', '/auth/request-code', data={'phone': phone, 'role': 'traveler'})
    return await api(request, 'POST', '/auth/verify', data={'phone': phone, 'role': 'traveler', 'code': '123456'})


async def seeded_context(browser, session, lang, errors):
    ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844}, service_workers='block')
    await ctx.route('https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/**', lambda r: r.fulfill(json={'display_name': 'تهران، آزمون خروج'}))
    await ctx.route('https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org/**', lambda r: r.abort())
    page = await ctx.new_page()
    page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
    page.set_default_timeout(20000)
    await page.goto(BASE + '/traveler/index.html')
    profile = {'name': 'Ali', 'last': 'Rezaei', 'gender': 'مرد',
               'phone': session['user']['phone'], 'authUserId': session['user']['id']}
    # Do not inject credentials with add_init_script: logout must really clear them.
    await page.evaluate("""([token, profile, lang]) => {
        localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.token.v1', token);
        localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.user.v1', JSON.stringify(profile));
        localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1', '[]');
        localStorage.setItem('hamzaban_lang', lang);
    }""", [session['token'], profile, lang])
    await page.goto(BASE + '/traveler/app.html')
    await page.wait_for_function('() => window.hzBookingsSynced === true')
    await page.locator('nav a[data-nav=account]').click()
    return ctx, page


async def assert_cleared(page, lang):
    await expect(page).to_have_url(BASE + '/traveler/index.html')
    await expect(page.locator('#step-identifier')).to_be_visible()
    stored = await page.evaluate("""() => [
        localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.token.v1'), localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.user.v1'),
        localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1'), localStorage.getItem('hamzaban_lang')
    ]""")
    assert stored == [None, None, None, lang], stored


async def scenario(browser, lang):
    setup = await browser.new_context()
    contexts, pages, errors = [], [], []
    release = asyncio.Event()
    try:
        phone = '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000)
        sessions = [await sign_in(setup.request, phone) for _ in range(3)]
        outsider = await sign_in(setup.request, '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000))
        for session in sessions:
            ctx, page = await seeded_context(browser, session, lang, errors)
            contexts.append(ctx)
            pages.append(page)
        a, b, c = pages
        # An offline single-device attempt must not claim success or erase the token.
        async def offline(route):
            await route.abort('internetdisconnected')
        await a.route('**/api/auth/logout', offline)
        await a.locator('#ac-logout').click()
        await expect(a.locator('#ac-logout')).to_be_enabled()
        await expect(a.locator('#toast-text')).to_have_text(FAILURE[lang])
        assert await a.evaluate("() => localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.token.v1')") == sessions[0]['token']
        await api(setup.request, 'GET', '/auth/me', sessions[0]['token'])
        await a.unroute('**/api/auth/logout', offline)

        # Hold the real request, then try both buttons again via synthetic events.
        arrived, requests = asyncio.Event(), []
        async def delayed(route):
            requests.append(route.request.url)
            arrived.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.continue_()
        await a.route('**/api/auth/logout', delayed)
        await a.locator('#ac-logout').click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(arrived.wait(), 20)
        for selector in ['#ac-logout', '#ac-logout-all']:
            await expect(a.locator(selector)).to_be_disabled()
        await expect(a.locator('#ac-logout')).to_have_attribute('aria-busy', 'true')
        await a.evaluate("""() => ['ac-logout','ac-logout-all'].forEach(id =>
            document.getElementById(id).dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {bubbles:true})))""")
        assert len(requests) == 1
        await api(setup.request, 'GET', '/auth/me', sessions[0]['token'])
        release.set()
        await assert_cleared(a, lang)
        await api(setup.request, 'GET', '/auth/me', sessions[0]['token'], status=401)
        for session in sessions[1:]:
            await api(setup.request, 'GET', '/auth/me', session['token'])
        assert len(requests) == 1
        print(f'PASS [{lang}]: single-device logout revokes only that session, clears private cache and guards duplicate clicks')

        # Both server failure and a superficially successful but unconfirmed JSON
        # response must retain credentials and keep all other sessions valid.
        for status, payload in [(503, {'error': 'unavailable'}), (200, {})]:
            async def failure(route, _request, *, status=status, payload=payload):
                await route.fulfill(status=status, json=payload)
            await b.route('**/api/auth/logout-all', failure)
            await b.locator('#ac-logout-all').click()
            await expect(b.locator('#ac-logout-all')).to_be_enabled()
            await expect(b.locator('#toast-text')).to_have_text(FAILURE[lang])
            assert b.url.endswith('/app.html')
            assert await b.evaluate("() => localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.token.v1')") == sessions[1]['token']
            await api(setup.request, 'GET', '/auth/me', sessions[1]['token'])
            await api(setup.request, 'GET', '/auth/me', sessions[2]['token'])
            await b.unroute('**/api/auth/logout-all', failure)
        await b.locator('#ac-logout-all').click()
        await assert_cleared(b, lang)
        for session in sessions:
            await api(setup.request, 'GET', '/auth/me', session['token'], status=401)
        # An already-open peer returns to login when its normal five-second poll
        # receives 401, rather than keeping a stale signed-in profile on screen.
        await assert_cleared(c, lang)
        await expect(c.locator('#ident-err')).to_have_text(EXPIRED[lang])
        await api(setup.request, 'GET', '/auth/me', outsider['token'])
        assert not errors, errors
        print(f'PASS [{lang}]: failed all-device logout stays retryable; confirmed logout revokes peers but not other accounts')
    except Exception:
        print('JavaScript errors:', errors)
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for i, page in enumerate(pages):
            try:
                await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / f'{lang}-device-{i}.png'), full_page=True)
            except Exception:
                pass
        raise
    finally:
        release.set()
        for ctx in contexts:
            await ctx.close()
        await setup.close()


async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        for lang in ['fa', 'en', 'ar']:
            await scenario(browser, lang)
        await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/map_search_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/map_search_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"9bb3336ac3c3bb9351a175f9441e78f72c7e5bfdbf42f2b322e4cd725501b4e8"} -->
````````````````
# تست جستجوی آدرس روی نقشه‌ی اپ مسافر: تایپ مکان ← انتخاب نتیجه ← رفتن پین به همان نقطه و گرفتن نشانی.
# پاسخ‌های Nominatim با route جعلی و قطعی داده می‌شوند تا تست به اینترنت وابسته نباشد.
import asyncio, re, json
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

SEARCH = [{'lat': '35.6892', 'lon': '51.3890', 'display_name': 'میدان انقلاب، تهران، ایران'}]
REVERSE = {'display_name': 'خیابان انقلاب، تهران، ایران', 'address': {'road': 'خیابان انقلاب', 'city': 'تهران'}}

async def m():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844})
        pg = await ctx.new_page(); errs = []
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:140]))

        async def geo(route):
            if '/search' in route.request.url:
                body = json.dumps(SEARCH)
            else:
                body = json.dumps(REVERSE)
            await route.fulfill(status=200, content_type='application/json', body=body)
        await pg.route(re.compile(r'nominatim\.openstreetmap\.org'), geo)

        await pg.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081/traveler/index.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(500)
        await pg.evaluate("()=>{localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.user.v1', JSON.stringify({name:'Ali',last:'Rezaei',gender:'male',contact:'+98 912 345 6789',lang:'fa',passport:null}));localStorage.setItem('hamzaban_lang','fa')}")
        await pg.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081/traveler/app.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        print('search box:', await pg.evaluate("()=>!!document.getElementById('addr-search')"))
        await pg.fill('#addr-search', 'میدان انقلاب')
        await pg.wait_for_selector('#addr-results button', timeout=8000)
        print('results shown:', await pg.evaluate("()=>document.querySelectorAll('#addr-results button').length"))
        await pg.click('#addr-results button')
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(2200)
        mp = await pg.evaluate("()=>window.meetingPoint")
        print('meeting point:', mp)
        ok = bool(mp) and abs(mp['lat'] - 35.6892) < 0.001 and abs(mp['lng'] - 51.3890) < 0.001
        print('pin moved to result:', ok)
        title = await pg.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('selected-location-title').textContent")
        print('address title:', title)
        print('errors:', [e for e in errs if 'tailwind' not in e] or 'none')
        await b.close()

asyncio.run(m())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/map_toasts.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/map_toasts.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"b75710074c3a6a4267f0ae13af4cf0fabecefb3496319c938c245b433894c459"} -->
````````````````
import asyncio, re, json, sys
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
lang = sys.argv[1]
PF = re.compile(r'[پچژگک]')
ANY = re.compile(r'[\u0600-\u06FF]')
async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch()
        ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844})
        await ctx.route(re.compile(r'https://(unpkg\.com|fonts\.googleapis\.com|fonts\.gstatic\.com|nominatim\.openstreetmap\.org|tile\.openstreetmap\.org).*'), lambda r: r.abort())
        await ctx.add_init_script("if(!sessionStorage.getItem('s')){localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.user.v1',JSON.stringify({name:'T'}));localStorage.setItem('hamzaban_lang','%s');sessionStorage.setItem('s','1')}" % lang)
        pg = await ctx.new_page(); errs=[]
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:120]))
        await pg.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081/traveler/app.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        results = []
        async def act(name, fn):
            await pg.evaluate("()=>{const t=document.getElementById('toast-pill');if(t)t.classList.add('hidden');}")
            try:
                await fn()
            except Exception as e:
                results.append((name, 'ACTION FAILED: ' + str(e)[:80])); return
            await pg.wait_for_timeout(700)
            msg = await pg.evaluate("()=>{const p=document.getElementById('toast-pill');return p&&!p.classList.contains('hidden')?document.getElementById('toast-text').textContent:null}")
            results.append((name, msg))
        await act('zoom in', lambda: pg.click('button[onclick="mapZoom(1)"]'))
        await act('locate me', lambda: pg.click('button[onclick="locateMe()"]'))
        await act('layers', lambda: pg.locator('button:has-text("layers")').first.click(timeout=2000))
        await act('notifications', lambda: pg.locator('button:has-text("notifications")').first.click(timeout=2000))
        await act('support chat', lambda: pg.locator('button:has-text("chat")').first.click(timeout=2000))
        await act('swap languages', lambda: pg.click('#btn-swap-langs'))
        await act('confirm location (pending)', lambda: pg.click('#confirm-location-btn'))
        await act('confirm location', lambda: pg.click('#confirm-location-btn'))
        await act('change location', lambda: pg.click('#change-location-btn'))
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(500)
        out = []
        for name, msg in results:
            flag = ''
            if msg:
                if lang == 'en' and ANY.search(msg): flag = '  <-- PERSIAN'
                if lang == 'ar' and PF.search(msg): flag = '  <-- PERSIAN'
            out.append('%-28s %s%s' % (name, msg, flag))
        print('\n'.join(out))
        print('errors:', errs or 'none')
        await b.close()
asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/mkpng.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/mkpng.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"905764c5400d0c886f0f8ad68fc80a86ba06d6804ed77492d5f31c802a2bd786"} -->
````````````````
import zlib, struct
w = h = 64
rows = []
for y in range(h):
    row = bytearray(b'\x00')
    for x in range(w):
        row += bytes([(x * 4) % 256, 120, 200])
    rows.append(bytes(row))
raw = b''.join(rows)
def ch(t, d):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t + d) & 0xffffffff)
open('assets/test_photo.png', 'wb').write(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' + ch(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)) + ch(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw)) + ch(b'IEND', b''))
print('png ok')
````````````````

## `reference/tests/no_sim_buttons.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/no_sim_buttons.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"2b5a23d6f3b4ed121189ba19403e6b0fc3b3b382c0f532cf0d0c46ec7458a1c2"} -->
````````````````
# در اپ مسافر نباید هیچ دکمه‌ی شبیه‌سازی باشد؛ صفحه‌ی تطبیق فقط با وضعیت واقعی سرور جلو می‌رود.
# جریان واقعی: ورود سروری → تأیید محل ملاقات → ثبت رزرو فوری → صفحهٔ تطبیق (stage-2) نشان داده می‌شود.
import asyncio
import secrets
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8081'


async def api(request, method, path, token=None, data=None, status=200):
    r = await request.fetch(BASE + '/api' + path, method=method, data=data,
                            headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token} if token else {})
    body = await r.json()
    assert r.status == status, (method, path, r.status, body)
    return body


async def m():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        setup = await b.new_context()
        ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844}, service_workers='block')
        # نشانی‌یاب خارجی در محیط آزمون mock می‌شود؛ در غیر این صورت تأیید محل تا پیدا شدن نشانی مسدود می‌ماند.
        await ctx.route('https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/**',
                        lambda r: r.fulfill(json={'display_name': 'تهران، میدان آزادی'}))
        await ctx.route('https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org/**', lambda r: r.abort())
        pg = await ctx.new_page()
        errs = []
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:140]))
        try:
            await api(setup.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
            phone = '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000)
            await api(setup.request, 'POST', '/auth/request-code', data={'phone': phone, 'role': 'traveler'})
            session = await api(setup.request, 'POST', '/auth/verify', data={'phone': phone, 'role': 'traveler', 'code': '123456'})
            token = session['token']
            await pg.goto(BASE + '/traveler/index.html')
            await pg.wait_for_timeout(400)
            await pg.evaluate("""([s]) => {
                localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.token.v1', s.token);
                localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.user.v1', JSON.stringify({name:'Ali', last:'Rezaei', gender:'مرد', phone:s.user.phone, authUserId:s.user.id}));
                localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1','[]');
                localStorage.setItem('hamzaban_lang','fa');
            }""", [session])
            await pg.goto(BASE + '/traveler/app.html')
            await pg.wait_for_function('() => window.hzBookingsSynced === true && !!window.HZ_NEAREST_CITY()')
            await pg.wait_for_function("() => !document.getElementById('selected-location-title').textContent.includes('در حال یافتن')")
            ids = await pg.evaluate("""()=>({
              simFound: !!document.getElementById('btn-sim-found'),
              simArrived: !!document.getElementById('btn-sim-arrived'),
              arrived: !!document.getElementById('btn-arrived'),
              simText: document.body.innerText.includes('شبیه‌سازی')
            })""")
            print(ids)
            assert not ids['simFound'] and not ids['simArrived'], 'دکمهٔ شبیه‌سازی وجود دارد'
            if ids['simText']:
                leak = await pg.evaluate("()=>document.body.innerText.split('\\n').filter(l=>l.includes('شبیه')).slice(0,4)")
                print('SIM TEXT LEAK:', leak)
            assert not ids['simText'], 'متن شبیه‌سازی در صفحه هست'
            print('no sim buttons: True')
            print('real arrived button exists:', ids['arrived'])
            # گام واقعی: تأیید محل ملاقات، شیت پایین باز می‌شود و دکمهٔ ثبت نمایان می‌گردد
            await pg.locator('#confirm-location-btn').click()
            await expect(pg.locator('#btn-main-submit')).to_be_visible()
            await pg.locator('#btn-main-submit').click()
            await pg.wait_for_timeout(800)
            stage2 = await pg.evaluate("()=>!document.getElementById('stage-2').classList.contains('hidden')")
            print('matching page shown:', stage2)
            assert stage2, 'صفحهٔ تطبیق بعد از ثبت رزرو واقعی باز نشد'
            print('errors:', [e for e in errs if 'tailwind' not in e] or 'none')
            assert not [e for e in errs if 'tailwind' not in e], errs
        finally:
            await ctx.close()
            await setup.close()
            await b.close()

asyncio.run(m())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/payment_methods_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/payment_methods_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"06327041473ce3d4d706189ff75fbbc2950097686d9b65101656f99e02bd7176"} -->
````````````````
"""Server-owned payment choices in both invoice and booking-list modal.

Changes only a disposable test server's settings and restores them in finally.
No payment is sent: also checks blocked/malformed configuration fails closed.
"""
import asyncio
import json
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api, booking, arrive_and_start
from booking_options_ui import login, translator

ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_payment_methods'


async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844}, service_workers='block')
        page = await ctx.new_page()
        page.set_default_timeout(20000)
        errors, payments = [], []
        page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
        page.on('request', lambda r: payments.append(r.url) if r.url.endswith('/payment') and r.method == 'POST' else None)
        admin = None
        original = None
        try:
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
            original = (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/config'))['payments']
            admin = (await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/admin/login', data={'password': 'test-admin-pass'}))['token']
            ptok, phone = await login(ctx.request, 'traveler')
            ttok = await translator(ctx.request, 'male')
            created = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/traveler/bookings', ptok,
                                {'kind': 'instant', 'origin_lang': 'ar', 'dest_lang': 'fa', 'hours': 1,
                                 'place': 'آزمون روش‌های پرداخت', 'traveler_name': 'علی رضایی'}, status=201)
            bid = created['id']
            offers = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/offers', ttok)
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/translator/offers/{offers['offers'][0]['id']}/accept", ttok)
            await arrive_and_start(ctx.request, bid, ttok, created['service_code'])
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f'/traveler/bookings/{bid}/finish', ptok)
            user = {'name': 'علی', 'last': 'رضایی', 'gender': 'مرد', 'phone': phone}
            await ctx.add_init_script(
                'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban.token.v1", ' + json.dumps(ptok) + ');'
                'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban.user.v1", ' + json.dumps(json.dumps(user)) + ');'
                'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban_lang", "fa");')
            await ctx.route('https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/**',
                            lambda route: route.fulfill(json={'display_name': 'تهران، آزمون پرداخت'}))
            await ctx.route('https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org/**', lambda route: route.abort())
            await page.goto(BASE + '/traveler/app.html')
            await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_visible()

            async def settings(cash, online):
                await api(ctx.request, 'PUT', '/admin/settings', admin,
                          {'cash_enabled': int(cash), 'online_enabled': int(online)})

            async def refresh():
                await page.locator('#btn-refresh-payment-methods').click()
                await expect(page.locator('#btn-refresh-payment-methods')).to_be_enabled()

            for cash, online in [(True, False), (False, True), (True, True), (False, False)]:
                await settings(cash, online)
                await refresh()
                for method, enabled in [('cash', cash), ('online', online)]:
                    await expect(page.locator('#pay-method-' + method)).to_be_visible(visible=enabled)
                    await expect(page.locator('#pay-method-' + method)).to_be_enabled(enabled=enabled)
                await expect(page.locator('#btn-settle-return')).to_be_enabled(enabled=cash or online)
                if cash:
                    await page.locator('#pay-method-cash').click()
                    await expect(page.locator('#pay-method-online')).to_be_visible(visible=online)
                if cash and online:
                    await refresh()
                    assert await page.evaluate('() => window.payChoice') == 'cash', 'Refresh must preserve an allowed selection'
                choice = await page.evaluate('() => window.payChoice')
                assert (cash if choice == 'cash' else online if choice == 'online' else not cash and not online)
                if not cash and not online:
                    await expect(page.locator('#payment-method-status')).to_have_text('در حال حاضر هیچ روش پرداختی فعال نیست.')
                else:
                    await expect(page.locator('#pay-method-' + choice)).to_have_attribute('aria-pressed', 'true')
                # The list modal must fetch again, not reuse its first configuration.
                await page.locator('nav a[data-nav=bookings]').click()
                await page.locator('#bk-tabs').get_by_role('button', name='در جریان', exact=True).click()
                await page.locator('#bk-list').get_by_role('button', name='پرداخت', exact=True).click()
                modal = page.locator('#bk-modal')
                await expect(modal).to_be_visible()
                assert await modal.get_by_role('button', name='نقدی پرداخت کردم', exact=True).count() == int(cash)
                assert await modal.get_by_role('button', name='پرداخت آنلاین', exact=True).count() == int(online)
                await modal.get_by_role('button', name='انصراف', exact=True).click()
                await page.locator('nav a[data-nav=map]').click()
                print(f'PASS: cash={cash}, online={online}; invoice and freshly opened modal agree')

            # A method can be disabled while its list modal is already open.
            await settings(True, False)
            await page.locator('nav a[data-nav=bookings]').click()
            await page.locator('#bk-tabs').get_by_role('button', name='در جریان', exact=True).click()
            await page.locator('#bk-list').get_by_role('button', name='پرداخت', exact=True).click()
            await expect(page.locator('#bk-modal')).to_be_visible()
            await settings(False, False)
            await page.locator('#bk-modal').get_by_role('button', name='نقدی پرداخت کردم', exact=True).click()
            await expect(page.locator('#toast-text')).to_have_text('این روش پرداخت فعال نیست.')
            await page.locator('nav a[data-nav=map]').click()
            assert not payments
            print('PASS: disabling cash while its modal is open blocks the pending attempt without any payment POST')

            # A failed pre-payment config request cannot leave stale active buttons.
            await settings(True, False)
            await refresh()
            await expect(page.locator('#btn-settle-return')).to_be_enabled()
            async def disconnected(route):
                await route.abort('internetdisconnected')
            await page.route('**/api/config', disconnected)
            await page.locator('#btn-settle-return').click()
            await expect(page.locator('#toast-text')).to_have_text('روش‌های پرداخت دریافت نشد. دوباره تلاش کنید.')
            await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_visible()
            await expect(page.locator('#payment-method-status')).to_have_text('روش‌های پرداخت دریافت نشد. دوباره تلاش کنید.')
            await expect(page.locator('#btn-settle-return')).to_be_disabled()
            await expect(page.locator('#pay-method-cash')).to_be_hidden()
            await page.unroute('**/api/config', disconnected)
            async def malformed(route):
                await route.fulfill(json={'payments': {'CASH': 'false', 'ONLINE': 'true'}})
            await page.route('**/api/config', malformed)
            await refresh()
            await expect(page.locator('#btn-settle-return')).to_be_disabled()
            await expect(page.locator('#payment-method-status')).to_have_text('روش‌های پرداخت دریافت نشد. دوباره تلاش کنید.')
            await page.unroute('**/api/config', malformed)
            await settings(True, False)
            await refresh()
            await expect(page.locator('#pay-method-cash')).to_be_visible()
            await expect(page.locator('#btn-settle-return')).to_be_enabled()
            assert await page.evaluate('() => window.payChoice') == 'cash'
            assert not payments, payments
            final = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, bid)
            assert final['pay_state'] is None and final['total'] == created['total'], final
            assert not errors, errors
            print('PASS: unavailable/malformed configuration blocks payment; retry restores cash without sending a charge')
        except Exception:
            print('JavaScript errors:', errors)
            ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            try:
                await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / 'payment-methods.png'), full_page=True)
            except Exception:
                pass
            raise
        finally:
            if admin and original:
                await api(ctx.request, 'PUT', '/admin/settings', admin,
                          {'cash_enabled': int(original['CASH']), 'online_enabled': int(original['ONLINE'])})
            await ctx.close()
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

````````````````
        await b.close()
asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/run_all.sh`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/run_all.sh","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"147cba5f9dd99ce7b0d8a86b5af6cf199a0dc8a238170ea2c2ed77af2d3149fa"} -->
````````````````
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# اجرای همهٔ تست‌ها.
# دو سرور همراه خودکار با پایگاه داده‌ی تازه بالا می‌آیند:
#   ۸۰۸۱: زمان‌بندی واقعی، اپ‌ها و API (حالت توسعه)
#   ۸۰۸۲: زمان‌بندی فشرده (HZ_TIME_SCALE=0.01) برای تست انقضا
# سرور مسافر جدا نیست؛ همه‌چیز از همان سرور سرو می‌شود.
set -u
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
TESTS_DIR="$(pwd)"
SERVER_DIR="$(cd ../server && pwd)"
for port in 8081 8082; do
  if curl -s -o /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/config"; then echo "پورت $port از قبل اشغال است؛ سرور قبلی را ببندید."; exit 2; fi
done
DB_TMP="$(mktemp -u /tmp/hz_run_XXXX).sqlite"
DB_FAST="$(mktemp -u /tmp/hz_fast_XXXX).sqlite"
SRV_LOG="$TESTS_DIR/assets/last_server.log"
FAST_LOG="$TESTS_DIR/assets/last_server_fast.log"
: > "$SRV_LOG"; : > "$FAST_LOG"
# حلقهٔ نگهبان: کرش محیطی better-sqlite3 (ادعای teardown هنگام خروج) گاهی سرور را وسط سویت می‌کشد؛
# ناظر همان سرور را با همان پایگاه داده بلافاصله بالا می‌آورد تا یک کرش، ۴۰ تست بعدی را نسوزاند.
srvloop() { # $1=log  $2=db  $3=port  بقیه: envهای اضافی
  local logf="$1" dbf="$2" port="$3"; shift 3
  while true; do
    ( cd "$SERVER_DIR" && exec env HZ_DEV=1 HZ_ADMIN_PASSWORD=test-admin-pass HZ_DB="$dbf" PORT="$port" "$@" node server.js >> "$logf" 2>&1 )
    echo "[supervise] سرور پورت $port خارج شد؛ راه‌اندازی مجدد..." >> "$logf"
    sleep 1
  done
}
( srvloop "$SRV_LOG" "$DB_TMP" 8081 ) & SERVER_PID=$!
( srvloop "$FAST_LOG" "$DB_FAST" 8082 HZ_TIME_SCALE=0.01 ) & FAST_PID=$!
trap 'kill $SERVER_PID $FAST_PID 2>/dev/null; pkill -P $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null; pkill -P $FAST_PID 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; rm -f "$DB_TMP" "$DB_TMP-wal" "$DB_TMP-shm" "$DB_FAST" "$DB_FAST-wal" "$DB_FAST-shm"' EXIT
for port in 8081 8082; do
  for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -s -o /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/config" && break; sleep 0.5; done
  if ! curl -s -o /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/config"; then echo "سرور پورت $port بالا نیامد"; exit 2; fi
done

python3 mkpng.py >/dev/null
fail=0
run() { echo "== $*"; if timeout 300 "$@" > "assets/last_$(echo "$*" | tr ' /' '__').log" 2>&1; then echo "   ok"; else echo "   FAILED (see assets/)"; fail=1; fi; }
run node "$SERVER_DIR/test/sms.test.js"
run env BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8081 node "$SERVER_DIR/test/api.test.js"
run env BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8081 node "$SERVER_DIR/test/capability_gates.test.js"
run env BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8081 node "$SERVER_DIR/test/early_finish_debt.test.js"
run env BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8081 node "$SERVER_DIR/test/features_cities_security.test.js"

run env BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8081 node "$SERVER_DIR/test/gateway_push.test.js"
run node --test translator_mission_map.test.js
run node --test translator_mission_actions.test.js
run node --test translator_session_headers.test.js
run node --test translator_settings.test.js
run node --test traveler_session_headers.test.js
run env BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8082 node "$SERVER_DIR/test/timing.test.js"
run python3 traveler_convert_ui.py http://127.0.0.1:8082
run python3 cross_app_e2e.py
run python3 traveler_change_ui.py
````````````````
