## `reference/tests/service_actions_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/service_actions_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"4323dd97c5fc9fed6b877139732b57eb7fd5a40a136e0f0bec7ff7a621c4e5b2"} -->
````````````````
"""Service controls must use the pinned, freshly read server booking.

Faults must not create a local clock/invoice/extension. Real extension approval
and two-sided finish rules stay intact; finish bills the actual served duration
(min one hour) and keeps the first quote in list_total.
"""
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
import secrets
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api, booking, arrive_and_start
from booking_options_ui import translator
from logout_sessions_ui import sign_in, seeded_context

ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_service_actions'
ERROR = {
    'fa': 'عملیات خدمت تأیید نشد. وضعیت را بررسی کنید و دوباره تلاش کنید.',
    'en': 'The service action was not confirmed. Check its status and try again.',
    'ar': 'لم يتم تأكيد إجراء الخدمة. تحقّق من حالتها وحاول مجدداً.',
}
NOT_STARTED = {
    'fa': 'خدمت هنوز با کد امنیتی در سرور شروع نشده است.',
    'en': 'The service has not started with the security code on the server yet.',
    'ar': 'لم تبدأ الخدمة برمز الأمان على الخادم بعد.',
}
START_CHECK_LABEL = {
    'fa': 'بررسی وضعیت شروع خدمت',
    'en': 'Check service start status',
    'ar': 'تحقّق من حالة بدء الخدمة',
}
REQUIRED = {
    'fa': 'برای این کار، ورود و رزرو معتبر سروری لازم است.',
    'en': 'This action requires sign-in and a valid server booking.',
    'ar': 'يتطلب هذا الإجراء تسجيل الدخول وحجزاً صالحاً على الخادم.',
}


async def scenario(browser, lang):
    setup = await browser.new_context()
    ctx, page = None, None
    release = asyncio.Event()
    errors, posts = [], []
    try:
        await api(setup.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
        session = await sign_in(setup.request, '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000))
        token = session['token']
        ctx, page = await seeded_context(browser, session, lang, errors)
        page.on('request', lambda r: posts.append(r.url) if r.method == 'POST' and '/api/traveler/bookings/' in r.url else None)
        # No server booking: synthetic service buttons cannot simulate any stage.
        before_hours = await page.locator('#label-hours-count').inner_text()
        await page.evaluate("localStorage.removeItem('hamzaban.token.v1')")
        for id in ['btn-arrived','btn-confirm-start','btn-finish-service','btn-extend-one-hour','btn-approve-finish','btn-reject-finish']:
            await page.locator('#'+id).dispatch_event('click')
            await expect(page.locator('#toast-text')).to_have_text(REQUIRED[lang])
        assert not posts
        await expect(page.locator('#stage-5')).to_be_hidden()
        await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_hidden()
        assert await page.locator('#label-hours-count').inner_text() == before_hours
        await page.evaluate("t => localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.token.v1',t)", token)

        # Put a different, canceled server reservation first in the local list.
        old = await api(setup.request,'POST','/traveler/bookings',token,
                        {'kind':'instant','origin_lang':'ar','dest_lang':'fa','place':'old-canceled'},status=201)
        await api(setup.request,'POST',f"/traveler/bookings/{old['id']}/cancel",token)
        ttok = await translator(setup.request,'male')
        await page.reload()
        await page.wait_for_function('() => window.hzBookingsSynced === true && !!window.HZ_NEAREST_CITY()')
        await expect(page.locator('#selected-location-title')).to_have_text('تهران، آزمون خروج')
        await page.locator('#confirm-location-btn').click()
        await page.locator('#btn-toggle-car').click()
        async with page.expect_response(lambda r: r.url.endswith('/api/traveler/bookings') and r.request.method == 'POST') as pending:
            await page.locator('#btn-main-submit').click()
        created = await (await pending.value).json()
        bid, total, hours = created['id'], created['total'], created['hours']
        offers = await api(setup.request,'GET','/translator/offers',ttok)
        await api(setup.request,'POST',f"/translator/offers/{offers['offers'][0]['id']}/accept",ttok)
        await expect(page.locator('#stage-3')).to_be_visible()
        await page.evaluate("id => {let b=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1'));b.sort((a,c)=>(a.serverId===id?-1:c.serverId===id?1:0));localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1',JSON.stringify(b));}",old['id'])

        async def faults(action, button, method='POST'):
            url = '**/api/traveler/bookings' + (f'/{bid}/{action}' if method == 'POST' else '')
            modes = ['offline','503','empty','false','string','malformed','partial']
            if method == 'POST': modes.append('misleading_success')
            else: modes.extend(['bad_start_snapshot','bad_finish_snapshot'])
            for mode in modes:
                async def failure(route, request, *, mode=mode):
                    if request.method != method:
                        await route.fallback()
                    elif mode == 'offline':
                        await route.abort('failed')
                    elif mode in ['bad_start_snapshot','bad_finish_snapshot']:
                        response = await route.fetch()
                        snapshot = await response.json()
                        row = next(x for x in snapshot['bookings'] if x['id']==bid)
                        row['service_started']=True
                        if mode == 'bad_start_snapshot': row['service_started_at']='invalid'
                        else:
                            row['status']='finished'; row['finished_at']=None; row['service_started_at']='2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'
                        await route.fulfill(json=snapshot)
                    elif mode == 'misleading_success':
                        if action == 'extend':
                            payload={'pending':True,'id':999999,'extra_hours':1,'extra_total':100,'new_total':total+100,'expires_at':'2099-01-01T00:00:00Z'}
                        elif action == 'finish-reject':
                            payload={'ok':True,'status':'matched'}
                        else:
                            payload={'ok':True,'status':'finished','finished_by':'traveler' if action=='finish' else 'translator','total':total}
                        await route.fulfill(status=200,json=payload)
                    elif mode == 'malformed':
                        await route.fulfill(status=200,content_type='application/json',body='{')
                    else:
                        payload = {'503':{'error':'unavailable'},'empty':{},'false':{'ok':False},'string':{'ok':'true'},'partial':{'ok':True,'pending':True,'id':1}}[mode]
                        await route.fulfill(status=503 if mode=='503' else 200,json=payload)
                await page.route(url,failure)
                await button.dispatch_event('click')
                await expect(button).to_be_enabled()
                await expect(page.locator('#toast-text')).to_have_text(ERROR[lang])
                await page.unroute(url,failure)

        # Read failures cannot show a code or start a timer.
        await faults('arrived',page.locator('#btn-arrived'),method='GET')
        await expect(page.locator('#stage-4')).to_be_hidden()
        await page.locator('#btn-arrived').click()
        await expect(page.locator('#stage-4')).to_be_visible()
        await expect(page.locator('#btn-confirm-start > span:last-child')).to_have_text(START_CHECK_LABEL[lang])
        await expect(page.locator('#btn-confirm-start .material-symbols-outlined')).to_have_text('sync')
        code = (await page.locator('#security-code').inner_text()).translate(str.maketrans('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹','0123456789'))
        assert code == created['service_code'], (code,created)
        count = len(posts)
        await page.locator('#btn-confirm-start').click()
        await expect(page.locator('#toast-text')).to_have_text(NOT_STARTED[lang])
        await expect(page.locator('#stage-5')).to_be_hidden()
        assert len(posts) == count
        await arrive_and_start(setup.request, bid, ttok, created['service_code'])
        await expect(page.locator('#stage-5')).to_be_visible()
        started = (await booking(setup.request,token,bid))['service_started_at']
        await api(setup.request,'POST',f'/translator/missions/{bid}/cancel',ttok,status=409)
        assert (await booking(setup.request,token,bid))['status'] == 'matched'

        extend = page.locator('#btn-extend-one-hour')
        await faults('extend',extend)
        await faults('finish',page.locator('#btn-finish-service'),method='GET')
        await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_hidden()
        unchanged = await booking(setup.request,token,bid)
        assert unchanged['hours'] == hours and unchanged['total'] == total and unchanged['pending_extension'] is None
        # Real deadline; no hanging intercepted route after an intentional abort.
        await page.clock.install()
        await page.evaluate("""() => {
            window.serviceTestFetch=window.fetch;window.serviceTestPost=false;window.serviceTestAborted=false;
            window.fetch=(url,opts)=>{
                if(url.endsWith('/extend')&&opts.method==='POST')return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
                    window.serviceTestPost=true;opts.signal.addEventListener('abort',()=>{
                        window.serviceTestAborted=true;reject(new DOMException('Aborted','AbortError'));
                    },{once:true});
                });
                return window.serviceTestFetch(url,opts);
            };
        }""")
        await extend.click()
        await page.wait_for_function('() => window.serviceTestPost')
        await page.clock.fast_forward(10001)
        await expect(extend).to_be_enabled()
        await expect(page.locator('#toast-text')).to_have_text(ERROR[lang])
        assert await page.evaluate('window.serviceTestAborted')
        await page.evaluate('window.fetch=window.serviceTestFetch')
        await page.clock.resume()

        # All service controls and card actions share one pending-operation lock.
        entered = asyncio.Event()
        async def delayed(route):
            entered.set(); await release.wait(); await route.continue_()
        await page.route(f'**/api/traveler/bookings/{bid}/extend',delayed)
        count = len(posts)
        await extend.click(); await entered.wait()
        for id in ['btn-extend-one-hour','btn-finish-service','btn-approve-finish','btn-reject-finish']:
            await expect(page.locator('#'+id)).to_be_disabled()
            await page.locator('#'+id).dispatch_event('click')
        await page.clock.fast_forward(2001)
        await page.clock.resume()
        await expect(extend).to_be_disabled()  # The timer's UI loop must not unlock it.
        assert len(posts) == count+1
        waiting = await booking(setup.request,token,bid)
        assert waiting['hours'] == hours and waiting['total'] == total and waiting['pending_extension'] is None
        release.set()
        await page.wait_for_function("id => {const b=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1')).find(x=>x.serverId===id);return !!b.pendingExtension;}",arg=bid)
        await page.unroute(f'**/api/traveler/bookings/{bid}/extend',delayed)
        pending_ext = (await booking(setup.request,token,bid))['pending_extension']
        assert pending_ext and (await booking(setup.request,token,bid))['total'] == total
        await api(setup.request,'POST',f"/translator/extensions/{pending_ext['id']}/reject",ttok)
        await expect(extend).to_be_enabled()
        assert (await booking(setup.request,token,bid))['hours'] == hours
        await extend.click()
        await page.wait_for_function("id => !!JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1')).find(x=>x.serverId===id).pendingExtension",arg=bid)
        next_ext = (await booking(setup.request,token,bid))['pending_extension']
        assert next_ext['id'] != pending_ext['id']
        await api(setup.request,'POST',f"/translator/extensions/{next_ext['id']}/accept",ttok)
        await page.wait_for_function("([id,h])=>JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1')).find(x=>x.serverId===id).hoursNum===h",arg=[bid,hours+1])
        extended = await booking(setup.request,token,bid)
        assert extended['total'] > total and extended['service_started_at'] == started
        total = extended['total']

        # Reject/approve translator finish and own early finish are never local.
        await api(setup.request,'POST',f'/translator/missions/{bid}/finish',ttok,status=202)
        await expect(page.locator('#finish-request-banner')).to_be_visible()
        await faults('finish-reject',page.locator('#btn-reject-finish'))
        assert (await booking(setup.request,token,bid))['finish_requested'] is True
        await page.locator('#btn-reject-finish').click()
        await expect(page.locator('#finish-request-banner')).to_be_hidden()
        await faults('finish',page.locator('#btn-finish-service'))
        await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_hidden()
        assert (await booking(setup.request,token,bid))['status'] == 'matched'
        await api(setup.request,'POST',f'/translator/missions/{bid}/finish',ttok,status=202)
        await expect(page.locator('#finish-request-banner')).to_be_visible()
        await faults('finish-approve',page.locator('#btn-approve-finish'))
        await page.locator('#btn-approve-finish').click()
        await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_visible()
        finished = await booking(setup.request,token,bid)
        # پایان با خدمت چندثانیه‌ای: کف یک ساعت؛ مبلغ اولیه در list_total
        assert finished['status'] == 'finished' and finished['finished_by']=='translator' and finished['billed_hours']==1 and finished['list_total']==total
        assert (await booking(setup.request,token,old['id']))['status']=='cancelled'

        # A late real finish receipt must not read/mutate the replacement account.
        new = await api(setup.request,'POST','/traveler/bookings',token,
                        {'kind':'instant','origin_lang':'ar','dest_lang':'fa','place':'late-service-response'},status=201)
        offers = await api(setup.request,'GET','/translator/offers',ttok)
        await api(setup.request,'POST',f"/translator/offers/{offers['offers'][0]['id']}/accept",ttok)
        await arrive_and_start(setup.request, new['id'], ttok, new['service_code'])
        await page.reload(); await expect(page.locator('#stage-5')).to_be_visible()
        replacement = await sign_in(setup.request,'9'+str(secrets.randbelow(900000000)+100000000))
        release.clear(); entered.clear()
        await page.route(f"**/api/traveler/bookings/{new['id']}/finish",delayed)
        await page.locator('#btn-finish-service').click(); await entered.wait()
        await page.evaluate("""s=>{
            localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.token.v1',s.token);
            localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.user.v1',JSON.stringify({name:'New',last:'Account',gender:'مرد',phone:s.user.phone,authUserId:s.user.id}));
            localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1','[]');document.getElementById('toast-text').textContent='';
        }""",replacement)
        release.set()
        await expect(page.locator('#btn-finish-service')).to_be_enabled()
        assert await page.evaluate("localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.token.v1')")==replacement['token']
        assert await page.evaluate("localStorage.getItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1')")=='[]'
        final=await booking(setup.request,token,new['id'])
        assert final['status']=='finished' and final['finished_by']=='traveler' and final['total']==new['total']
        await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_hidden()
        assert not errors,errors
        print(f'PASS [{lang}]: no local service simulation, pinned security code, real start/extension consent/full-price finish, safe failures/timeouts/locks and late-session isolation')
    except Exception:
        print('JavaScript errors:',errors)
        if page:
            ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS/f'{lang}.png'),full_page=True)
        raise
    finally:
        release.set()
        if ctx:
            await page.unroute_all(behavior='ignoreErrors')
            await ctx.close()
        await setup.close()

async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser=await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        for lang in ['fa','en','ar']:
            await scenario(browser,lang)
        await browser.close()

if __name__=='__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/service_clock_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/service_clock_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"5ff9841abb27d01a58aa593fc91f0a1f3fa48f7f0919bf040eadd267c7cd099f"} -->
````````````````
"""Reload/reopen regression for server-origin service time, extensions and invoice.

The browser clock advances 40 minutes; all APIs and the server clock remain real.
No real waiting or test-only mutation of the database/start timestamp is needed.
"""
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api, booking, arrive_and_start
from booking_options_ui import login, translator

ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_service_clock'
DIGITS = str.maketrans('0123456789', '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹')


def fa(value):
    return str(value).translate(DIGITS)


async def seconds(page):
    text = await page.locator('#live-timer-val').inner_text()
    parts = text.translate(str.maketrans('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹', '0123456789')).split(':')
    h, m, s = map(int, parts)
    return h * 3600 + m * 60 + s


async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844}, service_workers='block')
        page = await ctx.new_page()
        page.set_default_timeout(20000)
        errors = []
        page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
        admin_token = None
        original_rates = None
        try:
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
            ptok, phone = await login(ctx.request, 'traveler')
            ttok = await translator(ctx.request, 'male')
            user = {'name': 'علی', 'last': 'رضایی', 'gender': 'مرد', 'phone': phone}
            await ctx.add_init_script(
                'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban.token.v1", ' + json.dumps(ptok) + ');'
                'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban.user.v1", ' + json.dumps(json.dumps(user)) + ');'
                'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban_lang", "fa");')
            await ctx.route('https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/**',
                            lambda route: route.fulfill(json={'display_name': 'تهران، آزمون زمان خدمت'}))
            await ctx.route('https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org/**', lambda route: route.abort())
            await page.goto(BASE + '/traveler/app.html')
            # A stale cache entry alone must never resume a service for this user.
            await page.evaluate("""() => localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1', JSON.stringify([
              {serverId: 999999999, srvStatus: 'matched', serviceStarted: true,
               serviceStartedAt: new Date(Date.now()-60000).toISOString(), hoursNum: 1}
            ]))""")
            await page.reload()
            await page.wait_for_function('() => window.hzBookingsSynced === true')
            await page.wait_for_timeout(1500)  # allow the once-per-second restoration check
            await expect(page.locator('#stage-5')).to_be_hidden()
            await expect(page.locator('#location-picker-bar')).to_be_visible()
            await page.evaluate("() => localStorage.removeItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1')")

            created = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/traveler/bookings', ptok,
                                {'kind': 'instant', 'origin_lang': 'ar', 'dest_lang': 'fa',
                                 'category': 'medical', 'hours': 1, 'car': False,
                                 'place': 'آزمون بازیابی تایمر', 'traveler_name': 'علی رضایی'}, status=201)
            bid = created['id']
            assert created['service_started_at'] is None and created['finished_at'] is None
            offers = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/offers', ttok)
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/translator/offers/{offers['offers'][0]['id']}/accept", ttok)
            await arrive_and_start(ctx.request, bid, ttok, created['service_code'])
            started = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, bid)
            origin = started['service_started_at']
            assert origin
            origin_date = datetime.fromisoformat(origin.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
            await page.clock.install(time=origin_date + timedelta(minutes=40))
            await page.reload()
            await expect(page.locator('#stage-5')).to_be_visible()
            await expect(page.locator('#of-hours')).to_contain_text('۱ ساعت')
            await expect(page.locator('#expiry-warning')).to_be_visible()
            elapsed = await seconds(page)
            assert 2400 <= elapsed <= 2420, elapsed
            print('PASS: timer restores the server start (40 elapsed minutes), not zero; duration is 1 hour')

            # Reopening with no cached booking must yield the same time and duration.
            await page.evaluate("() => localStorage.removeItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1')")
            await page.reload()
            await expect(page.locator('#stage-5')).to_be_visible()
            await expect(page.locator('#of-hours')).to_contain_text('۱ ساعت')
            after_reload = await seconds(page)
            assert elapsed <= after_reload <= elapsed + 20, (elapsed, after_reload)

            async with page.expect_response(lambda r: r.url.endswith(f'/{bid}/extend') and r.request.method == 'POST') as result:
                await page.locator('#btn-extend-one-hour').click()
            response = await result.value
            assert response.status == 202, await response.text()
            extension = await response.json()
            await page.reload()
            await expect(page.locator('#stage-5')).to_be_visible()
            await expect(page.locator('#btn-extend-one-hour')).to_be_disabled()
            await expect(page.locator('#of-hours')).to_contain_text('۱ ساعت')
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/translator/extensions/{extension['id']}/accept", ttok)
            extended = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, bid)
            assert extended['hours'] == 2 and extended['service_started_at'] == origin
            await page.reload()
            await expect(page.locator('#stage-5')).to_be_visible()
            await expect(page.locator('#of-hours')).to_contain_text('۲ ساعت')
            await expect(page.locator('#expiry-warning')).to_be_hidden()
            assert after_reload <= await seconds(page) <= after_reload + 30
            print('PASS: pending extension survives reload; accepted duration restores without resetting time')

            # Finish requests also survive reopening; the traveler can still reject.
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f'/translator/missions/{bid}/finish', ttok, status=202)
            await page.reload()
            await expect(page.locator('#finish-request-banner')).to_be_visible()
            async with page.expect_response(lambda r: r.url.endswith(f'/{bid}/finish-reject')) as result:
                await page.locator('#btn-reject-finish').click()
            assert (await result.value).status == 200
            await expect(page.locator('#finish-request-banner')).to_be_hidden()

            # A new live tariff must not recalculate the agreed invoice on reopen.
            original_rates = (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/config'))['tariffs']['hourly']
            admin_token = (await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/admin/login',
                                     data={'password': 'test-admin-pass'}))['token']
            new_rates = {**original_rates, 'medical': original_rates['medical'] + 333333}
            await api(ctx.request, 'PUT', '/admin/settings', admin_token, {'hourly_tariffs': new_rates})
            async with page.expect_response(lambda r: r.url.endswith(f'/{bid}/finish') and r.request.method == 'POST') as result:
                await page.locator('#btn-finish-service').click()
            assert (await result.value).status == 200
            await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_visible()
            final = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, bid)
            assert final['service_started_at'] == origin and final['finished_at'] is not None
            # پایان زودهنگام: کف یک ساعت با نرخ توافق‌شده؛ مبلغ اولیه (تمدید‌شده) در list_total می‌ماند
            assert final['billed_hours'] == 1 and final['total'] < extended['total'] and final['list_total'] == extended['total']
            await page.evaluate("() => localStorage.removeItem('hamzaban.bookings.v1')")
            await page.reload()
            await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_visible()
            for key, selector in [('base', '#inv-base'), ('tax', '#inv-tax'), ('total', '#inv-total')]:
                await expect(page.locator(selector)).to_have_text(fa(f"{final[key]:,}") + ' تومان')
            await expect(page.locator('#inv-label')).to_contain_text('۲ ساعت')
            assert not errors, errors
            print('PASS: finished service reopens its invoice with the full agreed amount, despite changed tariffs')
        except Exception:
            print('JavaScript errors:', errors)
            ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            try:
                await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / 'service-clock.png'), full_page=True)
            except Exception:
                pass
            raise
        finally:
            if admin_token and original_rates:
                await api(ctx.request, 'PUT', '/admin/settings', admin_token, {'hourly_tariffs': original_rates})
            await ctx.close()
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/settlement_failure_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/settlement_failure_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"3df4bdcdaf6ce360533f07ebd363d9b558d69be5321ac980012581c8ad94a068"} -->
````````````````
"""Payment clicks are not success: rejected, disconnected and pending requests.

Uses actual server bookings/payments. Only the disconnected request is aborted;
for the slow-success test the original request is delayed then sent to the server.
"""
import asyncio
import json
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api, booking, arrive_and_start
from booking_options_ui import login, translator

ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_settlement_failure'


async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844}, service_workers='block')
        page = await ctx.new_page()
        page.set_default_timeout(20000)
        errors, payment_posts = [], []
        page.on('request', lambda r: payment_posts.append(r.url) if r.url.endswith('/payment') and r.method == 'POST' else None)
        page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
        release = asyncio.Event()
        admin_token = None
        try:
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
            config = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/config')
            assert config['payments']['CASH'] and not config['payments']['ONLINE'], config['payments']
            ptok, phone = await login(ctx.request, 'traveler')
            ttok = await translator(ctx.request, 'male')
            created = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/traveler/bookings', ptok,
                                {'kind': 'instant', 'origin_lang': 'ar', 'dest_lang': 'fa',
                                 'category': 'general', 'hours': 1, 'car': False,
                                 'place': 'آزمون شکست پرداخت', 'traveler_name': 'علی رضایی'}, status=201)
            bid = created['id']
            offers = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/offers', ttok)
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/translator/offers/{offers['offers'][0]['id']}/accept", ttok)
            await arrive_and_start(ctx.request, bid, ttok, created['service_code'])
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f'/traveler/bookings/{bid}/finish', ptok)
            user = {'name': 'علی', 'last': 'رضایی', 'gender': 'مرد', 'phone': phone}
            await ctx.add_init_script(
                'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban.token.v1", ' + json.dumps(ptok) + ');'
                'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban.user.v1", ' + json.dumps(json.dumps(user)) + ');'
                'localStorage.setItem("hamzaban_lang", "fa");')
            await ctx.route('https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/**',
                            lambda route: route.fulfill(json={'display_name': 'تهران، آزمون پرداخت'}))
            await ctx.route('https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org/**', lambda route: route.abort())
            await page.goto(BASE + '/traveler/app.html')
            await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_visible()
            await page.evaluate("""() => {
              window.paymentToasts = [];
              const show = window.showAppToast;
              window.showAppToast = (message, icon) => { paymentToasts.push(message); show(message, icon); };
            }""")
            button = page.locator('#btn-settle-return')
            path = f'**/api/traveler/bookings/{bid}/payment'

            async def unchanged():
                await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_visible()
                await expect(button).to_be_enabled()
                assert not await page.evaluate("() => paymentToasts.some(t => t.includes('پرداخت انجام شد'))")
                current = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, bid)
                assert current['status'] == 'finished' and current['pay_state'] is None, current
                assert current['total'] == created['total']

            # Online is hidden while disabled. Also guard stale selection when
            # an admin turns it off between displaying the invoice and clicking.
            await expect(page.locator('#pay-method-online')).to_be_hidden()
            admin_token = (await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/admin/login', data={'password': 'test-admin-pass'}))['token']
            await api(ctx.request, 'PUT', '/admin/settings', admin_token, {'online_enabled': 1})
            await page.locator('#btn-refresh-payment-methods').click()
            await expect(page.locator('#pay-method-online')).to_be_enabled()
            await page.locator('#pay-method-online').click()
            await api(ctx.request, 'PUT', '/admin/settings', admin_token, {'online_enabled': 0})
            await button.click()
            await expect(page.locator('#toast-text')).to_have_text('این روش پرداخت فعال نیست.')
            await unchanged()
            assert not payment_posts, 'Do not silently pay using the enabled cash fallback'
            print('PASS: newly disabled online payment keeps the invoice open, with no false success')

            await page.locator('#pay-method-cash').click()
            async def disconnected(route):
                await route.abort('internetdisconnected')
            await page.route(path, disconnected)
            await button.click()
            await expect(page.locator('#toast-text')).to_have_text('انجام نشد. دوباره تلاش کنید.')
            await unchanged()
            await page.unroute(path, disconnected)
            print('PASS: disconnected payment stays retryable without changing server payment state')

            await page.evaluate("() => localStorage.removeItem('hamzaban.token.v1')")
            await button.click()
            await expect(page.locator('#toast-text')).to_have_text('برای ثبت پرداخت، ورود و رزرو معتبر لازم است.')
            await unchanged()
            await page.evaluate('(token) => localStorage.setItem("hamzaban.token.v1", token)', ptok)

            # Hold the real cash request in flight. Even a synthetic duplicate click
            # must be ignored by the guard, independent of HTML's disabled behavior.
            requests = []
            arrived = asyncio.Event()
            async def delayed(route):
                requests.append(route.request.url)
                arrived.set()
                await release.wait()
                await route.continue_()
            await page.route(path, delayed)
            await button.click()
            await expect(button).to_be_disabled()
            await expect(button).to_have_attribute('aria-busy', 'true')
            await asyncio.wait_for(arrived.wait(), timeout=20)
            await page.evaluate("() => document.getElementById('btn-settle-return').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {bubbles: true}))")
            await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_visible()
            assert len(requests) == 1, requests
            pending = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, bid)
            assert pending['pay_state'] is None
            assert not await page.evaluate("() => paymentToasts.some(t => t.includes('پرداخت انجام شد'))")
            release.set()
            await expect(page.locator('#location-picker-bar')).to_be_visible()
            await expect(page.locator('#stage-6')).to_be_hidden()
            await expect(button).to_be_enabled()
            final = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, bid)
            assert final['status'] == 'finished' and final['pay_state'] == 'awaiting_cash', final
            assert len(requests) == 1
            assert not await page.evaluate("() => paymentToasts.some(t => t.includes('پرداخت انجام شد'))")
            assert await page.evaluate("() => paymentToasts.some(t => t.includes('با تأیید مترجم'))")
            assert not errors, errors
            print('PASS: exactly one request during pending payment; cash success awaits translator confirmation')
        except Exception:
            print('JavaScript errors:', errors)
            print('Toasts:', await page.evaluate('() => window.paymentToasts || []'))
            ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            try:
                await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / 'payment-failure.png'), full_page=True)
            except Exception:
                pass
            raise
        finally:
            release.set()
            if admin_token:
                await api(ctx.request, 'PUT', '/admin/settings', admin_token, {'online_enabled': 0})
            await ctx.close()
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

````````````````
import asyncio, json, sys
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS, SEED_JS
import random
JOBS = [
  ('tr_login', 'http://127.0.0.1:8081/translator/index.html', None),
  ('tr_desk',  'http://127.0.0.1:8081/translator/app.html', 'desk'),
  ('tr_missions', 'http://127.0.0.1:8081/translator/app.html', 'desk_missions'),
  ('tr_success', 'http://127.0.0.1:8081/translator/index.html', 'success'),
  ('tg_login', 'http://127.0.0.1:8081/traveler/index.html', None),
]
DESK_SEED = "()=>{const s=HZ.load(); s.status='active_general'; s.session={until:9999999999999}; s.profile={nameFa:'علی',lastFa:'رضایی'}; HZ.save(s)}"
MISSIONS = "()=>{const s=HZ.load(); s.status='active_general'; s.session={until:9999999999999}; s.profile={nameFa:'علی',lastFa:'رضایی'}; s.missions=[{code:'M-1001',purpose:'مذاکره تجاری',travelerName:'Christopher Reid',place:'نمایشگاه تهران',startAt:new Date(Date.now()+5*86400000).toISOString(),total:3200000,net:2560000,status:'accepted'}]; HZ.save(s)}"
MISSION_LIST = [{'code': 'M-1001', 'purpose': 'مذاکره تجاری', 'travelerName': 'Christopher Reid', 'place': 'نمایشگاه تهران', 'startAt': '2026-10-25T10:00:00', 'total': 3200000, 'net': 2560000, 'status': 'accepted'}]

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        for name, url, mode in JOBS:
            for w in (390, 1280):
                ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': w, 'height': 900})
                pg = await ctx.new_page(); errs = []
                pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:120]))
                await pg.goto(url.split('/app')[0] + '/index.html' if mode else url, wait_for_timeout=0) if False else None
                await pg.goto(url.replace('/app.html','/index.html') if mode else url); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
                if mode:
                    token = await pg.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999)))
                    if mode == 'desk_missions':
                        await pg.evaluate(SEED_JS, [token, MISSION_LIST])
                    if mode == 'success':
                        await pg.evaluate("()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.step-content').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));document.getElementById('step-panel-success').classList.add('active')}")
                    else:
                        await pg.goto(url); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
                await pg.screenshot(path=f'assets/real_{name}_{w}.png', full_page=True)
                print(name, w, 'errors:', errs or 'none')
                await ctx.close()
        await b.close()
asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

````````````````
import random
RANDPHONE = '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999))  # شماره‌ی تازه برای هر اجرا (محدودیت ارسال مجدد)
import asyncio, re, json
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
R = []
def rec(area, item, ok, note=''):
    R.append((area, item, ok, note))
async def ctx_for(b, w, lang='fa', seed=True):
    ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': w, 'height': 844})
    await ctx.route(re.compile(r'https://(unpkg\.com|fonts\.googleapis\.com|fonts\.gstatic\.com|nominatim\.openstreetmap\.org|tile\.openstreetmap\.org).*'), lambda r: r.abort())
    await ctx.add_init_script("if(!sessionStorage.getItem('s')){%s localStorage.setItem('hamzaban_lang','%s');sessionStorage.setItem('s','1')}" % ("localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.user.v1',JSON.stringify({name:'علی',last:'رضایی',gender:'مرد',verified:false}));" if seed else '', lang))
    return ctx
async def login_checks(b):
    ctx = await ctx_for(b, 390, seed=False)
    pg = await ctx.new_page(); errs=[]
    pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:100]))
    await pg.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081/traveler/index.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(800)
    rec('ورود', 'تب پیش‌فرض شماره موبایل', await pg.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('tab-phone').getAttribute('aria-selected')==='true' || document.getElementById('phone-container').offsetParent!==null"))
    rec('ورود', 'کشور پیش‌فرض IR+98', await pg.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('country-select').value.includes('98')"))
    opts = await pg.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('country-select').options.length")
    rec('ورود', 'نه کشور', opts==9, str(opts))
    ph1 = await pg.get_attribute('#phone-input','placeholder')
    await pg.select_option('#country-select', index=1); await pg.wait_for_timeout(200)
    ph2 = await pg.get_attribute('#phone-input','placeholder')
    rec('ورود', 'نمونه‌ی شماره با تغییر کشور عوض می‌شود', ph1!=ph2, f'{ph1} -> {ph2}')
    await pg.fill('#phone-input',RANDPHONE); await pg.check('#check-age')
    rec('ورود', 'با یک تیک، دکمه غیرفعال و هشدار دیده می‌شود', await pg.is_disabled('#btn-request-otp') and await pg.evaluate("()=>{const e=document.getElementById('ident-err');return !!e&&!e.classList.contains('hidden')&&e.textContent.trim().length>0}"), 'spec: warning visible')
    await pg.check('#check-terms')
    rec('ورود', 'با هر دو تیک، دکمه فعال', not_disabled:= not await pg.is_disabled('#btn-request-otp'))
    await pg.click('#btn-request-otp'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(500)
    cd = await pg.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('countdown').textContent.trim()")
    rec('ورود', 'شمارنده‌ی اول ۱۱۹ ثانیه (۰۱:۵۹)', '01:59' in cd or '۰۱:۵۹' in cd or '119' in cd or '۱۱۹' in cd, cd)
    rec('ورود', 'گیرنده ماسک‌شده', '*' in (await pg.text_content('#target-recipient')), await pg.text_content('#target-recipient'))
    rec('ورود', 'ارسال دوباره تا پایان شمارنده غیرفعال', await pg.is_disabled('#btn-resend'))
    rec('ورود', 'شش کادر کد', await pg.evaluate("()=>document.querySelectorAll('#otp-inputs-wrapper input').length")==6)

async def app_checks(b):

    rec('تقویم', 'هفته از شنبه شروع می‌شود (ش ی د س چ پ ج)', cal['hdr'].startswith('شیدسچپج'), cal['hdr'])

    rec('تقویم', 'برچسب ۱۳:۳۰ «بعدازظهر»', any('۱۳:۳۰' in s and 'بعدازظهر' in s for s in slots), '')
    rec('تقویم', 'بازهٔ نمایش ساعت‌ها، بدون ادعای هماهنگی شبانه‌روزی', await pg.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('time-selection-window-label').textContent.trim()==='ساعت‌های فهرست‌شده: ۸ صبح تا ۹ شب'"))
    await pg.click('#btn-cancel-time'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(200)

    rec('زبان', 'تعداد گزینه‌های زبان', lc==8, str(lc))

    rec('زبان', 'نتیجه‌ی خالی: «زبانی با این مشخصات یافت نشد»', await pg.evaluate("()=>document.body.innerText.includes('زبانی با این مشخصات یافت نشد')"))

    rec('حساب', 'بررسی گذرنامه صریحاً غیرفعال است', await pg.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('ac-passport-box').textContent.includes('بررسی گذرنامه هنوز فعال نیست')"))

    rec('واکنش‌گرایی', 'دسکتاپ: سایدبار شناور راست ۴۲۰px (spec 15)', abs(bs[0]-420)<=4 and bs[1]>600, f'w={bs[0]} left={bs[1]} top={bs[2]} h={bs[3]} pos={bs[4]}')

asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/tariff_browser_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/tariff_browser_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"81e93f7807c663d9199d8ba1f83798c1370d2b3f8e8c7970813f73344466a191"} -->
````````````````
# تست مرورگر: تعرفه‌ی مدیر در اپ مسافر و کارت‌های جفت‌زبان در اپ مترجم
# نیاز به سرور تست جدا دارد (پیش‌فرض ۸۰۹۰). مثال:
#   cd server && HZ_DEV=1 HZ_ADMIN_PASSWORD=test-admin-pass HZ_DB=/tmp/tb.sqlite PORT=8090 node server.js
import asyncio, sys, json, random, urllib.request
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

TRAV_LOGIN = """async (phone) => {
  const H = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'};
  await fetch('/api/auth/request-code', {method:'POST', headers:H, body: JSON.stringify({phone, role:'traveler'})});
  const v = await (await fetch('/api/auth/verify', {method:'POST', headers:H, body: JSON.stringify({phone, role:'traveler', code:'123456'})})).json();
  localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.token.v1', v.token);
  localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.user.v1', JSON.stringify({name:'علی', last:'رضایی', gender:'مرد', phone}));
  return v.token;
}"""

BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'http://127.0.0.1:8090'
PASSWORD = 'test-admin-pass'
results = []
def check(name, ok):
    results.append(bool(ok))
    print(('  ok   ' if ok else '  FAIL ') + name)

def api(method, path, body=None, token=None):
    h = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
    if token: h['X-Admin-Token'] = token
    rq = urllib.request.Request(BASE + '/api' + path, method=method, headers=h,
                                data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(rq, timeout=10) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read() or b'{}')
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, json.loads(e.read() or b'{}')

async def main():
    _, adm = api('POST', '/admin/login', {'password': PASSWORD})
    tok = adm['token']
    _, before = api('GET', '/admin/settings', token=tok)
    old_tariff = before['settings']['hourly_tariffs']['value']
    new_tariff = dict(old_tariff) if isinstance(old_tariff, dict) else json.loads(old_tariff)
    new_tariff['legal'] = 1777000
    st, _ = api('PUT', '/admin/settings', {'hourly_tariffs': new_tariff}, token=tok)
    check('admin: تغییر نرخ حوزهٔ حقوقی ذخیره شد', st == 200)
    try:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
            # ---- مسافر: نرخ ساعتی از سرور
            pg = await b.new_page(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844})
            errs = []
            pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)))
            await pg.goto(BASE + '/traveler/index.html', wait_until='networkidle')
            await pg.evaluate(TRAV_LOGIN, '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999)))
            await pg.goto(BASE + '/traveler/app.html', wait_until='networkidle')
            await pg.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            rate = await pg.evaluate("() => { const c = document.querySelector('.cat-chip[data-cat=legal]'); return c && c.dataset.rate; }")
            check('مسافر: نرخ legal از سرور خوانده شد (1777000)', rate == '1777000')
            med = await pg.evaluate("() => { const c = document.querySelector('.cat-chip[data-cat=medical]'); return c && c.dataset.rate; }")
            check('مسافر: نرخ medical همچنان از تعرفه (1685000)', med == '1685000')
            check('مسافر: بدون خطای JS', not errs)
            await pg.close()
            # ---- مترجم: کارت‌های جفت‌زبان
            tp = await b.new_page(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 844})
            terr = []
            tp.on('pageerror', lambda e: terr.append(str(e)))
            await tp.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html', wait_until='networkidle')
            await tp.wait_for_timeout(800)
            n = await tp.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('#langCards .lang-item').length")
            check('مترجم: ۶ جفت‌زبان فعال در #langCards', n == 6)
            labels = await tp.evaluate("() => [...document.querySelectorAll('#langCards h4')].map(h => h.textContent)")
            check('مترجم: برچسب ترکی از کاتالوگ آمده', any('ترکی' in x for x in labels))
            check('مترجم: بدون خطای JS', not terr)
            await tp.close()
            await b.close()
    finally:
        st, _ = api('PUT', '/admin/settings', {'hourly_tariffs': old_tariff if isinstance(old_tariff, dict) else json.loads(old_tariff)}, token=tok)
        check('بازگردانی تعرفه', st == 200)
    ok = all(results)
    print('RESULT %d/%d' % (sum(results), len(results)))
    sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/tr_daybar.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/tr_daybar.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"09cc8d9f64e81ca280711d3c882f7f93dc655ddae8a976e8c5b20ae5322ddf94"} -->
````````````````
# No calendar day/status may be inferred from development fixtures; only real reservations produce this schedule.
import asyncio, random
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS, SEED_JS

FIXTURES = [
  {'code': 'M-1', 'purpose': 'fixture', 'travelerName': 'Fixture Day A', 'place': 'Fixture Place A', 'startAt': '2026-11-01T15:00:00.000Z', 'total': 100, 'net': 80, 'status': 'accepted'},
  {'code': 'M-2', 'purpose': 'fixture', 'travelerName': 'Fixture Day B', 'place': 'Fixture Place B', 'startAt': '2026-11-03T09:00:00.000Z', 'total': 200, 'net': 160, 'status': 'accepted'},
]

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
        page = await context.new_page()
        errors = []
        page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
        await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081/translator/index.html')
        token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999)))
        assert token
        await page.evaluate(SEED_JS, [token, FIXTURES])
        await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081/translator/app.html')
        await page.wait_for_function("() => document.querySelector('#missions-list .translator-empty-missions')")
        buttons = await page.locator('#day-bar button').all_text_contents()
        assert buttons == [], buttons
        assert await page.locator('#day-bar').is_hidden()
        mission_text = await page.locator('#missions-list').inner_text()
        schedule_text = await page.locator('#schedule-list').inner_text()
        assert 'Fixture Day' not in mission_text + schedule_text
        assert not errors, errors
        print('PASS: the schedule stays empty until reservation-backed server missions exist')
        await context.close()
        await browser.close()

asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/tr_docs_send_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"f2d18f81d478ed769421f8e5cfbb5aacc11847ca12881acba4c3bc322ae9edf3"} -->
````````````````
# تست ارسال کامل مدارک در مرورگر: انتخاب فایل در گام‌های ۱، ۲ و ۴ → ثبت پرونده → سرور مدارک را دارد
import asyncio, re, sys, random, os, tempfile
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'http://127.0.0.1:8081'
results = []
def check(name, ok):
    results.append(bool(ok))
    print(('  ok   ' if ok else '  FAIL ') + name)

PNG = bytes.fromhex('89504e470d0a1a0a0000000d49484452000000010000000108060000001f15c4890000000d49444154789c6360f8cfc0f01f0005000201a7e6a9b40000000049454e44ae426082')

async def main():
    tdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    png_path = os.path.join(tdir, 'card.png'); open(png_path, 'wb').write(PNG)
    pdf_path = os.path.join(tdir, 'cert.pdf'); open(pdf_path, 'wb').write(b'%PDF-1.4 test')
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900})
        await ctx.route(re.compile(r'https://(unpkg\.com|cdn\.|fonts\.).*'), lambda r: r.abort())
        pg = await ctx.new_page(); errs = []
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:160]))
        # متن شرایط همکاری را از پنل مدیریت ثبت می‌کنیم؛ بدون آن گیت ثبت‌نام عمداً بسته می‌ماند (#c-terms غیرفعال).
        adm = await ctx.request.post(BASE + '/api/admin/login', data={'password': 'test-admin-pass'})
        assert adm.ok, adm.status()
        atok = (await adm.json())['token']
        st = await ctx.request.put(BASE + '/api/admin/settings',
                                   headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + atok},
                                   data={'translator_terms_text': 'شرایط آزمون همکاری مترجم برای ارسال مدارک.'})
        assert st.ok, st.status()
        await pg.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(700)
        # ۱. ورود
        await pg.click('#openTermsBtn'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(200)
        await pg.locator('#infoModal button', has_text='بستن').first.click(); await pg.wait_for_timeout(150)  # بستن پنجرهٔ شرایط  # بازکردن شرایط، پیش‌نیاز تیک‌زدن است
        await pg.fill('#mobileInput', '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999)))
        await pg.check('#c-age'); await pg.check('#c-terms')
        await pg.click('#sendOtpBtn'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(400)
        boxes = pg.locator('#step-panel-1 input[type=text]')
        for i, d in enumerate('123456'): await boxes.nth(i).fill(d)
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
        # کارت ملی (اولین ورودی فایل گام هویت)
        await pg.locator("#step-panel-2 input[type=file]").first.set_input_files(png_path)
        # ۲. گام هویت: همهٔ فیلدهای الزامی فرم فعلی پر می‌شوند
        await pg.fill('#firstName', 'علی')
        await pg.fill('#lastName', 'رضایی')
        await pg.fill('#nationalCode', '0012345678')
        await pg.fill('#birthDate', '1370-05-12')
        await pg.fill('#postalCode', '1234567890')
        await pg.locator("#step-panel-2 label:has(#portraitImg) input[type=file]").set_input_files(png_path)
        # گواهی سوءپیشینه با تاریخ انقضا + گواهی عدم اعتیاد
        await pg.locator("#step-panel-2 [data-doc-kind='criminal_record'] input[type=file]").set_input_files(pdf_path)
        await pg.locator("#step-panel-2 [data-doc-kind='criminal_record'] input[type=date]").fill('2031-02-01')
        await pg.locator("#step-panel-2 [data-doc-kind='drug_free'] input[type=file]").set_input_files(pdf_path)
        for step in (3, 4):
            await pg.evaluate("""(n)=>{const panel=document.getElementById('step-panel-'+(n-1));
               const btn=[...panel.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>(b.getAttribute('onclick')||'').includes('goToStep('+n+')')&&b.offsetHeight);
               if(btn) btn.click();}""", step)
            await pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
        # ۴. گام تخصص: فقط حوزهٔ درمانی می‌ماند و «مدرک زبان» (گیت تخصص) بارگذاری می‌شود
        await pg.locator('#domainsList .domain-card').nth(1).click()  # حذف بازرگانی
        await pg.locator('#domainsList .domain-card').nth(2).click()  # حذف گردشگری
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(200)
        await pg.locator("#step-panel-4 [data-doc-kind='lang_cert'] input[type=file]").set_input_files(pdf_path)
        # همراهی با خودرو فعال می‌شود تا مدارک خودرو/گواهینامه و فیلدهای خودرو لازم شوند
        await pg.locator('#carToggleLabel').click(); await pg.wait_for_timeout(250)
        await pg.fill('#carModel', 'پژو پارس آزمون')
        await pg.fill('#carColor', 'سفید')
        await pg.fill('#carPlate', '۱۲ ب ۳۴۵ ایران ۲۲')
        await pg.fill('#carCapacity', '4')
        await pg.locator("#step-panel-4 [data-doc-kind='car_docs'] input[type=file]").set_input_files(pdf_path)
        await pg.locator("#step-panel-4 [data-doc-kind='car_docs'] input[type=date]").fill('2031-03-01')
        await pg.locator("#step-panel-4 [data-doc-kind='licence'] input[type=file]").set_input_files(pdf_path)
        await pg.locator("#step-panel-4 [data-doc-kind='licence'] input[type=date]").fill('2031-01-01')
        await pg.evaluate("""()=>{const panel=document.getElementById('step-panel-4');
               const btn=[...panel.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>(b.getAttribute('onclick')||'').includes('goToStep(5)')&&b.offsetHeight);
               if(btn) btn.click();}""")
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
        # ۵. گام قرارداد: شبا (۲۴ رقم بدون IR) و پذیرش تعهدنامه (NDA)
        await pg.fill('#shabaInput', '123456789012345678901234')
        await pg.check('#termsConsent')
        # ۳. ثبت نهایی
        ok = await pg.evaluate("""()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>(b.getAttribute('onclick')||'').includes('finishRegistration()')&&b.offsetHeight);
           if(!b) return false; b.click(); return true;}""")
        check('دکمه‌ی ثبت نهایی کلیک شد', ok)
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        token = await pg.evaluate("()=>HZ.load().token")
        docs = await pg.evaluate("""async (t)=>{const r=await fetch('/api/translator/documents',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+t}});return (await r.json()).documents||[];}""", token)
        kinds = {d['kind']: d for d in docs}
        check('مدرک زبان (گیت تخصص) روی سرور است', 'lang_cert' in kinds and kinds['lang_cert']['status'] == 'uploaded')
        check('کارت ملی روی سرور است', 'nid_card' in kinds and kinds['nid_card']['status'] == 'uploaded')
        check('گواهی سوءپیشینه با تاریخ انقضا روی سرور است', 'criminal_record' in kinds and bool(kinds['criminal_record'].get('expires_at')))
        check('گواهینامه با تاریخ انقضا روی سرور است', 'licence' in kinds and bool(kinds['licence'].get('expires_at')))
        check('پرونده ثبت شد (در انتظار بررسی نهایی)', await pg.evaluate("()=>HZ.load().status") == 'pending_review')
        check('خطای صفحه', not errs)
        await b.close()
        ok_all = all(results)
        print('RESULT:', 'PASS' if ok_all else 'FAIL', f'({sum(results)}/{len(results)})')
        sys.exit(0 if ok_all else 1)

asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

````````````````
# تست بخش مدارک گام‌های ۲ و ۴ در اپ مترجم: کادرها ساخته می‌شوند و فایل انتخابی نگه داشته می‌شود
import asyncio, re, sys, os, tempfile
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'http://127.0.0.1:8081'
results = []
def check(name, ok):
    results.append(bool(ok))
    print(('  ok   ' if ok else '  FAIL ') + name)

async def main():
    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.pdf', delete=False)
    tmp.write(b'%PDF-1.4 test'); tmp.close()
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900})
        await ctx.route(re.compile(r'https://(unpkg\.com|cdn\.|fonts\.).*'), lambda r: r.abort())
        P = await ctx.new_page(); perr = []
        P.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)[:120]))
        await P.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html'); await P.wait_for_timeout(800)
        n2 = await P.evaluate("()=>document.querySelectorAll('#step-panel-2 [data-doc-kind]').length")
        n4 = await P.evaluate("()=>document.querySelectorAll('#step-panel-4 [data-doc-kind]').length")
        # طراحی فعلی (نردبان CAP): گام ۲ دو مدرک؛ گام ۴ یک «مدرک زبان» (گیت تخصص‌ها) + دو مدرک خودرو = ۳
        check('دو کادر مدرک در گام ۲ است', n2 == 2)
        check('سه کادر مدرک در گام ۴ است (مدرک زبان + دو مدرک خودرو)', n4 == 3)
        inp = P.locator("#step-panel-2 [data-doc-kind='criminal_record'] input[type=file]")
        await inp.set_input_files(tmp.name)
        await P.wait_for_timeout(300)
        kept = await P.evaluate("()=>!!(window.hzDocFiles && window.hzDocFiles.criminal_record)")
        check('فایل انتخاب‌شده نگه داشته می‌شود', kept)
        label = await P.evaluate("()=>document.querySelector(\"#step-panel-2 [data-doc-kind='criminal_record']\").textContent")
        check('نام فایل نشان داده می‌شود', os.path.basename(tmp.name) in label)
        check('خطای صفحه', not perr)
        await b.close()
        ok = all(results)
        print('RESULT:', 'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL', f'({sum(results)}/{len(results)})')
        os.unlink(tmp.name)
        sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

````````````````
import asyncio, re, json, sys, random
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
W = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 390
async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': W, 'height': 900})
        await ctx.route(re.compile(r'https://(unpkg\.com|cdn\.|fonts\.).*'), lambda r: r.abort())
        pg = await ctx.new_page(); errs = []; log = []
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:160]))
        # متن شرایط همکاری را از پنل مدیریت ثبت می‌کنیم؛ بدون آن گیت ثبت‌نام عمداً بسته می‌ماند (#c-terms غیرفعال).
        adm = await ctx.request.post('http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/admin/login', data={'password': 'test-admin-pass'})
        assert adm.ok, adm.status()
        atok = (await adm.json())['token']
        st = await ctx.request.put('http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/admin/settings',
                                   headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + atok},
                                   data={'translator_terms_text': 'شرایط آزمون همکاری مترجم برای e2e.'})
        assert st.ok, st.status()
        await pg.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081/translator/index.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(700)
        # 1. login
        await pg.click('#openTermsBtn'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(200)
        await pg.locator('#infoModal button', has_text='بستن').first.click(); await pg.wait_for_timeout(150)  # بستن پنجرهٔ شرایط  # بازکردن شرایط، پیش‌نیاز تیک‌زدن است
        await pg.fill('#mobileInput', '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999))); await pg.check('#c-age'); await pg.check('#c-terms')
        await pg.click('#sendOtpBtn'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(400)
        boxes = pg.locator('#step-panel-1 input[type=text]')
        for i, d in enumerate('123456'): await boxes.nth(i).fill(d)
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(800)
        log.append(('after code', await pg.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('step-panel-2').offsetHeight>0")))
        # 2..5: click the visible forward button of each panel
        for step in (3, 4, 5):
            ok = await pg.evaluate("""(n)=>{const panel=document.getElementById('step-panel-'+(n-1));
               const btn=[...panel.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>(b.getAttribute('onclick')||'').includes('goToStep('+n+')')&&b.offsetHeight);
               if(!btn) return false; btn.click(); return true;}""", step)
            log.append((f'go to step {step}', ok))
            await pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
        # step 5 -> finish
        ok = await pg.evaluate("""()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>(b.getAttribute('onclick')||'').includes('finishRegistration()')&&b.offsetHeight);
           if(!b) return false; b.click(); return true;}""")
        log.append(('finish clicked', ok)); await pg.wait_for_timeout(700)
        log.append(('success panel', await pg.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('step-panel-success').classList.contains('active')")))
        log.append(('status after finish', await pg.evaluate("()=>HZ.load().status")))
        # enter desk before approval: must show message, stay on index
        log.append(('success visible', await pg.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('step-panel-success').offsetHeight>0")))
        log.append(('panels', await pg.evaluate("()=>[1,2,3,4,5,'success'].map(n=>n+':'+(document.getElementById('step-panel-'+n).offsetHeight>0?'v':'h')).join(' ')")))
        if not any(k=='success visible' and v for k,v in log):
            for k,v in log: print(f'  {k:28s} {v}')
            print('  errors:', errs[:5]); await b.close(); return
        await pg.evaluate("()=>document.querySelector('#step-panel-success button[onclick=\"enterDesk()\"]').click()"); await pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
        log.append(('pending message', (await pg.text_content('#desk-msg') or '')[:30]))
        log.append(('still index before approval', pg.url.split('/')[-1] == 'index.html'))
        srv = await pg.evaluate("async()=>{const t=HZ.load().token; const r=await fetch('/api/translator/status',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+t}}); return (await r.json()).status;}")
        log.append(('server status before approval', srv))
        assert srv == 'pending_review', f'server status {srv}'
        # 3. approval via dev API (UI has no test-approve button anymore) -> desk
        await pg.evaluate("""async()=>{const t=HZ.load().token; await fetch('/api/dev/approve-translator',{method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+t}});}""")
        await pg.evaluate('()=>document.querySelector("#step-panel-success button[onclick*=enterDesk]").click()'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        log.append(('desk url', pg.url.split('/')[-1]))
        # 4. desk checks
        d = await pg.evaluate("""()=>({h: document.querySelector('h1,h2') && document.querySelector('h2').textContent.trim(),
            missions: [...document.getElementById('missions-list').children].map(c=>c.textContent.trim().slice(0,30)),
            schedule: document.getElementById('schedule-list').children.length,
            sampleHidden: !document.getElementById('missions-sample'),
            hscroll: document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth})""")
        log.append(('desk info', d))
        print(f'== full e2e {W}px')
        for k, v in log: print(f'  {k:28s} {v}')
        print('  errors:', [e for e in errs if 'tailwind' not in e] or 'none')
        await pg.screenshot(path=f'assets/tr_e2e_desk_{W}.png')
        await b.close()
asyncio.run(main())

````````````````
````````````````
# تست کارت مصاحبه‌ی زنده در میز کار مترجم: نمایش نوبت‌های آزاد، رزرو، و نبودن اتاق ویدئویی (هماهنگی حضوری یا بیرونی)
import asyncio, re, json, random, datetime, sys, urllib.request
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'http://127.0.0.1:8081'
PASSWORD = 'test-admin-pass'
PNG = 'data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNkYPhfDwAChwGA60e6kgAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=='
results = []
def check(name, ok):
    results.append(bool(ok))
    print(('  ok   ' if ok else '  FAIL ') + name)

def api(method, path, body=None, token=None):
    h = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
    if token: h['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + token
    rq = urllib.request.Request(BASE + '/api' + path, method=method, headers=h,
                                data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(rq, timeout=10) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read() or b'{}')
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, json.loads(e.read() or b'{}')

# ورود و ثبت‌نام مترجم از راه API (بدون تأیید؛ مصاحبه قبل از تأیید انجام می‌شود)
PHONE_JS = """async ([phone, token]) => {
  const st = HZ.load(); st.token = token; st.session = {phone, until: Date.now() + 3600e3};
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) st.completed[i] = true; st.status = 'active_general'; st.profile = {nameFa: 'نازنین', lastFa: 'تست'}; HZ.save(st); return true;
}"""

async def main():
    phone = '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999))
    api('POST', '/auth/request-code', {'phone': phone, 'role': 'translator'})
    _, v = api('POST', '/auth/verify', {'phone': phone, 'role': 'translator', 'code': '123456'})
    tok = v['token']
    api('POST', '/translator/registration', {'nda': True, 'charter': True, 'gender': 'female', 'first_name': 'نازنین',
        'last_name': 'تست', 'city': 'تهران', 'car': False, 'languages': ['ar', 'fa'], 'fields': ['general']}, tok)
    _, adm = api('POST', '/admin/login', {'password': PASSWORD})
    atok = adm.get('token')
    soon = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) + datetime.timedelta(days=2)
    _, sl = api('POST', '/admin/interview-slots', {'starts_at': soon.isoformat()}, atok)
    _, sl2 = api('POST', '/admin/interview-slots', {'starts_at': (soon + datetime.timedelta(hours=1)).isoformat()}, atok)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 900})
        await ctx.route(re.compile(r'https://(unpkg\.com|cdn\.|fonts\.).*'), lambda r: r.abort())
        pg = await ctx.new_page(); errs = []
        pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:140]))
        await pg.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(600)
        await pg.evaluate(PHONE_JS, [phone, tok])
        await pg.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        await pg.evaluate("""()=>{ const b=document.querySelector('#desk-nav [data-desk-view="credentials"]'); b.click(); }"""); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        box = await pg.evaluate("()=>{const e=document.getElementById('iv-box'); return e ? e.innerText : null}")
        check('کارت مصاحبه در میز کار نمایش داده می‌شود', box is not None and 'مصاحبه' in box)
        btns = pg.locator('#iv-box button')
        n = await btns.count()
        check('نوبت‌های آزاد به‌صورت دکمه نمایش داده می‌شوند', n >= 2)
        await pg.evaluate("()=>{const bs=[...document.querySelectorAll('#iv-box button')]; bs[0].click();}")
        await pg.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        box2 = await pg.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('iv-box').innerText")
        check('پس از رزرو، نوبت شما نمایش داده می‌شود', 'نوبت شما' in box2)
        msg = await pg.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('iv-box').innerText")
        check('دکمه‌ی ورود به اتاق مصاحبه وجود ندارد', await pg.get_by_role('button', name='ورود به اتاق مصاحبه').count() == 0)
        check('لینک اتاق در میز کار نیست', 'rooms.hamzaban' not in msg)
        check('خطای صفحه', not errs)
        await b.close()
    print('RESULT:', 'PASS' if all(results) else 'FAIL', f'({sum(results)}/{len(results)})')
    sys.exit(0 if all(results) else 1)

asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

````````````````
# تست وضعیت زنده‌ی مدارک در میز کار مترجم: مدرک ارسالی و وضعیت آن نشان داده می‌شود
import asyncio, re, sys, random
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'http://127.0.0.1:8081'
results = []
def check(name, ok):
    results.append(bool(ok))
    print(('  ok   ' if ok else '  FAIL ') + name)

PNG = 'data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNkYPhfDwAChwGA60e6kgAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=='

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900})
        await ctx.route(re.compile(r'https://(unpkg\.com|cdn\.|fonts\.).*'), lambda r: r.abort())
        P = await ctx.new_page(); perr = []
        P.on('pageerror', lambda e: perr.append(str(e)[:120]))
        await P.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html'); await P.wait_for_timeout(600)
        phone = '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999))
        await P.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, phone)
        tok = await P.evaluate("()=>HZ.load().token")
        await P.evaluate("async (t)=>{ await fetch('/api/dev/approve-translator',{method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+t}}); }", tok)
        status = await P.evaluate("""async ([t, png]) => {
          const x = await fetch('/api/translator/documents', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json', Authorization:'Bearer '+t}, body: JSON.stringify({kind:'criminal_record', data: png, expires_at:'2031-01-01'})});
          return x.status; }""", [tok, PNG])
        check('گواهی سوءپیشینه ارسال شد', status == 200)
        await P.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html'); await P.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        await P.evaluate("()=>{ const b=document.querySelector('[data-target=credentials]') || [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.getAttribute('onclick')&&x.getAttribute('onclick').includes(\"switchView('credentials')\")); if (b) b.click(); else switchView('credentials'); }")
        await P.wait_for_timeout(800)
        txt = await P.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('live-docs-box') ? document.getElementById('live-docs-box').textContent : ''")
        check('نام مدرک نشان داده می‌شود', 'گواهی عدم سوءپیشینه' in txt)
        check('وضعیت «در انتظار بررسی» نشان داده می‌شود', 'در انتظار بررسی' in txt)
        check('محتوای مدرک نشان داده نمی‌شود', 'iVBOR' not in txt)
        cap = await P.evaluate("()=>document.getElementById('cap-box') ? document.getElementById('cap-box').textContent : ''")
        check('وضعیت صلاحیت و گیت مدرک زبان از سرور نشان داده می‌شود', 'احراز هویت' in cap and 'مدرک زبان' in cap)
        static_hidden = await P.evaluate("()=>{const g=document.getElementById('static-cap-grid'); return !g || getComputedStyle(g).display === 'none';}")
        check('متن نمایشی ثابت CAP دیده نمی‌شود', static_hidden)
        check('خطای صفحه', not perr)
        await b.close()
        ok = all(results)
        print('RESULT:', 'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL', f'({sum(results)}/{len(results)})')
        sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

````````````````
"""Responsive smoke test: development fixture rows must not render as real missions."""
import asyncio, random, re
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8081'
FIXTURES = [
    {'code': 'fixture-1', 'purpose': 'general', 'travelerName': 'Fixture Passenger', 'place': 'Fixture Place',
     'startAt': '2026-11-01T10:00:00.000Z', 'total': 3200000, 'net': 2560000, 'status': 'accepted'},
]
LOGIN_JS = """async (phone) => {
  const headers = {'Content-Type':'application/json'};
  await fetch('/api/auth/request-code',{method:'POST',headers,body:JSON.stringify({phone,role:'translator'})});
  const v=await (await fetch('/api/auth/verify',{method:'POST',headers,body:JSON.stringify({phone,role:'translator',code:'123456'})})).json();
  if(!v.token)return null;
  const s=HZ.load();s.token=v.token;s.session={phone,until:Date.now()+3600e3};s.completed[1]=true;HZ.save(s);
  await fetch('/api/dev/approve-translator',{method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+v.token}});
  s.status='active_general';s.profile={nameFa:'آزمون',lastFa:'محلی'};HZ.save(s);return v.token;
}"""

async def scenario(browser, width):
    context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': width, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
    page = await context.new_page()
    await page.route(re.compile('https://(unpkg[.]com|cdn[.]|fonts[.]).*'), lambda route: route.abort())
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
    await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
    phone = '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999))
    token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, phone)
    assert token
    for mission in FIXTURES:
        response = await page.evaluate("""async ([token, mission]) => {
          const r=await fetch('/api/dev/missions',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',Authorization:'Bearer '+token},body:JSON.stringify(mission)});
          return r.status;
        }""", [token, mission])
        assert response == 200
    await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
    await page.wait_for_function("() => document.querySelector('#missions-list .translator-empty-missions')")
    text = await page.locator('#missions-list').inner_text()
    assert 'Fixture Passenger' not in text and 'Fixture Place' not in text, text
    assert await page.locator('#day-bar').is_hidden()
    assert await page.locator('#translator-map').is_visible()
    assert await page.locator('#translator-map-placeholder').is_visible()
    assert await page.locator('#translator-map .leaflet-marker-icon').count() == 0
    assert not errors, errors
    print(f'PASS [{width}]: no development fixture cards or map points appear')
    await context.close()

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser, 390)
            await scenario(browser, 1280)
        finally:
            await browser.close()

asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

````````````````
# توسعه-only mission rows are fixtures, not reservations; the translator UI must never render them as real work.
import asyncio, random, sys
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS, SEED_JS

BASE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'http://127.0.0.1:8081'
FIXTURES = [
  {'code': 'M-1', 'purpose': 'general', 'travelerName': 'Fixture Traveler A', 'place': 'Fixture Place A', 'startAt': '2026-11-01T09:00:00.000Z', 'total': 3200000, 'net': 2560000, 'status': 'accepted'},
  {'code': 'M-2', 'purpose': 'medical', 'travelerName': 'Fixture Traveler B', 'place': 'Fixture Place B', 'startAt': '2026-11-02T09:00:00.000Z', 'total': 900000, 'net': 720000, 'status': 'accepted'},
]

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
        page = await context.new_page()
        errors = []
        page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999)))
        assert token, 'translator API login failed'
        await page.evaluate(SEED_JS, [token, FIXTURES])
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
        await page.wait_for_function("() => document.querySelector('#missions-list .translator-empty-missions')")
        cards = await page.locator('#missions-list').inner_text()
        assert 'Fixture Traveler' not in cards and 'Fixture Place' not in cards, cards
        assert 'فعلاً مأموریت پذیرفته‌شده‌ای ندارید' in cards, cards
        assert await page.locator('#day-bar button').count() == 0
        assert await page.locator('#day-bar').is_hidden()
        schedule_text = await page.locator('#schedule-list').inner_text()
        assert 'Fixture Traveler' not in schedule_text and 'Fixture Place' not in schedule_text
        assert not errors, errors
        print('PASS: development-only mission fixtures are excluded; only reservation-backed mission cards reach the translator workspace')
        await context.close()
        await browser.close()

asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

````````````````
import asyncio, re, json
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        for w in (390, 1280):
            ctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': w, 'height': 844})
            await ctx.route(re.compile(r'https://(unpkg\.com|cdn\.|fonts\.googleapis\.com|fonts\.gstatic\.com).*'), lambda r: r.abort())
            pg = await ctx.new_page(); errs = []
            pg.on('pageerror', lambda e: errs.append(str(e)[:160]))
            pg.on('console', lambda m: errs.append('console:' + m.text[:120]) if m.type == 'error' else None)
            await pg.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081/translator/index.html'); await pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
            print('== width', w, 'url', pg.url.split('/')[-1])
            info = await pg.evaluate("""()=>{
              const vis = e => !!(e.offsetWidth || e.offsetHeight) && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden';
              const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,a')].filter(vis).map(e=>(e.id||'')+'|'+(e.textContent||'').trim().slice(0,30)+'|dis='+e.disabled);
              const inputs=[...document.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea')].filter(vis).map(e=>(e.id||e.name||e.type)+'|'+(e.placeholder||'')+'|val='+e.value.slice(0,15));
              const steps=[...document.querySelectorAll('[id^=step],[id^=screen],[data-step]')].map(e=>e.id+':'+(vis(e)?'shown':'hidden'));
              return {btns, inputs, steps, bodyH: document.body.scrollHeight};
            }""")
            print(json.dumps(info, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)[:2500])
            await pg.screenshot(path=f'assets/tr_login_{w}.png', full_page=True)
            print('errors:', errs[:8] or 'none')
            await ctx.close()
        await b.close()
asyncio.run(main())
````````````````
