````````````````
"""Pre-start cancellation needs an explicit receipt and private committed history."""
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import secrets
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api, booking, arrive_and_start
from booking_options_ui import login, translator
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

ERROR = 'نتیجهٔ عملیات تأیید نشد. وضعیت مأموریت را بررسی کنید و سپس دوباره تلاش کنید.'
SUCCESS = 'لغو مأموریت شما ثبت شد؛ پیدا شدن مترجم جایگزین هنوز قطعی نیست.'
ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_translator_cancel_actions'


async def scenario(browser):
    ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
    page = await ctx.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(20000)
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
    try:
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000))
        await api(ctx.request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', token, {'online': True})
        ptok, _ = await login(ctx.request, 'traveler')

        async def create(label):
            data = {'kind': 'instant', 'origin_lang': 'ar',
                    'dest_lang': 'fa', 'place': label, 'traveler_name': 'آزمون لغو واقعی مترجم'}
            b = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/traveler/bookings', ptok, data, status=201)
            o = next(o for o in (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/offers', token))['offers'] if o['reservation_id'] == b['id'])
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/translator/offers/{o['id']}/accept", token)
            return b

        b = await create('لغو اصلی')
        rid = b['id']
        pattern = f'**/api/translator/missions/{rid}/cancel'
        canonical = f'**/api/translator/missions/{rid}/cancellation'
        receipt = {'ok': True, 'reservation_id': rid, 'cancelled_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'reassigned': True}

        def cancel():
            return page.locator('#missions-list').get_by_role('button', name='لغو مأموریت', exact=True)

        async def open_app(reservation=None):
            # هر فراخوانی باید مأموریت خودش را بکاود؛ rid پیش‌فرض فقط برای مأموریت اصلی است
            # (رزروهای بعدی مثل b2/b3 شناسهٔ خودشان را می‌گیرند).
            target = reservation['id'] if reservation else rid
            await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
            await expect(cancel()).to_be_visible()
            mission = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{target}', token)
            if not mission['arrived_at']:
                arrival = page.locator('#missions-list').get_by_role('button', name='رسیدم به محل ملاقات', exact=True)
                await expect(arrival).to_be_visible()
                await arrival.click()
                await expect(page.locator('#missions-list').get_by_role('button', name='تأیید کد و آغاز همراهی', exact=True)).to_be_visible()
            await page.evaluate('''()=>{window.cancelToasts=[];const toast=HZ.toast;
                HZ.toast=(s)=>{cancelToasts.push(s);toast(s)}}''')

        async def clear():
            await page.evaluate('()=>{cancelToasts=[]}')

        async def failed():
            await page.wait_for_function('(s)=>cancelToasts.includes(s)', arg=ERROR)
            assert not await page.evaluate('(s)=>cancelToasts.includes(s)', SUCCESS)

        await open_app()
        for mode in ('network', 'http', 'html', 'empty', 'partial', 'contradictory'):
            async def fault(route, request, *, mode=mode):
                if mode == 'network': await route.abort()
                elif mode == 'http': await route.fulfill(status=503, json={'error': 'unavailable'})
                elif mode == 'html': await route.fulfill(body='<html>offline</html>')
                else: await route.fulfill(json={} if mode == 'empty' else {'ok': True} if mode == 'partial' else receipt)
            await page.route(pattern, fault)
            await clear()
            await cancel().click()
            await failed()
            await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
            await expect(cancel()).to_be_enabled()
            unchanged = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid)
            assert unchanged['status'] == 'matched' and unchanged['total'] == b['total']
            print('PASS cancellation', mode)

        posts = 0
        async def no_post(route):
            nonlocal posts
            posts += 1
            await route.abort()
        await page.route(pattern, no_post)
        for patch in ({'reservation_id': rid + 999}, {'cancelled': 'false'}, {'assigned': False},
                      {'cancelled_at': 'invalid'}, {'cancelled': True, 'cancelled_at': receipt['cancelled_at']}):
            async def bad_view(route, request, *, patch=patch):
                response = await route.fetch()
                data = await response.json()
                data.update(patch)
                await route.fulfill(json=data)
            await page.route(canonical, bad_view)
            await clear()
            await cancel().click()
            await failed()
            await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
            await page.route(pattern, no_post)
            await expect(cancel()).to_be_enabled()
        assert posts == 0
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')

        # Opposing start and duplicate calendar controls share the reservation lock.
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        async def held(route):
            nonlocal posts
            posts += 1
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json={})
        await page.route(pattern, held)
        await clear()
        await cancel().click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await expect(cancel()).to_be_disabled()
        await expect(page.locator('#missions-list').get_by_role('button', name='تأیید کد و آغاز همراهی', exact=True)).to_be_disabled()
        await page.evaluate("()=>document.querySelector('#day-bar button').click()")
        assert await page.locator(f'[data-service-mission="{rid}"]:not(:disabled)').count() == 0
        await page.evaluate('()=>document.querySelectorAll("[data-service-mission]").forEach(b=>b.click())')
        assert posts == 1
        release.set()
        await failed()
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        await expect(cancel()).to_be_enabled()

        await page.clock.install()
        await page.evaluate('''(rid)=>{window.cancelRid=rid;window.originalFetch=fetch;window.fetch=(url,opts)=>
            String(url).endsWith('/missions/' + cancelRid + '/cancel') && opts.method==='POST'
            ? (window.cancelStalled=true,new Promise(()=>{})) : originalFetch(url,opts)}''', rid)
        await clear()
        await cancel().click()
        await page.wait_for_function('()=>window.cancelStalled===true')
        await page.clock.run_for(10001)
        await failed()
        await page.evaluate('()=>{window.fetch=originalFetch}')
        await page.clock.resume()
        await expect(cancel()).to_be_enabled()

        other = await translator(ctx.request, 'male')
        await api(ctx.request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', other, {'online': False})
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        async def late(route):
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json=receipt)
        await page.route(pattern, late)
        await clear()
        await cancel().click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await page.evaluate('(t)=>{let s=HZ.load();s.token=t;HZ.save(s)}', other)
        release.set()
        await expect(cancel()).to_be_enabled()
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>cancelToasts.length') == 0
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        posts = 0
        await page.route(pattern, no_post)
        await cancel().click()
        await page.evaluate('()=>new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve))')
        assert posts == 0
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        await page.evaluate('(t)=>{let s=HZ.load();s.token=t;HZ.save(s)}', token)
        await open_app()

        # A retained old UI handler is safe; its stale in-flight list cannot restore the released mission.
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        once = False
        async def old_list(route):
            nonlocal once
            if once:
                await route.fallback()
                return
            once = True
            response = await route.fetch()
            data = await response.json()
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json=data, headers={'x-cancel-old': '1'})
        async def empty_receipt(route):
            await route.fulfill(json={})
        await page.route('**/api/translator/missions', old_list)
        await page.route(pattern, empty_receipt)
        await cancel().evaluate('(b)=>{window.retainedCancel=b}')
        await clear()
        await cancel().click()
        await failed()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await page.unroute(pattern, empty_receipt)
        await clear()
        await page.evaluate('()=>retainedCancel.click()')
        await page.wait_for_function('(s)=>cancelToasts.includes(s)', arg=SUCCESS)
        await expect(cancel()).to_have_count(0)
        async with page.expect_response(lambda r: r.headers.get('x-cancel-old') == '1'):
            release.set()
        await page.evaluate('()=>new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve)))')
        await expect(cancel()).to_have_count(0)
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        released = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{rid}/cancellation', token)
        assert released['cancelled'] and not released['assigned'] and released['cancelled_at']
        after = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid)
        assert not after['matched'] and after['total'] == b['total'] and not after['service_started']

        await api(ctx.request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', other, {'online': True})
        replacement = next(o for o in (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/offers', other))['offers'] if o['reservation_id'] == rid)
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/translator/offers/{replacement['id']}/accept", other)
        assert (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{rid}/cancellation', token)) == released
        await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{rid}', token, status=404)
        replacement_history = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{rid}/cancellation', other)
        assert replacement_history['cancelled'] is False and replacement_history['assigned'] is True
        await api(ctx.request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', other, {'online': False})

        b2 = await create('پاسخ لغو گم‌شده')
        await open_app(b2)
        async def lost_receipt(route):
            await route.fetch()
            await route.abort()
        await page.route(f"**/api/translator/missions/{b2['id']}/cancel", lost_receipt)
        await clear()
        await cancel().click()
        await failed()
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        assert (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f"/translator/missions/{b2['id']}/cancellation", token))['cancelled']
        assert not (await booking(ctx.request, ptok, b2['id']))['matched']

        b3 = await create('شروع در دستگاه دیگر')
        await open_app(b3)
        await arrive_and_start(ctx.request, b3['id'], token, b3['service_code'])
        posts = 0
        await page.route(f"**/api/translator/missions/{b3['id']}/cancel", no_post)
        await clear()
        await cancel().click()
        await failed()
        assert posts == 0
        await expect(cancel()).to_have_count(0)
        assert (await booking(ctx.request, ptok, b3['id']))['service_started']
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/traveler/bookings/{b3['id']}/finish", ptok)

        assert not errors, errors
        print('PASS cancellation: committed release, no replacement promise, unchanged price, faults, shared locks, timeout, session isolation, stale list, lost response and blocked cancellation after start')
    except Exception:
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / 'failure.png'), full_page=True)
        raise
    finally:
        await ctx.close()


async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser)
        finally:
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())

## `reference/tests/translator_cash_actions_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/translator_cash_actions_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"40ee353dacc5a1a88982a38f9b0cdaaf974762702e77cde23ddba256b0fb9a53"} -->
````````````````
"""Translator cash controls must reconcile the exact private server payment.
Real lifecycle and owner authorization; faults only intercept specified requests.
"""
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
import secrets
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api, booking, arrive_and_start
from booking_options_ui import login, translator
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

ERROR = 'نتیجهٔ عملیات تأیید نشد. وضعیت مأموریت را بررسی کنید و سپس دوباره تلاش کنید.'
ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_translator_cash_actions'


async def scenario(browser):
    ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
    page = await ctx.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(20000)
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
    try:
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000))
        await api(ctx.request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', token, {'online': True})
        ptok, _ = await login(ctx.request, 'traveler')

        async def create(label):
            b = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/traveler/bookings', ptok, {
                'kind': 'instant', 'origin_lang': 'ar', 'dest_lang': 'fa',
                'place': label, 'traveler_name': 'آزمون پرداخت'}, status=201)
            offers = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/offers', token)
            offer = next(o for o in offers['offers'] if o['place'] == label)
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/translator/offers/{offer['id']}/accept", token)
            await arrive_and_start(ctx.request, b['id'], token, b['service_code'])
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/traveler/bookings/{b['id']}/finish", ptok)
            await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/traveler/bookings/{b['id']}/payment", ptok, {'method': 'cash'})
            return b

        b = await create('نقدی اصلی')
        second = await create('نقدی اختلاف')
        rid = b['id']
        pattern = f'**/api/translator/missions/{rid}'
        confirm_pattern = pattern + '/cash-confirm'
        disputed_pattern = pattern + '/cash-dispute'

        def card(bid=rid):
            return page.locator(f'[data-payment-reservation="{bid}"]')

        def button(action, bid=rid):
            label = 'تأیید دریافت وجه' if action == 'cash-confirm' else 'ثبت اختلاف'
            return page.locator('#mission-cash-modal').get_by_role('button', name=label, exact=True)

        async def prepare_payment_action(action, bid=rid):
            modal = page.locator('#mission-cash-modal')
            # پس از شکست، مودال باز می‌ماند (طرح corrections جدید)؛ قبل از بازکردن دوباره، آن را می‌بندیم.
            if await modal.is_visible():
                await modal.locator('[data-modal-close]').first.click()
                await expect(modal).to_be_hidden()
            trigger = card(bid).get_by_role('button', name='دریافت وجه را تأیید می‌کنم' if action == 'cash-confirm' else 'اختلاف دارم', exact=True)
            await trigger.click()
            await expect(modal).to_be_visible()

        async def open_app():
            await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
            await expect(card().get_by_role('button', name='دریافت وجه را تأیید می‌کنم', exact=True)).to_be_visible()
            await page.evaluate('''() => {window.cashToasts=[]; const toast=HZ.toast;
                HZ.toast=(s)=>{cashToasts.push(s);toast(s)};}''')

        async def clear():
            await page.evaluate('() => {cashToasts=[]}')

        async def failed():
            await page.wait_for_function('(s)=>cashToasts.includes(s)', arg=ERROR)
            assert not await page.evaluate("() => cashToasts.some(s=>['پرداخت تسویه شد.','اختلاف پرداخت ثبت شد.','دریافت شما ثبت شد؛ منتظر تأیید مسافر.'].includes(s))")

        async def unchanged():
            data = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid)
            assert data['status'] == 'finished' and data['pay_state'] == 'awaiting_cash' and data['total'] == b['total']
            private = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{rid}', token)
            assert private['confirmed'] is False

        await open_app()
        await expect(page.locator('[data-settlement-reservation]')).to_have_count(0)
        for action in ('cash-confirm', 'cash-dispute'):
            for mode in ('network', 'http', 'html', 'empty', 'partial', 'contradictory', 'typed', 'wrong_status'):
                async def fault(route, request, *, mode=mode, action=action):
                    receipt = {'ok': True, 'settled': True, 'waiting_traveler': False} if action == 'cash-confirm' else {'ok': True, 'pay_state': 'disputed'}
                    if mode == 'network': await route.abort()
                    elif mode == 'http': await route.fulfill(status=503, json={'error': 'unavailable'})
                    elif mode == 'html': await route.fulfill(body='<html>offline</html>')
                    else:
                        if mode == 'typed': receipt = {'ok': True, 'settled': 'true', 'waiting_traveler': False, 'pay_state': True}
                        await route.fulfill(status=202 if mode == 'wrong_status' else 200,
                                            json={} if mode == 'empty' else {'ok': True} if mode == 'partial' else receipt)
                post = pattern + '/' + action
                await page.route(post, fault)
                await clear()
                await prepare_payment_action(action)
                await button(action).click()
                await failed()
                await page.unroute(post, fault)
                await expect(button(action)).to_be_enabled()
                await unchanged()
                print('PASS', action, mode)

        # Bad identity/amount/types must stop before a financial mutation.
        posts = 0
        async def forbidden_post(route):
            nonlocal posts
            posts += 1
            await route.abort()
        await page.route(confirm_pattern, forbidden_post)
        for patch in ({'reservation_id': rid + 999}, {'total': b['total'] + 1}, {'confirmed': 'false'},
                      {'traveler_paid': None}, {'pay_state': 'settled'}, {'status': 'matched'}, {'net': -1}):
            async def bad_state(route, request, *, patch=patch):
                response = await route.fetch()
                data = await response.json()
                data.update(patch)
                await route.fulfill(json=data)
            await page.route(pattern, bad_state)
            await clear()
            await prepare_payment_action('cash-confirm')
            await button('cash-confirm').click()
            await failed()
            await expect(button('cash-confirm')).to_be_enabled()
            await page.unroute(pattern, bad_state)
        assert posts == 0
        await page.unroute(confirm_pattern, forbidden_post)

        # Poll-driven replacements must keep both opposing actions disabled.
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        async def held(route):
            nonlocal posts
            posts += 1
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json={})
        await page.route(confirm_pattern, held)
        await clear()
        await card().evaluate('(e)=>e.dataset.beforePoll="1"')
        await prepare_payment_action('cash-confirm')
        await button('cash-confirm').click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await expect(button('cash-confirm')).to_be_disabled()
        await expect(button('cash-dispute')).to_be_disabled()
        await expect(page.locator('[data-before-poll]')).to_have_count(0)
        await expect(button('cash-dispute')).to_be_disabled()
        await card().evaluate('(e)=>e.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b=>b.click())')
        assert posts == 1
        release.set()
        await failed()
        await page.unroute(confirm_pattern, held)
        await expect(button('cash-confirm')).to_be_enabled()

        # Whole-operation timeout, even if a transport ignores AbortSignal.
        await page.clock.install()
        await page.evaluate('''() => {window.originalFetch=fetch; window.fetch=(url,opts)=>
            String(url).endsWith('/cash-confirm') && opts.method==='POST'
            ? (window.cashStalled=true,new Promise(()=>{})) : originalFetch(url,opts)}''')
        await clear()
        await prepare_payment_action('cash-confirm')
        await button('cash-confirm').click()
        await page.wait_for_function('() => window.cashStalled === true')
        await page.clock.run_for(10001)
        await failed()
        await page.evaluate('() => {window.fetch=originalFetch}')
        await page.clock.resume()
        await expect(button('cash-confirm')).to_be_enabled()
        await unchanged()

        # A previous account's late response and old card cannot act as the next user.
        other = await translator(ctx.request, 'male')
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        async def late(route):
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json={'ok': True, 'settled': True, 'waiting_traveler': False})
        await page.route(confirm_pattern, late)
        await clear()
        await prepare_payment_action('cash-confirm')
        await button('cash-confirm').click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await page.evaluate('(token)=>{let s=HZ.load();s.token=token;HZ.save(s)}', other)
        release.set()
        await page.wait_for_function('() => !document.querySelector("[aria-busy=true]")')
        assert await page.evaluate('() => cashToasts.length') == 0
        await page.unroute(confirm_pattern, late)
        posts = 0
        await page.route(confirm_pattern, forbidden_post)
        # مودال پس از پاسخ دیرهنگام با context حساب قبلی باز مانده است؛
        # کلیک روی همان مودال نباید به نام کاربر جدید درخواستی بفرستد.
        await expect(page.locator('#mission-cash-modal')).to_be_visible()
        await button('cash-confirm').click()
        await page.evaluate('() => new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve))')
        assert posts == 0 and await page.evaluate('() => cashToasts.length') == 0
        await page.unroute(confirm_pattern, forbidden_post)
        await page.evaluate('(token)=>{let s=HZ.load();s.token=token;HZ.save(s)}', token)
        await open_app()

        # Malformed payment-list snapshots clear old actionable cards and expose retry.
        async def bad_list(route):
            await route.fulfill(json={'payments': [{'reservation_id': rid, 'confirmed': 'false'}]})
        await page.route('**/api/translator/payments', bad_list)
        await expect(page.locator('#payments-box')).to_contain_text('وضعیت پرداخت‌ها دریافت نشد')
        await expect(card()).to_have_count(0)
        await page.unroute('**/api/translator/payments', bad_list)
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='دریافت دوبارهٔ پرداخت‌ها', exact=True).click()
        await expect(card()).to_be_visible()
        # پس از بازیابی فهرست، مودال تأیید دوباره باز و فعال می‌شود
        await prepare_payment_action('cash-confirm')
        await expect(button('cash-confirm')).to_be_enabled()

        # Hold an old list response across a real confirm. It must not resurrect
        # the already-settled payment card once the action refresh has applied.
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        once = False
        async def old_list(route):
            nonlocal once
            if once:
                await route.fallback()
                return
            once = True
            response = await route.fetch()
            data = await response.json()
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json=data, headers={'x-cash-stale': '1'})
        await page.route('**/api/translator/payments', old_list)
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await clear()
        await prepare_payment_action('cash-confirm')
        await button('cash-confirm').click()
        await page.wait_for_function("() => cashToasts.includes('پرداخت تسویه شد.')")
        await expect(card()).to_have_count(0)
        # تسویه‌های نهایی در پنل میز کار نیستند؛ پنل فقط کارت اقدام‌پذیر دارد (تاریخچه در نمای مالی)
        await expect(page.locator('#payments-box [data-settlement-reservation]')).to_have_count(0)
        async with page.expect_response(lambda r: r.headers.get('x-cash-stale') == '1'):
            release.set()
        await page.evaluate('() => new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve)))')
        await expect(card()).to_have_count(0)
        await page.unroute('**/api/translator/payments', old_list)
        settled = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid)
        assert settled['status'] == 'done' and settled['pay_state'] == 'settled' and settled['total'] == b['total']

        # تسویهٔ نهایی فقط در گزارش مالی ظاهر می‌شود (کارت کامل از دادهٔ واقعی سرور)
        await page.locator('.desk-nav-item[data-desk-view="earnings"]').click()
        settlement_card = page.locator(f'#view-earnings [data-settlement-reservation="{rid}"]')
        await expect(settlement_card).to_be_visible()
        await expect(settlement_card).to_contain_text('نهایی و تأییدشده در سرور')
        await expect(settlement_card).to_contain_text('نقدی')
        await page.locator('#view-earnings .translator-alt-back').click()
        await expect(page.locator('#payments-box')).to_be_attached()

        await clear()
        await prepare_payment_action('cash-dispute', second['id'])
        await button('cash-dispute', second['id']).click()
        await page.wait_for_function("() => cashToasts.includes('اختلاف پرداخت ثبت شد.')")
        await expect(card(second['id'])).to_contain_text('اختلاف پرداخت ثبت شده')
        await expect(card(second['id']).get_by_role('button')).to_have_count(0)
        await expect(page.locator(f'[data-settlement-reservation="{second["id"]}"]')).to_have_count(0)
        disputed = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, second['id'])
        assert disputed['status'] == 'finished' and disputed['pay_state'] == 'disputed' and disputed['total'] == second['total']
        assert not errors, errors
        print('PASS translator cash: real confirm/dispute, unchanged amounts, faults, locks, timeout, stale list, account isolation')
    except Exception:
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / 'failure.png'), full_page=True)
        raise
    finally:
        await ctx.close()


async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser)
        finally:
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())

## `reference/tests/translator_change_actions_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/translator_change_actions_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"84a80f818ba77b69049fa33d25ad06161a90349b9dc9f47b1325bebe09e8b859"} -->
````````````````
"""Translator change consent requires the exact recorded decision AND mission details."""
import asyncio
import secrets
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api, booking
from booking_options_ui import login, translator
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

ERROR = 'نتیجهٔ عملیات تأیید نشد. وضعیت مأموریت را بررسی کنید و سپس دوباره تلاش کنید.'
ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_translator_change_actions'


async def scenario(browser):
    ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
    page = await ctx.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(20000)
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
    try:
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000))
        await api(ctx.request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', token, {'online': True})
        ptok, _ = await login(ctx.request, 'traveler')
        b = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/traveler/bookings', ptok, {
            'kind': 'instant', 'origin_lang': 'ar', 'dest_lang': 'fa', 'place': 'محل اولیه',
            'traveler_name': 'آزمون رضایت تغییر', 'car': False, 'hours': 2}, status=201)
        rid = b['id']
        offer = next(o for o in (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/offers', token))['offers'] if o['reservation_id'] == rid)
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/translator/offers/{offer['id']}/accept", token)
        # سقف مدت مأموریت ۱۲ ساعت است (رفع یافتهٔ #6)؛ تغییر به ۱۰ ساعت در محدودهٔ مجاز اعمال می‌شود.
        changes = {'place': 'محل جدید توافقی', 'hours': 10, 'car': True, 'party': 3, 'notes': 'یادداشت همراه تغییر'}
        c = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f'/traveler/bookings/{rid}/change', ptok, changes, status=202)
        cid = c['id']
        pattern = f'**/api/translator/changes/{cid}'
        before = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{rid}', token)

        def card(change_id=cid):
            return page.locator(f'[data-change-id="{change_id}"]')

        def button(action, change_id=cid):
            return card(change_id).get_by_role('button', name='پذیرش' if action == 'accept' else 'رد', exact=True)

        def start_button():
            return page.locator('#missions-list').get_by_role('button', name='تأیید کد و آغاز همراهی', exact=True)

        async def fill_code(code):
            for index, digit in enumerate(code):
                await page.locator('#missions-list input').nth(index).fill(digit)

        async def open_app():
            await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
            await expect(button('accept')).to_be_visible()
            mission = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{rid}', token)
            if not mission['arrived_at']:
                arrival = page.locator('#missions-list').get_by_role('button', name='رسیدم به محل ملاقات', exact=True)
                await expect(arrival).to_be_visible()
                await arrival.click()
                await expect(start_button()).to_be_visible()
            await page.evaluate('''()=>{window.changeToasts=[]; const toast=HZ.toast;
                HZ.toast=(s)=>{changeToasts.push(s);toast(s)}}''')

        async def clear():
            await page.evaluate('()=>{changeToasts=[]}')

        async def failed():
            await page.wait_for_function('(s)=>changeToasts.includes(s)', arg=ERROR)
            assert not await page.evaluate("()=>changeToasts.some(s=>s==='تغییر پذیرفته شد.' || s==='رد تغییر ثبت شد.')")

        await open_app()
        await expect(card()).to_contain_text('یادداشت همراه تغییر')
        for action in ('accept', 'reject'):
            for mode in ('network', 'http', 'html', 'empty', 'contradictory'):
                async def fault(route, request, *, mode=mode):
                    if mode == 'network': await route.abort()
                    elif mode == 'http': await route.fulfill(status=503, json={'error': 'unavailable'})
                    elif mode == 'html': await route.fulfill(body='<html>offline</html>')
                    else: await route.fulfill(json={} if mode == 'empty' else {'ok': True})
                post = pattern + '/' + action
                await page.route(post, fault)
                await clear()
                await button(action).click()
                await failed()
                await page.unroute(post, fault)
                await expect(button(action)).to_be_enabled()
                unchanged = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{rid}', token)
                assert unchanged['details'] == before['details'] and unchanged['total'] == before['total']
                print('PASS change', action, mode)

        # Fabricated accepted history alone cannot substitute for applied mission details.
        receipt_sent = False
        async def fabricated_receipt(route):
            nonlocal receipt_sent
            receipt_sent = True
            await route.fulfill(json={'ok': True})
        async def fabricated_decision(route):
            response = await route.fetch()
            data = await response.json()
            if receipt_sent: data['status'] = 'accepted'
            await route.fulfill(json=data)
        await page.route(pattern, fabricated_decision)
        await page.route(pattern + '/accept', fabricated_receipt)
        await clear()
        await button('accept').click()
        await failed()
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        await expect(button('accept')).to_be_enabled()

        posts = 0
        async def no_post(route):
            nonlocal posts
            posts += 1
            await route.abort()
        await page.route(pattern + '/accept', no_post)
        for patch in ({'id': cid + 999}, {'reservation_id': rid + 999}, {'changes': {'place': 'تغییر دیگر'}},
                      {'changes': {'unknown_column': 'x'}}, {'status': 'expired'}, {'expires_at': 'invalid'}):
            async def malformed(route, request, *, patch=patch):
                response = await route.fetch()
                data = await response.json()
                data.update(patch)
                await route.fulfill(json=data)
            await page.route(pattern, malformed)
            await clear()
            await button('accept').click()
            await failed()
            await page.unroute(pattern, malformed)
            await expect(button('accept')).to_be_enabled()
        assert posts == 0
        await page.unroute(pattern + '/accept', no_post)

        # Opposing actions and mission start share the reservation lock, including re-render.
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        async def held(route):
            nonlocal posts
            posts += 1
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json={})
        async def changed_list(route):
            response = await route.fetch()
            data = await response.json()
            for row in data['changes']: row['place'] = 'بازسازی کارت'
            await route.fulfill(json=data)
        await page.route(pattern + '/accept', held)
        await page.route('**/api/translator/offers', changed_list)
        await clear()
        await card().evaluate('(e)=>e.dataset.beforePoll="1"')
        await button('accept').click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await expect(button('reject')).to_be_disabled()
        await expect(start_button()).to_be_disabled()
        await expect(page.locator('[data-before-poll]')).to_have_count(0)
        await expect(button('reject')).to_be_disabled()
        await card().evaluate('(e)=>e.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b=>b.click())')
        assert posts == 1
        release.set()
        await failed()
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        await expect(button('accept')).to_be_enabled()

        await page.clock.install()
        await page.evaluate('''(id)=>{window.currentChange=id; window.originalFetch=fetch; window.fetch=(url,opts)=>
            String(url).endsWith('/changes/' + currentChange + '/accept') && opts.method==='POST'
            ? (window.changeStalled=true,new Promise(()=>{})) : originalFetch(url,opts)}''', cid)
        await clear()
        await button('accept').click()
        await page.wait_for_function('()=>window.changeStalled===true')
        await page.clock.run_for(10001)
        await failed()
        await page.evaluate('()=>{window.fetch=originalFetch}')
        await page.clock.resume()
        await expect(button('accept')).to_be_enabled()

        other = await translator(ctx.request, 'male')
        await api(ctx.request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', other, {'online': False})
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        async def late(route):
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json={'ok': True})
        await page.route(pattern + '/accept', late)
        await clear()
        await button('accept').click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await page.evaluate('(t)=>{let s=HZ.load();s.token=t;HZ.save(s)}', other)
        release.set()
        await expect(button('accept')).to_be_enabled()
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>changeToasts.length') == 0
        await page.unroute(pattern + '/accept', late)
        posts = 0
        await page.route(pattern + '/accept', no_post)
        await button('accept').click()
        await page.evaluate('()=>new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve))')
        assert posts == 0
        await page.unroute(pattern + '/accept', no_post)
        await page.evaluate('(t)=>{let s=HZ.load();s.token=t;HZ.save(s)}', token)
        await open_app()

        async def bad_list(route):
            await route.fulfill(json={'offers': [], 'changes': [{'id': cid, 'reservation_id': rid,
                'changes': {'hours': '20'}, 'expires_at': c['expires_at']}], 'extensions': []})
        await page.route('**/api/translator/offers', bad_list)
        await expect(page.locator('#offers-box')).to_contain_text('دریافت درخواست‌ها انجام نشد')
        await expect(card()).to_have_count(0)
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='تلاش دوباره', exact=True).click()
        await expect(button('accept')).to_be_enabled()

        # Keep one old pending list in flight across real acceptance.
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        once = False
        async def old_list(route):
            nonlocal once
            if once:
                await route.fallback()
                return
            once = True
            response = await route.fetch()
            data = await response.json()
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json=data, headers={'x-change-old': '1'})
        await page.route('**/api/translator/offers', old_list)
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await clear()
        await button('accept').click()
        await page.wait_for_function("()=>changeToasts.includes('تغییر پذیرفته شد.')")
        await expect(card()).to_have_count(0)
        async with page.expect_response(lambda r: r.headers.get('x-change-old') == '1'):
            release.set()
        await page.evaluate('()=>new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve)))')
        await expect(card()).to_have_count(0)
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        accepted = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{rid}', token)
        assert accepted['details']['place'] == changes['place'] and accepted['hours'] == 10
        assert accepted['details']['car'] == 1 and accepted['details']['party'] == 3
        assert accepted['details']['notes'] == changes['notes'] and accepted['total'] == before['total'] and accepted['net'] == before['net']

        second = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f'/traveler/bookings/{rid}/change', ptok, {'place': 'تغییر مردود'}, status=202)
        await expect(button('reject', second['id'])).to_be_visible()
        await clear()
        await button('reject', second['id']).click()
        await page.wait_for_function("()=>changeToasts.includes('رد تغییر ثبت شد.')")
        assert (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{rid}', token))['details'] == accepted['details']

        third = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f'/traveler/bookings/{rid}/change', ptok, {'place': 'رد با پاسخ گم‌شده'}, status=202)
        await expect(button('reject', third['id'])).to_be_visible()
        async def lost_receipt(route):
            await route.fetch()
            await route.abort()
        post = f"**/api/translator/changes/{third['id']}/reject"
        await page.route(post, lost_receipt)
        await clear()
        await button('reject', third['id']).click()
        await failed()
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        assert (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f"/translator/changes/{third['id']}", token))['status'] == 'rejected'
        assert (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{rid}', token))['details'] == accepted['details']

        # Existing allowed change must not strand subsequent service controls.
        # تغییر مکان، رسیدن ثبت‌شده را در سرور پاک می‌کند؛ دوباره رسیدن را ثبت می‌کنیم.
        arrive_btn = page.locator('#missions-list').get_by_role('button', name='رسیدم به محل ملاقات', exact=True)
        if await arrive_btn.count():
            await arrive_btn.click()
            await expect(page.locator('#missions-list').get_by_role('button', name='تأیید کد و آغاز همراهی', exact=True)).to_be_visible()
        await fill_code(b['service_code'])
        await page.locator('#missions-list').get_by_role('button', name='تأیید کد و آغاز همراهی', exact=True).click()
        await page.wait_for_function("()=>changeToasts.includes('خدمت شروع شد.')")
        result = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid)
        assert result['hours'] == 10 and result['service_started'] and result['total'] == before['total']
        assert not errors, errors
        print('PASS change consent: exact applied details, preserved price snapshot, real accept/reject, faults, shared locks, timeout and session isolation')
    except Exception:
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / 'failure.png'), full_page=True)
        raise
    finally:
        await ctx.close()


async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser)
        finally:
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())

````````````````
"""Translator workspace must use real server offers, never a canned dispatch simulation."""
import asyncio
import os
import secrets
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

BASE = os.environ.get('BASE', 'http://127.0.0.1:8081')
ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_translator_dispatch_truth'
FORBIDDEN = (
    'اعزام فوری پزشکی', 'MAT-030', 'بیمارستان دی', 'عبدالرحمن السالم',
    '۲,۳۵۰,۰۰۰', '2,350,000', '۱.۸ کیلومتر', '۵ دقیقه',
    'تماس با مسافر (+۹۶۴)', 'مسیریابی با نشان / بلد',
    'رسیده به محل بیمارستان دی', 'تسویه خودکار پس از پایان مأموریت',
    'در انتظار درخواست بعدی سامانه دیسپچ', 'پیشنهاد جدید اعزام بارگذاری شد',
    'اعزام‌های فوری فرودگاهی و بیمارستانی',
)
FAKE_IDS = (
    'dispatch-view-wrapper', 'dispatch-offer-card', 'inline-active-dispatch-card',
    'dispatch-empty-card', 'countdown-number', 'inline-confirm-arrival-btn',
    'mission-live-timer',
)
FAKE_HANDLERS = (
    'handleAcceptMission', 'handleRejectMission', 'revertToDispatchOffer',
    'resetDispatchDemo', 'callPassengerSecurely', 'openNavigatorApp',
    'confirmArrivalAtDestination',
)


async def scenario(browser, width):
    context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': width, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
    page = await context.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(15000)
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda err: errors.append(str(err)))
    try:
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        phone = '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000)
        token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, phone)
        assert token, 'translator session was not established'
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
        workspace = page.locator('#view-workspace')
        await expect(workspace).to_be_visible()
        await expect(workspace.locator('#calendar-section')).to_be_visible()
        await expect(workspace.locator('#offers-box')).to_be_attached()
        await expect(workspace.locator('#missions-list')).to_be_attached()

        text = await workspace.inner_text()
        for value in FORBIDDEN:
            assert value not in text, f'canned dispatch data remains in workspace: {value}'
        for selector in FAKE_IDS:
            assert await page.locator('#' + selector).count() == 0, f'legacy dispatch element remains: #{selector}'
        handlers = await page.evaluate('(names) => names.filter(name => typeof window[name] === "function")', list(FAKE_HANDLERS))
        assert not handlers, f'fake dispatch handlers remain: {handlers}'
        await expect(page.locator('#shift-status-desc')).not_to_contain_text('اعزام فوری')
        await page.evaluate('''() => {
            window.__dispatchToasts = [];
            const original = window.showToast;
            window.showToast = function (message, ...args) {
                window.__dispatchToasts.push(String(message));
                return original.call(this, message, ...args);
            };
        }''')
        if width == 390:
            # The former canned countdown falsely announced a rejection 14 seconds after load.
            await page.wait_for_timeout(16000)
            toasts = await page.evaluate('() => window.__dispatchToasts')
            assert not any('مأموریت رد شد' in message or 'دیسپچ' in message for message in toasts), toasts
        assert not errors, errors
        print(f'PASS [{width}]: no canned mission/tracking/actions; live offers and mission containers remain')
    except Exception:
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / f'failure-{width}.png'), full_page=True)
            (ARTIFACTS / f'failure-{width}.html').write_text(await page.content())
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise
    finally:
        await context.close()


async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser, 390)
            await scenario(browser, 1280)
        finally:
            await browser.close()
    print('RESULT: PASS (2/2 viewports)')


asyncio.run(main())

"""The translator earnings view must not invent balances or payout history."""
import asyncio
import os
import secrets
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

BASE = os.environ.get('BASE', 'http://127.0.0.1:8081')
ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_translator_earnings_truth'
FORBIDDEN = (
    '۴,۹۲۰,۰۰۰', '٤,٩٢٠,٠٠٠', '4,920,000', 'IR820170000000123456789012',
    'IR8201...', 'PAYA-7701', 'شاپرک', 'تسویه پایا خودکار', 'موجودی قابل تسویه',
    'نمودار درآمد ۷ روز گذشته', 'مجموع هفته:', '۱۱,۳۵۰,۰۰۰',
    'آخرین واریزی‌های مأموریت', 'هیئت تجاری امارات', 'کلینیک نور',
    'ترانسفر CIP فرودگاه', '۲,۴۰۰,۰۰۰', '۱,۸۵۰,۰۰۰', '۱,۶۰۰,۰۰۰',
)


async def scenario(browser, width):
    context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': width, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
    page = await context.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(15000)
    errors, payment_posts = [], []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda err: errors.append(str(err)))
    page.on('request', lambda request: payment_posts.append(request.url)
            if request.method == 'POST' and request.url.rstrip('/').endswith('/payment') else None)
    try:
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        phone = '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000)
        token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, phone)
        assert token, 'translator session was not established'
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
        await page.locator('#header-financial-shortcut').click()
        view = page.locator('#view-earnings')
        summary = page.locator('#earnings-summary')
        await expect(view).to_be_visible()
        # نمای مالی اکنون سرور-پشتیبان است: خلاصه از /translator/payments می‌آید، نه متن ثابت
        await expect(summary).to_be_visible()
        await expect(summary).to_contain_text('رزروهای در انتظار تسویه')
        debt = page.locator('#earnings-debt')
        # مترجم تازه‌ثبت‌نام‌شده بدهی ندارد؛ اگر بنر بدهی دیده شد باید عدد واقعی سرور باشد
        if await debt.is_visible():
            assert 'تومان' in await debt.inner_text()
        text = await view.inner_text()
        for value in FORBIDDEN:
            assert value not in text, f'fabricated earnings or settlement data remains: {value}'
        assert not payment_posts, f'opening the report must not initiate payment: {payment_posts}'
        await page.locator('#view-earnings .translator-alt-back').click()
        await expect(page.locator('#view-workspace')).to_be_visible()
        await expect(page.locator('#payments-box')).to_be_attached()
        assert not errors, errors
        print(f'PASS [{width}]: no invented wallet, account, income, or payout data/actions; server-backed payment area remains')
    except Exception:
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / f'failure-{width}.png'), full_page=True)
            (ARTIFACTS / f'failure-{width}.html').write_text(await page.content())
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise
    finally:
        await context.close()


async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser, 390)
            await scenario(browser, 1280)
        finally:
            await browser.close()
    print('RESULT: PASS (2/2 viewports)')


asyncio.run(main())

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/translator_mission_actions.test.js","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"b05e0aa875ae0f687069b89b032e2c1718bad3be16688254cf1b7ef42bbf2cb7"} -->
````````````````
'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const vm = require('node:vm');
const test = require('node:test');

const root = path.join(__dirname, '..');
const actionsSource = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'translator/mission-actions.js'), 'utf8');
const appSource = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'translator/app.js'), 'utf8');
const ERROR = 'نتیجهٔ عملیات تأیید نشد. وضعیت مأموریت را بررسی کنید و سپس دوباره تلاش کنید.';

function createRunner(action, serverTimeOffset) {
  const clientNow = 100_000;
  const serverExpiredAt = new Date(clientNow + 4_000).toISOString();
  const requests = [];
  const toasts = [];
  const token = 'translator-session';
  const mission = {
    reservation_id: 42, status: 'matched', started: true, finish_requested: false,
    arrived_at: null, service_started_at: new Date(clientNow - 10_000).toISOString(),
    hours: 1, total: 100, net: 80,
    details: {
      scheduled_at: null, place: 'Old meeting place', origin_lang: 'fa', dest_lang: 'en',
      field: 'general', hours: 1, car: 0, party: 1, gender_pref: 'any', notes: ''
    }
  };
  const change = {
    id: 88, reservation_id: 42, status: 'pending', expires_at: serverExpiredAt,
    changes: { place: 'New meeting place' }
  };
  const offer = {
    id: 77, reservation_id: 42, status: 'pending', assigned: false,
    expires_at: serverExpiredAt, net: 80
  };
  const extension = {
    id: 99, reservation_id: 42, status: 'pending', extra_hours: 1,
    extra_total: 100, extra_net: 80, expires_at: serverExpiredAt
  };
  const FakeDate = class extends Date {
    static now() { return clientNow; }
  };
  function reply(data) { return { ok: true, status: 200, json: async () => data }; }
  const sandbox = {
    window: {
      HZ: {
        load: () => ({ token }),
        authHeaders: () => ({ Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token }),
        toast: (message) => toasts.push(message)
      }
    },
    document: { querySelectorAll: () => [] },
    Date: FakeDate,
    AbortController,
    fetch: async (url, options) => {
      requests.push({ url, method: options.method });
      if (options.method === 'POST') return reply({ ok: true });
      if (url.endsWith('/offers/77')) return reply(offer);
      if (url.endsWith('/changes/88')) return reply(change);
      if (url.endsWith('/extensions/99')) return reply(extension);
      if (url.endsWith('/missions/42')) return reply(mission);
      throw new Error('Unexpected test request: ' + url);
    },
    setTimeout,
    clearTimeout
  };
  vm.runInNewContext(actionsSource, sandbox, { filename: 'translator/mission-actions.js' });
  const options = {
    action, reservation_id: 42, id: action === 'offer-accept' ? 77 : action === 'change-accept' ? 88 : 99,
    token, serverTimeOffset
  };
  if (action === 'offer-accept') options.net = 80;
  if (action === 'change-accept') options.changes = { place: 'New meeting place' };
  return { run: () => sandbox.window.HZ_MISSION_ACTION.run(options), requests, toasts };
}

test('offer, change and extension expiry guards use the server-clock offset, not a skewed client clock', async () => {
  // The browser clock is four seconds before expiry, but the server is five
  // seconds ahead. Each operation must stop before sending its mutation.
  for (const action of ['offer-accept', 'change-accept', 'accept']) {
    const runner = createRunner(action, 5_000);
    await runner.run();
    assert.equal(runner.requests.filter((request) => request.method === 'POST').length, 0, action);
    assert.deepEqual(runner.toasts, [ERROR], action);
  }
});

test('translator operation callers pass the offer endpoint server-time offset into expiry checks', () => {
  assert.match(appSource, /serverTimeOffset:\s*offerServerClockOffset/);
  assert.match(actionsSource, /Date\.parse\(before\.expires_at\)\s*<=\s*serverNow\(options\.serverTimeOffset\)/);
  assert.match(actionsSource, /Date\.parse\(e\.expires_at\)\s*<=\s*serverNow\(options\.serverTimeOffset\)/g);
  assert.equal((actionsSource.match(/<= serverNow\(options\.serverTimeOffset\)/g) || []).length, 3);
});

'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const crypto = require('node:crypto');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const vm = require('node:vm');
const test = require('node:test');

const root = path.join(__dirname, '..');
const source = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'translator/mission-map.js'), 'utf8');
const workspaceHTML = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'translator/app.html'), 'utf8');
const appSource = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'translator/app.js'), 'utf8');
const styleSource = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'translator/code6.css'), 'utf8');
const utilitySource = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'translator/code6-utilities.css'), 'utf8');
const serviceWorkerSource = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'translator/sw.js'), 'utf8');
const serverSource = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'server/server.js'), 'utf8');
const leafletCSS = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'traveler/vendor/leaflet/leaflet.css'));
const leafletJS = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'traveler/vendor/leaflet/leaflet.js'));
const sri = (content) => 'sha384-' + crypto.createHash('sha384').update(content).digest('base64');

function createFixture(origin = 'https://preview.example') {
  const elements = {
    'translator-map': { style: {}, offsetWidth: 360, offsetHeight: 720 },
    'translator-map-preview-note': { hidden: true },
    'translator-map-preview-open': { hidden: false, href: '' },
    'translator-map-placeholder': { hidden: false },
    'translator-map-placeholder-title': { textContent: '' },
    'translator-map-placeholder-note': { textContent: '' },
    'translator-map-location': { hidden: true },
    'translator-map-label': { textContent: '' },
    'translator-map-open': { hidden: true, href: '' },
    'translator-map-zoom-in': { disabled: true },
    'translator-map-zoom-out': { disabled: true },
    'translator-map-recenter': { disabled: true }
  };
  let mapCreated = 0;
  const mapState = {
    center: null,
    zoom: 0,
    worldFits: 0,
    worldView: false,
    layers: [],
    removed: [],
    setView(center, zoom) { this.center = center.slice(); this.zoom = zoom; this.worldView = false; return this; },
    fitWorld(options) { this.worldFits++; this.fitOptions = options; this.center = null; this.zoom = 2; this.worldView = true; return this; },
    setZoom(zoom) { this.zoom = zoom; return this; },
    getZoom() { return this.zoom; },
    invalidateSize() { this.invalidated = true; },
    removeLayer(layer) { this.removed.push(layer); if (this.marker === layer) this.marker = null; }
  };
  const L = {
    map(_element, options) { mapCreated++; mapState.options = options; return mapState; },
    tileLayer(url, options) {
      const layer = { url, options, addTo(map) { map.layers.push(this); return this; } };
      return layer;
    },
    marker(latlng, options) {
      return {
        latlng: latlng.slice(), options, tooltip: null,
        addTo(map) { map.marker = this; return this; },
        setLatLng(next) { this.latlng = next.slice(); return this; },
        bindTooltip(content, tooltipOptions) { this.tooltip = { content, options: tooltipOptions }; return this; },
        setTooltipContent(content) { if (this.tooltip) this.tooltip.content = content; return this; }
      };
    }
  };
  const window = {
    origin,
    location: { href: 'https://preview.example/translator/app.html' },
    L,
    requestAnimationFrame(callback) { callback(); },
    addEventListener() {}
  };
  const document = { getElementById(id) { return elements[id] || null; } };
  vm.runInNewContext(source, { window, document }, { filename: 'mission-map.js' });
  return { elements, window, mapState, get mapCreated() { return mapCreated; } };
}

test('shows the real base map before an accepted mission, without inventing a meeting pin or center', () => {
  const f = createFixture();
  assert.equal(f.mapCreated, 1);
  assert.equal(f.mapState.layers[0].url, 'https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png');
  assert.equal(f.mapState.worldFits, 1);
  assert.equal(f.mapState.worldView, true);
  assert.equal(f.mapState.zoom, 2);
  assert.equal(f.mapState.options.minZoom, 2);
  assert.equal(f.mapState.center, null); // fitWorld is a neutral overview, not a mission coordinate.
  assert.equal(f.mapState.marker, undefined);
  assert.equal(f.elements['translator-map-placeholder'].hidden, false);
  assert.equal(f.elements['translator-map'].style.visibility, 'visible');
  assert.equal(f.elements['translator-map-zoom-in'].disabled, false);
  assert.equal(f.window.HZ_TRANSLATOR_MAP.setMission({ reservation_id: 42, lat: '35.6997', lng: 51.338 }), false);
  assert.equal(f.window.HZ_TRANSLATOR_MAP.setMission({ lat: 35.6997, lng: 51.338 }), false);
  assert.equal(f.window.HZ_TRANSLATOR_MAP.setMission({ reservation_id: 0, lat: 35.6997, lng: 51.338 }), false);
  assert.equal(f.mapCreated, 1);
  assert.equal(f.mapState.marker, undefined);
  assert.equal(f.mapState.center, null);
});

test('uses the shared OpenStreetMap tiles and only the accepted mission point', () => {
  const f = createFixture();

## `reference/tests/translator_notifications_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/translator_notifications_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"627dcc3018820659ee1af6507371820f3ceadb119c6791c2be7321f15088813e"} -->
````````````````
"""Account-bound, server-backed translator notifications on mobile and desktop."""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import secrets
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

BASE = os.environ.get('BASE', 'http://127.0.0.1:8081')
ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_translator_notifications'
PNG = 'data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNkYPhfDwAChwGA60e6kgAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=='
READY = 'اعلان‌های ثبت‌شدهٔ این حساب از سرور دریافت شدند.'
ERROR = 'دریافت اعلان‌ها انجام نشد. دوباره تلاش کنید.'
CHANGED = 'حساب تغییر کرده است؛ اعلان‌ها را دوباره دریافت کنید.'


async def api(page, method, path, token=None, body=None, admin=False):
    return await page.evaluate("""async ({method, path, token, body, admin}) => {
      const headers = {};
      if (body !== null && body !== undefined) headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
      if (token) headers[admin ? 'X-Admin-Token' : 'Authorization'] = admin ? token : 'Bearer ' + token;
      const response = await fetch(path, {method, headers, body: body === null || body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body), cache: 'no-store'});
      let data = null; try { data = await response.json(); } catch (_) {}
      return {status: response.status, data};
    }""", {'method': method, 'path': path, 'token': token, 'body': body, 'admin': admin})


async def translator_token(page, phone):
    token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, phone)
    assert token, 'translator login did not issue a token'
    return token


async def create_real_rejection(page, translator, phone):
    uploaded = await api(page, 'POST', '/api/translator/documents', translator, {
        'kind': 'criminal_record', 'data': PNG, 'expires_at': '2035-01-01'
    })
    assert uploaded['status'] == 200 and uploaded['data']['status'] == 'uploaded', uploaded
    login = await api(page, 'POST', '/api/admin/login', body={
        'password': os.environ.get('HZ_ADMIN_PASSWORD', 'test-admin-pass')
    })
    assert login['status'] == 200 and login['data'].get('token'), login
    admin = login['data']['token']
    docs = await api(page, 'GET', '/api/admin/documents?status=uploaded', admin, admin=True)
    assert docs['status'] == 200, docs
    doc = next((d for d in docs['data']['documents'] if d['phone'] == phone and d['kind'] == 'criminal_record'), None)
    assert doc, 'uploaded test document missing from admin review queue'
    reason = '<img src=x onerror=window.__notificationXss=1>'
    rejected = await api(page, 'POST', f"/api/admin/documents/{doc['id']}/decision", admin,
                         {'decision': 'reject', 'reason': reason}, admin=True)
    assert rejected['status'] == 200 and rejected['data'].get('ok') is True, rejected
    feed = await api(page, 'GET', '/api/translator/notifications', translator)
    assert feed['status'] == 200 and len(feed['data']['notifications']) == 1, feed
    item = feed['data']['notifications'][0]
    assert item['kind'] == 'doc_rejected' and reason in item['text'], item
    return item, reason


async def scenario(browser, width):
    context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': width, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
    page = await context.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(15000)
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda err: errors.append(str(err)))
    phone = '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000)
    notification_requests = []
    page.on('request', lambda req: notification_requests.append(req.method)
            if '/api/translator/notifications' in req.url else None)
    try:
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        first_token = await translator_token(page, phone)
        item, reason = await create_real_rejection(page, first_token, phone)
        # Login helper seeds only this browser's session; the notification is independently created by the real admin workflow.
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
        await page.locator('#notifications-btn').wait_for(state='visible')
        notification_requests.clear()
        button = page.locator('#notifications-btn')
        panel = page.locator('#inline-notifications-panel')
        status = page.locator('#notifications-status')
        listing = page.locator('#notifications-list')
        retry = page.locator('#notifications-retry')
        read_disabled = page.locator('#notifications-mark-read')

        await button.click()
        await expect(panel).to_be_visible()
        await expect(button).to_have_attribute('aria-expanded', 'true')
        await expect(status).to_have_text(READY)
        card = listing.locator('[data-notification-id]')
        await expect(card).to_have_count(1)
        await expect(card).to_contain_text('گواهی عدم سوءپیشینه')
        await expect(card).to_contain_text(reason)
        assert await card.locator('img').count() == 0, 'untrusted notification text became HTML'
        assert await page.evaluate('window.__notificationXss || false') is False
        assert await page.locator('#notifications-btn .bg-error').count() == 0, 'a fake unread badge is still shown'
        assert 'واریز موفق پایا' not in await panel.inner_text()
        assert '۱,۸۵۰,۰۰۰' not in await panel.inner_text()
        assert await read_disabled.is_disabled(), 'read state must not claim to work without server support'
        # The unsupported read action is inert, and notifications are fetched read-only.
        await read_disabled.evaluate('(button) => button.click()')
        assert notification_requests == ['GET'], notification_requests
        assert item['id'] == int(await card.get_attribute('data-notification-id'))

        await retry.click()
        await expect(status).to_have_text(READY)
        assert notification_requests == ['GET', 'GET'], notification_requests
        await page.locator('#notifications-close').click()
        await expect(panel).to_be_hidden()
        await expect(button).to_have_attribute('aria-expanded', 'false')
        await expect(button).to_be_focused()

        # HTTP/auth failures clear the previous notification and leave retry available.
        async def unauthorized(route):
            await route.fulfill(status=401, content_type='application/json', body='{"error":"unauthorized"}')
        await page.route('**/api/translator/notifications', unauthorized)
        await button.click()
        await expect(status).to_have_text(ERROR)
        await expect(listing.locator('[data-notification-id]')).to_have_count(0)
        await expect(retry).to_be_enabled()
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        await retry.click()
        await expect(status).to_have_text(READY)
        await expect(card).to_have_count(1)

        async def offline(route):
            await route.abort()
        await page.route('**/api/translator/notifications', offline)
        await retry.click()
        await expect(status).to_have_text(ERROR)
        await expect(listing.locator('[data-notification-id]')).to_have_count(0)
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        await retry.click()
        await expect(status).to_have_text(READY)
        await expect(card).to_have_count(1)

        async def malformed(route):
            await route.fulfill(status=200, content_type='application/json', body='{"notifications":[{}]}')
        await page.route('**/api/translator/notifications', malformed)
        await retry.click()
        await expect(status).to_have_text(ERROR)
        await expect(listing.locator('[data-notification-id]')).to_have_count(0)
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        await retry.click()
        await expect(status).to_have_text(READY)
        await expect(card).to_have_count(1)

        # A second account has no access to the first account's private notification.
        second_phone = '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000)
        second_token = await translator_token(page, second_phone)
        await page.evaluate("""(token) => {
          const state = HZ.load(); state.token = token; HZ.save(state);
          window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
        }""", second_token)
        await expect(status).to_have_text(CHANGED)
        await expect(listing.locator('[data-notification-id]')).to_have_count(0)
        await retry.click()
        await expect(status).to_have_text('اعلانی برای این حساب ثبت نشده است.')
        await expect(listing.locator('[data-notification-id]')).to_have_count(0)

        # No token means no request and no cached account's content.
        before = len(notification_requests)
        await page.evaluate("""() => {
          const state = HZ.load(); state.token = null; HZ.save(state);
          window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
        }""")
        await expect(status).to_have_text(CHANGED)
        await retry.click()
        await expect(status).to_have_text('برای دریافت اعلان‌ها دوباره وارد شوید.')
        assert len(notification_requests) == before, notification_requests
        await expect(listing.locator('[data-notification-id]')).to_have_count(0)

        # Deliberately ignore AbortSignal, then close: the delayed response must never repaint the panel.
        await page.evaluate("""(token) => {
          const state = HZ.load(); state.token = token; HZ.save(state);
          window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
          window.originalNotificationsFetch = window.fetch;
          window.holdNotification = true;
          window.fetch = (url, options) => String(url) === '/api/translator/notifications' && window.holdNotification
            ? new Promise(resolve => { window.releaseNotification = () => resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify({notifications:[{
                id: 999999, kind:'doc_rejected', doc_kind:'criminal_record', doc_name:'x', created_at:new Date().toISOString(), text:'پاسخ قدیمی حساب قبلی'
              }]}), {status:200, headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}})); })
            : window.originalNotificationsFetch(url, options);
        }""", first_token)
        await retry.click()
        await page.wait_for_function('typeof window.releaseNotification === "function"')
        await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
        await expect(panel).to_be_hidden()
        await page.evaluate('window.releaseNotification()')
        await page.wait_for_timeout(150)
        assert await listing.locator('[data-notification-id]').count() == 0
        await expect(button).to_be_focused()
        assert not errors, errors
        print(f'PASS [{width}]: real per-account notice, safe rendering, no fake read/badge, retry/errors, account isolation, Escape and stale-response protection')
    except Exception:
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / f'failure-{width}.png'), full_page=True)
            (ARTIFACTS / f'failure-{width}.html').write_text(await page.content())
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise
    finally:
        await context.close()


async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser, 390)
            await scenario(browser, 1280)
        finally:
            await browser.close()
    print('RESULT: PASS (2/2 viewports)')


asyncio.run(main())
