## `reference/tests/translator_offer_actions_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/translator_offer_actions_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"31705d9cda02b4e3332fb6dc8fc77cf34efbde54e53e4fc97ac411c03a7003f1"} -->
````````````````
"""Offer accept/decline: real decisions, private canonical proof and safe faults."""
import asyncio
import secrets
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api, booking, arrive_and_start
from booking_options_ui import login, translator
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

ERROR = 'نتیجهٔ عملیات تأیید نشد. وضعیت مأموریت را بررسی کنید و سپس دوباره تلاش کنید.'
ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_translator_offer_actions'


async def scenario(browser):
    ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
    page = await ctx.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(20000)
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
    try:
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000))
        await api(ctx.request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', token, {'online': True})
        ptok, _ = await login(ctx.request, 'traveler')

        async def create(label):
            b = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/traveler/bookings', ptok, {
                'kind': 'instant', 'origin_lang': 'ar', 'dest_lang': 'fa', 'place': label,
                'traveler_name': 'آزمون پیشنهاد'}, status=201)
            offers = (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/offers', token))['offers']
            return b, next(o for o in offers if o['reservation_id'] == b['id'])

        b, o = await create('پیشنهاد اصلی')
        oid, rid = o['id'], b['id']
        pattern = f'**/api/translator/offers/{oid}'

        def card(offer_id=oid):
            return page.locator(f'[data-offer-id="{offer_id}"]')

        def button(action, offer_id=oid):
            # نام‌های واقعی دکمه‌ها (aria-label): «پذیرش مأموریت و اعزام» و «رد درخواست»
            return card(offer_id).get_by_role('button', name='پذیرش مأموریت و اعزام' if action == 'accept' else 'رد درخواست', exact=True)

        async def open_app():
            await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
            await expect(button('accept')).to_be_visible()
            await page.evaluate('''()=>{window.offerToasts=[]; const toast=HZ.toast;
                HZ.toast=(s)=>{offerToasts.push(s);toast(s)}}''')

        async def clear():
            await page.evaluate('()=>{offerToasts=[]}')

        async def failed():
            await page.wait_for_function('(s)=>offerToasts.includes(s)', arg=ERROR)
            assert not await page.evaluate("()=>offerToasts.some(s=>s==='ماموریت پذیرفته شد.' || s==='رد پیشنهاد ثبت شد.')")

        await open_app()
        for action in ('accept', 'decline'):
            for mode in ('network', 'http', 'html', 'empty', 'partial', 'contradictory'):
                async def fault(route, request, *, mode=mode, action=action):
                    if mode == 'network': await route.abort()
                    elif mode == 'http': await route.fulfill(status=503, json={'error': 'unavailable'})
                    elif mode == 'html': await route.fulfill(body='<html>offline</html>')
                    else: await route.fulfill(json={} if mode == 'empty' else {'ok': True} if mode == 'partial' else {'ok': True, 'reservation_id': rid})
                post = pattern + '/' + action
                await page.route(post, fault)
                await clear()
                await button(action).click()
                await failed()
                await page.unroute(post, fault)
                await expect(button(action)).to_be_enabled()
                assert (await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid))['status'] == 'searching'
                assert (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/offers/{oid}', token))['status'] == 'pending'
                print('PASS offer', action, mode)

        # Even a fabricated accepted decision needs the real assigned mission.
        receipt_sent = False
        async def fabricated_receipt(route):
            nonlocal receipt_sent
            receipt_sent = True
            await route.fulfill(json={'ok': True, 'reservation_id': rid})
        async def fabricated_decision(route):
            response = await route.fetch()
            data = await response.json()
            if receipt_sent:
                data.update(status='accepted', assigned=True)
            await route.fulfill(json=data)
        await page.route(pattern, fabricated_decision)
        await page.route(pattern + '/accept', fabricated_receipt)
        await clear()
        await button('accept').click()
        await failed()
        await page.unroute(pattern, fabricated_decision)
        await page.unroute(pattern + '/accept', fabricated_receipt)
        await expect(button('accept')).to_be_enabled()
        assert (await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid))['status'] == 'searching'

        # Invalid identity, amount or state must not send an accept POST.
        posts = 0
        async def no_post(route):
            nonlocal posts
            posts += 1
            await route.abort()
        await page.route(pattern + '/accept', no_post)
        for patch in ({'id': oid + 999}, {'reservation_id': rid + 999}, {'net': o['net'] + 1},
                      {'status': 'expired'}, {'assigned': 'false'}, {'expires_at': 'invalid'}):
            async def malformed(route, request, *, patch=patch):
                response = await route.fetch()
                data = await response.json()
                data.update(patch)
                await route.fulfill(json=data)
            await page.route(pattern, malformed)
            await clear()
            await button('accept').click()
            await failed()
            await page.unroute(pattern, malformed)
            await expect(button('accept')).to_be_enabled()
        assert posts == 0
        await page.unroute(pattern + '/accept', no_post)

        # Poll-replaced offer cards inherit the opposing-decision lock.
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        async def held(route):
            nonlocal posts
            posts += 1
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json={})
        await page.route(pattern + '/accept', held)
        await card().evaluate('(e)=>e.dataset.beforePoll="1"')
        # Force a harmless displayed quote/notes refresh so polling re-renders.
        async def changed_list(route):
            response = await route.fetch()
            data = await response.json()
            for row in data['offers']: row['notes'] = 'بازسازی کارت'
            await route.fulfill(json=data)
        await page.route('**/api/translator/offers', changed_list)
        await clear()
        await button('accept').click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await expect(button('accept')).to_be_disabled()
        await expect(button('decline')).to_be_disabled()
        await expect(page.locator('[data-before-poll]')).to_have_count(0)
        await expect(button('decline')).to_be_disabled()
        await card().evaluate('(e)=>e.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b=>b.click())')
        assert posts == 1
        release.set()
        await failed()
        # Drain in-flight polling mocks before removing them; unroute alone
        # may race route.fetch()/fulfill() and hand a request twice.
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        await expect(button('accept')).to_be_enabled()

        await page.clock.install()
        await page.evaluate('''()=>{window.originalFetch=fetch; window.fetch=(url,opts)=>
            String(url).endsWith('/offers/' + window.currentOffer + '/accept') && opts.method==='POST'
            ? (window.offerStalled=true,new Promise(()=>{})) : originalFetch(url,opts)}''')
        await page.evaluate('(id)=>{window.currentOffer=id}', oid)
        await clear()
        await button('accept').click()
        await page.wait_for_function('()=>window.offerStalled===true')
        await page.clock.run_for(10001)
        await failed()
        await page.evaluate('()=>{window.fetch=originalFetch}')
        await page.clock.resume()
        await expect(button('accept')).to_be_enabled()

        # Late response and old-card click cannot mutate the next account.
        other = await translator(ctx.request, 'male')
        await api(ctx.request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', other, {'online': False})
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        async def late(route):
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json={'ok': True, 'reservation_id': rid})
        await page.route(pattern + '/accept', late)
        await clear()
        await button('accept').click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await page.evaluate('(t)=>{let s=HZ.load();s.token=t;HZ.save(s)}', other)
        release.set()
        await expect(button('accept')).to_be_enabled()
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>offerToasts.length') == 0
        await page.unroute(pattern + '/accept', late)
        posts = 0
        await page.route(pattern + '/accept', no_post)
        await button('accept').click()
        await page.evaluate('()=>new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve))')
        assert posts == 0
        await page.unroute(pattern + '/accept', no_post)
        await page.evaluate('(t)=>{let s=HZ.load();s.token=t;HZ.save(s)}', token)
        await open_app()

        async def bad_list(route):
            await route.fulfill(json={'offers': [{'id': oid}], 'changes': [], 'extensions': []})
        await page.route('**/api/translator/offers', bad_list)
        await expect(page.locator('#offers-box')).to_contain_text('دریافت درخواست‌ها انجام نشد')
        await expect(card()).to_have_count(0)
        await page.unroute('**/api/translator/offers', bad_list)
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='تلاش دوباره', exact=True).click()
        await expect(button('accept')).to_be_enabled()

        # A delayed old pending-list response may not undo a real decline.
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        once = False
        async def old_list(route):
            nonlocal once
            if once:
                await route.fallback()
                return
            once = True
            response = await route.fetch()
            data = await response.json()
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json=data, headers={'x-offer-old': '1'})
        await page.route('**/api/translator/offers', old_list)
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await clear()
        await button('decline').click()
        await page.wait_for_function("()=>offerToasts.includes('رد پیشنهاد ثبت شد.')")
        await expect(card()).to_have_count(0)
        async with page.expect_response(lambda r: r.headers.get('x-offer-old') == '1'):
            release.set()
        await page.evaluate('()=>new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve)))')
        await expect(card()).to_have_count(0)
        await page.unroute('**/api/translator/offers', old_list)
        assert (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/offers/{oid}', token))['status'] == 'declined'
        assert (await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid))['status'] == 'searching'

        # A real accept with a lost receipt stays unconfirmed, not auto-retried.
        uncertain, pending = await create('پذیرش با پاسخ گم‌شده')
        await expect(button('accept', pending['id'])).to_be_visible()
        async def lost_receipt(route):
            await route.fetch()
            await route.abort()
        post = f"**/api/translator/offers/{pending['id']}/accept"
        await page.route(post, lost_receipt)
        await clear()
        await button('accept', pending['id']).click()
        await failed()
        await page.unroute(post, lost_receipt)
        assert (await booking(ctx.request, ptok, uncertain['id']))['status'] == 'matched'
        await arrive_and_start(ctx.request, uncertain['id'], token, uncertain['service_code'])
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/traveler/bookings/{uncertain['id']}/finish", ptok)

        real, pending = await create('پذیرش واقعی')
        await expect(button('accept', pending['id'])).to_be_visible()
        await clear()
        await button('accept', pending['id']).click()
        await page.wait_for_function("()=>offerToasts.includes('ماموریت پذیرفته شد.')")
        await expect(page.locator('#missions-list')).to_contain_text('پذیرش واقعی')
        result = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, real['id'])
        assert result['status'] == 'matched' and not result['service_started'] and result['total'] == real['total']
        assert not errors, errors
        print('PASS offer decisions: real accept/decline, privacy-backed state, faults, lock, timeout, stale list and session isolation')
    except Exception:
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / 'failure.png'), full_page=True)
        raise
    finally:
        await ctx.close()


async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser)
        finally:
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/translator_pay_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/translator_pay_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"e41d65149c4c723101cfba87ef6283acff467c1d9ecc220832ac888f3b5585be"} -->
````````````````
# تست میز کار مترجم: پذیرش ← پایان خدمت ← مسافر نقدی ثبت می‌کند ← مترجم دریافت را تأیید می‌کند ← رزرو «انجام‌شده».
import asyncio, re, random, sys, urllib.request
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8081'
results = []
def check(name, ok):
    results.append(bool(ok))
    print(('  ok   ' if ok else '  FAIL ') + name)

urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(BASE + '/api/dev/offline-all', method='POST'), timeout=10).read()

TRAV_LOGIN = """async (phone) => {
  const H = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'};
  await fetch('/api/auth/request-code', {method:'POST', headers:H, body: JSON.stringify({phone, role:'traveler'})});
  const v = await (await fetch('/api/auth/verify', {method:'POST', headers:H, body: JSON.stringify({phone, role:'traveler', code:'123456'})})).json();
  localStorage.setItem('hamzaban.token.v1', v.token);
  return v.token;
}"""
API = """async ([method, path, body, token]) => {
  const r = await fetch('/api' + path, {method, headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json', Authorization:'Bearer '+token}, body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined});
  let d = null; try { d = await r.json(); } catch (e) {}
  return {status: r.status, data: d};
}"""

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        b = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        async def route(ctx):
            await ctx.route(re.compile(r'https://(unpkg\.com|cdn\.|fonts\.).*'), lambda r: r.abort())
        tctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900}); await route(tctx)
        T = await tctx.new_page(); terr = []; T.on('pageerror', lambda e: terr.append(str(e)[:120]))
        await T.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html'); await T.wait_for_timeout(600)
        await T.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999)))
        ttok = await T.evaluate("()=>HZ.load().token")
        await T.evaluate("async (t)=>{await fetch('/api/translator/online',{method:'PATCH',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',Authorization:'Bearer '+t},body:JSON.stringify({online:true})});}", ttok)
        # مسافر: رزرو فوری
        pctx = await b.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900}); await route(pctx)
        P = await pctx.new_page(); await P.goto(BASE + '/traveler/index.html'); await P.wait_for_timeout(400)
        ptok = await P.evaluate(TRAV_LOGIN, '9' + str(random.randint(100000000, 999999999)))
        place = 'میز کار پرداخت ' + str(random.randint(100, 999))
        bid = (await P.evaluate(API, ['POST', '/traveler/bookings', {'kind': 'instant', 'origin_lang': 'ar', 'dest_lang': 'fa', 'place': place, 'traveler_name': 'علی رضایی'}, ptok]))['data']['id']
        # مترجم در میز کار: پذیرش پیشنهاد
        await T.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html'); await T.wait_for_timeout(4500)
        ok_btn = await T.evaluate("()=>{const box=document.getElementById('offers-box'); const b=[...box.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-label')==='پذیرش مأموریت و اعزام'); if(b){b.click(); return true;} return false;}")
        check('مترجم در میز کار پیشنهاد را پذیرفت', ok_btn)
        await T.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        await T.reload(); await T.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        # حضور دستی را ثبت می‌کنیم؛ سپس کد اعلام‌شدهٔ مسافر را در پنج خانه وارد می‌کنیم.
        scode = next(x['service_code'] for x in (await P.evaluate(API, ['GET', '/traveler/bookings', None, ptok]))['data']['bookings'] if x['id'] == bid)
        await T.get_by_role('button', name='رسیدم به محل ملاقات', exact=True).click()
        await T.get_by_role('button', name='تأیید کد و آغاز همراهی', exact=True).wait_for()
        for index, digit in enumerate(scode):
            await T.locator('#missions-list input').nth(index).fill(digit)
        await T.get_by_role('button', name='تأیید کد و آغاز همراهی', exact=True).click()
        await T.locator('#missions-list [data-service-clock]').wait_for()
        started_booking = next(x for x in (await P.evaluate(API, ['GET', '/traveler/bookings', None, ptok]))['data']['bookings'] if x['id'] == bid)
        check('شروع خدمت با کد امنیتی از میز کار', started_booking['service_started'])
        await T.wait_for_timeout(1500); await T.reload(); await T.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        check('دکمهٔ درخواست پایان روی مأموریت است', await T.evaluate("()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#missions-list button')].some(x=>x.textContent.includes('درخواست پایان مأموریت'))"))
        await T.get_by_role('button', name='درخواست پایان مأموریت', exact=True).click()
        await T.get_by_role('button', name='ارسال درخواست پایان', exact=True).click()
        await T.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        await T.reload(); await T.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        pending = next(x for x in (await P.evaluate(API, ['GET', '/traveler/bookings', None, ptok]))['data']['bookings'] if x['id'] == bid)
        check('درخواست مترجم به‌تنهایی خدمت را تمام نکرد', pending['status'] == 'matched' and pending['finish_requested'])
        approved = await P.evaluate(API, ['POST', f'/traveler/bookings/{bid}/finish-approve', None, ptok])
        check('مسافر پایان خدمت را تأیید کرد', approved['status'] == 200)
        # مسافر روش نقدی را انتخاب می‌کند
        await P.evaluate(API, ['POST', f'/traveler/bookings/{bid}/payment', {'method': 'cash'}, ptok])
        await T.wait_for_timeout(5500)
        check('بخش پرداخت منتظر تأیید نمایش داده می‌شود', await T.evaluate("()=>!!document.getElementById('payments-box') && document.getElementById('payments-box').textContent.includes('دریافت وجه را تأیید می‌کنم')"))
        # کلیک با انتظار خودکار Playwright به‌جای کلیک بی‌صدای evaluate تا کندی همگام‌سازی شکست سازنده نباشد
        await T.locator('#payments-box button', has_text='دریافت وجه را تأیید می‌کنم').first.click()
        await T.get_by_role('button', name='تأیید دریافت وجه', exact=True).click()
        await T.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        st = (await P.evaluate(API, ['GET', '/traveler/bookings', None, ptok]))['data']['bookings']
        bk = next(x for x in st if x['id'] == bid)
        check('با تأیید مترجم، رزرو انجام‌شده و تسویه است', bk['status'] == 'done' and bk['pay_state'] == 'settled')
        check('خطای صفحه‌ها', not terr)
        await b.close()
        ok = all(results)
        print('RESULT:', 'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL', f'({sum(results)}/{len(results)})', terr if terr else '')
        sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/translator_presence_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/translator_presence_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"e2d987f5c62e235469681038044cf4539815fd8dc5a46c4696b44615d1465b43"} -->
````````````````
"""Server-confirmed translator presence; no cached or optimistic availability."""
import asyncio
import secrets
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS
from booking_options_ui import translator

ERROR = 'وضعیت آمادگی تأیید نشد؛ برای بررسی دوباره تلاش کنید.'
ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_translator_presence'


async def scenario(browser):
    ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
    page = await ctx.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(20000)
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
    toggle = page.locator('#shift-toggle-btn')
    pattern = '**/api/translator/online'
    try:
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000))
        await page.evaluate('()=>{let s=HZ.load();s.shift=true;HZ.save(s)}')
        patches = []
        page.on('request', lambda r: patches.append(r.post_data_json) if r.method == 'PATCH' and r.url.endswith('/translator/online') else None)
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
        await expect(toggle).to_have_attribute('aria-pressed', 'false')
        assert not patches
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>HZ.load().shift') is False
        await page.evaluate('''()=>{window.presenceToasts=[]; const toast=HZ.toast;
            HZ.toast=(s)=>{presenceToasts.push(s);toast(s)}}''')

        async def clear():
            await page.evaluate('()=>{presenceToasts=[]}')

        async def failed():
            await page.wait_for_function('(s)=>presenceToasts.includes(s)', arg=ERROR)
            await expect(toggle).to_have_attribute('aria-pressed', 'mixed')
            assert await page.evaluate('()=>HZ.load().shift === null')
            assert not await page.evaluate("()=>presenceToasts.some(s=>s==='آمادگی شما برای دریافت مأموریت ثبت شد.' || s==='وضعیت آفلاین شما ثبت شد.')")

        async def retry(value=False):
            await page.get_by_role('button', name='بررسی دوبارهٔ آمادگی', exact=True).click()
            await expect(toggle).to_have_attribute('aria-pressed', str(value).lower())
            await expect(toggle).to_be_enabled()

        for mode in ('network', 'http', 'html', 'empty', 'typed', 'opposite', 'contradictory'):
            async def fault(route, request, *, mode=mode):
                if request.method != 'PATCH':
                    await route.fallback()
                    return
                if mode == 'network': await route.abort()
                elif mode == 'http': await route.fulfill(status=503, json={'error': 'unavailable'})
                elif mode == 'html': await route.fulfill(body='<html>offline</html>')
                else:
                    await route.fulfill(json={} if mode == 'empty' else {'online': 'true'} if mode == 'typed' else {'online': mode != 'opposite'})
            await page.route(pattern, fault)
            await clear()
            await toggle.click()
            await failed()
            await page.unroute(pattern, fault)
            assert not (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/online', token))['online']
            before = len(patches)
            await retry()
            assert len(patches) == before  # Retry is read-only, never a repeated mutation.
            print('PASS presence', mode)

        # Invalid canonical preflight must not send a mutation at all.
        async def bad_preflight(route, request):
            if request.method == 'GET': await route.fulfill(json={'online': False, 'enabled': 'yes'})
            else: await route.abort()
        await page.route(pattern, bad_preflight)
        await clear()
        before = len(patches)
        await toggle.click()
        await failed()
        assert len(patches) == before
        await page.unroute(pattern, bad_preflight)
        await retry()

        # All presence entry points share one lock; no optimistic label or cache.
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        async def held(route, request):
            if request.method != 'PATCH':
                await route.fallback()
                return
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json={})
        await page.route(pattern, held)
        await clear()
        before = len(patches)
        await toggle.click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        assert await page.locator('[data-presence-control]:not(:disabled)').count() == 0
        await expect(toggle).to_have_attribute('aria-pressed', 'false')
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>HZ.load().shift') is False
        await page.evaluate("()=>document.querySelectorAll('[data-presence-control]').forEach(b=>b.click())")
        assert len(patches) == before + 1
        release.set()
        await failed()
        await page.unroute(pattern, held)
        await retry()

        await page.clock.install()
        await page.evaluate('''()=>{window.originalFetch=fetch;window.fetch=(url,opts)=>
            String(url).endsWith('/translator/online') && opts.method==='PATCH'
            ? (window.presenceStalled=true,new Promise(()=>{})) : originalFetch(url,opts)}''')
        await clear()
        await toggle.click()
        await page.wait_for_function('()=>window.presenceStalled===true')
        await page.clock.run_for(10001)
        await failed()
        await page.evaluate('()=>{window.fetch=originalFetch}')
        await page.clock.resume()
        await retry()

        # Real server mutation but lost receipt => unknown, not a fake rollback.
        async def lost_receipt(route, request):
            if request.method != 'PATCH':
                await route.fallback()
                return
            await route.fetch()
            await route.abort()
        await page.route(pattern, lost_receipt)
        await clear()
        await toggle.click()
        await failed()
        await page.unroute(pattern, lost_receipt)
        assert (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/online', token))['online'] is True
        await retry(True)
        await clear()
        await toggle.click()
        await page.wait_for_function("()=>presenceToasts.includes('وضعیت آفلاین شما ثبت شد.')")
        await expect(toggle).to_have_attribute('aria-pressed', 'false')
        await clear()
        await toggle.click()
        await page.wait_for_function("()=>presenceToasts.includes('آمادگی شما برای دریافت مأموریت ثبت شد.')")
        await expect(toggle).to_have_attribute('aria-pressed', 'true')
        assert all(set(body) == {'online'} and type(body['online']) is bool for body in patches)

        # Real admin feature disable is reflected even if the page was online.
        admin = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/admin/login', data={'password': 'test-admin-pass'})
        await api(ctx.request, 'PUT', '/admin/features', admin['token'], {'translator_online': False})
        try:
            await page.evaluate("()=>window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus'))")
            await expect(toggle).to_have_attribute('aria-pressed', 'false')
            await expect(page.locator('#shift-status-desc')).to_contain_text('توسط مدیر غیرفعال')
            await expect(toggle).to_be_disabled()
            assert not (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/online', token))['enabled']
        finally:
            await api(ctx.request, 'PUT', '/admin/features', admin['token'], {'translator_online': True})
        await retry()

        # An old account's late receipt cannot change the next account's cache.
        other = await translator(ctx.request, 'male')
        await api(ctx.request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', other, {'online': False})
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        async def late(route, request):
            if request.method != 'PATCH':
                await route.fallback()
                return
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json={'online': True})
        await page.route(pattern, late)
        await clear()
        await toggle.click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await page.evaluate('(t)=>{let s=HZ.load();s.token=t;s.shift="sentinel";HZ.save(s)}', other)
        release.set()
        await expect(toggle).to_be_enabled()
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>HZ.load().shift') == 'sentinel'
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>presenceToasts.length') == 0
        await page.unroute(pattern, late)
        before = len(patches)
        await toggle.click()  # Different owner => read-only synchronization.
        await expect(toggle).to_have_attribute('aria-pressed', 'false')
        assert len(patches) == before
        assert not (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/online', other))['online']

        # Invalid reads may not revive cached online=true; explicit retry works.
        async def malformed(route, request):
            if request.method == 'GET': await route.fulfill(json={'online': True, 'enabled': 'yes'})
            else: await route.fallback()
        await page.route(pattern, malformed)
        await page.evaluate("()=>window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus'))")
        await expect(toggle).to_have_attribute('aria-pressed', 'mixed')
        await page.unroute(pattern, malformed)
        await retry()
        await page.evaluate('()=>{let s=HZ.load();s.token=null;s.shift=true;HZ.save(s)}')
        before = len(patches)
        await toggle.click()
        await expect(toggle).to_have_attribute('aria-pressed', 'mixed')
        assert len(patches) == before
        assert not errors, errors
        print('PASS presence: cache isolation, real online/offline, feature gate, faults, lock, timeout, uncertain outcome and session isolation')
    except Exception:
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / 'failure.png'), full_page=True)
        raise
    finally:
        await ctx.close()


async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser)
        finally:
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

````````````````
"""Translator profile panel must not present hard-coded ratings or credentials as personal facts."""
import asyncio
import os
import secrets
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

BASE = os.environ.get('BASE', 'http://127.0.0.1:8081')
ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_translator_profile'
FORBIDDEN = ('۴.۹۵', '4.95', '۱۲۸ نظر', '۱۲۸ مأموریت', '۶۴ ساعت', 'CAP-100-IR41',
             '۰۰۸****۳۲۱', 'پژو ۲۰۷', 'بیمه‌نامه کامل بدنه', 'خودرو تایید شده سامانه')


async def scenario(browser, width):
    context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': width, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
    page = await context.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(15000)
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda err: errors.append(str(err)))
    try:
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        phone = '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000)
        token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, phone)
        assert token, 'translator session was not established'
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
        profile_button = page.locator('#header-profile-btn')
        await profile_button.click()
        panel = page.locator('#inline-profile-panel')
        await expect(panel).to_be_visible()
        await expect(panel.locator('#profile-title')).to_have_text('نمایهٔ مترجم')
        await expect(panel.locator('[data-tr-name]')).to_have_text('علی رضایی')
        note = panel.locator('#profile-data-note')
        # متن واقعی یادداشت شفافیت نمایه: منبع داده، عدم اثبات هویت و نبود امتیاز/ساعات/خودرو
        await expect(note).to_contain_text('نام نمایشی')
        await expect(note).to_contain_text('هویت تأییدشده را ثابت نمی‌کند')
        await expect(note).to_contain_text('از حساب دریافت نشده‌اند')
        content = await panel.inner_text()
        for claim in FORBIDDEN:
            assert claim not in content, f'unsupported profile claim remains: {claim}'
        await panel.locator('button:has-text("بستن پنل")').click()
        await expect(panel).to_be_hidden()
        assert not errors, errors
        print(f'PASS [{width}]: display name is labeled local; fabricated rating, activity, identity ID and vehicle approval are absent')
    except Exception:
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / f'failure-{width}.png'), full_page=True)
            (ARTIFACTS / f'failure-{width}.html').write_text(await page.content())
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise
    finally:
        await context.close()


async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser, 390)
            await scenario(browser, 1280)
        finally:
            await browser.close()
    print('RESULT: PASS (2/2 viewports)')


asyncio.run(main())

````````````````
````````````````
"""Translator service controls: real authorization/state, adversarial receipts,
shared locks across duplicate cards, bounded requests and account isolation.
All booking/matching/consent APIs are real; only explicit fault cases are mocked.
"""
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api, booking
from booking_options_ui import login, translator
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_translator_service_actions'
ERROR = 'نتیجهٔ عملیات تأیید نشد. وضعیت مأموریت را بررسی کنید و سپس دوباره تلاش کنید.'


async def scenario(browser):
    ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 390, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
    page = await ctx.new_page()
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
    page.set_default_timeout(20000)
    try:
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/dev/offline-all')
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        import secrets
        token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000))
        await api(ctx.request, 'PATCH', '/translator/online', token, {'online': True})
        ptok, _ = await login(ctx.request, 'traveler')
        b = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', '/traveler/bookings', ptok, {
            'kind': 'instant', 'origin_lang': 'ar', 'dest_lang': 'fa',
            'place': 'آزمون کنترل واقعی مترجم', 'traveler_name': 'مسافر آزمون'}, status=201)
        rid, total = b['id'], b['total']
        offers = await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/offers', token)
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f"/translator/offers/{offers['offers'][0]['id']}/accept", token)

        async def open_app():
            await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
            await expect(page.locator('#missions-list')).to_contain_text('آزمون کنترل واقعی مترجم')
            await page.evaluate('''() => { window.actionToasts=[];
                const toast=HZ.toast; HZ.toast=(s)=>{actionToasts.push(s);toast(s)}; }''')

        def mission_button(name):
            return page.locator('#missions-list').get_by_role('button', name=name, exact=True)

        def extension_review():
            return page.locator('#missions-list .translator-extension-card').get_by_role('button', name='بررسی درخواست تمدید', exact=True)

        def extension_button(name):
            label = 'پذیرش تمدید' if name in ('پذیرش', 'accept') else 'رد تمدید'
            return page.locator('#mission-extension-modal').get_by_role('button', name=label, exact=True)

        def finish():
            return page.locator('#mission-finish-confirm')

        async def close_any_modal():
            # پس از شکست، مودال باز می‌ماند (اصلاح فعلی)؛ پیش از آماده‌سازی بعدی می‌بندیم.
            for mid in ('#mission-extension-modal', '#mission-finish-modal', '#mission-cash-modal'):
                modal = page.locator(mid)
                if await modal.is_visible():
                    await modal.locator('[data-modal-close]').first.click()
                    await expect(modal).to_be_hidden()

        async def prepare_finish():
            await close_any_modal()
            await mission_button('درخواست پایان مأموریت').click()
            await expect(finish()).to_be_visible()

        async def prepare_extension():
            await close_any_modal()
            await extension_review().click()
            await expect(page.locator('#mission-extension-modal')).to_be_visible()

        async def clear():
            await page.evaluate('() => {window.actionToasts=[]}')

        async def failed():
            await page.wait_for_function('(s) => window.actionToasts.includes(s)', arg=ERROR)
            assert not await page.evaluate("() => actionToasts.some(s=>s==='خدمت شروع شد.' || s==='تمدید رد شد.' || s.startsWith('تمدید پذیرفته شد') || s.startsWith('درخواست پایان برای مسافر'))")

        async def faults(button, path, receipt, status, prepare=None):
            for mode in ('network', 'http', 'html', 'empty', 'partial', 'contradictory'):
                async def handler(route, request, *, mode=mode):
                    if mode == 'network':
                        await route.abort()
                    elif mode == 'http':
                        await route.fulfill(status=503, json={'error': 'unavailable'})
                    elif mode == 'html':
                        await route.fulfill(status=status, content_type='text/html', body='<html>offline</html>')
                    else:
                        await route.fulfill(status=status, json={} if mode == 'empty' else {'ok': True} if mode == 'partial' else receipt)
                await page.route('**/api/translator/' + path, handler)
                await clear()
                if prepare:
                    await prepare()
                await button().click()
                await failed()
                await page.unroute('**/api/translator/' + path, handler)
                await expect(button()).to_be_enabled()
                unchanged = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid)
                assert unchanged['status'] == 'matched' and unchanged['total'] == total
                print('PASS', path, mode)

        await open_app()
        arrive = lambda: mission_button('رسیدم به محل ملاقات')
        await faults(arrive, f'missions/{rid}/arrive',
                     {'ok': True, 'already_arrived': False, 'arrived_at': '2026-10-24T12:00:00.000Z'}, 200)
        await clear()
        await arrive().click()
        await page.wait_for_function("() => actionToasts.includes('رسیدن شما به‌صورت دستی در سرور ثبت شد.')")
        assert (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', f'/translator/missions/{rid}', token))['arrived_at']

        start = lambda: mission_button('تأیید کد و آغاز همراهی')
        async def fill_code():
            for index, digit in enumerate(b['service_code']):
                await page.locator('#missions-list input').nth(index).fill(digit)
        # Security-code input is re-created after each canonical refresh.
        for mode in ('network', 'http', 'html', 'empty', 'partial', 'contradictory'):
            async def handler(route, request, *, mode=mode):
                if mode == 'network': await route.abort()
                elif mode == 'http': await route.fulfill(status=503, json={'error': 'unavailable'})
                elif mode == 'html': await route.fulfill(status=200, body='not JSON')
                else: await route.fulfill(status=200, json={} if mode == 'empty' else {'ok': True} if mode == 'partial' else {'ok': True, 'started': True})
            pattern = f'**/api/translator/missions/{rid}/verify-code'
            await page.route(pattern, handler)
            await clear()
            await fill_code()
            await start().click()
            await failed()
            await page.unroute(pattern, handler)
            await expect(start()).to_be_enabled()
            assert not (await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid))['service_started']
            print('PASS start', mode)

        # Malformed canonical preflight must not even send the security code.
        count = 0
        async def no_post(route):
            nonlocal count
            count += 1
            await route.abort()
        async def malformed(route):
            await route.fulfill(json={'reservation_id': rid, 'status': 'matched', 'started': True})
        pattern = f'**/api/translator/missions/{rid}'
        post_pattern = f'**/api/translator/missions/{rid}/verify-code'
        await page.route(pattern, malformed)
        await page.route(post_pattern, no_post)
        await clear()
        await fill_code()
        await start().click()
        await failed()
        assert count == 0
        await page.unroute(pattern, malformed)
        await page.unroute(post_pattern, no_post)
        await expect(start()).to_be_enabled()

        # A believable receipt still needs a complete canonical start snapshot.
        # Do not let a started boolean without a usable timestamp suffice.
        read_count = 0
        async def bad_started_snapshot(route):
            nonlocal read_count
            read_count += 1
            response = await route.fetch()
            data = await response.json()
            if read_count > 1:
                data['started'] = True
                data['service_started_at'] = 'invalid timestamp'
            await route.fulfill(json=data)
        async def fake_started(route):
            await route.fulfill(json={'ok': True, 'started': True})
        await page.route(pattern, bad_started_snapshot)
        await page.route(post_pattern, fake_started)
        await clear()
        await fill_code()
        await start().click()
        await failed()
        assert read_count == 2
        await page.unroute(pattern, bad_started_snapshot)
        await page.unroute(post_pattern, fake_started)
        await expect(start()).to_be_enabled()

        # A stalled POST is shared by calendar/workspace cards. No second POST,
        # and re-rendering the day bar must not enable a duplicate action.
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        async def held(route):
            nonlocal count
            count += 1
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(json={})
        await page.route(post_pattern, held)
        await clear()
        await fill_code()
        await start().click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await expect(start()).to_be_disabled()
        await expect(mission_button('لغو مأموریت')).to_be_disabled()
        await page.evaluate("() => document.querySelector('#day-bar button').click()")
        assert await page.locator(f'[data-service-mission="{rid}"]:not(:disabled)').count() == 0
        await page.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-service-mission]').forEach(b=>b.click())")
        assert count == 1
        release.set()
        await failed()
        await page.unroute(post_pattern, held)
        await expect(start()).to_be_enabled()

        # Timeout applies even when a transport ignores AbortSignal entirely.
        await page.clock.install()
        await page.evaluate('''() => { window.originalFetch=fetch;
            window.fetch=(url,opts)=>String(url).endsWith('/verify-code') && opts.method==='POST'
              ? (window.postStalled=true, new Promise(()=>{})) : originalFetch(url,opts); }''')
        await clear()
        await fill_code()
        await start().click()
        await expect(start()).to_be_disabled()
        await page.wait_for_function('() => window.postStalled === true')
        await page.clock.run_for(10001)
        await failed()
        await page.evaluate('() => { window.fetch=originalFetch }')
        await page.clock.resume()
        await expect(start()).to_be_enabled()

        # Actual start via the UI; timer origin must remain server-owned.
        await clear()
        await fill_code()
        await start().click()
        await page.wait_for_function("() => actionToasts.includes('خدمت شروع شد.')")
        before = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid)
        assert before['service_started'] and before['total'] == total
        await expect(mission_button('درخواست پایان مأموریت')).to_be_visible()
        await faults(finish, f'missions/{rid}/finish', {'ok': True, 'pending_finish': True}, 202, prepare=prepare_finish)
        assert not (await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid))['finish_requested']

        # Late response from the previous account cannot toast or refresh the
        # next account. Restore the real owner afterwards and reload its UI.
        other = await translator(ctx.request, 'male')
        entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        async def late(route):
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            await route.fulfill(status=202, json={'ok': True, 'pending_finish': True})
        finish_pattern = f'**/api/translator/missions/{rid}/finish'
        await page.route(finish_pattern, late)
        await clear()
        await prepare_finish()
        await finish().click()
        await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
        await page.evaluate('(token) => {let s=HZ.load();s.token=token;HZ.save(s)}', other)
        release.set()
        await page.wait_for_function('() => !document.querySelector("[aria-busy=true]")')
        assert await page.evaluate('() => actionToasts.length') == 0
        await page.unroute(finish_pattern, late)
        await page.evaluate('(token) => {let s=HZ.load();s.token=token;HZ.save(s)}', token)
        await open_app()

        # Finish remains a request, not a completed or payable service.
        await prepare_finish()
        await finish().click()
        await page.wait_for_function("() => actionToasts.some(s=>s.startsWith('درخواست پایان برای مسافر'))")
        pending = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid)
        assert pending['status'] == 'matched' and pending['finish_requested'] and pending['total'] == total
        assert not (await api(ctx.request, 'GET', '/translator/payments', token))['payments']
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f'/traveler/bookings/{rid}/finish-reject', ptok)
        await open_app()

        # Both accept and reject must reconcile the exact extension, quote,
        # duration and unchanged service-start origin, not just HTTP 200.
        for decision, label in [('reject', 'رد'), ('accept', 'پذیرش')]:
            e = await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f'/traveler/bookings/{rid}/extend', ptok, {'extra_hours': 1}, status=202)
            button = lambda: extension_button(label)
            await expect(extension_review()).to_be_visible()
            await faults(button, f"extensions/{e['id']}/{decision}", {'ok': True}, 200, prepare=prepare_extension)
            pending = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid)
            assert pending['hours'] == before['hours'] and pending['pending_extension']['id'] == e['id']
            if decision == 'reject':
                # The opposing decision and finish control must share the lock,
                # even when polling replaces the extension card with a new quote.
                entered, release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
                async def held_decision(route):
                    entered.set()
                    await release.wait()
                    await route.fulfill(json={})
                async def changed_offer(route):
                    response = await route.fetch()
                    data = await response.json()
                    for item in data.get('extensions', []):
                        item['extra_hours'] = 2
                    await route.fulfill(json=data)
                decision_pattern = f"**/api/translator/extensions/{e['id']}/reject"
                await page.route(decision_pattern, held_decision)
                await page.route('**/api/translator/offers', changed_offer)
                await clear()
                await prepare_extension()
                await button().click()
                await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 10)
                # کنترل پایانِ در دسترس کاربر، دکمهٔ کارت است (مودال پایان بسته است)؛ همان قفل مشترک را نشان می‌دهد
                await expect(mission_button('درخواست پایان مأموریت')).to_be_disabled()
                await expect(extension_button('پذیرش')).to_be_disabled()
                await expect(page.locator('#missions-list')).to_contain_text('تمدید درخواستی: ۲ ساعت')
                await expect(extension_button('پذیرش')).to_be_disabled()
                await expect(button()).to_be_disabled()
                release.set()
                await failed()
                # Do not remove a polling route while route.fetch/fulfill is active.
                await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
                await expect(button()).to_be_enabled()
            stale_entered, stale_release = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
            held_once = False
            async def stale_offer(route):
                nonlocal held_once
                if held_once:
                    await route.fallback()
                    return
                held_once = True
                response = await route.fetch()
                data = await response.json()
                stale_entered.set()
                await stale_release.wait()
                await route.fulfill(json=data, headers={'x-offer-stale': '1'})
            await page.route('**/api/translator/offers', stale_offer)
            await asyncio.wait_for(stale_entered.wait(), 10)
            await clear()
            await prepare_extension()
            await button().click()
            await page.wait_for_function('(decision) => actionToasts.some(s=>decision==="reject" ? s==="تمدید رد شد." : s.startsWith("تمدید پذیرفته شد"))', arg=decision)
            await expect(extension_review()).to_have_count(0)
            async with page.expect_response(lambda r: r.headers.get('x-offer-stale') == '1'):
                stale_release.set()
            await page.evaluate('() => new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve)))')
            await expect(extension_review()).to_have_count(0)
            await page.unroute('**/api/translator/offers', stale_offer)
            after = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid)
            assert after['hours'] == before['hours'] + (1 if decision == 'accept' else 0)
            assert after['total'] == total + (e['extra_total'] if decision == 'accept' else 0)
            assert after['service_started_at'] == before['service_started_at']
            if decision == 'accept': total = after['total']
            print('PASS real extension', decision)

        # Traveler may end early without translator approval; billing follows actual served time (min 1h).
        await api(ctx.request, 'POST', f'/traveler/bookings/{rid}/finish', ptok)
        ended = await booking(ctx.request, ptok, rid)
        assert ended['status'] == 'finished' and ended['billed_hours'] == 1 and ended['list_total'] == total
        assert not errors, errors
        print('PASS translator service actions: real lifecycle, faults, shared locks, timeout, account isolation')
    except Exception:
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / 'failure.png'), full_page=True)
        raise
    finally:
        await ctx.close()


async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser)
        finally:
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())

````````````````
````````````````
const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const vm = require('node:vm');

const root = path.join(__dirname, '..');
const read = (name) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, name), 'utf8');
const uiSource = read('translator/ui.js');

test('shared translator auth helper sends both server-supported session headers', () => {
  const context = vm.createContext({
    window: {},
    localStorage: { getItem() { return null; }, setItem() {} }
  });
  vm.runInContext(uiSource, context, { filename: 'translator/ui.js' });

  const extra = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
  const actual = context.window.HZ.authHeaders('session-token', extra);
  assert.deepEqual({ ...actual }, {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    Authorization: 'Bearer session-token',
    'X-Auth-Token': 'session-token'
  });
  assert.deepEqual(extra, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
  assert.deepEqual({ ...context.window.HZ.authHeaders('', extra) }, extra);
  assert.deepEqual({ ...context.window.HZ.authHeaders(null) }, {});
});

test('every authenticated translator workspace client uses the shared dual-header helper', () => {
  const app = read('translator/app.js');
  assert.match(app, /fetch\('\/api\/translator\/missions',\s*\{\s*headers:\s*H\.authHeaders\(st\.token\)/);
  assert.match(app, /fetch\('\/api\/translator\/payments',\s*\{\s*headers:\s*H\.authHeaders\(token\)/);
  assert.match(app, /headers:\s*H\.authHeaders\(t,\s*\{\s*'Content-Type':\s*'application\/json'/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(app, /headers:\s*\{\s*Authorization\s*:/);

  for (const file of ['translator/mission-actions.js', 'translator/presence.js', 'translator/notifications.js']) {
    const source = read(file);
    assert.match(source, /window\.HZ\.authHeaders\(/, `${file} should use the shared session-header helper`);
    assert.doesNotMatch(source, /headers:\s*\{\s*Authorization\s*:/, `${file} should not send Authorization alone`);
  }

  const entry = read('translator/index.html');
  assert.match(entry, /var headers = H\.authHeaders\(state\.token,\s*\{\s*'Content-Type':\s*'application\/json'/);
  assert.match(entry, /X-Auth-Token/, 'the development approval request also keeps the proxy fallback header');
});

test('translator service-worker cache and entry script use the bumped version', () => {
  const entry = read('translator/index.html');
  const workspace = read('translator/app.html');
  const serviceWorker = read('translator/sw.js');
  assert.match(entry, /<script src="ui\.js\?v=53"><\/script>/);
  assert.match(workspace, /<script src="ui\.js\?v=53"><\/script>/);
  assert.match(serviceWorker, /hz-translator-v55/);
  assert.match(serviceWorker, /ui\.js\?v=53/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(workspace + serviceWorker, /\?v=49|hz-translator-v49/);
});
````````````````

````````````````
'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const test = require('node:test');

const root = path.join(__dirname, '..');
const read = (name) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, name), 'utf8');
const appHTML = read('translator/app.html');
const settingsSource = read('translator/settings.js');
const serverSource = read('server/server.js');

test('translator settings expose the three passenger-gender choices in the new workspace', () => {
  assert.match(appHTML, /id="view-settings"/);
  assert.match(appHTML, /id="translator-traveler-gender-pref"/);
  assert.match(appHTML, /<option value="any">فرقی نمی‌کند؛ مرد یا زن<\/option>/);
  assert.match(appHTML, /<option value="male">فقط مسافران مرد<\/option>/);
  assert.match(appHTML, /<option value="female">فقط مسافران زن<\/option>/);
  // تنظیمات از ناوبری میز کار (چیپ «تنظیمات») در دسترس است؛ دکمهٔ ثابت قدیمی حذف شده
  assert.match(appHTML, /data-desk-view="settings"/);
  assert.match(appHTML, /'settings'\]\.?forEach/);
});

test('settings read and save the selected preference through authenticated server requests', () => {
  assert.match(settingsSource, /fetch\('\/api\/translator\/preferences'/);
  assert.match(settingsSource, /request\('PATCH', actor, \{ traveler_gender_pref: value \}\)/);
  assert.match(settingsSource, /window\.HZ\.authHeaders\(actor/);
  assert.match(settingsSource, /traveler_gender_pref: value/);
  assert.match(settingsSource, /تنظیم ذخیره شد و برای پیشنهادهای جدید اعمال می‌شود/);
  assert.match(appHTML, /<script src="settings\.js\?v=53"><\/script>/);
});

test('the server validates, persists, and applies the translator preference to new matching', () => {
  assert.match(serverSource, /ALTER TABLE translators ADD COLUMN traveler_gender_pref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'any'/);
  assert.match(serverSource, /route\('GET', '\/api\/translator\/preferences'/);
  assert.match(serverSource, /route\('PATCH', '\/api\/translator\/preferences'/);
  assert.match(serverSource, /TRAVELER_GENDER_PREF = new Set\(\['any', 'female', 'male'\]\)/);
  assert.match(serverSource, /r\.traveler_gender !== acceptedTravelerGender/);
  assert.match(serverSource, /t\.traveler_gender_pref/);
});
````````````````

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/translator_support_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"e02aaa3cb96e46502d71cca5e2ae4eada29d977e9d5f28c5a40216ea53fc0259"} -->
````````````````
"""Translator safety panel is guidance only, with fresh, validated support settings."""
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
import secrets
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from finish_flow_ui import BASE, api
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_translator_support'
EMPTY = 'شمارهٔ پشتیبانی هنوز در پنل مدیریت تنظیم نشده است.'
INVALID = 'شمارهٔ پشتیبانی ثبت‌شده معتبر نیست؛ امکان تماس از این بخش وجود ندارد.'
ERROR = 'شمارهٔ پشتیبانی دریافت نشد. دوباره تلاش کنید.'
READY = 'شمارهٔ پشتیبانی از تنظیمات مدیر دریافت شد.'


async def scenario(browser, setup, admin, width):
    ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': width, 'height': 1000}, service_workers='block')
    page = await ctx.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(20000)
    errors, mutations = [], []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
    try:
        async def settings(number):
            await api(setup.request, 'PUT', '/admin/settings', admin, {'support_phone': number})
        await settings('')
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000))
        page.on('request', lambda r: mutations.append(r.url) if '/api/' in r.url and r.method in ['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'] else None)
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
        await page.evaluate('''()=>{
            window.supportToasts=[];window.supportGeo=[];window.supportWindows=[];
            window.showToast=(s)=>supportToasts.push(s);HZ.toast=(s)=>supportToasts.push(s);
            Object.defineProperty(navigator,'geolocation',{configurable:true,value:{
                getCurrentPosition:()=>supportGeo.push('position'),watchPosition:()=>supportGeo.push('watch')}});
            window.open=(...args)=>supportWindows.push(args);
        }''')
        panel = page.locator('#inline-sos-panel')
        call = page.locator('#translator-support-call')
        retry = page.locator('#translator-support-retry')
        status = page.locator('#translator-support-status')

        async def no_call():
            await expect(call).to_be_hidden()
            assert await call.get_attribute('href') is None
            await expect(page.locator('#translator-support-phone')).to_have_text('')

        async def check_status(text):
            await expect(status).to_have_text(text)
            await expect(retry).to_be_enabled()

        await page.locator('#sos-btn').click()
        await expect(panel).to_be_visible()
        await expect(page.locator('#sos-btn')).to_have_attribute('aria-expanded', 'true')
        await expect(page.locator('#translator-support-safety-note')).to_contain_text('در خطر فوری، با خدمات اضطراری محل تماس بگیرید.')
        await expect(panel).to_contain_text('اتصال تماس یا پاسخ‌گویی تضمین نمی‌شود.')
        await check_status(EMPTY)
        await no_call()
        await expect(page.locator('#translator-support-escort')).to_be_disabled()
        await page.locator('#translator-support-escort').dispatch_event('click')
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>[typeof handleEmergencySupportEscort,typeof handleEmergencyCallOperator,typeof handleEmergencyPolice]') == ['undefined'] * 3
        for claim in ('موقعیت زنده شما به مرکز دیسپچ مخابره شد', 'زمان تقریبی رسیدن گشت تشریفات', '۰۲۱-۹۱۰۱۰۰۰۰', 'پشتیبانی ۲۴/۷'):
            assert claim not in await panel.inner_text()

        await settings('+۹۸ (۲۱) ۱۲۳۴-۵۶۷۸')
        await retry.click()
        await check_status(READY)
        await expect(call).to_have_attribute('href', 'tel:+982112345678')
        await expect(page.locator('#translator-support-phone')).to_have_text('+982112345678')
        await call.evaluate("e=>e.addEventListener('click',event=>{event.preventDefault();window.selectedSupportNumber=e.getAttribute('href')})")
        await call.click()
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>selectedSupportNumber') == 'tel:+982112345678'

        await settings('')
        await retry.click()
        await check_status(EMPTY)
        await no_call()
        for number in ('tel:02112345678', '021123#45', '*1234567', '123', '1234567890123456',
                       '<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>', '+98\n2112345678', '02112345678;ext=1'):
            await settings(number)
            await retry.click()
            await check_status(INVALID)
            await no_call()

        await settings('٠٢١-٨٨٨٨-٧٧٧٧')
        await page.locator('#translator-support-close').click()
        await expect(panel).to_be_hidden()
        await no_call()
        await expect(page.locator('#sos-btn')).to_be_focused()
        await page.locator('#sos-btn').click()
        await check_status(READY)
        await expect(call).to_have_attribute('href', 'tel:02188887777')

        for mode in ('network', 'http', 'html', 'empty', 'typed', 'wrong-status'):
            async def fault(route, request, *, mode=mode):
                if mode == 'network': await route.abort()
                elif mode == 'http': await route.fulfill(status=503, json={'error': 'unavailable'})
                elif mode == 'html': await route.fulfill(body='<html>offline</html>')
                else: await route.fulfill(status=201 if mode == 'wrong-status' else 200,
                    json={} if mode == 'empty' else {'support_phone': 2112345678} if mode == 'typed' else {'support_phone': '02112345678'})
            await page.route('**/api/config', fault)
            await retry.click()
            await check_status(ERROR)
            await no_call()
            await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
            await retry.click()
            await check_status(READY)
            print(f'PASS [{width}] support {mode}')

        # Closing and reopening invalidates a late transport that ignores AbortSignal.
        await page.evaluate('''()=>{
            window.originalSupportFetch=fetch;window.supportTrap=true;window.supportReads=0;
            window.fetch=(url,opts)=>String(url)==='/api/config' && supportTrap
                ? (supportReads++,new Promise(resolve=>{window.releaseSupportFetch=()=>resolve(
                    new Response(JSON.stringify({support_phone:'0210000000'}),{status:200}))}))
                : originalSupportFetch(url,opts);
        }''')
        await retry.click()
        await page.wait_for_function('()=>supportReads===1')
        await no_call()
        await expect(retry).to_be_disabled()
        await retry.evaluate('(e)=>{e.click();e.click()}')
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>supportReads') == 1
        await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
        await expect(panel).to_be_hidden()
        await no_call()
        await expect(page.locator('#sos-btn')).to_be_focused()
        await page.evaluate('()=>{supportTrap=false}')
        await settings('+1 (212) 555-0123')
        await page.locator('#sos-btn').click()
        await check_status(READY)
        await expect(call).to_have_attribute('href', 'tel:+12125550123')
        await page.evaluate('()=>{releaseSupportFetch()}')
        await page.evaluate('()=>new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve)))')
        await expect(call).to_have_attribute('href', 'tel:+12125550123')
        await page.evaluate('()=>{window.fetch=originalSupportFetch}')

        # The ten-second deadline also covers a stalled JSON response body.
        await page.clock.install()
        await page.evaluate('''()=>{
            window.originalSupportFetch=fetch;window.supportBodyStalled=false;
            window.fetch=(url,opts)=>String(url)==='/api/config'
                ? Promise.resolve({status:200,json:()=>new Promise(resolve=>{
                    window.supportBodyStalled=true;window.releaseSupportBody=resolve})})
                : originalSupportFetch(url,opts);
        }''')
        await retry.click()
        await page.wait_for_function('()=>supportBodyStalled===true')
        await no_call()
        await page.clock.run_for(10001)
        await check_status(ERROR)
        await no_call()
        await page.evaluate('()=>{window.fetch=originalSupportFetch;releaseSupportBody({support_phone:"0210000000"})}')
        await page.clock.resume()
        await page.evaluate('()=>new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve)))')
        await check_status(ERROR)
        await no_call()
        await retry.click()
        await check_status(READY)
        await expect(call).to_have_attribute('href', 'tel:+12125550123')

        await page.locator('#header-financial-shortcut').click()
        await expect(panel).to_be_hidden()
        await no_call()
        await settings('02177776666')
        await page.locator('#view-earnings .translator-alt-back').click()
        await page.locator('#sos-btn').click()
        await check_status(READY)
        await expect(call).to_have_attribute('href', 'tel:02177776666')
        assert not mutations, mutations
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>supportToasts') == []
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>supportGeo') == []
        assert await page.evaluate('()=>supportWindows') == []
        assert not errors, errors
        print(f'PASS [{width}] guidance only; real settings, validated links, no alert/location/call claims, faults, cancellation, late response and body timeout')
    except Exception:
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / f'failure-{width}.png'), full_page=True)
        raise
    finally:
        await page.unroute_all(behavior='wait')
        await ctx.close()


async def main():
    expect.set_options(timeout=20000)
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        setup = await browser.new_context()
        original = (await api(setup.request, 'GET', '/config'))['support_phone']
        admin = (await api(setup.request, 'POST', '/admin/login', data={'password': 'test-admin-pass'}))['token']
        try:
            for width in (390, 1280):
                await scenario(browser, setup, admin, width)
        finally:
            await api(setup.request, 'PUT', '/admin/settings', admin, {'support_phone': original})
            await setup.close()
            await browser.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
````````````````

## `reference/tests/translator_workspace_metrics_ui.py`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/tests/translator_workspace_metrics_ui.py","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"8e7877165b716af9426a2737c48b1a94f1bc9331015b3e97ddab839f7ba65352"} -->
````````````````
"""The translator workspace must not invent daily earnings, work time or satisfaction metrics.

ساختار نو (پس از بازسازی میز کار): پنل مأموریت فقط کارت درخواست/مأموریت + اعلان فشرده + پشتیبانی را نگه می‌دارد؛
«خلاصهٔ عملکرد» ثابت حذف شده و آمار واقعی به نمای مالی (سرور-پشتیبان) منتقل شده است.
"""
import asyncio
import os
import secrets
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, expect
from hz_api import LOGIN_JS

BASE = os.environ.get('BASE', 'http://127.0.0.1:8081')
ARTIFACTS = Path(__file__).parent / 'assets' / 'last_translator_workspace_metrics'
FORBIDDEN = ('۱,۸۵۰,۰۰۰', '1,850,000', '۴:۰۰', '4:00', '۴.۹۵', '4.95',
             '۱۲۸ مأموریت', '128 missions', 'درآمد امروز')


async def scenario(browser, width):
    context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': width, 'height': 900}, service_workers='block')
    page = await context.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(15000)
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda err: errors.append(str(err)))
    try:
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/index.html')
        phone = '9' + str(secrets.randbelow(900000000) + 100000000)
        token = await page.evaluate(LOGIN_JS, phone)
        assert token, 'translator session was not established'
        await page.goto(BASE + '/translator/app.html')
        workspace = page.locator('#view-workspace')
        await expect(workspace).to_be_visible()
        # یادداشت ثابت «خلاصهٔ عملکرد» حذف شده است — آمار فقط از سرور در نمای مالی می‌آید
        assert await page.locator('#workspace-metrics-note').count() == 0, 'static metrics note must stay removed'
        assert await page.locator('#desk-nav [data-desk-view="earnings"]').count() == 1, 'finance section must be reachable from desk nav'
        text = await workspace.inner_text()
        for value in FORBIDDEN:
            assert value not in text, f'fabricated workspace metric remains: {value}'
        assert not errors, errors
        print(f'PASS [{width}]: no fixed metric note in sheet; real stats live in server-backed finance view')
    except Exception:
        ARTIFACTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            await page.screenshot(path=str(ARTIFACTS / f'failure-{width}.png'), full_page=True)
            (ARTIFACTS / f'failure-{width}.html').write_text(await page.content())
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise
    finally:
        await context.close()


async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(args=['--no-sandbox'])
        try:
            await scenario(browser, 390)
            await scenario(browser, 1280)
        finally:
            await browser.close()
    print('RESULT: PASS (2/2 viewports)')


asyncio.run(main())
````````````````
