    if (box) box.classList.toggle('hidden', !vehicleOn.checked);
  });

  var offersBox = document.getElementById('offers-box');
  var lastOffers = [];
  var lastChanges = [];
  var lastExtensions = [];
  function updateWorkspaceSheetSummary() {
    var label = document.getElementById('workspace-sheet-state');
    var meta = document.getElementById('workspace-sheet-meta');
    var dot = document.getElementById('workspace-sheet-state-dot');
    if (!label || !meta || !dot) return;

    var stateText = 'در انتظار درخواست تازه';
    var metaText = 'فاصله و زمان مسیر نمایش داده نمی‌شود';
    var tone = 'is-idle';
    var offer = Array.isArray(lastOffers) && lastOffers.length ? lastOffers[0] : null;
    var extension = Array.isArray(lastExtensions) && lastExtensions.length ? lastExtensions[0] : null;
    var change = Array.isArray(lastChanges) && lastChanges.length ? lastChanges[0] : null;
    var pendingResponse = offer || extension || change;
    if (pendingResponse) {
      stateText = offer ? (offer.kind === 'scheduled' ? 'پیشنهاد زمان‌دار' : 'پیشنهاد فوری')
        : extension ? 'درخواست تمدید خدمت' : 'درخواست تغییر مأموریت';
      metaText = 'فرصت پاسخ: ' + HZ.toFa(Math.max(0, Math.ceil((Date.parse(pendingResponse.expires_at) - (Date.now() + offerServerClockOffset)) / 1000))) + ' ثانیه';
      tone = 'is-offer';
      meta.setAttribute('data-exp', pendingResponse.expires_at);
      meta.setAttribute('data-offer-timer', '1');
    } else {
      meta.removeAttribute('data-exp');
      meta.removeAttribute('data-offer-timer');
      if (MISSIONS.length) {
        var mappedMission = MISSIONS.find(hasMissionCoordinates);
        stateText = 'مأموریت پذیرفته‌شده';
        metaText = mappedMission ? 'نقطهٔ ملاقات ثبت‌شده روی نقشه' : 'مختصات واقعی از سرور موجود نیست';
        tone = 'is-accepted';
      } else if (missionsState === 'nosession') {
        stateText = 'ورود به حساب لازم است';
        metaText = 'اطلاعات مأموریت از سرور دریافت نمی‌شود';
        tone = 'is-error';
      } else if (offersState === 'error' || missionsState === 'error') {
        stateText = 'درخواست‌ها دریافت نشدند';
        metaText = 'برای تلاش دوباره، دریافت را بررسی کنید';
        tone = 'is-error';
      } else if (offersState === 'loading' || missionsState === 'loading') {
        stateText = 'در حال بررسی درخواست‌ها';
        metaText = 'وضعیت واقعی از سرور دریافت می‌شود';
        tone = 'is-loading';
      }
    }
    label.textContent = stateText;
    meta.textContent = metaText;
    dot.className = 'translator-sheet-state-dot ' + tone;
    // شمارنده‌های زندهٔ میز کار: فقط دادهٔ واقعی سرور (بدون هیچ آمار ساختگی)
    var counts = document.getElementById('desk-counts');
    if (counts) {
      var offerCount = (Array.isArray(lastOffers) ? lastOffers.length : 0) +
        (Array.isArray(lastChanges) ? lastChanges.length : 0) +
        (Array.isArray(lastExtensions) ? lastExtensions.length : 0);
      var payCount = Array.isArray(PAYMENTS_LIST) ? PAYMENTS_LIST.length : 0;
      if (!offerCount && !MISSIONS.length && !payCount) {
        counts.classList.add('hidden'); counts.textContent = '';
      } else {
        counts.classList.remove('hidden'); counts.textContent = '';
        [[offerCount, 'پیشنهاد منتظر پاسخ'], [MISSIONS.length, 'مأموریت فعال'], [payCount, 'پرداخت منتظر تأیید']].forEach(function (c) {
          var item = el('span', 'code6-count-item');
          item.appendChild(el('b', '', HZ.toFa(c[0])));
          item.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' ' + c[1]));
          counts.appendChild(item);
        });
      }
    }
  }
  function syncWorkspaceEmptyMissions() {
    var box = document.getElementById('missions-list');
    if (!box || MISSIONS.length || missionsState !== 'ok') return;
    var pending = lastOffers.length || lastChanges.length || lastExtensions.length;
    var emptyCard = box.querySelector('.translator-empty-missions');
    if (pending && emptyCard) emptyCard.remove();
    if (!pending && !emptyCard) {
      box.innerHTML = '';
      box.appendChild(el('div', 'translator-empty-missions', 'فعلاً مأموریت پذیرفته‌شده‌ای ندارید. درخواست‌های جدید بعد از تأیید پذیرفته می‌شوند.'));
    }
  }
  var CHANGE_LABEL = { notes: 'یادداشت', scheduled_at: 'زمان', place: 'محل ملاقات', origin_lang: 'زبان مبدأ', dest_lang: 'زبان مقصد', field: 'حوزه', hours: 'مدت', car: 'خودرو', party: 'تعداد همراه', gender_pref: 'ترجیح جنسیت' };
  function renderChange(c) {
    var actor = tok();
    var card = el('div', 'translator-change-card rounded-2xl bg-surface p-4 sm:p-5 neu-raised flex flex-col gap-3 border border-secondary/40');
    card.setAttribute('data-change-id', c.id);
    card.appendChild(el('span', 'text-[13px] font-bold text-on-surface', 'درخواست تغییر ماموریت'));
    var parts = Object.keys(c.changes).filter(function (k) { return CHANGE_LABEL[k]; }).map(function (k) {
      var v = c.changes[k];
      if (k === 'scheduled_at') v = HZ.jDate(new Date(v)) + ' ' + HZ.clock(new Date(v));
      return CHANGE_LABEL[k] + ': ' + v;
    });
    card.appendChild(el('span', 'text-[13.5px] text-on-surface-variant', parts.join(' • ') || 'تغییر جزئی'));
    var row = el('div', 'flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-surface-variant/40 text-[12px]');
    var tm = el('span', 'font-bold text-secondary', HZ.toFa(Math.max(0, Math.ceil((Date.parse(c.expires_at) - (Date.now() + offerServerClockOffset)) / 1000))) + ' ثانیه');
    tm.setAttribute('data-exp', c.expires_at); tm.setAttribute('data-pure', '1');
    row.appendChild(tm);
    var btns = el('div', 'flex gap-2');
    var no = el('button', 'px-4 py-2 rounded-xl neu-raised text-[12px] font-bold text-on-surface cursor-pointer', 'رد');
    no.type = 'button';
    HZ_MISSION_ACTION.bind(no, c.reservation_id);
    function decideChange(action) {
      return HZ_MISSION_ACTION.run({ action: action, id: c.id, reservation_id: c.reservation_id, changes: c.changes, token: actor,
        serverTimeOffset: offerServerClockOffset, refresh: function () { loadMissions(); refreshOffers(true); } });
    }
    no.onclick = function () { decideChange('change-reject'); };
    var yes = el('button', 'px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#026aa7] text-white text-[12px] font-bold cursor-pointer', 'پذیرش');
    yes.type = 'button';
    HZ_MISSION_ACTION.bind(yes, c.reservation_id);
    yes.onclick = function () { decideChange('change-accept'); };
    btns.appendChild(no); btns.appendChild(yes); row.appendChild(btns);
    card.appendChild(row);
    return card;
  }
  function renderExtension(m) {

    var card = el('section', 'translator-extension-card');

  var FIELD_LABEL_FA = { tourism: 'گردشگری و خرید', pilgrimage: 'زیارتی و مذهبی', medical: 'درمانی', business: 'بازرگانی', legal: 'حقوقی' };
  var LANGUAGE_LABEL_FA = { fa: 'فارسی', ar: 'عربی', en: 'انگلیسی', tr: 'ترکی', fr: 'فرانسوی', ru: 'روسی', zh: 'چینی' };
  function renderOffers() {
    if (!offersBox) return;
    offersBox.innerHTML = '';
    if (offersState === 'error') {
      var errorCard = el('div', 'translator-offer-card translator-request-error');

      var errorSummary = el('div', 'translator-offer-summary');
      errorSummary.appendChild(el('strong', 'translator-offer-traveler', 'دریافت درخواست‌ها انجام نشد'));
      var errorState = el('div', 'translator-offer-state-line');
      errorState.appendChild(el('span', 'translator-offer-state-title', 'اتصال به سرور را بررسی کنید'));
      errorSummary.appendChild(errorState);
      errorPrimary.appendChild(errorSummary);
      var errorIcon = el('div', 'translator-offer-countdown translator-offer-error-icon');
      errorIcon.appendChild(el('span', 'material-symbols-outlined', 'sync_problem'));
      errorPrimary.appendChild(errorIcon);
      errorCard.appendChild(errorPrimary);
      var errorNote = el('div', 'translator-offer-notes');
      errorNote.appendChild(el('span', 'material-symbols-outlined translator-offer-note-icon', 'info'));
      errorNote.appendChild(el('strong', 'translator-offer-error-copy', 'برای دریافت دوباره تلاش کنید. دادهٔ مأموریت یا محل ساختگی نمایش داده نمی‌شود.'));
      errorCard.appendChild(errorNote);
      var retry = el('button', 'translator-offer-retry neu-flat', 'تلاش دوباره');
      retry.type = 'button'; retry.onclick = function () { refreshOffers(true); }; errorCard.appendChild(retry);
      offersBox.appendChild(errorCard);
      if (missionsState === 'ok') renderMissions();
      updateTranslatorMap();
      updateWorkspaceSheetSummary();
      syncWorkspaceEmptyMissions();
      return;
    }
    lastChanges.forEach(function (c) { offersBox.appendChild(renderChange(c)); });
    if (offersState === 'ok' && !lastExtensions.length && !lastChanges.length && !lastOffers.length) {
      offersBox.appendChild(el('div', 'translator-empty-offers', 'در حال حاضر پیشنهاد یا درخواست تغییری برای پاسخ ثبت نشده است.'));
    }
    lastOffers.forEach(function (o) {
      var card = el('article', 'translator-offer-card');
      var actor = tok();
      card.setAttribute('data-offer-id', o.id);

      var primary = el('div', 'translator-offer-primary');
      var summary = el('div', 'translator-offer-summary');
      summary.appendChild(el('strong', 'translator-offer-traveler', o.traveler_name || 'نام مسافر اعلام نشده'));
      var stateLine = el('div', 'translator-offer-state-line');
      stateLine.appendChild(el('span', 'translator-offer-state-title', 'پیشنهاد جدید منتظر بررسی'));
      stateLine.appendChild(el('span', 'translator-offer-state-dot', ''));
      stateLine.appendChild(el('span', 'translator-offer-kind', o.kind === 'scheduled' ? 'درخواست زمان‌دار' : 'درخواست فوری'));
      summary.appendChild(stateLine);
      if (o.kind === 'scheduled' && o.scheduled_at) {
        var scheduled = new Date(o.scheduled_at);
        summary.appendChild(el('small', 'translator-offer-kind-detail', HZ.jDate(scheduled) + ' • ' + HZ.clock(scheduled)));
      }
      var remaining = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((Date.parse(o.expires_at) - (Date.now() + offerServerClockOffset)) / 1000));
      var expiryLine = el('small', 'translator-offer-expiry', 'انقضا در ' + HZ.toFa(remaining) + ' ثانیه');
      expiryLine.setAttribute('data-exp', o.expires_at);
      expiryLine.setAttribute('data-offer-expiry', '1');
      summary.appendChild(expiryLine);
      primary.appendChild(summary);

      var timer = el('div', 'translator-offer-countdown');
      timer.setAttribute('role', 'timer');
      timer.setAttribute('aria-label', 'فرصت پاسخ به پیشنهاد');
      var ring = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');
      ring.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 44 44');
      ring.setAttribute('class', 'translator-offer-countdown-svg');
      var track = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
      track.setAttribute('cx', '22'); track.setAttribute('cy', '22'); track.setAttribute('r', '17');
      track.setAttribute('class', 'translator-offer-countdown-track');
      var progress = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
      progress.setAttribute('cx', '22'); progress.setAttribute('cy', '22'); progress.setAttribute('r', '17');
      progress.setAttribute('class', 'translator-offer-countdown-progress');
      progress.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', '106.8');
      var offerDurationMs = Math.max(1, Date.parse(o.expires_at) - Date.parse(o.created_at));
      var offerElapsed = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 1 - (Date.parse(o.expires_at) - (Date.now() + offerServerClockOffset)) / offerDurationMs));
      progress.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', String(106.8 * offerElapsed));
      progress.setAttribute('data-exp', o.expires_at);
      progress.setAttribute('data-countdown-progress', '1');
      progress.setAttribute('data-countdown-total-ms', String(offerDurationMs));
      ring.appendChild(track); ring.appendChild(progress);
      var count = el('span', 'translator-offer-countdown-value', HZ.toFa(remaining));
      count.setAttribute('data-exp', o.expires_at);
      count.setAttribute('data-countdown-ring', '1');
      timer.appendChild(ring); timer.appendChild(count);
      primary.appendChild(timer);

      var compensation = el('div', 'translator-offer-compensation');
      compensation.appendChild(el('small', '', 'حق‌الزحمه تعهد (' + HZ.toFa(o.hours) + ' ساعت)'));
      compensation.appendChild(el('strong', '', HZ.money(o.net)));
      compensation.appendChild(el('small', 'translator-offer-currency', 'سهم خالص مترجم'));
      primary.appendChild(compensation);
      card.appendChild(primary);

      var facts = el('div', 'translator-offer-facts');
      function offerFact(icon, label, value) {
        var fact = el('div', 'translator-offer-fact');
        fact.appendChild(el('span', 'material-symbols-outlined translator-offer-fact-icon', icon));
        var copy = el('div', 'translator-offer-fact-copy');
        copy.appendChild(el('small', '', label));
        copy.appendChild(el('strong', '', value));
        fact.appendChild(copy);
        facts.appendChild(fact);
      }
      var language = (LANGUAGE_LABEL_FA[o.origin_lang] || o.origin_lang) + ' ⟷ ' + (LANGUAGE_LABEL_FA[o.dest_lang] || o.dest_lang);
      if (o.field && o.field !== 'general') language += ' • ' + (FIELD_LABEL_FA[o.field] || o.field);
      offerFact('translate', 'خدمت زبانی', language);
      offerFact(o.car ? 'directions_car' : 'directions_walk', 'نوع همراهی', o.car ? 'با خودرو' : 'پیاده');
      offerFact('pin_drop', 'محل قرار ملاقات', o.place || 'نشانی در درخواست ثبت نشده');
      offerFact('groups', 'تعداد مسافران', HZ.toFa(o.party) + ' نفر');
      card.appendChild(facts);

      var note = el('div', 'translator-offer-notes');
      note.appendChild(el('span', 'material-symbols-outlined translator-offer-note-icon', 'format_quote'));
      var noteCopy = el('div', 'translator-offer-note-copy');
      noteCopy.appendChild(el('small', '', 'یادداشت مسافر'));
      noteCopy.appendChild(el('strong', '', o.notes ? '«' + o.notes + '»' : 'یادداشتی ثبت نشده است'));
      note.appendChild(noteCopy);
      card.appendChild(note);

      var btns = el('div', 'translator-offer-actions');
      var no = el('button', 'translator-offer-reject');
      no.type = 'button'; no.setAttribute('aria-label', 'رد درخواست');
      no.appendChild(el('span', 'material-symbols-outlined', 'close'));
      no.appendChild(el('span', '', 'رد درخواست'));
      HZ_MISSION_ACTION.bind(no, o.reservation_id);
      function decideOffer(action) {
        return HZ_MISSION_ACTION.run({ action: action, id: o.id, reservation_id: o.reservation_id, net: o.net, token: actor,
          serverTimeOffset: offerServerClockOffset, refresh: function () { loadMissions(); refreshOffers(true); } });
      }
      no.onclick = function () { decideOffer('offer-decline'); };
      var yes = el('button', 'translator-offer-accept');
      yes.type = 'button'; yes.setAttribute('aria-label', 'پذیرش مأموریت و اعزام');
      yes.appendChild(el('span', 'material-symbols-outlined', 'check_circle'));
      yes.appendChild(el('span', '', 'قبول مأموریت و اعزام'));
      HZ_MISSION_ACTION.bind(yes, o.reservation_id);
      yes.onclick = function () { decideOffer('offer-accept'); };
      btns.appendChild(no); btns.appendChild(yes);
      card.appendChild(btns);
      offersBox.appendChild(card);
    });
    updateTranslatorMap();
    updateWorkspaceSheetSummary();
    syncWorkspaceEmptyMissions();
  }
  var offersSig = '', offersState = 'loading';
  var offerRead = 0, offerApplied = 0, offerRevision = 0, offerServerClockOffset = 0;
  function refreshOffers(invalidate) {
    var token = tok(), read = ++offerRead, revision = invalidate ? ++offerRevision : offerRevision;
    if (!token) return;
    srv('GET', '/translator/offers').then(function (res) {
      if (tok() !== token || revision !== offerRevision || read < offerApplied) return;
      if (res.status !== 200 || !res.data || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(res.data.server_time)) || !Array.isArray(res.data.offers) || !Array.isArray(res.data.changes) || !Array.isArray(res.data.extensions) ||
          !res.data.changes.every(function (c) { return c && Number.isSafeInteger(c.id) && c.id > 0 && Number.isSafeInteger(c.reservation_id) && c.reservation_id > 0 &&
            typeof c.expires_at === 'string' && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(c.expires_at)) && HZ_MISSION_ACTION.validChanges(c.changes); }) ||
          !res.data.extensions.every(function (e) { return e && Number.isSafeInteger(e.id) && e.id > 0 && Number.isSafeInteger(e.reservation_id) && e.reservation_id > 0 &&
            Number.isInteger(e.extra_hours) && e.extra_hours >= 1 && e.extra_hours <= 4 && typeof e.extra_total === 'number' && Number.isFinite(e.extra_total) && e.extra_total >= 0 &&
            typeof e.extra_net === 'number' && Number.isFinite(e.extra_net) && e.extra_net >= 0 && typeof e.new_net === 'number' && Number.isFinite(e.new_net) && e.new_net >= 0 &&
            typeof e.expires_at === 'string' && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(e.expires_at)) &&
            (e.traveler_name == null || typeof e.traveler_name === 'string') && (e.place == null || typeof e.place === 'string'); }) ||
          !res.data.offers.every(function (o) { return o && Number.isSafeInteger(o.id) && o.id > 0 && Number.isSafeInteger(o.reservation_id) && o.reservation_id > 0 &&
            ['instant', 'scheduled'].includes(o.kind) && typeof o.created_at === 'string' && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(o.created_at)) &&
            typeof o.expires_at === 'string' && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(o.expires_at)) && typeof o.net === 'number' && Number.isFinite(o.net) && o.net >= 0 &&
            Number.isInteger(o.hours) && o.hours >= 1 && o.hours <= 24 && (o.car === 0 || o.car === 1) && Number.isInteger(o.party) && o.party >= 1 && o.party <= 20 &&
            (o.kind !== 'scheduled' || (typeof o.scheduled_at === 'string' && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(o.scheduled_at)))) &&
            (o.traveler_name == null || typeof o.traveler_name === 'string') && (o.place == null || typeof o.place === 'string') &&
            (o.notes == null || typeof o.notes === 'string'); }) ||
          new Set(res.data.offers.map(function (o) { return o.id; })).size !== res.data.offers.length) {
        offerApplied = read; offersState = 'error'; offersSig = ''; lastOffers = []; lastChanges = []; lastExtensions = []; renderOffers(); return;
      }
      offersState = 'ok';
      offerServerClockOffset = Date.parse(res.data.server_time) - Date.now();
      offerApplied = read;
      lastOffers = res.data.offers;
      lastChanges = res.data.changes;
      lastExtensions = res.data.extensions;
      // Quote changes as well as IDs invalidate cards. Re-rendered controls
      // inherit the reservation lock, never silently unlocking an action.
      var sig = JSON.stringify([lastOffers, lastChanges, lastExtensions]);
      if (sig !== offersSig) {
        offersSig = sig; renderOffers();
        if (missionsState === 'ok') renderMissions();
      }
      HZ_MISSION_ACTION.update();
    });
  }
  setInterval(refreshOffers, 3000);
  loadPayments(); setInterval(loadPayments, 5000);
  // شمارش معکوس هر ثانیه، بدون بازسازی کارت‌ها
  setInterval(function () {
    var serverNow = Date.now() + offerServerClockOffset;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-exp]').forEach(function (t) {
      var expiresAt = Date.parse(t.getAttribute('data-exp'));
      if (!Number.isFinite(expiresAt)) return;
      var left = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((expiresAt - serverNow) / 1000));
      if (t.getAttribute('data-countdown-progress')) {
        var total = Number(t.getAttribute('data-countdown-total-ms'));
        var elapsed = Number.isFinite(total) && total > 0 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 1 - (expiresAt - serverNow) / total)) : 1;
        t.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', String(106.8 * elapsed));
      } else if (t.getAttribute('data-countdown-ring')) t.textContent = HZ.toFa(left);
      else if (t.getAttribute('data-pure')) t.textContent = HZ.toFa(left) + ' ثانیه';
      else if (t.getAttribute('data-offer-expiry')) t.textContent = 'انقضا در ' + HZ.toFa(left) + ' ثانیه';
      else if (t.getAttribute('data-offer-timer')) t.textContent = 'فرصت پاسخ: ' + HZ.toFa(left) + ' ثانیه';
      else t.textContent = t.textContent.replace(/• .*ثانیه$/, '• ' + HZ.toFa(left) + ' ثانیه');
    });
  }, 1000);
  refreshOffers(true);

  loadMissions();
  setInterval(loadMissions, 5000);
  setInterval(updateServiceTimers, 1000);

  var p = state.profile || {};
  var displayName = [p.nameFa, p.lastFa].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || 'مترجم';

  // نام نمایشی از دادهٔ محلی در سرایند و کارت‌ها می‌آید؛ این داده به‌تنهایی هویت سروری را ثابت نمی‌کند.
  function applyDisplayName() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-tr-name]').forEach(function (el) { el.textContent = displayName; });
  }

  applyDisplayName();
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', applyDisplayName);

  // کشوی نمایهٔ سربرگ: شمارهٔ حساب و وضعیت فقط از دادهٔ واقعی حساب
  (function fillProfilePanel() {
    var st = HZ.load();
    var phone = document.getElementById('profile-phone');
    if (phone && st.session && st.session.phone) phone.textContent = st.session.phone;
    var stat = document.getElementById('profile-status');
    if (stat) stat.textContent = HZ.STATUS_LABEL[st.status] || st.status;
  })();

  // ---------- ناوبری بخش‌های میز کار (داک پایینی — طرح تأییدشدهٔ موکاپ) ----------
  var NAV_FA = { workspace: 'میز کار', schedule: 'مأموریت‌ها', credentials: 'صلاحیت', earnings: 'مالی', settings: 'تنظیمات' };
  function syncDeskNav(target) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.desk-nav-item').forEach(function (b) {
      var on = b.getAttribute('data-desk-view') === target;
      b.classList.toggle('on', on);
      if (on) b.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true'); else b.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.desk-nav-item').forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var v = b.getAttribute('data-desk-view');
      if (typeof window.switchView === 'function') window.switchView(v);
    });
  });
  var _origSwitchView = window.switchView;
  if (typeof _origSwitchView === 'function') {
    window.switchView = function (target) {
      _origSwitchView(target);
      syncDeskNav(target);
      if (target === 'earnings') renderEarnings();
      if (target === 'settings') renderProfile();
      if (target === 'credentials') { renderCertGate(); renderVehicleDocs(); }
    };
    syncDeskNav('workspace');
  }

  // ---------- گزارش مالی واقعی (تسویه‌ها + بدهی نقدی) ----------
  function fmtMan(n) { return (Number(n) || 0).toLocaleString('fa-IR'); }
  function renderEarnings() {
    var sum = document.getElementById('earnings-summary');
    var setBox = document.getElementById('earnings-settlements');
    var debtBox = document.getElementById('earnings-debt');
    if (!sum) return;
    srv('GET', '/translator/payments').then(function (r) {
      if (r.status !== 200 || !r.data) return;
      var d = r.data;
      if (debtBox) {
        var debt = d.debt || { amount: 0, blocked: false };
        debtBox.classList.toggle('hidden', !(debt.amount > 0));
        if (debt.amount > 0) document.getElementById('earnings-debt-text').textContent =
          fmtMan(debt.amount) + ' تومان بدهی سهم پلتفرم از رزروهای نقدی دارید؛ ' +
          (debt.blocked ? 'تا تسویه، پیشنهاد درخواست جدید برایتان بسته است. برای تسویه با پشتیبانی در تماس باشید.' : 'باقیمانده پس از پرداخت‌های ثبت‌شده.');
      }
      var waiting = (d.payments || []);
      var settled = (d.settlements || []);
      var sumNet = settled.reduce(function (a, s) { return a + (s.net || 0); }, 0);
      sum.textContent = '';
      var cards = [
        ['رزروهای در انتظار تسویه', fmtMan(waiting.length) + ' مورد'],
        ['تسویه‌شدهٔ اخیر', fmtMan(settled.length) + ' مورد'],
        ['سهم خالص تسویه‌شدهٔ اخیر', fmtMan(sumNet) + ' تومان'],
      ];
      cards.forEach(function (c) {
        var row = el('div', 'p-3 rounded-xl bg-surface-container-low flex justify-between gap-3 text-[12px]');
        row.appendChild(el('span', 'font-bold text-on-surface', c[0]));
        row.appendChild(el('span', 'font-bold text-primary', c[1]));
        sum.appendChild(row);
      });
      if (setBox) {
        setBox.textContent = '';
        if (!settled.length) { setBox.appendChild(el('p', 'text-[13px] text-on-surface-variant', 'تسویه‌ای ثبت نشده است.')); }
        settled.forEach(function (s) { setBox.appendChild(settlementCard(s)); });
      }
    });
  }

  // ---------- گیت مدرک زبان: ارسال واقعی مدرک از کارت صلاحیت (مثل ثبت‌نام) ----------
  function renderCertGate() {
    var box = document.getElementById('cert-gate-box');
    if (!box || !lastCapability) return;
    var dm = lastCapability.dimensions || {};
    var ld = lastCapability.ladder || { fields: [] };
    var lockedSpec = (ld.fields || []).some(function (f) { return f.selected && !f.base && !f.active; });
    var certOk = dm.specialized && dm.specialized.ok;
    box.classList.toggle('hidden', !(lockedSpec && !certOk));
    var pending = (lastCapability.pending_docs && lastCapability.pending_docs.lang_cert) || false;
    if (pending) {
      var m = document.getElementById('cert-msg');
      if (m) { m.textContent = 'مدرک زبان ارسال شده و در انتظار تأیید کارشناس است.'; m.className = 'text-[13px] text-secondary font-bold'; }
    }
  }
  function fileToDataUrl(file) {
    return new Promise(function (res, rej) {
      var fr = new FileReader();
      fr.onload = function () { res(String(fr.result)); };
      fr.onerror = rej;
      fr.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  }
  function sendDoc(kind, file, expiresAt) {
    return fileToDataUrl(file).then(function (dataUrl) {
      var body = { kind: kind, data: dataUrl };
      if (expiresAt) body.expires_at = expiresAt;
      return srv('POST', '/translator/documents', body).then(function (r) {
        if (r.status === 200 || r.status === 201) return { ok: true };
        return { ok: false, error: (r.data && r.data.error) || 'error' };
      });
    });
  }
  var certSend = document.getElementById('cert-send');
  if (certSend) certSend.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var msg = document.getElementById('cert-msg');
    var file = (document.getElementById('cert-file') || {}).files;
    var say = function (t, err) { if (msg) { msg.textContent = t; msg.className = 'text-[13px] font-bold ' + (err ? 'text-error' : 'text-primary'); } };
    if (!file || !file[0]) { say('فایل مدرک را انتخاب کنید.', true); return; }
    if (file[0].size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) { say('حجم فایل باید کمتر از ۵ مگابایت باشد.', true); return; }
    say('در حال ارسال…', false);
    sendDoc('lang_cert', file[0]).then(function (r) {
      if (r.ok) { say('ارسال شد؛ پس از تأیید کارشناس، حوزه‌های تخصصی فعال می‌شود.', false); renderLiveDocs(); }
      else say('ارسال نشد: ' + (r.error === 'invalid_file_type' ? 'نوع فایل مجاز نیست' : 'دوباره تلاش کنید'), true);
    });
  });

  // ---------- مدارک خودرو: ارسال بیمه‌نامه + گواهینامه از کارت صلاحیت ----------
  function renderVehicleDocs() {
    var box = document.getElementById('vehicle-docs-box');
    if (!box || !lastCapability) return;
    var car = (lastCapability.dimensions || {}).car || {};
    // جعبهٔ مدارک فقط وقتی باز است که خودرو ثبت شده اما هنوز فعال نیست
    box.classList.toggle('hidden', !(car.registered && !car.active));
    var st = document.getElementById('vehicle-docs-status');
    if (st && car.registered && !car.active) {
      var pendingCar = lastCapability.pending_docs && (lastCapability.pending_docs.car_docs || lastCapability.pending_docs.licence);
      st.textContent = pendingCar
        ? 'مدارک ارسال شده و در انتظار تأیید کارشناس است؛ تا آن زمان فقط درخواست پیاده می‌بینید.'
        : 'برای فعال شدن رزرو سواره، بیمه‌نامهٔ خودرو و گواهینامه را با تاریخ انقضا بفرستید.';
    }
  }
  var vdocsSend = document.getElementById('vehicle-docs-send');
  if (vdocsSend) vdocsSend.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var msg = document.getElementById('vehicle-docs-msg');
    var say = function (t, err) { if (msg) { msg.textContent = t; msg.className = 'text-[13px] font-bold ' + (err ? 'text-error' : 'text-primary'); } };
    var carF = (document.getElementById('cardocs-file') || {}).files;
    var licF = (document.getElementById('licence-file') || {}).files;
    var carExp = (document.getElementById('cardocs-expiry') || {}).value;
    var licExp = (document.getElementById('licence-expiry') || {}).value;
    if ((!carF || !carF[0]) && (!licF || !licF[0])) { say('حداقل یکی از دو مدرک را انتخاب کنید.', true); return; }
    if (carF && carF[0] && !carExp) { say('تاریخ انقضای بیمه‌نامه را مشخص کنید.', true); return; }
    if (licF && licF[0] && !licExp) { say('تاریخ انقضای گواهینامه را مشخص کنید.', true); return; }
    say('در حال ارسال…', false);
    var jobs = [];
    if (carF && carF[0]) jobs.push(sendDoc('car_docs', carF[0], carExp));
    if (licF && licF[0]) jobs.push(sendDoc('licence', licF[0], licExp));
    Promise.all(jobs).then(function (rs) {
      if (rs.every(function (r) { return r.ok; })) { say('ارسال شد؛ پس از تأیید کارشناس، رزرو سواره فعال می‌شود.', false); renderLiveDocs(); }
      else say('ارسال یکی از مدارک ناموفق بود؛ دوباره تلاش کنید.', true);
    });
  });

  // ---------- پروفایل و تنظیمات (خواندن از سرور، ویرایش جنسیت/شهر) ----------
  var CITY_FA = {};
  function renderProfile() {
    srv('GET', '/translator/profile').then(function (r) {
      if (r.status !== 200 || !r.data) return;
      var d = r.data;
      var info = document.getElementById('profile-info');
      if (info) {
        info.textContent = '';
        var rows = [
          ['نام ثبت‌شده', ([d.first_name, d.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || '—')],
          ['شمارهٔ حساب', d.phone || '—'],
          ['زبان‌ها', (d.langs || []).join('، ') || '—'],
          ['شهر فعلی', d.city_name || '—'],
        ];
        rows.forEach(function (x) {
          var row = el('div', 'p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-surface-container-low flex justify-between gap-3');
          row.appendChild(el('span', 'font-bold text-on-surface-variant text-[13px]', x[0]));
          row.appendChild(el('span', 'font-bold text-on-surface text-[13.5px]', String(x[1])));
          info.appendChild(row);
        });
      }
      var g = document.getElementById('profile-gender');
      if (g) g.value = d.gender || '';
      var locChk = document.getElementById('loc-sharing');
      if (locChk) locChk.checked = !!(d.location && d.location.sharing);
      var locSt = document.getElementById('loc-status');
      if (locSt && d.location && d.location.sharing && d.location.at) {
        locSt.textContent = 'اشتراک روشن است؛ آخرین موقعیت ثبت‌شده: ' + new Date(d.location.at).toLocaleString('fa-IR');
      }
    });
    fetch('/api/config').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (c) {
      var sel = document.getElementById('profile-city');
      if (!sel || !c || !Array.isArray(c.translator_cities)) return;
      var cur = sel.value;
      sel.textContent = '';
      c.translator_cities.forEach(function (city) {
        var o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = String(city.id); o.textContent = city.name_fa;
        sel.appendChild(o); CITY_FA[city.id] = city.name_fa;
      });
      if (cur) sel.value = cur;
    }).catch(function () {});
  }
  var profileSave = document.getElementById('profile-save');
  if (profileSave) profileSave.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var msg = document.getElementById('profile-msg');
    var say = function (t, err) { if (msg) { msg.textContent = t; msg.className = 'text-[13px] font-bold ' + (err ? 'text-error' : 'text-primary'); } };
    var body = {};
    var g = document.getElementById('profile-gender');
    if (g && g.value) body.gender = g.value;
    var c = document.getElementById('profile-city');
    if (c && c.value) body.city_id = Number(c.value);
    if (!Object.keys(body).length) { say('تغییری برای ذخیره نیست.', true); return; }
    say('در حال ذخیره…', false);
    srv('PATCH', '/translator/profile', body).then(function (r) {
      if (r.status === 200) { say('پروفایل ذخیره شد.', false); renderProfile(); }
      else if (r.data && r.data.error === 'invalid_city') say('شهر انتخابی معتبر نیست.', true);
      else say('ذخیره نشد؛ دوباره تلاش کنید.', true);
    });
  });

  // ---------- ارسال موقعیت مکانی (اختیاری؛ فقط با اجازه و هنگام آنلاین بودن) ----------
  var locTimer = null;
  function sendLocation() {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) return;
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function (pos) {
      srv('POST', '/translator/location', { lat: pos.coords.latitude, lng: pos.coords.longitude, sharing: true });
      var st = document.getElementById('loc-status');
      if (st) st.textContent = 'اشتراک روشن است؛ موقعیت ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString('fa-IR') + ' ثبت شد.';
    }, function () {}, { enableHighAccuracy: false, timeout: 8000, maximumAge: 60000 });
  }
  var locChk = document.getElementById('loc-sharing');
  if (locChk) locChk.addEventListener('change', function () {
    var st = document.getElementById('loc-status');
    if (locChk.checked) {
      if (st) st.textContent = 'درخواست دسترسی به موقعیت…';
      sendLocation();
      if (locTimer) clearInterval(locTimer);
      locTimer = setInterval(function () { if (window.isShiftActive) sendLocation(); }, 3 * 60 * 1000);
    } else {
      if (locTimer) { clearInterval(locTimer); locTimer = null; }
      srv('POST', '/translator/location', { lat: 0, lng: 0, sharing: false }).then(function () {
        if (st) st.textContent = 'اشتراک موقعیت خاموش شد؛ موقعیت شما دیگر در تطبیق به کار نمی‌آید.';
      });
    }
  });

  // وضعیت گیت‌های ارسال مدرک در renderCapability ذخیره می‌شود؛ اینجا یک‌بار در بوت رندر می‌شوند
  renderCertGate(); renderVehicleDocs();
})();

## `reference/translator/code6.css`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/translator/code6.css","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"6a78767c8adf53805e4f9f4c26f662f2ebdce8417a3bcdb27379dfbeab8682d8"} -->
````````````````
/* Local production styles for the code6 translator workspace. */
:root {
  --bg-color: #edf2f7;
  --neu-light: #fff;
  --neu-dark: #cad6e2;
  --primary-teal: #00685f;
  --primary-dark: #004d46;
  --primary-light: #008378;
  --code6-ink: #171c21;
  --code6-muted: #4d5b68;
  --code6-shadow: 6px 6px 14px rgba(202, 214, 226, .92), -6px -6px 14px rgba(255, 255, 255, .98);
  --code6-shadow-sm: 3px 3px 8px rgba(202, 214, 226, .9), -3px -3px 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, .98);
  --code6-inset: inset 3px 3px 7px rgba(202, 214, 226, .92), inset -3px -3px 7px rgba(255, 255, 255, .98);
}

html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
body { font-family: 'Vazirmatn', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--bg-color); color: var(--code6-ink); overscroll-behavior: none; }
.hidden { display: none !important; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; }
button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed !important; opacity: .64; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00685f; outline-offset: 2px; }
* { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; box-sizing: border-box; }

#view-workspace { position: relative; }
#map-wrapper { transform-origin: 50% 50%; }
#translator-map-stage { background: #e8eef4; }
#translator-map-stage > svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; object-fit: cover; }
#translator-map { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 2; visibility: hidden; background: #e8eef4; }
#translator-map .leaflet-tile-pane { z-index: 1; }
#translator-map.leaflet-container { background: #e4ecf6; font-family: inherit; }
#translator-map .leaflet-tile { max-width: none !important; max-height: none !important; }
#translator-map .leaflet-control-attribution { background: rgba(255,255,255,.94); font: 9px/1.2 'Vazirmatn', sans-serif; }
#translator-map-preview-note {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 6;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  display: flex;
  width: min(300px, calc(100vw - 90px));
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  padding: 13px 16px;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: rgba(237,242,247,.96);
  box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow);
  color: var(--code6-ink);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  text-align: center;
}
#translator-map-preview-note[hidden] { display: none !important; }
#translator-map-preview-open { color: var(--primary-teal); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; text-decoration: underline; }
#translator-map-placeholder { position: absolute; z-index: 4; top: 19%; left: 54%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }
.code6-map-placeholder {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  width: max-content;
  max-width: min(290px, calc(100vw - 90px));
  padding: 9px 13px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: rgba(237,242,247,.96);
  box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm);
  color: var(--code6-ink);
  text-align: right;
}
.code6-map-placeholder > .material-symbols-outlined { color: var(--primary-teal); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.code6-map-placeholder strong { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; }
.code6-map-placeholder p { margin: 2px 0 0; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; }
.code6-map-location {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 5;
  top: 19%;
  left: 54%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  max-width: min(280px, calc(100vw - 90px));
  padding: 7px 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: rgba(237,242,247,.96);
  box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm);
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.code6-map-location > .material-symbols-outlined { color: var(--primary-teal); }
.code6-map-location a { color: var(--primary-teal); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; }

.map-grid-pattern { background-size: 60px 60px; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(195,209,222,.35) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(195,209,222,.35) 1px, transparent 1px); }
.neu-flat, .neu-raised { background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow); }
.neu-flat-sm { background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm); }
.neu-pressed, .neu-inset-shallow { background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); }
.neu-btn-primary { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#026aa7 0%,#025a8e 100%); box-shadow: 4px 4px 12px rgba(2,106,167,.32),-3px -3px 9px #fff; transition: transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease; }
.neu-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.985); box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 5px rgba(0,30,25,.5); }
.neu-btn-danger { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444 0%,#dc2626 100%); box-shadow: 4px 4px 12px rgba(220,38,38,.3),-3px -3px 9px #fff; }
.neu-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(.985); box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 5px rgba(120,0,0,.5); }
.bg-surface-container { background-color: #e4e9f0; }
.bg-surface-container-low { background-color: #e9eef5; }
.bg-surface-container-lowest { background-color: #fff; }
.bg-secondary-fixed\/40 { background-color: rgba(108,248,187,.4); }

.code6-header { min-height: 66px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }
.code6-profile { padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; text-align: right; }
.code6-avatar { display: grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; place-items: center; color: var(--primary-teal); border-radius: 16px; }
.code6-avatar .material-symbols-outlined { font-size: 24px; }
.code6-finance { color: var(--code6-ink); text-align: right; }

#mission-sheet {
  transition: max-height .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1), height .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1);
  min-height: 205px;
  height: min(58dvh, calc(100dvh - 170px - env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)));
  max-height: min(88dvh, calc(100dvh - 84px - env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px))) !important;
  background: rgba(237,242,247,.98);
  box-shadow: 8px 8px 22px rgba(202,214,226,.9), -7px -7px 22px rgba(255,255,255,.98);
}
#mission-sheet.sheet-collapsed { height: 80px; min-height: 80px; max-height: 80px !important; }
#sheet-scroll-area { scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: #cad6e2 transparent; }
#sheet-scroll-area::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; height: 4px; }
#sheet-scroll-area::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #cad6e2; border-radius: 4px; }
.code6-sheet-handle { border: 0; background: transparent; width: 100%; }
.code6-sheet-handle #workspace-sheet-state { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.code6-sheet-handle #workspace-sheet-meta { max-width: 46%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; flex: 0 0 auto; }
#shift-paused-notice { color: var(--code6-ink); }
.translator-sheet-state-dot { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: 0 0 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #94a3b8; }
.translator-sheet-state-dot.is-loading { background: #94a3b8; }
.translator-sheet-state-dot.is-idle { background: #94a3b8; }
.translator-sheet-state-dot.is-offer, .translator-sheet-state-dot.is-accepted { background: #006c49; }
.translator-sheet-state-dot.is-error { background: #ba1a1a; }

/* Server-rendered offer and mission cards follow code6's card geometry. */
.translator-offer-card,
.translator-mission-card,
.translator-extension-card,
.translator-change-card,
.translator-payment-card,
.code6-status-card {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.88);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: #edf2f7;
  box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm);
  color: var(--code6-ink);
}
.translator-offer-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; }
.translator-offer-primary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 44px max-content; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.translator-offer-summary { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; text-align: right; }
.translator-offer-traveler { overflow: hidden; color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.translator-offer-state-line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; color: var(--primary-teal); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 800; }
.translator-offer-state-title { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.translator-offer-state-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #94a3b8; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.translator-offer-kind { color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12.5px; white-space: nowrap; }
.translator-offer-countdown { position: relative; display: grid; width: 42px; height: 42px; place-items: center; border-radius: 16px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); color: var(--primary-teal); }
.translator-offer-countdown-svg { position: absolute; inset: 4px; width: 34px; height: 34px; transform: rotate(-90deg); overflow: visible; }
.translator-offer-countdown-track, .translator-offer-countdown-progress { fill: transparent; stroke-width: 2.5; }
.translator-offer-countdown-track { stroke: #cad6e2; }
.translator-offer-countdown-progress { stroke: #00685f; stroke-linecap: round; transition: stroke-dashoffset .9s linear; }
.translator-offer-countdown-value { position: relative; z-index: 1; font: 900 12px/1 'Vazirmatn',sans-serif; }
.translator-offer-kind-detail, .translator-offer-expiry { color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; }
.translator-offer-compensation { display: flex; min-width: 100px; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5); border-radius: 13px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); text-align: right; }
.translator-offer-compensation small { color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; }
.translator-offer-compensation strong { color: var(--primary-teal); font: 900 13px/1.3 'Vazirmatn',sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }
.translator-offer-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 8px; }
.translator-offer-fact { display: flex; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8); border-radius: 14px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm); }
.translator-offer-fact-icon { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; flex: 0 0 32px; place-items: center; border-radius: 12px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); color: var(--primary-teal); font-size: 17px; }
.translator-offer-fact-copy { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; text-align: right; }
.translator-offer-fact-copy small { color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; }
.translator-offer-fact-copy strong { overflow: hidden; color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 800; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.translator-offer-notes { display: flex; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5); border-radius: 13px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); }
.translator-offer-note-icon { color: #825100; font-size: 18px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.translator-offer-note-copy { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; }
.translator-offer-note-copy small { color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; }
.translator-offer-note-copy strong { overflow: hidden; color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.translator-offer-actions { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 9px; padding-top: 2px; }
.translator-offer-actions button { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 16px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 900; }
.translator-offer-reject { min-width: 112px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8); background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm); color: #ba1a1a; }
.translator-offer-reject .material-symbols-outlined, .translator-offer-accept .material-symbols-outlined { font-size: 19px; }
.translator-offer-accept { flex: 1; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#026aa7,#025a8e); box-shadow: 4px 4px 12px rgba(2,106,167,.3),-3px -3px 9px #fff; color: white; }
.translator-offer-retry { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--primary-teal); }
.translator-offer-error-copy { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; }
.translator-offer-error-icon { color: #ba1a1a; }
.translator-offer-error-icon .material-symbols-outlined { font-size: 20px; }
.translator-empty-offers,
.translator-empty-missions { padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.75); border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(237,242,247,.84); box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; text-align: center; }
.translator-request-error { border-color: rgba(186,26,26,.24); }
.translator-extension-card,
.translator-change-card,
.translator-payment-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; }
.translator-extension-card > span:first-child,
.translator-change-card > span:first-child,
.translator-payment-card > span:first-child { color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 900; }
.translator-mission-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; }
.translator-mission-state-icon .material-symbols-outlined { color: var(--primary-teal); font-size: 23px; }
.translator-mission-state-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,104,95,.22); border-radius: 16px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); }
.translator-mission-state-copy { color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.7; text-align: right; }
.translator-mission-primary-action { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; }
.translator-secure-communication { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 8px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(202,214,226,.6); }
.translator-secure-unavailable { display: flex; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8); border-radius: 13px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm); color: var(--code6-muted); text-align: right; }
.translator-secure-unavailable .material-symbols-outlined { color: var(--primary-teal); font-size: 17px; }
.translator-secure-unavailable-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; }
.translator-secure-unavailable-copy strong { font-size: 12px; }
.translator-secure-unavailable-copy small { font-size: 12px; }
.translator-otp-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; padding: 13px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,104,95,.28); border-radius: 17px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); }
.translator-otp-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.translator-otp-heading strong { color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; }
.translator-otp-heading small { color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; }
.translator-otp-note { margin: 0; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.65; }
.translator-otp-inputs { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 3px 0; }
.translator-otp-digit { width: 40px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8); border-radius: 13px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm); color: var(--primary-teal); text-align: center; font: 900 17px/1 'Vazirmatn',sans-serif; outline: none; }
.translator-otp-digit:focus-visible { box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); outline: 2px solid var(--primary-teal); outline-offset: 2px; }
.translator-active-service-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; padding: 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,108,73,.24); border-radius: 17px; background: rgba(108,248,187,.08); }
.translator-active-service-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #006c49; }
.translator-active-service-heading > .material-symbols-outlined { font-size: 20px; }
.translator-active-service-copy { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.translator-active-service-copy strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; }
.translator-active-service-copy small { color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; }
.translator-service-terms, .translator-mission-cancel-note { margin: 0; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.65; }
.translator-mission-danger-action { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; align-self: stretch; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#dc2626); box-shadow: 4px 4px 12px rgba(220,38,38,.25),-3px -3px 9px #fff; color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; }
.translator-finish-pending { padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(130,81,0,.08); color: #825100; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.6; }
.translator-mission-cancel { display: inline-flex; min-height: 39px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; align-self: flex-start; padding: 6px 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(186,26,26,.18); border-radius: 12px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm); color: #ba1a1a; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 800; }
.translator-mission-cancel .material-symbols-outlined { font-size: 16px; }
.translator-mission-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; }
.translator-mission-card > span { color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; }
.translator-mission-money { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding-top: 7px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(202,214,226,.6); font-size: 13px; }
.translator-service-code-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.translator-service-code-row input { min-width: 0; min-height: 40px; flex: 1; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65); border-radius: 12px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); text-align: center; font-size: 12px; }
.translator-service-code-row button,
.translator-map-focus,
.translator-change-card button { min-height: 40px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #026aa7; color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
.translator-service-timer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; border-radius: 13px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
.translator-service-timer-icon { color: var(--primary-teal); font-size: 18px; }
.translator-service-timer-value { flex: 1; color: var(--code6-ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: left; }
.translator-map-focus { background: #edf2f7 !important; box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm); color: #026aa7 !important; }
.translator-payment-card { border-color: rgba(0,108,73,.22); }
.translator-settlement-card { border-color: rgba(0,108,73,.34); background: rgba(108,248,187,.045); }
.translator-settlement-card .translator-payment-heading { color: #006c49; }
.translator-payment-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: #006c49; }
.translator-payment-heading > .material-symbols-outlined { font-size: 22px; }
.translator-payment-title { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.translator-payment-title strong { overflow: hidden; color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.translator-payment-title small { color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; }
.translator-payment-summary { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; padding: 10px 11px; border-radius: 14px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); }
.translator-payment-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12.5px; }
.translator-payment-row strong { color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
.translator-payment-net { padding-top: 7px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(202,214,226,.7); color: #006c49; font-weight: 900; }
.translator-payment-net strong { color: #006c49; font-size: 13.5px; }
.translator-payment-state { margin: 0; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; }
.translator-payment-actions { padding-top: 4px; }
.translator-payment-actions .translator-offer-reject { min-width: 0; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.translator-change-card { border-color: rgba(0,104,95,.23); }
.translator-extension-card { gap: 8px; padding: 10px; border-color: rgba(130,81,0,.26); border-radius: 15px; background: rgba(130,81,0,.035); box-shadow: none; }
.translator-extension-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #825100; }
.translator-extension-heading > .material-symbols-outlined { font-size: 18px; }
.translator-extension-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; }
.translator-extension-copy strong { color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 900; }
.translator-extension-copy small { color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; }
.translator-extension-details { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }
.translator-extension-details strong { color: #825100; font-size: 12.5px; }
.translator-extension-unavailable-note { margin: 0; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; }
.translator-extension-review { display: inline-flex; min-height: 39px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(130,81,0,.16); border-radius: 12px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm); color: #825100; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; }
.translator-extension-review .material-symbols-outlined { font-size: 16px; }
.translator-extension-review:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

.code6-more-content { padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px); }
.code6-more-content > section { min-width: 0; }
.code6-more-content button { color: var(--primary-teal); }
#notifications-list, #cap-box, #live-docs-box, #notif-box { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; }
#notifications-list article, #cap-box > div, #live-docs-box > div, #notif-box > div { padding: 9px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.45); font-size: 13px; }
.translator-alt-view { position: absolute; z-index: 25; inset: 0; display: block; overflow-y: auto; padding: 8px 10px 16px; background: var(--bg-color); -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
.translator-alt-view.hidden { display: none !important; }
.code6-alt-card { max-height: none; overflow: visible; margin: 0 auto; }
.code6-overlay-card { max-width: 440px; box-shadow: 10px 10px 22px rgba(202,214,226,.88),-8px -8px 22px #fff; }
.translator-action-modal { position: fixed; z-index: 75; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px; background: rgba(15,23,42,.42); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(5px); backdrop-filter: blur(5px); }
.translator-action-modal[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.translator-action-modal-card { width: min(100%, 420px); max-height: calc(100dvh - 32px); overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 19px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92); border-radius: 24px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: 10px 10px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.2),-7px -7px 18px rgba(255,255,255,.9); text-align: right; }
.translator-action-modal-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(202,214,226,.7); color: #825100; }
.translator-action-modal-heading h2 { min-width: 0; flex: 1; margin: 0; color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; }
.translator-action-modal-heading > .material-symbols-outlined { font-size: 22px; }
.translator-finish-modal-heading { color: #ba1a1a; }
.translator-cash-modal-heading { color: #006c49; }
.translator-modal-close { display: grid; width: 30px; height: 30px; flex: 0 0 30px; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm); color: var(--code6-muted); }
.translator-modal-close .material-symbols-outlined { font-size: 17px; }
.translator-action-modal-copy { margin: 0; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; }
.translator-modal-summary { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); }
.translator-modal-summary > div { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12.5px; }
.translator-modal-summary strong { color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 800; text-align: left; }
.translator-modal-summary .translator-modal-total { padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(202,214,226,.75); color: var(--primary-teal); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; }
.translator-modal-summary .translator-modal-total strong { color: var(--primary-teal); font-size: 13.5px; }
.translator-action-modal-note { margin: 0; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.65; }
.translator-action-modal-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding-top: 3px; }
.translator-action-modal-actions button { min-height: 44px; border-radius: 13px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; }
.translator-modal-primary, .translator-modal-danger { flex: 1; border: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#026aa7,#025a8e); box-shadow: 4px 4px 12px rgba(2,106,167,.25),-3px -3px 9px #fff; color: #fff; }
.translator-modal-danger { background: linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#dc2626); }
.translator-modal-secondary { padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9); background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm); color: var(--code6-ink); }
.translator-modal-dispute { color: #ba1a1a; }
.translator-generic-toast, .translator-hz-toast { position: fixed; z-index: 80; left: 50%; bottom: 22px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); padding: 11px 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92); border-radius: 15px; background: #edf2f7; box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow); color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 13.5px; transform: translateX(-50%); transition: opacity .2s, transform .2s; }
.translator-generic-toast { transform: translate(-50%, 7rem); opacity: 0; }
.translator-generic-toast.translate-y-0.opacity-100 { transform: translate(-50%, 0); opacity: 1; }
.translator-hz-toast { bottom: 72px; }
.translator-hz-toast:empty { display: none; }
#translator-support-call { display: inline-block; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 10px; background: #026aa7; color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
#translator-support-call.hidden { display: none !important; }

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  #mission-sheet { border-bottom-left-radius: 0; border-bottom-right-radius: 0; }
  .translator-offer-card { padding: 11px; gap: 8px; }
  .translator-offer-primary { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 42px max-content; gap: 6px; }
  .translator-offer-compensation { min-width: 94px; padding: 7px 8px; }
  .translator-offer-traveler { font-size: 12px; }
  .translator-offer-facts { gap: 7px; }
  .translator-offer-fact { padding: 7px; gap: 6px; }
  .translator-offer-fact-icon { width: 29px; height: 29px; flex-basis: 29px; }
  .translator-offer-actions button { min-height: 46px; }
  .translator-offer-reject { min-width: 105px; }
}
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  #view-workspace { min-height: 0; }
  #mission-sheet { height: auto; min-height: 280px; max-height: calc(100vh - 2rem) !important; }
  #sheet-scroll-area { max-height: calc(100vh - 125px); }
  #translator-map-placeholder, .code6-map-location { top: 26%; left: 50%; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { scroll-behavior: auto !important; animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; }
}

/* ═════════ بازسازی میز کار (Task 26): داک، کشوهای سربرگ، اجزای نو ═════════ */

/* داک پایینی — ناوبری واقعی پنج‌بخشی (طرح تأییدشدهٔ موکاپ) */
.code6-dock {
  display: flex; align-items: stretch; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px;
  padding: 7px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8); border-radius: 22px;
  background: var(--bg-color);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(120,140,170,.4), -4px -4px 10px rgba(255,255,255,.9), 4px 4px 12px rgba(163,180,204,.55);
}
.code6-dock-item {
  flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px;
  min-height: 54px; padding: 6px 4px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 15px;
  background: transparent; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1;
}
.code6-dock-item .material-symbols-outlined { font-size: 20px; }
.code6-dock-item.on { color: #026aa7; background: var(--bg-color); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm); }
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .code6-dock-item { flex: 0 0 auto; flex-direction: row; gap: 7px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 13px; }
}

/* زنگ اعلان‌ها در سربرگ */
.code6-bell { color: var(--code6-ink); }

/* کشوهای زیر سربرگ: اعلان‌ها و نمایه */
.code6-dropdown {
  position: fixed; z-index: 55; top: 74px; right: 10px; left: 10px;
  max-width: 420px; max-height: calc(100dvh - 170px); overflow-y: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(120,140,170,.35), var(--code6-shadow);
}
@media (min-width: 768px) { .code6-dropdown { right: auto; left: calc(50% - 210px); top: 84px; } }

/* شمارنده‌های زندهٔ میز کار (فقط دادهٔ واقعی سرور) */
.code6-counts { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 800; }
.code6-counts small { display: block; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.code6-counts b { color: #026aa7; }

/* کارت «قدم بعدی» بر پایهٔ گیت‌های واقعی صلاحیت */
.code6-hint { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 9px; color: var(--code6-ink); }
.code6-hint .material-symbols-outlined { color: #825100; font-size: 20px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.code6-hint strong { display: block; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 900; }
.code6-hint p { margin: 2px 0 0; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7; }

/* چیپ‌های حوزه‌های فعالیت — بدون چک‌باکس خام؛ انتخاب با ضربه روی چیپ */
.code6-chip-grid { position: relative; }
.code6-chip {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px;
  min-height: 52px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8); border-radius: 15px;
  background: var(--bg-color); box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow-sm); color: var(--code6-ink);
  font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 800; text-align: right; cursor: pointer;
}
.code6-chip small { display: block; color: var(--code6-muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.code6-chip .material-symbols-outlined { font-size: 18px; color: var(--code6-muted); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.code6-chip.is-on { border-color: rgba(0,104,95,.35); box-shadow: var(--code6-inset); color: #006c49; }
.code6-chip.is-on .material-symbols-outlined { color: #006c49; }
.code6-chip.is-locked { opacity: .78; }
.code6-chip input[type="checkbox"] { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

/* یادداشت نقشه: نسخهٔ کلاس‌محور (رفع کلاس گم‌شدهٔ HTML) */
.code6-map-preview-note {
  position: absolute; z-index: 6; top: 50%; left: 50%;
  display: flex; width: min(300px, calc(100vw - 90px)); flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  padding: 13px 16px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92); border-radius: 18px;
  background: rgba(237,242,247,.96); box-shadow: var(--code6-shadow);
  color: var(--code6-ink); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.7; text-align: center;
}
.code6-map-preview-note a { color: var(--primary-teal); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 900; text-decoration: underline; }

## `reference/translator/config-features.js`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/translator/config-features.js","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"07cf18c8bf5fc544cfe89f7650dc3e98f4a4656fcd6f9f80e40eb2bd432c31ee"} -->
````````````````

// امکانات از سرور (پنل مدیر): خاموش‌بودن هر امکان، بخش مربوط را در میز کار پنهان می‌کند
(function () {
  function show(el, on) { if (el) el.style.display = on ? '' : 'none'; }
  fetch('/api/config').then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
    var f = d.features || {};
    if (f.translator_online === false) {
      var t = document.querySelector('[aria-label="تغییر وضعیت آماده به خدمت"]');
      if (t) show(t, false);
    }
    if (f.interview_scheduling === false) show(document.getElementById('iv-box'), false);
  }).catch(function () {});
})();

<p class="">© سامانه هوشمند همراه مترجم • پیاده‌سازی منطبق بر معماری CAP و الزامات حقوقی مترجمان حضوری</p>

<span class="text-[#005182] font-semibold">پروتکل امنیتی ITP-200</span>
<span class="">•</span>
<span class="text-[#006a61] font-semibold">نسخه پلتفرم ۴.۲ (چندپلتفرمی)</span>
</div>
