## `reference/translator/ui.css`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/translator/ui.css","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"8204b517543fbe67c576419a8bbafd2fa6377d5b33812f150949b4b06b9249b0"} -->
````````````````
/* مترجم همراه تشریفات — استایل مشترک (برگرفته از میز کار نمونه‌ی code1.html) */
:root{
  --primary:#005182; --primary-c:#026aa7; --teal:#006a61; --teal-2:#89f5e7;
  --bg:#f7f9ff; --surface:#ffffff; --sc:#e8eef7; --sc-low:#eef4fd; --sc-high:#e3e9f2;
  --ink:#161c23; --ink2:#404750; --muted:#717881; --line:#c0c7d1;
  --err:#ba1a1a; --err-bg:#ffdad6; --warn:#8f5a00; --warn-bg:#ffddb8; --ok:#047857; --ok-bg:#d1fae5;
  --shadow-raised:-5px -5px 14px rgba(255,255,255,.95),5px 5px 14px rgba(163,180,204,.42);
  --shadow-card:-6px -6px 16px rgba(255,255,255,.95),6px 6px 16px rgba(163,180,204,.42);
  --shadow-in:inset 2px 2px 5px rgba(163,180,204,.5),inset -2px -2px 5px rgba(255,255,255,.95);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0}
body{font-family:'Vazirmatn','Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;min-height:100vh;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.material-symbols-outlined{font-family:'Material Symbols Outlined';font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;font-size:22px;line-height:1;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;direction:ltr;-webkit-font-feature-settings:'liga';font-feature-settings:'liga';width:24px;height:24px;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.hidden{display:none !important}
.flex{display:flex}
.dir-ltr{direction:ltr;unicode-bidi:isolate;text-align:left}
.num{direction:ltr;unicode-bidi:isolate;display:inline-block}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #026aa7;outline-offset:2px;border-radius:8px}
#view:focus,#root:focus{outline:none}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}

/* ---------- سطح‌ها ---------- */
.neu-card{background:var(--surface);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);padding:18px}
.neu-raised{box-shadow:var(--shadow-raised)}
.neu-in{box-shadow:var(--shadow-in)}
.panel{background:var(--surface);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);padding:18px;margin-bottom:16px;border:1px solid rgba(192,199,209,.35)}
.panel h2{font-size:17px;margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--primary)}
.muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.ink2{color:var(--ink2)}

/* ---------- سربرگ ---------- */
.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(247,249,255,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(192,199,209,.4);padding:12px 16px}
.topbar .row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.brand .logo{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--primary);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-raised)}
.brand b{display:block;font-size:16px;color:var(--primary)}
.brand small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}

/* ---------- دکمه‌ها: یک رنگ برای همه، غیرفعال کمرنگ نمی‌شود ---------- */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:46px;padding:10px 20px;border:0;border-radius:16px;font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .08s,background .2s;text-decoration:none}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.btn-primary{background:#006a61;color:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow-raised)}
.btn-primary:hover{background:#005a52}
.btn-primary:disabled{background:#006a61;color:#fff;cursor:not-allowed;box-shadow:var(--shadow-raised);pointer-events:none}
.btn-danger{background:var(--err);color:#fff}
.btn-danger:disabled{background:var(--err);color:#fff;cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--sc);color:var(--primary);box-shadow:var(--shadow-raised)}
.btn-ghost:disabled{background:var(--sc);color:var(--primary);cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none}
.btn-block{width:100%}
.btn-sm{min-height:44px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:14px}
.link{background:none;border:0;color:var(--primary);font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;padding:8px 6px;min-height:44px}
.link:disabled{color:var(--muted);cursor:not-allowed;text-decoration:none;pointer-events:none}

/* ---------- ورودی‌ها ---------- */
label.field{display:block;margin-bottom:12px}
label.field > span{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink2);margin-bottom:6px}
input[type=text],input[type=tel],input[type=number],input[type=date],select,textarea{width:100%;min-height:46px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:#fff;font:inherit;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--shadow-in)}
textarea{min-height:80px}
input.invalid{border-color:var(--err);background:#fff6f5}
.hint{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.err{color:var(--err);font-size:13px;margin-top:6px;font-weight:600}
.ok-text{color:var(--ok);font-weight:700}
.check{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px;border-radius:14px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;min-height:44px}
.check input{width:22px;height:22px;margin-top:3px;accent-color:#006a61;flex:0 0 auto}
.check.disabled{opacity:1}
.seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.seg button{min-height:46px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:var(--sc);color:var(--ink2);font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--shadow-raised)}
.seg button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#fff;color:var(--teal);box-shadow:var(--shadow-in);outline:2px solid #006a61}
.otp{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;direction:ltr}
.otp input{width:48px;height:56px;text-align:center;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow-in);color:var(--ink)}
.otp input:focus{border-color:#006a61;outline:3px solid #026aa7}

/* ---------- چیپ‌ها و برچسب‌ها ---------- */
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;background:var(--sc);color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap}
.chip.ok{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.chip.warn{background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn)}
.chip.err{background:var(--err-bg);color:var(--err)}
.chip.info{background:#cee5ff;color:var(--primary)}
.chip.teal{background:#86f2e4;color:#00504a}

/* ---------- نوار پیشرفت و مراحل ---------- */
.steps{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:6px 0 16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.steps .st{flex:1 1 90px;min-width:90px;padding:10px 8px;border-radius:14px;text-align:center;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;background:var(--sc);color:var(--muted)}
.steps .st.done{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.steps .st.now{background:#fff;color:var(--teal);box-shadow:var(--shadow-in);outline:2px solid #006a61}
.bar{height:10px;background:var(--sc);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden}
.bar > i{display:block;height:100%;background:#006a61;border-radius:999px}

/* ---------- شمارنده‌ی بزرگ ---------- */
.timer{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;direction:ltr;font-weight:800;font-size:28px;color:var(--primary)}
.countdown-ring{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:22px;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow-in);color:var(--primary);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;direction:ltr}

/* ---------- جدول و فهرست ---------- */
.kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px 16px;margin:8px 0}
.kv div{background:var(--sc-low);border-radius:14px;padding:10px 12px}
.kv small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.kv b{font-size:14.5px}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13.5px}
th,td{padding:10px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(192,199,209,.5);text-align:right;vertical-align:top}
th{color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px}
.table-wrap{overflow-x:auto}

/* ---------- تب‌ها ---------- */
.tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding:4px;background:var(--sc);border-radius:16px;margin-bottom:14px;scrollbar-width:none}
.tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.tabs button{flex:0 0 auto;min-height:44px;padding:8px 14px;border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:12px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink2);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.tabs button[aria-selected=true]{background:#fff;color:var(--primary);box-shadow:var(--shadow-in)}

/* ---------- پایین صفحه (موبایل) و کناری (دسکتاپ) ---------- */
.bottom-nav{position:fixed;bottom:0;inset-inline:0;z-index:40;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);box-shadow:0 -4px 18px rgba(163,180,204,.25);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));padding:6px 4px calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
.bottom-nav button{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;min-height:52px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted);font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:12px}
.bottom-nav button[aria-current=page]{color:var(--primary);background:var(--sc-low)}
.side-nav{display:none}
@media (min-width:900px){
  .bottom-nav{display:none}
  .side-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;position:sticky;top:90px;align-self:flex-start;width:220px;padding:14px;background:#fff;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card)}
  .side-nav button{min-height:48px;border:0;background:none;border-radius:14px;text-align:right;padding:10px 14px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer}
  .side-nav button[aria-current=page]{background:var(--sc);color:var(--primary);box-shadow:var(--shadow-in)}
  .app-shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px 1fr;gap:22px;align-items:start}
  .app-shell main{min-width:0}
}
.page{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 16px 110px}
@media (min-width:900px){.page{padding:22px 24px 40px}}
.grid-2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}
@media (min-width:900px){.grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}

/* ---------- ورود و ثبت‌نام ---------- */
.auth-wrap{max-width:460px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 18px 40px}
.auth-hero{text-align:center;margin:8px 0 18px}
.auth-hero .logo{width:72px;height:72px;margin:0 auto 10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--primary);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-raised)}
.auth-hero h1{font-size:21px;margin:0;color:var(--primary)}
.auth-hero p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:88px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:60;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;max-width:92vw;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.2);align-items:center;gap:8px}
@media (min-width:900px){.toast{bottom:28px}}
.modal-back{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(22,28,35,.45);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:70;padding:16px}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:20px;max-width:440px;width:100%;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto}
.modal h3{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--primary)}
.sos{background:#fff1f0;border:2px solid #f0b3ad;border-radius:20px;padding:16px}
.sos .btn-sos{background:var(--err);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;width:104px;height:104px;font-size:20px;font-weight:900;border:6px solid #ffd6d1;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(186,26,26,.35)}
.test-box{border:2px dashed #b38a3a;background:#fff9ec;border-radius:16px;padding:12px;margin-top:18px}
.test-box b{color:var(--warn)}
.test-box .btn{margin:4px 4px 0 0}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none !important;animation:none !important}}

/* ---------- ورود (بر پایه‌ی code.html): موبایل تک‌ستون، تبلت دو ستون، دسکتاپ سه ستون ---------- */
.login-wrap{max-width:460px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 16px 40px}
.l-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}
.l-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;padding:6px;border-radius:18px;background:#dbe4ee;box-shadow:var(--shadow-in)}
.l-step{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:8px 4px;border-radius:14px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);min-width:0;overflow:hidden}
.l-step.on{background:#e6ebf1;color:var(--primary);box-shadow:var(--shadow-raised)}
.l-step .material-symbols-outlined{font-size:20px}
.l-main{min-width:0}
.l-card{background:#fff;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);padding:20px;border:1px solid rgba(192,199,209,.3)}
.l-head{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}
span.px-3.py-1{white-space:nowrap;flex:0 0 auto}
.l-head h1{font-size:18px;margin:0;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5}
.l-head p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.l-ico{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:16px;background:#e6ebf1;box-shadow:var(--shadow-raised);color:var(--primary);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto}
.phone-box{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-in);padding:6px 8px;direction:ltr;border:1px solid transparent}
.phone-box:focus-within{border-color:#006a61;outline:3px solid #026aa7;outline-offset:2px}
.phone-box .cc{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:#dbe4ee;color:var(--primary);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-in)}
.phone-box input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:10px 4px;color:var(--ink);text-align:left}
.phone-box input.invalid{color:var(--err)}
.consents{border:0;padding:0;margin:14px 0 14px}
.l-foot{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;margin:14px 0 0}
.otp-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px}
.otp-top .timer{font-size:20px}
.l-cap{background:#fff;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);padding:18px;border:1px solid rgba(192,199,209,.3)}
.l-cap h2{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--primary);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.cap-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:12px}
.cap-item{background:#eef4fd;border-radius:16px;padding:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-in);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.cap-item .material-symbols-outlined{color:var(--teal);margin-bottom:4px}
.cap-item b{font-size:13px}
.cap-item small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}
@media (min-width:768px){
  .login-wrap{max-width:900px;padding:22px 20px 44px}
  .l-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)}
  .l-steps{grid-column:1/-1;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .l-cap{grid-column:2;grid-row:2}
  .l-main{grid-column:1;grid-row:2}
  .hide-sm{display:none}
}
@media (min-width:1100px){
  .login-wrap{max-width:1180px}
  .l-grid{grid-template-columns:200px minmax(0,1fr) 320px;align-items:start}
  .l-steps{grid-column:1;grid-row:1/span 2;grid-template-columns:1fr;position:sticky;top:96px;padding:10px;gap:8px}
  .l-step{flex-direction:row;font-size:14px;padding:12px;gap:10px}
  .l-main{grid-column:2;grid-row:1}
  .l-cap{grid-column:3;grid-row:1;position:sticky;top:96px}
  .cap-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hide-sm{display:inline-flex}
}

/* سرایند ورود: متن نباید زیر آیکون‌ها پنهان شود */
.login-wrap header p,.login-wrap header h1{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.login-wrap header{padding-inline:8px}
````````````````

## `reference/translator/ui.js`

<!-- HAMRAH_SOURCE_BEGIN {"path":"reference/translator/ui.js","encoding":"utf8","sha256":"fd757e5d3255e46df7392cca1b2df85640e2ef6d0d8b54db6202f012152baba5"} -->
````````````````
/* مترجم همراه تشریفات — کتابخانه‌ی مشترک: تنظیمات، ذخیره‌سازی، تاریخ شمسی، اعلان */
(function (w) {
  'use strict';

  // تنظیمات که در نسخه‌ی تولید از پنل مدیریت خوانده می‌شوند
  const CONFIG = {
    OTP_LENGTH: 6,
    OTP_RESEND_SECONDS: 120,
    OTP_MAX_FAILS: 5,
    OTP_LOCK_MINUTES: 10,
    SESSION_DAYS: 30,
    INVITE_SECONDS: 60,           // مهلت پذیرش دعوت (با مسافر یکی است)
    CHANGE_RESPONSE_SECONDS: 300, // مهلت پاسخ به تغییر مهم مسافر
    CHANGE_MIN_LEAD_MINUTES: 30,  // کمتر از این فاصله، تغییر مهم پیشنهاد نمی‌شود
    EXPIRY_REMINDER_DAYS: 30,
    SETTLEMENT_PERIOD: 'روزانه',   // پیش‌فرض پنل مدیریت
    SEARCH_RADIUS_NOTE: '',
    SOS_ESCALATION_MINUTES: 10
  };

  const KEY = 'hz.translator.v1';

  // ---------- ذخیره‌سازی ----------
  const defaultState = () => ({
    session: null,               // { phone, until }
    lock: null,                  // timestamp پایان قفل
    status: 'registered',        // registered | in_progress | pending_review | active_general | active_specialized | rejected | suspended | deleted
    step: 1,
    completed: { 1: false, 2: false, 3: false, 4: false, 5: false },
    profile: { nameFa: '', nameEn: '', nationalId: '', birth: '', gender: '', city: '', acceptFrom: 'all', photo: false, biometric: false, address: false, criminal: false, drug: false, idCard: false, emergency: null },
    languages: [],
    interview: null,             // { slot, result: null|'pass'|'repeat', attempts: [] }
    fields: { tourism: true, pilgrim: true, medical: false, business: false, legal: false, airport: false },
    certs: {},                   // { medical: 'pending'|'approved'|'rejected', ... ipd/cip }
    vehicle: { on: false, model: '', year: '', color: '', capacity: 4, plate: '', docs: {}, licenceOk: false, expiry: { insurance: '', inspection: '' } },
    finance: { sheba: '', holder: '', taxId: '', charter: false, nda: false },
    shift: false,
    missions: [],
    settled: [],
    rating: { score: 4.8, count: 0 },
    cancelCount: 0,
    rejectCount: 0,
    appeal: null,
    log: []
  });

  function load() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
      if (!raw) return defaultState();
      return Object.assign(defaultState(), JSON.parse(raw));
    } catch (e) { return defaultState(); }
  }
  function save(state) { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); }

  // Same-origin preview proxies can strip Authorization; keep the server-supported fallback too.
  function authHeaders(token, extra) {
    const headers = Object.assign({}, extra || {});
    if (typeof token === 'string' && token.length) {
      headers.Authorization = 'Bearer ' + token;
      headers['X-Auth-Token'] = token;
    }
    return headers;
  }

  // ---------- تاریخ و عدد ----------
  const FA_DIGITS = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹';
  const toFa = (v) => String(v).replace(/[0-9]/g, (d) => FA_DIGITS[d]);
  const toEn = (v) => String(v).replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => FA_DIGITS.indexOf(d)).replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(d));
  const money = (n) => toFa(Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US')) + ' تومان';
  const pad2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');

  const jFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR-u-ca-persian', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric', weekday: 'long' });
  const jShort = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR-u-ca-persian', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
  const hhmm = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false });
  const jFull = (d) => jFmt.format(d);
  const jDate = (d) => jShort.format(d);
  const clock = (d) => hhmm.format(d);

  // تبدیل شمسی به میلادی: با جست‌وجو در اطراف تخمین، همان تقویم Intl نمایش را مبنا می‌گیرد
  const jalParts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR-u-ca-persian', { year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' });
  function jalToGreg(jy, jm, jd) {
    const want = [jy, jm, jd].join('/');
    const guess = new Date(jy + 621, 2 + (jm - 1), 21 + (jd - 1), 12);
    for (let off = -40; off <= 40; off++) {
      const d = new Date(guess.getTime() + off * 86400000);
      const parts = jalParts.formatToParts(d);
      const g = (t) => toEn(parts.find((p) => p.type === t).value);
      if ([g('year'), g('month'), g('day')].join('/') === want) return new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());
    }
    return null;
  }

  function ageFrom(date) {
    const now = new Date();
    let a = now.getFullYear() - date.getFullYear();
    const m = now.getMonth() - date.getMonth();
    if (m < 0 || (m === 0 && now.getDate() < date.getDate())) a--;
    return a;
  }

  // کد ملی ده‌رقمی با رقم کنترل
  function validNationalId(code) {
    if (!/^\d{10}$/.test(code)) return false;
    if (/^(\d)\1{9}$/.test(code)) return false;
    const c = Number(code[9]);
    let s = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) s += Number(code[i]) * (10 - i);
    const r = s % 11;
    return r < 2 ? c === r : c === 11 - r;
  }

  function validSheba(v) {
    return /^IR\d{24}$/.test(String(v).replace(/\s/g, '').toUpperCase());
  }

  // ---------- اعلان و پیام ----------
  function toast(msg, opts) {
    const el = document.getElementById('hz-toast');
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.setAttribute('role', opts && opts.error ? 'alert' : 'status');
    el.classList.remove('hidden');
    el.classList.add('flex');
    clearTimeout(toast._t);
    toast._t = setTimeout(() => { el.classList.add('hidden'); el.classList.remove('flex'); }, 3600);
  }

  // ---------- شمارنده ----------
  function countdown(seconds, onTick, onDone) {
    let left = seconds;
    onTick(left);
    const t = setInterval(() => {
      left -= 1;
      onTick(left);
      if (left <= 0) { clearInterval(t); onDone && onDone(); }
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }

  // ---------- نشست ----------
  function requireSession(state) {
    if (!state.session || state.session.until < Date.now()) {
      state.session = null;
      save(state);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  // ---------- وضعیت حساب ----------
  const STATUS_LABEL = {
    registered: 'ثبت‌نام‌شده',
    in_progress: 'در حال احراز',
    pending_review: 'در انتظار بررسی نهایی',
    active_general: 'فعال (عمومی)',
    active_specialized: 'فعال (تخصصی)',
    rejected: 'رد شده',
    suspended: 'تعلیق',
    deleted: 'حذف‌شده'
  };

  /* ماموریت‌های پذیرفته‌شده و آینده (سند مترجم).
     فقط مبلغ کل و سهم خالص مترجم نمایش داده می‌شود؛ مسافر فقط با نام. */
  function acceptedMissions(state) {
    var now = Date.now();
    return (state.missions || [])
      .filter(function (m) { return m.status === 'accepted' && Date.parse(m.startAt) > now - 3600000; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return Date.parse(a.startAt) - Date.parse(b.startAt); });
  }

  w.HZ = { acceptedMissions, authHeaders, CONFIG, KEY, load, save, defaultState, toFa, toEn, money, jFull, jDate, clock, pad2, jalToGreg, ageFrom, validNationalId, validSheba, toast, countdown, requireSession, STATUS_LABEL };
})(window);

````````````````

````````````````
1. Prevent padding and border from affecting element width. (https://github.com/mozdevs/cssremedy/issues/4)
2. Allow adding a border to an element by just adding a border-width. (https://github.com/tailwindcss/tailwindcss/pull/116)
*/

*,
::before,
::after {
  box-sizing: border-box; /* 1 */
  border-width: 0; /* 2 */
  border-style: solid; /* 2 */
  border-color: #e5e7eb; /* 2 */
}

::before,
::after {
  --tw-content: '';
}

/*
1. Use a consistent sensible line-height in all browsers.
2. Prevent adjustments of font size after orientation changes in iOS.
3. Use a more readable tab size.
4. Use the user's configured `sans` font-family by default.
5. Use the user's configured `sans` font-feature-settings by default.
6. Use the user's configured `sans` font-variation-settings by default.
7. Disable tap highlights on iOS
*/

html,
:host {
  line-height: 1.5; /* 1 */
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; /* 2 */
  -moz-tab-size: 4; /* 3 */
  tab-size: 4; /* 3 */
  font-family: Vazirmatn, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif; /* 4 */
  font-feature-settings: normal; /* 5 */
  font-variation-settings: normal; /* 6 */
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; /* 7 */
}

/*
1. Remove the margin in all browsers.
2. Inherit line-height from `html` so users can set them as a class directly on the `html` element.
*/

body {
  margin: 0; /* 1 */
  line-height: inherit; /* 2 */
}

/*
1. Add the correct height in Firefox.
2. Correct the inheritance of border color in Firefox. (https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=190655)
3. Ensure horizontal rules are visible by default.
*/

  height: 0; /* 1 */
  color: inherit; /* 2 */
  border-top-width: 1px; /* 3 */
}

/*
Add the correct text decoration in Chrome, Edge, and Safari.
*/

  text-decoration: underline dotted;
}

/*
Remove the default font size and weight for headings.
*/

h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6 {
  font-size: inherit;
  font-weight: inherit;
}

/*

*/

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: inherit;
}

/*

/*
1. Use the user's configured `mono` font-family by default.
2. Use the user's configured `mono` font-feature-settings by default.
3. Use the user's configured `mono` font-variation-settings by default.
4. Correct the odd `em` font sizing in all browsers.

kbd,
samp,

  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace; /* 1 */
  font-feature-settings: normal; /* 2 */
  font-variation-settings: normal; /* 3 */
  font-size: 1em; /* 4 */
}

/*

small {

}

/*

*/

  font-size: 75%;
  line-height: 0;
  position: relative;
  vertical-align: baseline;
}

}

}

/*
1. Remove text indentation from table contents in Chrome and Safari. (https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=999088, https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=201297)
2. Correct table border color inheritance in all Chrome and Safari. (https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=935729, https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=195016)
3. Remove gaps between table borders by default.
*/

  text-indent: 0; /* 1 */
  border-color: inherit; /* 2 */
  border-collapse: collapse; /* 3 */
}

1. Change the font styles in all browsers.
2. Remove the margin in Firefox and Safari.
3. Remove default padding in all browsers.

input,

  font-feature-settings: inherit; /* 1 */
  font-variation-settings: inherit; /* 1 */
  font-size: 100%; /* 1 */
  font-weight: inherit; /* 1 */
  line-height: inherit; /* 1 */
  letter-spacing: inherit; /* 1 */
  color: inherit; /* 1 */
  margin: 0; /* 2 */
  padding: 0; /* 3 */
}

}

2. Remove default button styles.

  outline: auto;
}

Remove the additional `:invalid` styles in Firefox. (https://github.com/mozilla/gecko-dev/blob/2f9eacd9d3d995c937b4251a5557d95d494c9be1/layout/style/res/forms.css#L728-L737)
*/

  box-shadow: none;
}

  vertical-align: baseline;
}

/*
Correct the cursor style of increment and decrement buttons in Safari.
*/

  height: auto;
}

/*
1. Correct the odd appearance in Chrome and Safari.
2. Correct the outline style in Safari.

}

}

1. Correct the inability to style clickable types in iOS and Safari.
2. Change font properties to `inherit` in Safari.

  -webkit-appearance: button; /* 1 */

}

Add the correct display in Chrome and Safari.

  display: list-item;
}

*/

dl,
dd,
h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6,
hr,
figure,
p,
pre {
  margin: 0;
}

fieldset {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

legend {
  padding: 0;
}

ol,
ul,
menu {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

/*
Reset default styling for dialogs.
*/

  padding: 0;
}

/*
Prevent resizing textareas horizontally by default.
*/

  resize: vertical;
}

1. Reset the default placeholder opacity in Firefox. (https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/issues/3300)
2. Set the default placeholder color to the user's configured gray 400 color.

  color: #9ca3af; /* 2 */

  cursor: pointer;
}

Make sure disabled buttons don't get the pointer cursor.

  cursor: default;
}

1. Make replaced elements `display: block` by default. (https://github.com/mozdevs/cssremedy/issues/14)
2. Add `vertical-align: middle` to align replaced elements more sensibly by default. (https://github.com/jensimmons/cssremedy/issues/14#issuecomment-634934210)
   This can trigger a poorly considered lint error in some tools but is included by design.
*/

svg,
video,
canvas,
audio,
iframe,
embed,
object {
  display: block; /* 1 */
  vertical-align: middle; /* 2 */
}

/*
Constrain images and videos to the parent width and preserve their intrinsic aspect ratio. (https://github.com/mozdevs/cssremedy/issues/14)
*/

video {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

  display: none;
}
````````````````

````````````````
<!DOCTYPE html>

<html dir="rtl" lang="fa" style=""><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" name="viewport"/>
<meta content="mobile_tab" name="shell-type"/>
<title>همراه - درخواست و رزرو مترجم</title>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#E6ECF5"/>
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.webmanifest"/>
<link rel="icon" href="icon.svg" type="image/svg+xml"/>
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="icon.svg"/>
<!-- Google Fonts: Vazirmatn & Plus Jakarta Sans -->
<!-- Tailwind CSS -->
<style>
    body {
      font-family: 'Vazirmatn', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      overscroll-behavior: none;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }
    
    /* Neumorphic Soft System */
    .neu-flat {
      background: #e2e9f3;
      box-shadow: -4px -4px 9px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9),
                   4px 4px 9px rgba(162, 178, 198, 0.55);
    }
    .neu-card {
      background: #e3ebf5;
      box-shadow: -5px -5px 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95),
                   5px 5px 12px rgba(158, 175, 196, 0.58);
    }
    .neu-pressed {
      background: #e0e7f1;
      box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 6px rgba(158, 175, 196, 0.65),
                  inset -3px -3px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
    }
    .neu-inset-shallow {
      box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 4px rgba(158, 175, 196, 0.45),
                  inset -2px -2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
    }
    .neu-btn-teal {
      background: #006a61;
      box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35),
                  0 4px 12px rgba(0, 106, 97, 0.35);
    }
    
    /* Bottom Sheet transition */
    #bottom-sheet {
      touch-action: none;
      transition: height 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), opacity 0.25s ease;
    }
    #bottom-sheet.is-dragging {
      transition: none !important;
    }
    .sheet-scroll-area {
      touch-action: pan-y;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    }

    .no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }
    .no-scrollbar {
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    #location-picker-bar {
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
    }
  #bk-list>:only-child{grid-column:1/-1}
  
    /* ---- artful screens ---- */
    #scr-bookings,#scr-translators,#scr-account{
      background:
        radial-gradient(900px 500px at 92% -10%, rgba(137,245,231,.45), transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(800px 500px at -10% 110%, rgba(2,106,167,.18), transparent 60%),
        linear-gradient(180deg,#e6eef8 0%,#dbe4ef 100%) !important;
    }
    .scr-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
      padding:18px 20px;border-radius:26px;color:#fff;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#005182 0%,#026aa7 55%,#006a61 120%);
      box-shadow:0 18px 34px -14px rgba(0,81,130,.6), inset 1px 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.25);}
    .scr-hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -40px -60px auto;width:180px;height:180px;
      border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(137,245,231,.55),transparent 65%);pointer-events:none;}
    .scr-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-50px;left:-30px;width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none;}
    .scr-hero-ico{width:52px;height:52px;flex:0 0 52px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
      border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
      font-size:26px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);}
    .scr-title{font-size:21px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.3;color:#fff;}
    .scr-sub{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);margin-top:3px;line-height:1.7;}
    @media (min-width:768px){.scr-title{font-size:24px}.scr-hero{padding:24px 28px}}

    /* bookings */
    #bk-tabs{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#e9f0f9,#dfe8f4);box-shadow:inset 3px 3px 8px #c3cddb,inset -3px -3px 8px #fff;}
    #bk-tabs button.neu-flat{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#eaf6f4) !important;color:#006a61 !important;
      box-shadow:0 6px 14px -6px rgba(0,106,97,.45),inset 0 1px 0 #fff;}
    #bk-list>.neu-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.75);
      background:linear-gradient(160deg,#ffffff 0%,#eef4fd 100%) !important;
      box-shadow:0 12px 26px -14px rgba(0,81,130,.35), inset 0 1px 0 #fff;}
    #bk-list>.neu-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;right:0;top:14px;bottom:14px;width:4px;border-radius:4px;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#006a61,#026aa7);}
    #bk-list>.neu-card:only-child{padding:36px 24px;text-align:center;
      background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%,rgba(137,245,231,.35),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(160deg,#fff,#eef4fd) !important;}
    #bk-list>.neu-card:only-child::before{display:none;}

    /* bookings: larger, roomier cards on tablet and desktop */
    @media (min-width:768px){
      #bk-list>.neu-card{padding:20px 24px;gap:12px;font-size:14px;}
      #bk-list>.neu-card .font-extrabold{font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;}
      #bk-list>.neu-card .b-when,#bk-list>.neu-card .b-field,#bk-list>.neu-card .b-hours{font-size:13px;}
      #bk-list>.neu-card .b-amt{font-size:15px;}
      #bk-list>.neu-card .text-secondary{font-size:12px;}
    }
    #bk-list>.neu-card:only-child{max-width:none;}
    #bk-list>.neu-card>div:first-child{gap:10px;}
    #bk-list>.neu-card>div:first-child>span:first-child{min-width:0;}
    #bk-list>.neu-card>div:first-child>span.text-secondary{white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;}

    /* translators */
    .tr-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);
      background:linear-gradient(150deg,#ffffff 0%,#e9f7f4 55%,#e6eef8 100%) !important;}
    .tr-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-60px;bottom:-80px;width:240px;height:240px;border-radius:50%;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,106,97,.18),transparent 65%);pointer-events:none;}

    /* account */
    .ac-profile{position:relative;overflow:hidden;
      background:linear-gradient(160deg,#ffffff 0%,#eef4fd 100%) !important;}
    #ac-avatar{width:56px !important;height:56px !important;font-size:20px;color:#fff !important;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#005182,#006a61) !important;box-shadow:0 10px 20px -8px rgba(0,81,130,.6),inset 1px 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.3);}
    #scr-account section.neu-card:not(.ac-profile){position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
    #scr-account section.neu-card:not(.ac-profile)::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;right:18px;width:44px;height:4px;
      border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#006a61,#026aa7);}
    #scr-account section.neu-card>span:first-child{color:#005182;}
    #ac-logout{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffffff,#e9f0f9) !important;color:#005182 !important;}
    #ac-delete{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffffff,#fdeeee) !important;}
  
    /* دسترس‌پذیری: هدف لمسی حداقل ۴۴ پیکسل و فوکوس قابل دیدن */
    [aria-label="بزرگنمایی"],[aria-label="کوچک‌نمایی"],[aria-label="موقعیت فعلی"],[aria-label="لایه‌ها"],[aria-label="اعلان‌ها"],[aria-label="ایمنی سفر و پشتیبانی"],[aria-label="پشتیبانی سریع"],[aria-label="جابجایی زبان مبدأ و مقصد"],[aria-label="بستن انتخاب زبان"],[aria-label="بستن تقویم"],[aria-label="بستن ساعت"],#change-location-btn,#btn-mode-instant,#btn-mode-scheduled,.cat-chip,.gender-btn{min-width:44px;min-height:44px;}
    a[data-nav]{min-height:44px;min-width:44px;}
    button[aria-label="بستن"],#ac-gender-btn,#ac-contact-btn,#ac-passport-box input,#ac-passport-box button,#ac-cards button,#ac-invoices button,#ac-logout,#ac-logout-all,#ac-delete{min-width:44px;min-height:44px;}
    #btn-dec-hours,#btn-inc-hours,#btn-dec-pax,#btn-inc-pax,#bk-tabs button,#bk-list button,#bk-modal button,#bk-modal input,#bk-modal select{min-width:44px;min-height:44px;}
    button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #026AA7;outline-offset:2px;}
  
    /* دسترس‌پذیری: کنتراست متن (حداقل ۴٫۵:۱) */
    .text-outline{color:#4A5868 !important;}
    .text-emerald-600{color:#047857 !important;}

<style>/* صفحه‌های فهرست زیر ناوبری پایین قرار نگیرند (موبایل و دسکتاپ) */
#scr-bookings, #scr-translators, #scr-account { padding-bottom: 128px; }
/* پیام کوتاه: رنگ و چیدمان مستقل از فهرست کلاس‌های فشرده‌ی Tailwind */
#toast-pill { background: #1d2a2e; color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; z-index: 50; }
#toast-pill.hidden { display: none !important; }
#toast-pill #toast-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
/* در دسکتاپ پیام‌ها پایین وسط نقشه می‌آیند تا روی کارت محل ملاقات نیفتند */
@media (min-width: 768px){ #toast-pill { top: auto !important; bottom: 24px !important; left: 50% !important; right: auto !important; transform: translateX(-50%); width: min(92vw, 24rem); } }
</style>
</head>
<body class="bg-[#dbe4ef] text-on-surface antialiased flex flex-col h-screen select-none overflow-hidden relative">
<!-- Full Map Canvas in Background -->

<!-- Center User Location Pin (Stage 1 Map Confirmation) -->

</div>
</div>
<div class="w-5 h-2 bg-black/20 rounded-full blur-[1px] mt-0.5"></div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Map Floating Control Actions -->
<div class="absolute top-16 left-3.5 md:top-6 md:left-6 z-30 flex flex-col gap-2.5 pointer-events-auto"><button type="button" id="btn-safety-support" aria-label="ایمنی سفر و پشتیبانی" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl neu-flat flex items-center justify-center text-error hover:scale-105 active:neu-pressed transition-all border border-white/60 shadow-sm"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">shield_with_heart</span></button><button aria-label="موقعیت فعلی" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl neu-flat flex items-center justify-center text-secondary hover:scale-105 active:neu-pressed transition-all border border-white/60 shadow-sm" onclick="locateMe()"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">my_location</span></button><div class="flex flex-col neu-flat rounded-2xl overflow-hidden p-0.5 border border-white/60 shadow-sm"><button aria-label="بزرگنمایی" class="w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:text-secondary active:neu-pressed transition-all" onclick="mapZoom(1)"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[19px]">add</span></button><div class="h-px bg-outline-variant/40 mx-1.5"></div><button aria-label="کوچک‌نمایی" class="w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:text-secondary active:neu-pressed transition-all" onclick="mapZoom(-1)"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[19px]">remove</span></button></div><button aria-label="لایه‌ها" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl neu-flat flex items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:scale-105 active:neu-pressed transition-all border border-white/60 shadow-sm" id="btn-map-layers" onclick="showAppToast('تغییر لایهٔ نقشه در این نسخه فعال نیست.', 'info')"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[19px]">layers</span></button></div>
<!-- Top Header Bar -->
<header class="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 pt-safe pointer-events-none md:pt-4 md:right-auto md:left-24"><div class="max-w-md md:max-w-none mx-auto px-4 py-3 md:py-0 flex items-center justify-between md:justify-start md:gap-3 pointer-events-auto"><div class="neu-card rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-2 border border-white/70 shadow-md"><div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full neu-pressed flex items-center justify-center text-primary relative"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">translate</span></div><div class="flex flex-col text-right leading-tight"><span class="font-bold text-[14px] text-primary tracking-tight">همراه</span><span id="app-header-tagline" class="text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant font-medium">درخواست و رزرو مترجم</span></div></div><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><button id="btn-notifications" aria-label="اعلان‌ها" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full neu-flat flex items-center justify-center text-on-surface-variant hover:scale-105 active:neu-pressed transition-all border border-white/50" onclick="showAppToast('اعلان‌های مسافر در این نسخه در دسترس نیستند', 'notifications')"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[19px]">notifications</span></button><button type="button" id="btn-quick-support" aria-label="پشتیبانی سریع" class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full neu-flat flex items-center justify-center text-secondary hover:scale-105 active:neu-pressed transition-all border border-white/50"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[19px]">support_agent</span></button></div></div></header>

      </span>

</button>

<button class="gender-btn py-1 rounded-lg neu-flat text-on-surface-variant text-[10px] cursor-pointer" data-gender="female" type="button">خانم</button>
<button class="gender-btn py-1 rounded-lg neu-flat text-on-surface-variant text-[10px] cursor-pointer" data-gender="male" type="button">آقا</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Passengers Counter -->
<div class="neu-card rounded-2xl p-2 flex flex-col justify-between">

<span class="">تعداد مسافران</span>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[15px] text-outline">group</span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center justify-between mt-1">
<button class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg neu-flat flex items-center justify-center text-secondary font-bold active:neu-pressed cursor-pointer" id="btn-dec-pax" type="button">-</button>
<span class="text-[12.5px] font-bold text-on-surface" id="label-pax-count">۱ نفر</span>
<button class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg neu-flat flex items-center justify-center text-secondary font-bold active:neu-pressed cursor-pointer" id="btn-inc-pax" type="button">+</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Notes for translator (optional; not in price) -->
<div class="neu-card rounded-2xl p-2.5 flex flex-col gap-1.5">
<span class="text-[10.5px] text-on-surface-variant font-medium">توضیحات برای مترجم (اختیاری)</span>
<textarea id="notes-input" rows="2" class="w-full rounded-xl neu-pressed bg-transparent p-2 text-[11.5px] outline-none resize-none" placeholder="مثلاً: ساعت ۶ صبح از ترمینال"></textarea>
<div class="flex items-center justify-between text-[9.5px] text-outline"><span>فقط مترجمان دعوت‌شده می‌بینند؛ روی قیمت اثری ندارد.</span><span id="notes-count">۰ / ۳۰۰</span></div>
</div>
<!-- Pricing Estimate Summary Card -->
<div class="neu-pressed rounded-2xl p-2.5 flex items-center justify-between bg-surface-container">
<div class="flex flex-col">
<span class="text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant font-medium">برآورد کل هزینه خدمت</span>
<span class="text-[10.5px] text-outline" id="label-price-note">همراهی ۲ ساعت با خودروی اختصاصی</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col text-left">
<span class="text-[15px] font-black text-primary" id="label-price-toman">۴,۰۷۰,۰۰۰ تومان</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- ========================================== -->
<!-- STAGE 2: INSTANT SEARCH STATUS             -->
<!-- ========================================== -->
<div class="fsm-stage hidden flex-col gap-3 py-1" id="stage-2">
<div class="relative w-full h-44 rounded-2xl neu-pressed flex flex-col items-center justify-center overflow-hidden bg-surface-container/60">
<div class="w-16 h-16 rounded-full neu-flat flex items-center justify-center text-secondary shadow-lg">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[32px] text-secondary">person_search</span>
</div>
<div id="search-status-pill" class="mt-3 px-3 py-1 rounded-full neu-flat text-[10.5px] font-bold text-secondary shadow-sm">در حال جست‌وجو</div>
</div>
<div class="neu-card rounded-2xl p-3 flex flex-col gap-1.5">
<div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
<span id="search-status-title" class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[12px] font-bold text-on-surface">در حال جست‌وجوی مترجم برای درخواست شما</span>
<span id="search-time-limit" class="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-extrabold text-primary">حداکثر زمان جست‌وجو: ۱۰ دقیقه</span>
</div>
<p id="search-status-description" class="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant leading-relaxed">مترجمان در دسترس بر اساس زبان‌ها و نوع خدمت درخواست شما بررسی می‌شوند.</p>
</div>
<div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-surface-container-low flex items-center gap-2">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] text-secondary">info</span>
<span class="text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">امکان لغو رایگان تا پیش از تایید نهایی مترجم بدون هیچ‌گونه جریمه محفوظ است. مترجم دعوت‌شده ۶۰ ثانیه فرصت پذیرش دارد.</span>
</div>
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 pt-1">
<button class="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl neu-flat text-error font-bold text-[12px] active:neu-pressed transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer" id="btn-cancel-search" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[17px]">close</span>
<span class="">لغو درخواست</span>
</button>
</div>
<p class="text-[10px] text-outline text-center">به‌محض اینکه مترجمی درخواست را بپذیرد، این صفحه خودکار به‌روز می‌شود.</p>
</div>
<!-- ========================================== -->
<!-- STAGE 3: SERVER-CONFIRMED MATCHED BOOKING -->
<!-- ========================================== -->
<div class="hidden flex-col gap-3" id="nomatch-block">
<div class="neu-card rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center gap-2 text-center">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[30px] text-outline">search_off</span>
<span class="text-[13px] font-extrabold text-on-surface">در این لحظه مترجمی پیدا نشد</span>
<p id="nomatch-copy" class="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">هیچ مبلغی کسر نشده است. می‌توانید دوباره تلاش کنید، رزرو زمان‌دار ثبت کنید یا درخواست را لغو کنید.</p>
</div>
<button id="btn-retry-search" type="button" class="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-secondary text-on-secondary font-bold text-[12.5px] shadow cursor-pointer">تلاش دوباره</button>
<button id="btn-to-scheduled" type="button" class="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-2xl neu-flat text-secondary font-bold text-[12px] cursor-pointer">تبدیل به رزرو زمان‌دار</button>
<button id="btn-cancel-nomatch" type="button" class="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-2xl neu-flat text-error font-bold text-[12px] cursor-pointer">لغو یا انصراف</button>
</div>
<div class="fsm-stage hidden flex-col gap-3" id="stage-3">
<!-- Only the server-confirmed match is shown; no movement or arrival estimate is available. -->
<div class="neu-pressed rounded-2xl p-3 flex items-center gap-2 bg-surface-container">
<div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl neu-flat flex items-center justify-center text-secondary shrink-0">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[22px]">check_circle</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col min-w-0">
<span id="match-status-title" class="text-[10.5px] text-on-surface-variant">وضعیت رزرو</span>
<span id="match-status-description" class="text-[14px] font-extrabold text-primary">مترجم درخواست شما را پذیرفت.</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Matched translator details returned by the server -->
<div class="neu-card rounded-2xl p-3 flex flex-col gap-2.5">
<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
<div class="relative w-13 h-13 rounded-2xl neu-flat p-0.5 overflow-hidden flex-shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[30px] text-secondary">person</span>
</div>
<div class="flex-1 flex flex-col">
<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
<span class="text-[13px] font-bold text-on-surface" id="matched-translator-name">مترجم همراه</span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
<span class="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] text-secondary font-bold" id="matched-translator-car">—</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Masked Contacts Row -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 pt-0.5">
<button class="py-2 rounded-xl neu-flat text-secondary text-[10.5px] font-bold flex flex-col items-center gap-1 active:neu-pressed cursor-not-allowed opacity-60" id="btn-call-masked" type="button" disabled aria-describedby="trip-contact-unavailable">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">call</span>
<span class="">تماس امن</span>
</button>
<button class="py-2 rounded-xl neu-flat text-secondary text-[10.5px] font-bold flex flex-col items-center gap-1 active:neu-pressed cursor-not-allowed opacity-60" id="btn-chat-inapp" type="button" disabled aria-describedby="trip-contact-unavailable">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">chat</span>
<span class="">پیامک</span>
</button>
<button class="py-2 rounded-xl neu-flat text-on-surface-variant text-[10.5px] font-medium flex flex-col items-center gap-1 active:neu-pressed cursor-not-allowed opacity-60" id="btn-share-ride" type="button" disabled aria-describedby="trip-contact-unavailable">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">share_location</span>
<span class="">اشتراک سفر</span>
</button>
<button class="py-2 rounded-xl neu-flat text-error text-[10.5px] font-bold flex flex-col items-center gap-1 active:neu-pressed cursor-pointer" id="btn-sos" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">shield_person</span>
<span class="">راهنمای اضطراری</span>
</button>
</div>
</div>
<p id="trip-contact-unavailable" class="text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant leading-relaxed">تماس امن، پیامک با مترجم و ردیابی زنده هنوز فعال نیستند.</p>
<!-- تأیید واقعی مسافر هنگام رسیدن مترجم؛ بعد کد امنیتی شروع خدمت نمایش داده می‌شود -->
<button class="w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-2xl bg-secondary text-on-secondary font-bold text-[12px] shadow hover:bg-secondary/90 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer" id="btn-arrived" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">location_on</span>
<span class="">مترجم به محل رسید</span>
</button>
<p class="text-[10px] text-outline text-center">وقتی مترجم را دیدید، این دکمه را بزنید تا کد امنیتی شروع خدمت را ببینید.</p>
</div>
<!-- ========================================== -->
<!-- STAGE 4: ARRIVED & CHECK SERVICE START STATUS  -->
<!-- ========================================== -->
<div class="fsm-stage hidden flex-col gap-3" id="stage-4">
<div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-secondary-container text-on-secondary-container flex items-center gap-2.5">
<div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-secondary text-on-secondary flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">where_to_vote</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col">
<span class="text-[12.5px] font-bold">مترجم به محل استقرار شما رسید!</span>
<span class="text-[10px] opacity-90">مترجم منتظر شروع همراهی است.</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Security Handshake PIN -->
<div class="neu-card rounded-2xl p-3.5 flex flex-col items-center gap-2 text-center">
<span class="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant font-medium">کد امنیتی شروع خدمت را به مترجم اعلام فرمایید</span>
<div class="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl bg-surface-container neu-inset-shallow w-full max-w-[220px]">
<span class="text-[24px] text-primary font-black tracking-widest" id="security-code">۰۰۰۰۰</span>
</div>
<p class="text-[10px] text-outline">با اعلام این کد، تایمر رسمی خدمت همراهی آغاز خواهد شد.</p>
</div>
<button class="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-2xl neu-btn-teal text-white font-bold text-[13px] shadow-lg shadow-secondary/25 hover:bg-secondary/90 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer" id="btn-confirm-start" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[19px]">sync</span>
<span class="">بررسی وضعیت شروع خدمت</span>
</button>
</div>
<!-- ========================================== -->
<!-- STAGE 5: IN SERVICE LIVE TIMER & EXTENSION -->
<!-- ========================================== -->
<div class="fsm-stage hidden flex-col gap-3" id="stage-5">
<!-- Digital Chronometer -->
<div class="neu-pressed rounded-3xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-surface-container gap-1">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-ping"></span>
<span class="text-[11px] text-secondary font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wide">همراهی حضوری در جریان است</span>
</div>
<div class="text-[32px] text-primary font-extrabold tracking-wider my-0.5" id="live-timer-val">۰۱:۳۴:۲۶</div>
<span class="text-[10.5px] text-on-surface-variant" id="of-hours">از مجموع ۲ ساعت زمان رزرو شده</span>
</div>
<!-- Extension Card: همیشه روی صفحه‌ی تایمر دیده می‌شود؛ تمدید با تأیید مترجم انجام می‌شود -->
<div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-surface-container-high flex flex-col gap-2" id="extension-card">
<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-secondary font-bold text-[11.5px]">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[17px]">more_time</span>
<span class="">تمدید زمان خدمت</span>
</div>
<p class="text-[10.5px] text-on-surface-variant leading-relaxed">اگر زمان بیشتری لازم دارید، درخواست تمدید برای مترجم فرستاده می‌شود و فقط با تأیید او یک ساعت به خدمت و مبلغ نهایی اضافه می‌شود.</p>
<p class="hidden text-[10.5px] font-bold text-amber-800" id="extension-status"></p>
<button class="w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-secondary text-on-secondary font-bold text-[11px] active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer" id="btn-extend-one-hour" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[15px]">add_circle</span>
<span class="">تمدید خدمت (+۱ ساعت)</span>
</button>
</div>
<!-- 30-min Expiry Warning Card -->
<div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-surface-container-high flex flex-col gap-2 hidden" id="expiry-warning">
<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-800 font-bold text-[11.5px]">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[17px]">notification_important</span>
<span class="">کمتر از ۳۰ دقیقه تا پایان وقت رزرو</span>
</div>
<p class="text-[10.5px] text-on-surface-variant leading-relaxed">
          اگر زمان بیشتری لازم دارید، از کارت «تمدید زمان خدمت» در همین صفحه درخواست بدهید؛ مترجم باید آن را تأیید کند.
        </p>
</div>
<!-- درخواست پایان از سوی مترجم: قبول یا رد با مسافر است -->
<div class="hidden p-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 flex flex-col gap-2" id="finish-request-banner">
<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-800 font-bold text-[11.5px]">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[17px]">notification_important</span>
<span class="">مترجم درخواست پایان خدمت داده است</span>
</div>
<p class="text-[10.5px] text-on-surface-variant leading-relaxed">اگر قبول کنید، خدمت همین حالا تمام و فاکتور بر اساس مدت واقعی خدمت صادر می‌شود (هر ساعتِ شروع‌شده کامل، کف یک ساعت).</p>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<button class="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-error text-white font-bold text-[11px] active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer" id="btn-approve-finish" type="button">قبول پایان خدمت</button>
<button class="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl neu-flat text-on-surface-variant font-bold text-[11px] cursor-pointer" id="btn-reject-finish" type="button">ادامه‌ی خدمت</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Finish Service CTA: مسافر هر وقت خواست خودش تمام می‌کند؛ مبلغ بر اساس مدت واقعی -->
<button class="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-2xl neu-flat text-error font-bold text-[12px] active:neu-pressed transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer" id="btn-finish-service" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">stop_circle</span>
<span class="">ثبت پایان رسمی خدمت و صدور فاکتور</span>
</button>
</div>
<!-- ========================================== -->
<!-- STAGE 6: ITEMISED INVOICE & PAYMENT       -->
<!-- ========================================== -->
<div class="fsm-stage hidden flex-col gap-3" id="stage-6">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px] text-primary">receipt_long</span>
<span class="text-[12.5px] font-extrabold text-on-surface">صورت‌حساب قطعی خدمت همراهی</span>
</div>
<span id="invoice-source-label" class="text-[10px] text-secondary font-bold bg-secondary-container/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">جزئیات رزرو</span>
</div>
<div class="neu-card rounded-2xl p-3 flex flex-col gap-2 text-[11px]">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between text-on-surface-variant"><span id="inv-label">خدمت همراهی</span><span class="text-on-surface font-semibold" id="inv-base">—</span></div>
<div class="flex items-center justify-between text-on-surface-variant"><span id="inv-tax-label">مالیات و خدمات رفاهی</span><span class="text-on-surface font-semibold" id="inv-tax">—</span></div>
<div class="h-px bg-outline-variant/30 my-0.5"></div>
<div class="flex items-center justify-between font-extrabold"><span class="text-on-surface text-[12px]">مبلغ کل قابل پرداخت:</span><div class="flex flex-col text-left"><span class="text-[14px] text-primary" id="inv-total">—</span></div></div>
</div>
<!-- Payment Method Selection -->
<p id="payment-method-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" class="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">در حال دریافت روش‌های پرداخت…</p>
<button id="btn-refresh-payment-methods" type="button" class="self-start text-[11px] font-bold text-secondary underline cursor-pointer">تازه‌سازی روش‌های پرداخت</button>
<div class="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
<span class="text-[10.5px] text-on-surface-variant px-1">شیوه پرداخت:</span>
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
<button class="neu-pressed rounded-2xl p-2.5 flex flex-col text-right gap-1 border border-secondary/40 cursor-pointer" id="pay-method-online" type="button" disabled>
<div class="flex items-center justify-between">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] text-secondary">credit_card</span>
<span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-secondary" id="dot-pay-online"></span>
</div>
<span class="text-[11.5px] font-bold text-on-surface">پرداخت آنلاین</span>
<span class="text-[9.5px] text-on-surface-variant">درگاه شتاب و بانکی</span>
</button>
<button class="neu-flat rounded-2xl p-2.5 flex flex-col text-right gap-1 cursor-pointer" id="pay-method-cash" type="button" disabled>
<div class="flex items-center justify-between">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] text-outline">payments</span>
<span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-outline-variant" id="dot-pay-cash"></span>
</div>
<span class="text-[11.5px] font-bold text-on-surface">پرداخت نقدی</span>
<span class="text-[9.5px] text-on-surface-variant">پرداخت نقدی به تومان؛ دریافت را هر دو طرف تأیید می‌کنند</span>
</button>
</div>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col gap-2 pt-1">
<button class="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-secondary text-on-secondary font-bold text-[12.5px] shadow hover:bg-secondary/90 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer" id="btn-settle-return" type="button" disabled>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">check_circle</span>
<span class="">پرداخت و بازگشت به خانه</span>
</button>
<button class="w-full py-1.5 text-on-surface-variant text-[11px] font-medium flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer" id="btn-back-to-timer" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[15px]">arrow_forward</span>
<span class="">بازگشت به تایمر خدمت</span>
</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- STICKY ACTION BUTTON CONTAINER AT BOTTOM OF PANEL -->
<div class="p-3 pt-2 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#e3ebf5] via-[#e3ebf5] to-[#e3ebf5]/90 border-t border-white/50 flex-shrink-0" id="sticky-cta-container">
<!-- Primary CTA Button (Visible on Stage 1) -->
<button class="w-full py-3.5 px-4 rounded-2xl neu-btn-teal text-white font-bold text-[14px] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:brightness-105 shadow-lg" id="btn-main-submit" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]" id="icon-main-submit">radar</span>
<span class="" id="txt-main-submit">ثبت درخواست مترجم</span>
</button>
</div>
</section>
<!-- ========================================================================= -->
<!-- MODAL: JALALI PERSIAN CALENDAR DIALOG                                      -->
<!-- ========================================================================= -->
<div class="fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-black/45 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-end md:items-center justify-center p-0 md:p-4 transition-opacity duration-200 hidden" id="modal-datepicker">
<div class="w-full max-w-sm neu-card rounded-t-3xl md:rounded-3xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-3.5 shadow-2xl border border-white/60 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom duration-200">
<!-- Modal Header -->
<div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-1 border-b border-outline-variant/30">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl neu-pressed flex items-center justify-center text-secondary">
````````````````
